hindi: काम करने वाला — जो वह काम पेशे की तरह करता है
definition: attached to a noun it names the one who practises that work as an occupation, wider than the maker suffix because the work need not produce an object
example: काश्तकार और मददगार में -कार काम करने वाले को बताता है। — In cultivator and helper, this suffix names the one doing the work.

hindi: खाने वाला — लफ़्ज़ के आख़िर में लगकर 'जो यह खाता है'
definition: a suffix meaning one who eats or consumes the thing named before it, turning any food or gain into the name of its devourer
example: हराम की कमाई खाने वाले को हराम-ख़ोर कहते हैं। — One who lives off unlawful gain is called an eater of the unlawful.

hindi: करने वाला — काम या पेशे से पहचान देने वाला अंत
definition: attached to a noun it names the person who works that material or does that act, marking a trade by what the hands do rather than by what is made
example: ज़रगर, सौदागर और कारीगर, तीनों नामों के आख़िर में -गर लगा है। — Goldsmith, merchant, craftsman: all three names end in this suffix.

hindi: मारा हुआ / ग्रस्त — किसी आफ़त से पीड़ित बताने वाला प्रत्यय
definition: suffix meaning 'struck by', attached to the name of a calamity to name its victim; ग़म becomes ग़मज़दा and मुसीबत becomes मुसीबतज़दा
example: ग़म के साथ -ज़दा जोड़ो तो ग़म-ज़दा बनता है — Joining -ज़दा to ग़म gives the word for grief-stricken.

hindi: -वेत्ता / जानने वाला — किसी इल्म के जानकार के मानी देने वाला प्रत्यय
definition: suffix naming one who knows a subject, attached to a field to make its expert; the recogniser has an eye for a thing, this one has actually studied it
example: क़ानून-दान और ज़बान-दान दोनों इल्म रखते हैं — A jurist and a linguist both possess learning.

hindi: बेचने वाला — जो वह चीज़ बेचता है
definition: attached to a noun it names the seller of that commodity, marking the trade by what is sold rather than by what is made or handled
example: गुलफ़रोश और मयफ़रोश में -फ़रोश बेचने वाले का पता देता है। — In flower-seller and wine-seller, this suffix names the one who sells.

hindi: बुनने वाला — जो कपड़ा या जाली बुनता है
definition: attached to a noun it names the weaver of that cloth or stuff, the narrowest of the trade suffixes because it commits to one craft, weaving
example: शालबाफ़ और ज़रबाफ़ में -बाफ़ बुनने वाले को बताता है। — In shawl-weaver and gold-weaver, this suffix names the one who weaves.

hindi: वाला / युक्त — गुण रखने वाला बताने वाला प्रत्यय
definition: suffix marking possession of a quality, turning अक़्ल into अक़्लमंद, wise; it credits ownership of the trait rather than mere presence, which is why ज़रूरतमंद names the needy without sounding like pity
example: दफ़्तर को एक अक़्लमंद नहीं, एक ज़रूरतमंद आदमी चाहिए था। — The office wanted not a clever man but a needy one.

hindi: -ज्ञ / पहचानने वाला — किसी चीज़ को पहचानने वाले के मानी देने वाला प्रत्यय
definition: suffix marking one who recognises and can judge a thing, turning a noun into a connoisseur of it; it claims discernment rather than the stored learning a scholar has
example: क़द्र-शनास, नब्ज़-शनास, हक़-शनास, सब पहचानने वाले हैं। — Judge of worth, reader of the pulse, knower of what is due: all are recognisers.

hindi: बनाने वाला — जो चीज़ को गढ़ता या तैयार करता है
definition: attached to a noun it names the maker or fabricator of that thing, stressing manufacture and assembly where the doer suffix stresses handling
example: घड़ीसाज़ और जालसाज़ दोनों में -साज़ बनाने वाले को बताता है। — In watchmaker and forger alike, this suffix marks the maker.

hindi: अत्यंत दुर्लभ — नाम सुना हो पर मिले नहीं
definition: vanishingly rare, after the mythical bird nobody has ever seen; it says a thing exists in talk but not in reach
example: इस बाज़ार में ईमानदारी अंक़ा हो चुकी है — Honesty has become a mythical bird in this market.

hindi: उँगली की अँगूठी — फ़ारसी ढब का लफ़्ज़
definition: a ring worn on the finger, named in Persianate Urdu; the finger ring as ornament and as keepsake
example: विरासत में उसे दादा की अंगुश्तरी मिली। — He inherited his grandfather's ring.

hindi: आख़िरकार — सब कुछ के बाद जो हुआ
definition: in the end, after all the turns a matter took; states the outcome as a conclusion rather than naming it
example: अंजाम-कार उसे माफ़ी माँगनी पड़ी। — In the end he had to apologise.

hindi: संगत — लोगों का स्थायी संगठन या मंडली
definition: a standing association of people bound by a shared interest, which outlasts any single gathering; where a महफ़िल disperses at dawn, this keeps its membership and its name
example: शहर की अदबी अंजुमन हर महीने मिलती है — The city's literary association meets every month.

hindi: बुलबुल का अरबी नाम — विरह में गाने वाली चिड़िया
definition: the same songbird under its Arabic name, kept for high verse; it sounds bookish where the common word sounds sung
example: अंदलीब की फ़रियाद सारी रात जारी रही — The nightingale's plaint went on all night.

hindi: देह — शरीर का गठन
definition: the body considered as shape and build, the limbs taken together rather than the flesh itself
example: उसका अंदाम बहुत मौज़ूँ है — His build is very well proportioned.

hindi: आशंका — आगे कुछ बुरा होने का डर
definition: apprehension about what may come, a worry projected forward rather than fear of what already stands before you
example: बारिश का अंदेशा है, छाता ले लो। — There's a chance of rain; take an umbrella.

hindi: रंज — भीतर बैठा हुआ लगातार दुख
definition: grief that has settled inside and stays, colouring days that look ordinary from outside; sorrow as a resident, not an outburst
example: उसकी हँसी के पीछे बरसों का अंदोह छुपा है — Behind his laugh hides the sorrow of years.

hindi: सुगंधित द्रव्य — इत्रसाज़ी में काम आने वाला क़ीमती भूरा पदार्थ
definition: ambergris, the costly grey base of classical perfumery, invoked for a rich lingering smell rather than a light one
example: उसके बालों से अंबर की ख़ुशबू आती थी — Her hair smelled of ambergris.

hindi: निकट संबंधी — सबसे नज़दीकी रिश्तेदार
definition: one's nearest relatives taken as a group, the kin with the strongest claim on help and inheritance; the inner circle of the family, not every relation
example: पहले अक़ारिब का हक़ है, फिर औरों का — The nearest relatives have the first claim, then others.

hindi: जन्म-संस्कार — बच्चे के पैदा होने पर की जाने वाली क़ुर्बानी और रस्म
definition: the thanksgiving rite performed days after a birth, when the child's head is shaved and a sacrifice made; the ceremony that follows, not the birth itself
example: सातवें दिन बच्चे का अक़ीक़ा किया गया — On the seventh day the child's birth rite was performed.

hindi: धारणा — मानी हुई निश्चित मान्यता
definition: a specific article of belief a person holds as doctrine, the content of faith rather than the state of having it
example: इस मसले पर दोनों का अक़ीदा अलग है — On this question the two hold different beliefs.

hindi: अनुबंध — बाँधने वाला क़रार, ख़ासकर विवाह का
definition: the formal act of binding two parties by contract, used above all for marriage; names the tying, where the marriage contract names the agreement's content
example: उनका अक़्द दोपहर को हुआ और दावत रात को — Their contract was solemnised at noon and the feast was at night.

hindi: प्रतिबिंब — किसी की झलक या परछाईं
definition: a reflection or lingering trace carried on some other surface, implying the original itself is missing
example: बेटों में बाप का अक्स दिखता है। — You can catch a trace of the father in his sons.

hindi: तारा — भाग्य से जुड़ा हुआ सितारा
definition: a star of the night sky read as a sign of fortune, the star that decides luck rather than the star merely observed
example: उसका अख़्तर बुलंद है, हर काम बन जाता है। — His star is high; every venture succeeds.

hindi: धातुएँ — शरीर के चार बुनियादी रस
definition: the four bodily humours whose balance classical medicine held health to depend on, the framework behind every traditional diagnosis
example: हकीम के मुताबिक़ अख़्लात का तवाज़ुन बिगड़ा है। — According to the physician the balance of humours is disturbed.

hindi: मौत का मुक़र्रर वक़्त — जो घड़ी पहले से तय है
definition: the appointed hour of a person's death, fixed in advance and neither hurried nor postponed; not death itself but its unmovable appointment
example: अजल आ जाए तो दवा भी बेकार है — When the appointed hour comes even medicine is useless.

hindi: अजगर — विशाल भयानक साँप
definition: the dragon-serpent of story, a snake grown monstrous in size; it names an engulfing danger rather than a venomous one
example: क़र्ज़ अज़दहा बन कर सामने खड़ा था — The debt stood before him like a dragon.

hindi: शोक-सभा — मरने वाले की याद में होने वाला मजलिसी मातम
definition: formal mourning held as a gathering with recitation and lament, mourning organised into an occasion others attend
example: मजलिस-ए-अज़ा दस दिन जारी रही — The mourning assembly continued for ten days.

hindi: यातना — ख़ुदा की तरफ़ से आने वाला दंड
definition: punishment as torment inflicted by God, in the grave or hereafter, and by extension any suffering that feels unending; a court's punishment ends, this word suggests it does not
example: यह इंतज़ार किसी अज़ाब से कम नहीं — This waiting is no less than torment.

hindi: प्रियजन — प्यारा रिश्तेदार या क़रीबी
definition: a dear one, a relative or intimate held in affection rather than merely acknowledged; kinship felt, where the terms of degree only record the connection
example: उनके एक अज़ीज़ का इंतिक़ाल हो गया — A dear relative of theirs has passed away.

hindi: झाड़-फूँक — जिन्न या आसेब भगाने का मंत्र-अमल
definition: the conjuring formula spoken to command a spirit out of a person or place; exorcism worked by words, unlike a charm worn for protection
example: आमिल ने अज़ीमत पढ़कर आसेब उतारा — The exorcist recited the formula and drove the spirit off.

hindi: यातना — लंबे समय तक दी जाने वाली तकलीफ़
definition: prolonged suffering inflicted on someone, a torment that continues day after day instead of striking once and ending
example: हवालात में उसे बहुत अज़ीयत दी गई — He was put through great torment in the lock-up.

hindi: संकल्प — पक्का कर लिया गया इरादा
definition: firm resolve taken and held, the decision a person will not reopen, stronger than an intention and quieter than a vow
example: उसने अज़्म कर लिया कि लौटकर नहीं आएगा — He resolved firmly that he would not come back.

hindi: चमकीला रेशमी कपड़ा — एक तरफ़ से चिकना
definition: smooth glossy silk cloth with a sheen on one face; satin, named for its surface rather than its weave
example: अतलस का दुपट्टा हाथ से फिसल गया। — The satin wrap slipped out of her hand.

hindi: प्रदान — बख़्शी हुई चीज़ या देने का काम
definition: the bestowing of something as a gift, naming the giving itself, which is why it takes an object where the other favour-words name a manner
example: यह हुनर ख़ुदा की अता है — This skill is a gift bestowed by God.

hindi: अनुदान — ऊपर से दी गई रक़म
definition: a grant of money bestowed by someone in authority, a gift that flows downward as a benefaction
example: रियासत की तरफ़ से अतिया मिला — A grant came from the state.

hindi: बच्चे — बालकों का समूह
definition: children taken together as a group, the plural used in notices and institutions rather than about one child
example: अत्फ़ाल के लिए अलग कमरा रखा गया है। — A separate room has been kept for the children.

hindi: शिष्टाचार — बड़ों के सामने बैठने-बोलने का सलीक़ा
definition: respectful conduct owed to elders and superiors, performed through posture and lowered voice; manners are habit, this is obligation
example: बड़े भाई के सामने अदब से बैठना सिखाया गया था — We were taught to sit respectfully before an elder brother.

hindi: अदायगी न होना — देय रक़म वक़्त पर न चुकाना
definition: failure to pay what is due, default on an obligation rather than a refusal to accept it
example: अदम-अदायगी की सूरत में ज़मानत ज़ब्त होगी। — In case of default, the security will be forfeited.

hindi: न्याय — हर एक को उसका हक़ बराबरी से देना
definition: justice as the ruler's duty to give each person exactly what is owed, weighed evenly, without favour to rank or family
example: उस बादशाह का अदल आज तक मिसाल में आता है — That king's justice is quoted as an example even today.

hindi: अंदाज़ — चलने-बोलने का मोहक ढंग
definition: a charming manner of moving, speaking or glancing, the style of a gesture rather than the gesture itself
example: उसकी हर अदा में एक कशिश है — There is a pull in her every gesture.

hindi: चुकौती — लिया हुआ धन लौटाना
definition: the repayment of money owed, the settlement of a debt rather than an ordinary payment made for goods
example: अदायगी की तारीख़ आगे बढ़वा ली — He got the date of repayment pushed forward.

hindi: शत्रुता — दो पक्षों के बीच चलती हुई दुश्मनी
definition: an open standing enmity between people or families, the relationship rather than the feeling; hatred sits in one heart, this needs two sides
example: दोनों ख़ानदानों में पुरानी अदावत थी — There was an old enmity between the two families.

hindi: साहित्यकार — गद्य और तहज़ीब दोनों का जानकार लिखने वाला
definition: a literary writer whose authority rests on prose and cultivation rather than on verse; a शायर performs from a stage, this one is read on a page
example: वह शायर नहीं, अदीब हैं — He is not a poet but a man of letters.

hindi: शत्रु — जान का दुश्मन
definition: the enemy in the elevated register, the adversary of a poem or an oath rather than the one named in a police report
example: अदू भी उसकी तारीफ़ करता था — Even the enemy praised him.

hindi: न्यायप्रियता — हक़ को उसकी जगह रखने का उसूल
definition: justice as a settled principle of giving each his due, spoken of as a ruler's or God's attribute; fairness is done case by case, this is a standing character
example: उसके अद्ल के क़िस्से मशहूर थे — Tales of his justice were famous.

hindi: बागडोर — घोड़े की डोर, और मजाज़न इख़्तियार
definition: the reins held in the hand, the rider's grip on where the horse goes; handing them over means giving another man control
example: मुल्क की अनान नए हाथों में आ गई — The reins of the country passed into new hands.

hindi: अहंकार — जिसे झुक जाना भी अपनी शिकस्त लगे
definition: the ego that will not concede a single point in a quarrel because conceding anything feels to it like defeat
example: अनानियत ने दोनों को झुकने नहीं दिया — Ego let neither of them bend.

hindi: विषधर साँप — जिसका डसना जानलेवा हो
definition: the viper, the snake named specifically for a deadly bite rather than for stealth; it marks the most venomous of the kind
example: अफ़ई का डसा पानी भी नहीं माँगता — One bitten by a viper does not even ask for water.

hindi: अफ़ीम — नींद और सुन्नपन लाने वाला मादक द्रव्य
definition: opium used as a medicine to dull pain and bring sleep, a drug that heals and enslaves by the same property
example: दर्द के लिए अफ़यून दी जाती थी, आदत भी उसी से पड़ती थी। — Opium was given for pain, and the addiction came from it too.

hindi: उड़ती ख़बर — बिना सबूत फैलने वाली बात
definition: an unverified report that travels faster than its correction; the standard word bulletins use while denying something
example: बाज़ार बंद होने की अफ़वाह शहर भर में फैल गई। — The rumour of a market shutdown spread across the city.

hindi: उदासी — मुरझाया हुआ मन
definition: a quiet withering of spirits that dims a person without any visible cause; sadness of temperament, not despair over a defeat
example: उसके चेहरे की अफ़सुर्दगी सबने महसूस की — Everyone felt the dejection on his face.

hindi: आराम — बीमारी में थोड़ी कमी आना
definition: the first measurable easing of a disease after treatment, improvement short of recovery; what a physician asks about on the second visit
example: दवा से अफ़ाक़ा है, मगर पूरी सेहत अभी दूर है। — There is improvement from the medicine, though full health is still far.

hindi: क्षमा — दंड का हक़ रखते हुए भी उसे माफ़ करना
definition: pardon that wipes the offence out entirely, granted by the one who had full authority to punish; an apology asks for it, only power can give it
example: बादशाह ने अफ़्व का ऐलान किया — The king proclaimed a pardon.

hindi: सुनहरा बुरादा — दुल्हन के बालों और माथे पर छिड़का जाता है
definition: gold or silver dust scattered on the hair and forehead to adorn a bride
example: उसकी माँग में अफ़्शाँ चमक रही थी। — Gold dust glittered in her parting.

hindi: भौंह — आँख के ऊपर की कमान
definition: the eyebrow read as an archer's bow whose arch signals mood before any word is spoken
example: उसकी अबरू ज़रा-सी उठ गई — His eyebrow rose very slightly.

hindi: बिन आस्तीन का चोग़ा — कंधों पर डाला जाने वाला लबादा
definition: a wide sleeveless outer cloak worn over the shoulders by scholars and clerics; marks learning rather than rank
example: मौलाना काली अबा ओढ़े मिंबर पर बैठे थे। — The scholar sat at the pulpit wrapped in a black cloak.

hindi: गुप्त संत — छिपे हुए वे बुज़ुर्ग जिन पर दुनिया क़ायम मानी जाती है
definition: the hidden saints held to number a fixed few, unknown to people, on whom the world is said to rest; concealed by rank, unlike a famous saint
example: कहते हैं ज़मीन अब्दाल की बरकत से क़ायम है — They say the earth stands by the blessing of the hidden saints.

hindi: बादल — आसमान पर छाया हुआ पानी भरा घना बादल
definition: the rain-bearing cloud taken as one spread mass covering the sky, not a single drifting puff of vapour
example: सुबह से अब्र छाया हुआ है, बारिश किसी भी वक़्त हो सकती है। — Cloud has covered the sky since morning; rain may fall any moment.

hindi: काला बादल — तूफ़ान की चेतावनी देता गहरा बादल
definition: the black heavy cloud, darker than an ordinary rain cloud and read as a warning of storm rather than of relief
example: पहाड़ों पर अब्र-ए-सियाह उतर आया और हवा ठंडी हो गई। — Black cloud came down over the hills and the wind turned cold.

hindi: कर्मचारी-वृंद — किसी दफ़्तर का मातहत स्टाफ़
definition: the working staff attached to an office, the hands that carry out orders rather than those who give them
example: पूरा अमला सुबह से काम पर लगा है — The entire staff has been at work since morning.

hindi: टोना-टोटका — मंत्र और अमल के ज़रिए असर डालने की विद्या
definition: the practice of working occult formulas to produce an effect on someone's body or luck; the operative craft, not the charm object itself
example: वो अमलियात के चक्कर में पड़कर बर्बाद हुआ — He was ruined chasing after occult practices.

hindi: अभयदान — जान बख़्शने का वचन
definition: a pledge of safety granted to an enemy or a stranger, protection promised on one's own word
example: हथियार डालने वालों को अमान दी गई। — Safety was pledged to those who laid down arms.

hindi: धरोहर — रखने को दी गई चीज़, जो ज्यों की त्यों लौटे
definition: money or goods left in someone's keeping as a trust, to be returned untouched rather than used or owed back
example: ये रक़म अमानत है, ख़र्च मत करना — This money is a trust; do not spend it.

hindi: ईमानदारी — सौंपी हुई चीज़ को सही-सलामत लौटाना
definition: trustworthiness with what belongs to others, the virtue proved by returning a deposit untouched rather than by telling truth
example: उसकी अमानत-दारी पर सबको भरोसा था — Everyone relied on his trustworthiness.

hindi: आलिम की पगड़ी — दीनी ओहदे की निशानी
definition: the turban wound on the head by a religious scholar; marks learning and office rather than social rank
example: अमामा बाँधे इमाम ने ख़ुत्बा शुरू किया। — The imam in his scholar's turban began the sermon.

hindi: स्पष्ट — जो बिना बताए साफ़ दिखाई दे
definition: evident to anyone who looks, needing no argument in order to be seen; the literary word for what lies plainly before the eyes
example: सच्चाई अब सब पर अयाँ है — The truth is now clear to everyone.

hindi: आश्रित — जिनका ख़र्च किसी के ज़िम्मे हो
definition: the dependents whose food and expenses fall on one earner, children and other kin alike; counts who must be supported, not who is related
example: इतनी तनख़्वाह में इतने अयाल कैसे पलें — How are so many dependents to be kept on such a salary?

hindi: दिन-रात — बीत रहे दिनों का सिलसिला
definition: days taken as a run of time that a life passes through, not the single days of a calendar
example: वो अय्याम बड़े तंगी के थे। — Those days were days of great want.

hindi: चतुर धूर्तता — भेस और चाल से काम निकालने की कला
definition: resourceful cunning that works through disguise, quick invention and misdirection; admired as skill where plain deceit is only condemned
example: उसने अय्यारी से क़िले का दरवाज़ा खुलवा लिया — By cunning he got the fort gate opened.

hindi: मन की साध — बरसों से पाली गई उम्मीद
definition: a cherished hope carried for years, usually about a marriage, a child, a homecoming; warmer and more domestic than ambition
example: माँ का अरमान था कि बेटी डॉक्टर बने — Mother's one wish was that her daughter become a doctor.

hindi: लंबा समय-खंड — बहुत दिन बीत जाना
definition: a long stretch of elapsed time, felt as absence; reached for when something has not happened for ages
example: अरसा हो गया उनसे मिले हुए। — It has been ages since I met him.

hindi: दुल्हन — विवाह के दिन सजी हुई वधू
definition: the bride on her wedding day, seen as adorned and given in marriage, a word of poetry and formal address; names her role that day, not her later status as wife
example: अरूस को चाँदी के तख़्त पर बिठाया गया — The bride was seated on a silver dais.

hindi: निवेदन-पत्र — ऊपर भेजा गया औपचारिक निवेदन
definition: a formal written representation submitted upward to a superior, more ceremonious in wording than a plain petition
example: बादशाह के हुज़ूर अर्ज़दाश्त पेश की गई। — A formal representation was presented before the king.

hindi: सस्तापन — दामों का गिरा हुआ होना
definition: the condition of rates standing low across the market, goods within easy reach; the exact opposite of dearness and a comment on the market, not on quality
example: फ़सल अच्छी हुई तो बाज़ार में अर्ज़ानी आ गई। — The harvest was good, so cheapness came to the market.

hindi: प्रार्थना-पत्र — अधिकारी को लिखी गई विनती
definition: a written petition addressed to an authority, asking for relief rather than claiming it as a right
example: उसने छुट्टी की अर्ज़ी दे दी। — He submitted a written request for leave.

hindi: व्यथा — देह और मन दोनों की पीड़ा
definition: pain considered as suffering borne, covering bodily hurt and grief with one word; names the enduring, not the sensation
example: मरीज़ का अलम कम करना भी इलाज है। — Easing a patient's suffering is also treatment.

hindi: चिह्न — जो किसी चीज़ की मौजूदगी बताए
definition: a sign standing for something not visible itself, a mark that indicates rather than a clue that leads
example: बादल बारिश की अलामत हैं — Clouds are a sign of rain.

hindi: अस्वस्थता — बीमार पड़ने की हालत
definition: the state of being unwell, spoken of as a period rather than as a named disease; the formal word used in leave letters and obituaries
example: लंबी अलालत के बाद उन्होंने कुर्सी छोड़ दी। — After a long illness he gave up the post.

hindi: रोगी — बीमारी में पड़ा हुआ
definition: laid up with a settled, prolonged illness rather than momentarily unwell; the register of a formal medical bulletin
example: वालिद साहब कई हफ़्तों से अलील हैं। — Father has been ill for several weeks.

hindi: जनता — हुकूमत के नीचे रहने वाले आम लोग
definition: the common people considered as those who are governed, the public as against the officials and the powerful
example: अवाम की राय जाने बिना फ़ैसला कर लिया गया — The decision was taken without asking the public.

hindi: आँसू — आँख से गिरने वाला एक क़तरा
definition: a tear counted singly as it leaves the eye; the literary word, where the everyday one names only the wetness on a face
example: उसने एक अश्क भी बहने नहीं दिया — He did not let a single tear fall.

hindi: शेर — साहस और रोब का प्रतीक जानवर
definition: the lion as the emblem beast of courage among predators, invoked for a man's bearing rather than his violence
example: मैदान में वो असद की तरह डटा रहा — He stood his ground on the field like a lion.

hindi: सामान-असबाब — सफ़र या घर का सारा सामान
definition: the whole baggage and belongings one carries or owns, goods regarded as a load rather than as possessions
example: असबाब बाँध कर स्टेशन पहुँचे — We tied up the baggage and reached the station.

hindi: पुराण-कथाएँ — पुराने ज़माने के मिथक और दास्तानें
definition: the inherited myths of earlier peoples, studied or cited as old tales rather than believed; neutral where superstition is dismissive
example: ये क़िस्सा असातीर में मिलता है — This story is found among the ancient myths.

hindi: संपत्ति — पास मौजूद माल जो हैसियत बनाता है
definition: the assets standing to someone's name, weighed as the base of their financial standing; an accounting term, unlike goods sitting in a market
example: उसका सारा असासा एक दुकान और दो कमरे हैं। — His whole assets are one shop and two rooms.

hindi: बंदी — जो पकड़ा जाकर छूट न सके
definition: one caught and held, a captive of a net, a cage, or a passion; it names the condition of being kept, not the crime that put him there
example: वो अपनी ही आदतों का असीर है — He is a captive of his own habits.

hindi: बंदीपन — क़ैद में रहने की हालत
definition: the condition of captivity itself, the years spent held; the state, where the other word is the person
example: असीरी के दिनों ने उसे ख़ामोश कर दिया — The days of captivity silenced him.

hindi: भीतरी तह — कपड़े के अंदर की ओर लगाया जाने वाला दूसरा कपड़ा
definition: the inner cloth stitched behind the outer one to give a garment body and finish; it is built in at the making, not added later as a repair
example: शेरवानी का अस्तर रेशम का लगवाया है। — The lining of the sherwani has been made of silk.

hindi: अश्व — सवारी और जंग का घोड़ा
definition: the horse as a mount, the Persian word used in compounds and formal speech; it names the animal itself, not its speed or breeding
example: अस्प-सवारी उस ख़ानदान की पुरानी रिवायत थी — Horsemanship was an old tradition of that family.

hindi: प्रतिज्ञा — निभाने की ज़िम्मेदारी वाला वचन
definition: a solemn undertaking one binds oneself to, weightier than a casual promise because breaking it is a stain on character
example: उसने अहद किया कि दोबारा नहीं आएगा — He made a solemn vow never to come again.

hindi: अभय-संधि — अमन बरतने का पक्का क़रार
definition: the covenant of safe conduct agreed between hostile parties, safety guaranteed by a formal pact
example: दोनों लश्करों में अहद-ए-अमान तय पाया। — A covenant of safe conduct was settled between the two armies.

hindi: वफ़ा का वादा — साथ न छोड़ने का क़ौल
definition: the pledge of faithfulness given between lovers or friends, loyalty promised privately rather than sworn in office
example: अहद-ए-वफ़ा निभाना आसान नहीं होता। — Keeping a pledge of faithfulness is never easy.

hindi: क़रार और वचन — दोनों तरफ़ से बंधा हुआ पक्का वादा
definition: the mutual covenant and pledge exchanged by two sides, binding each of them alike
example: बचपन के अहद-ओ-पैमान अब याद भर हैं। — The covenants and pledges of childhood are now only a memory.

hindi: वचन तोड़ने वाला — जिसके क़ौल का कोई भरोसा न हो
definition: describing a person who habitually breaks promises, naming the character rather than one broken pact
example: ऐसे अहद-शिकन आदमी से मुआहदा करना बेकार है। — Making an agreement with such a promise-breaking man is useless.

hindi: वचन-भंग — किए हुए अहद से मुकर जाना
definition: the breaking of a solemn pact or oath, heavier than an ordinary broken promise because the bond itself was sworn
example: अहद-शिकनी के बाद कोई बात बाक़ी नहीं रही — After the pact was broken nothing remained to say.

hindi: घर वाले — घर के सब सदस्य
definition: the members of one house taken as a unit, addressing them as residents rather than as blood relations
example: अहल-ए-ख़ाना सब ख़ैरियत से हैं — The members of the household are all well.

hindi: बाल-बच्चे — बीवी और बच्चे, यानी आश्रित परिवार
definition: a man's wife and children considered as those he must provide for; names the family as dependents, where the household names the work of keeping them
example: अहल-ओ-अयाल समेत वो शहर छोड़ गए — He left the city along with his wife and children.

hindi: धर्मपत्नी — आदरपूर्वक कही जाने वाली पत्नी
definition: a wife spoken of with courtesy in someone else's presence, the polite public word for one's own or another's wife; respect where the legal term is merely accurate
example: आपकी अहलिया की तबीयत अब कैसी है — How is your wife's health now?

hindi: घिरा हुआ मैदान — इमारत के साथ की बाड़ी
definition: an enclosed compound around a building, ground that belongs to the house while lying outside its walls
example: मकान के साथ एक बड़ा अहाता भी है — There is a large compound along with the house.

hindi: आगामी — जो वक़्त अभी आना है
definition: belonging to the time still to come, used for days ahead where the past ones are settled
example: आइंदा ऐसी ग़लती न हो। — Let no such mistake happen in the time to come.

hindi: संविधान — वह बुनियादी क़ानून जिससे बाक़ी क़ानून निकलते हैं
definition: the constitution, the founding law that sets up the state's organs and limits their power; the source above which no ordinary statute may stand
example: यह हुक्म आईन के ख़िलाफ़ है — This order is against the constitution.

hindi: अंतिम परिणाम — ख़ासकर मरने के बाद का हाल
definition: the final outcome of a life, the end that religion cares about rather than the end of a single act
example: आक़िबत सँवारने की फ़िक्र करो। — Care about setting your final end right.

hindi: अंजाम की फ़िक्र — आख़िरी नतीजे को ध्यान में रखना
definition: weighing the final outcome, especially the moral one, before choosing; foresight concerned with what a deed ends in
example: थोड़ी आक़िबत-अंदेशी करो, फ़ायदा ही सब कुछ नहीं। — Think of the end result; profit is not everything.

hindi: परलोक — मरने के बाद का स्थायी जीवन
definition: the life that begins after death and does not end, set against this passing world in every religious argument
example: दुनिया के लिए आख़िरत मत बेचो — Do not sell the next life for this world.

hindi: जागरूकता — किसी बात का सचेत बोध होना
definition: the state of being aware of something, knowledge that has reached you and registered; unlike stored learning, this is awareness alive in the present moment
example: उसे अपने हालात की पूरी आगही है — He has complete awareness of his own situation.

hindi: शुरुआत — काम छिड़ने का लम्हा
definition: the moment a thing is set going, stressing the act of starting rather than the beginning point on a line
example: नए दौर का आग़ाज़ यहीं से हुआ। — The start of a new era happened right here.

hindi: परखा हुआ — जिसे आज़माकर सही पाया गया हो
definition: already tried and found reliable, tested by use rather than merely recommended
example: ये आज़्मूदा नुस्ख़ा है, बेफ़िक्र इस्तेमाल करो। — This is a tested remedy; use it without worry.

hindi: दीनता — हाथ जोड़कर, दबकर की गई विनती
definition: self-lowering before another in request or apology, visible in the voice; where इंकिसार is carried, this is performed downward
example: उसने बहुत आजिज़ी से माफ़ी माँगी — He apologised with great humility.

hindi: आग जैसा — जलाने वाला, तेज़ असर वाला
definition: fiery in nature, said of wine that burns the throat and of speech that inflames a crowd; heat that acts on others
example: उसकी आतिशीं तक़रीर ने सबको खड़ा कर दिया। — His fiery speech brought everyone to their feet.

hindi: विपत्ति — अचानक सिर पर आ पड़ी मुसीबत
definition: a sudden trouble that lands on a person without warning and demands immediate handling; arrives, unlike a worry that grows
example: एक आफ़त टली नहीं कि दूसरी आ गई — One calamity had not passed before the next arrived.

hindi: सूर्य — दिन में चमकने वाला सूरज
definition: the shining body that lights the day, the common poetic name for the sun and the image for anything supremely bright
example: आफ़ताब निकलते ही धुंध छँट गई। — The mist lifted as soon as the sun rose.

hindi: शाबाशी — तारीफ़ में कहा जाने वाला शब्द
definition: the exclamation of well-done offered to a performer, praise compressed into one spoken word
example: हर शेर पर आफ़रीन की आवाज़ आई — A cry of well-done came after every couplet.

hindi: चमक-दमक — पानी जैसी चमक और साथ में तेज़
definition: wet shine and blaze together, the lustre of a thing shown at its best; said of a face, a stone or a performance alike
example: महफ़िल पूरी आब-ओ-ताब के साथ सजी थी — The gathering was arranged in full splendour.

hindi: चमक और रंगत — किसी चीज़ की दमक
definition: the lustre and colouring a thing shows on its surface, the finish of a bloom rather than the mood behind it
example: इस तस्वीर का आब-ओ-रंग बेमिसाल है। — The lustre and colouring of this picture are unmatched.

hindi: जलवायु — किसी जगह का मौसम और हवा का मिज़ाज
definition: the settled climate of a place, its long-run pattern of air and water rather than the weather of one day
example: इस शहर की आब-ओ-हवा उसे रास नहीं आई। — The climate of this city did not suit him.

hindi: पानी पीने का बर्तन — मिट्टी या धातु का सादा कटोरा
definition: a plain cup or bowl kept only for drinking water, named by its use rather than its shape or the drink it holds
example: मिट्टी का आब-ख़ोरा पानी ठंडा रखता है। — The clay drinking bowl keeps the water cool.

hindi: छिड़काव — पानी छिड़कने का काम
definition: the sprinkling of water over plants or ground, a light surface watering rather than a field's full irrigation
example: शाम को क्यारियों पर आब-पाशी की जाती है। — The flower beds are sprinkled with water in the evening.

hindi: इज़्ज़त — लोगों की नज़र में बनी हुई साख
definition: the standing a person holds in other people's eyes; honour understood as public reputation, which is why being seen can destroy it
example: पैसा गया तो गया, आबरू बच गई — The money is gone, but the reputation was saved.

hindi: छाला — जलने या रगड़ से उठा हुआ फफोला
definition: a blister raised by burning or rubbing, a small fluid swelling on the skin; the mildest of injuries but named exactly
example: नए जूतों से पाँव में आबला पड़ गया। — The new shoes raised a blister on the foot.

hindi: छालों भरे पाँव वाला — चल-चल कर पाँव छिल गए हों
definition: having feet blistered from walking, describing a traveller whose journey has physically cost him
example: आबला-पा मुसाफ़िर दरवाज़े पर आ खड़ा हुआ — The blister-footed traveller stood at the door.

hindi: झरना — ऊपर से गिरता हुआ पानी
definition: water falling from a height in the open, natural water that arrives by dropping rather than by being led
example: पहाड़ से एक आबशार गिर रहा था। — A waterfall was coming down from the mountain.

hindi: पूर्वज — बाप-दादा और उनसे पहले के लोग
definition: the forefathers a family descends from, the dead of the lineage rather than the living household
example: यह ज़मीन हमारे आबा-ओ-अजदाद की है — This land belonged to our forefathers.

hindi: पैतृक — बाप-दादा से चला आया हुआ
definition: ancestral, belonging to one's forefathers and inherited from them rather than acquired in one's own lifetime
example: आबाई मकान बेच दिया गया — The ancestral house was sold.

hindi: सिंचाई — फ़सल या पौदों को पानी देना
definition: the watering of crops and plants as a regular duty, and figuratively the nurturing that keeps something growing
example: इस रिश्ते की आबियारी दोनों ने की है। — Both of them have nurtured this relationship.

hindi: आगमन — किसी के आ पहुँचने की घड़ी
definition: the arrival of an awaited person or thing, naming the coming itself and, in accounts, the income that comes in
example: मेहमानों की आमद शुरू हो चुकी थी — The arrival of the guests had already begun.

hindi: आना-जाना — किसी जगह पर लगातार होने वाली आवाजाही
definition: the continual coming and going of people or traffic through a place, movement in both directions rather than a single journey
example: इस सड़क पर रात भर आमद-ओ-रफ़्त रहती है — There is coming and going on this road all night.

hindi: आयत या निशानी — क़ुरआन का एक वाक्य, या ईश्वरीय चिह्न
definition: a single verse of revealed scripture, the same word also meaning a sign that points to God
example: उसने एक आयत पढ़कर दम किया — He recited a verse and blew a blessing.

hindi: अभिलाषा — दिल में पली हुई चाह
definition: a wish carried in the heart over time, softer than demand and more personal than ambition, often one the person never voices
example: एक आरज़ू थी कि उन्हें एक बार देख लूँ — I had one wish, to see them once.

hindi: करवत — दाँतेदार औज़ार जिससे लकड़ी चीरी जाती है
definition: the toothed tool that cuts through wood or stone by being drawn back and forth; separates material by sawing, where the file only wears it down
example: आरा चलते ही लकड़ी का बुरादा उड़ने लगा। — As the saw moved, sawdust began to fly.

hindi: सजावट — तरतीब से सजाने का काम
definition: the work of decorating and arranging a space or a person, decoration named as an activity carried out with care
example: शादी के घर की आराइश देखते ही बनती थी — The decoration of the wedding house was a sight.

hindi: विश्राम-स्थल — क़ब्र या मज़ार का नरम, सम्मानजनक नाम
definition: the burial place named as somewhere the dead are finally at rest, the phrase used on plaques and in eulogies to avoid the harder word
example: यह उनकी आख़िरी आराम-गाह है — This is his final resting place.

hindi: आरामपसंदी — मेहनत से जी चुराना
definition: a settled preference for ease over work, the habit that creeps in when a life stops being asked to labour
example: आराम-तलबी ने उन्हें वक़्त से पहले बूढ़ा कर दिया। — Love of ease made him old before his time.

hindi: विश्रामस्थल — आराम करने की जगह
definition: a place set aside for rest along a route, chosen for comfort rather than for lodging travellers commercially
example: बाग़ के कोने में एक आरामगाह बनी है — A resting place has been built in the corner of the garden.

hindi: सजाया हुआ — क़रीने से सँवारा गया
definition: decorated and set in order, said of a room, a table or a person made ready for showing; the finished state that आराइश produces
example: मेज़ फूलों से आरास्ता थी — The table was decorated with flowers.

hindi: गाल — चेहरे का उभरा हुआ पार्श्व
definition: the cheek, named in verse as the plane where colour and light show themselves; almost never heard in plain speech
example: उसके आरिज़ पर सुर्ख़ी दौड़ गई — Colour ran across his cheek.

hindi: आत्माओं का लोक — जिस्म से पहले और बाद रूहों का ठिकाना
definition: the realm where souls exist before birth and after death, outside the visible world; a world of spirits, not the grave itself
example: सूफ़ी आलम-ए-अरवाह के अहद का ज़िक्र करते हैं — Sufis speak of the covenant in the world of souls.

hindi: स्वप्न-लोक — नींद में देखा जाने वाला अलग जहान
definition: the world entered in sleep, treated as a place with its own happenings; a realm visited while dreaming, unlike the dream that is recalled
example: आलम-ए-ख़्वाब में उसने अपने वालिद को देखा — In the world of dreams he saw his father.

hindi: ऊपरी लोक — इस दुनिया से ऊँचा, नज़र से बाहर का जहान
definition: the higher world above this one, from which commands and blessings are held to descend; the realm above, where the spirits' world is the realm beyond
example: उनकी निगाह आलम-ए-बाला पर थी — His gaze was on the higher world.

hindi: विस्मय की अवस्था — हैरानी में डूबे रहने की हालत
definition: the condition of being lost in wonder, unable to judge or move; an inward world one enters, not a place existing outside
example: ये सुनकर वो आलम-ए-हैरत में डूब गया — Hearing this, he sank into a state of wonder.

hindi: यंत्र — नापने या काम करने का बना-बनाया साधन
definition: a single made instrument used as the means of some work, from a scalpel to a telescope; more formal than a hand tool and often not gripped at all
example: डॉक्टर ने नब्ज़ देखने का आला निकाला। — The doctor took out the instrument for checking the pulse.

hindi: यंत्रों का समूह — कई साधन एक साथ
definition: instruments taken together as the equipment of a place or a craft; the plural word used when the whole apparatus, not one instrument, is meant
example: जंगी आलात गोदाम में बंद पड़े थे। — The war equipment lay locked in the warehouse.

hindi: धर्म-विद्वान — शास्त्रों का जानकार
definition: a scholar trained in religious knowledge, an authority on the texts rather than a guide of the heart
example: गाँव के आलिम से मसला पूछा गया — The question was put to the village scholar.

hindi: बेमक़सद घूमना — बिना ठिकाने भटकते रहने की हालत
definition: aimless roaming as a condition of life, wandering with no destination and no wish for one
example: उन दिनों आवारगी के सिवा कुछ न था — In those days there was nothing but aimless roaming.

hindi: लटकन — कान या गले से झूलता हुआ गहना
definition: an ornament that hangs and swings from the ear or the neck; hanging is what names it, not its stone
example: चलते वक़्त उसका आवेज़ा हिलता रहा। — Her pendant swung as she walked.

hindi: हाथापाई — दो पक्षों का गुत्थमगुत्था हो जाना
definition: a scuffle in which two sides grapple physically with each other; a fight of bodies, briefer and hotter than a feud
example: बाज़ार में दोनों गुटों की आवेज़िश हो गई — The two groups came to blows in the market.

hindi: उजागर — छिपा हुआ जो खुल गया हो
definition: brought out into view after having been concealed; said of a secret that has become visible, not of a thing that was always plain
example: राज़ आख़िर आशकार हो ही गया — The secret came out in the end.

hindi: प्रेमी — जो किसी पर मर मिटा हो
definition: the one who loves, with the burning, self-consuming sense the word carries in poetry; a boyfriend is a relationship, this is a condition
example: वह उसका पुराना आशिक़ है — He is her old lover.

hindi: घोंसला / छोटा-सा घर — अपनी बनाई हुई पनाह
definition: a nest of a home, small and self-built, valued for shelter and belonging rather than for size or address
example: दो कमरों का सही, आशियाना अपना है — Two rooms it may be, but the little nest is ours.

hindi: अस्तव्यस्तता — मन और हाल दोनों का बिखराव
definition: the scattered, dishevelled condition of a mind coming apart, visible in a person's appearance and speech; disorder where its siblings name intensity
example: उसकी आशुफ़्तगी चेहरे से ही ज़ाहिर थी। — His derangement showed plainly on his face.

hindi: उथल-पुथल — पूरे शहर या ज़माने की बदहाली और हंगामा
definition: the tumult of a whole city or age in disorder; the chaos itself, felt as a standing condition rather than one event
example: आशोब-ए-ज़माना ने अच्छे-अच्छों को तोड़ दिया — The tumult of the times broke even the strongest.

hindi: मेल — झगड़े के बाद लौटी हुई गर्मजोशी
definition: the return of peace between two sides after a quarrel; names the warmth restored rather than the terms they agreed on
example: बरसों की तल्ख़ी के बाद आश्ती हुई — Peace returned after years of bitterness.

hindi: जान-पहचान वाला — क़रीबी परिचित, कहीं-कहीं माशूक़ भी
definition: one you are familiar with, warmer than an acquaintance and often standing in for a beloved; closeness that comes from knowing, not from relation
example: इस शहर में मेरा कोई आश्ना नहीं — I have no one familiar to me in this city.

hindi: सुख-सुविधा — आराम से रहने का साज़-ओ-सामान
definition: the settled comfort of a life with its needs met, ease as a condition of living rather than relief from a particular pain
example: बुढ़ापे की आसाइश के लिए यही मकान है। — This house is for the comfort of old age.

hindi: चिह्न — बचे हुए निशान या लक्षण
definition: the remaining traces by which something past or something coming can be read, evidence left behind rather than memory held
example: पुराने घर के आसार अब भी बाक़ी हैं — Traces of the old house still remain.

hindi: संतोषजनक संपन्नता — काफ़ी होने का सुकून
definition: the settled ease of having enough, prosperity felt as contentment rather than counted as a quantity of wealth
example: बड़ी दौलत नहीं, मगर आसूदगी है — There is no great wealth, but there is sufficiency.

hindi: साया — किसी अदृश्य असर का इंसान पर क़ब्ज़ा
definition: an unseen affliction that settles on a person or house and disorders it; possession felt as a shadow, not the being itself
example: उस पर आसेब का असर बताया गया — It was said he was under the influence of a possessing spirit.

hindi: चौखट / दर — जिस दर पर सिर झुकाया जाए
definition: a doorstep approached in devotion or petition, a threshold that names whose door it is rather than where the house divides
example: फ़क़ीर उसका आस्ताना छोड़कर नहीं गया — The mendicant did not leave his doorstep.

hindi: स्वर-लहरी — किसी आवाज़ या रचना की अंतर्निहित लय
definition: the underlying tune or cadence running through a sound, a sentence or a performance, felt even when no instrument is playing
example: उसकी बातों में एक अजीब आहंग है — There is a strange music in the way he talks.

hindi: लोहा — आग में गलने वाली भारी धातु
definition: iron as the raw metal itself, before tempering makes it steel; the substance the blacksmith's whole trade is named after
example: आहन को गरम किए बिना कोई शक्ल नहीं दी जा सकती। — Iron cannot be given any shape without being heated.

hindi: लोहार — लोहे को आग में गढ़ने वाला कारीगर
definition: the craftsman whose material is iron, softened at the fire and beaten on the anvil; the heaviest of the skilled hands, working force rather than fineness
example: आहनगर की चोट से गरम लोहा मुड़ने लगा। — Under the blacksmith's blow the hot iron began to bend.

hindi: हिरन — बड़ी आँखों वाला डरपोक जंगली जानवर
definition: the deer of poetry, a shy wild animal praised for its eyes and named as the classic prey of the hunt
example: उसकी आँखें आहू की आँखें हैं — Her eyes are the eyes of a deer.

hindi: क्रांति — पूरे निज़ाम को उलट देने वाली तबदीली
definition: a change that overturns the whole order of rule, replacing the system itself rather than merely the people running it
example: इंक़लाब के बाद ज़मीनें बाँट दी गईं — After the revolution the lands were distributed.

hindi: प्रकटीकरण — छिपी हुई हक़ीक़त का सामने आना
definition: a revelation of something that was concealed, neutral disclosure of a fact rather than the shaming exposure of a person
example: तहक़ीक़ात में हैरान करने वाला इंकिशाफ़ हुआ — A startling disclosure came in the inquiry.

hindi: विनम्रता — अपनी हैसियत जताए बिना पेश आना
definition: the humility of a person entitled to claim status who quietly declines to; modesty about achievement rather than about the self
example: इतने बड़े आलिम हैं, फिर भी क्या इंकिसार है — Such a great scholar, and yet such humility.

hindi: चेतावनी — आने वाले नुक़सान से पहले से आगाह करना
definition: a warning about harm that is still ahead, given so the hearer can still avoid it
example: सैलाब का इंज़ार पहले ही दे दिया गया था। — The warning of the flood had already been given.

hindi: अनुशासन — नियम के भीतर रखने की सख़्ती
definition: discipline enforced within a body of people, order kept by rules and consequences rather than by anyone's willingness
example: फ़ौजी इंज़िबात में देर माफ़ नहीं होती — Military discipline does not forgive lateness.

hindi: एकांतवास — मेल-जोल से पूरी तरह कट जाना
definition: complete isolation from company, a severing of contact deeper than merely retiring into a quiet corner
example: सालों की इंज़िवा ने उसे चुप कर दिया — Years of isolation made him silent.

hindi: बदला — ख़ुद अपने हाथ से लिया गया हिसाब
definition: revenge taken privately to settle a wrong, satisfying the injured rather than the law; what justice exists to replace
example: इंतक़ाम की आग ने उसे भी जला दिया — The fire of revenge burnt him too.

hindi: प्रशासन — चलाने और इंतज़ाम करने वाला अमला
definition: the administration of an institution, the body responsible for its daily running as against those who own or elect it
example: कॉलेज की इंतज़ामिया ने छुट्टी का ऐलान किया — The college administration announced a holiday.

hindi: प्रतीक्षा — किसी के आने की राह देखना
definition: waiting charged with expectation; the waiting itself becomes the experience instead of dead time before one
example: रात भर उसका इंतज़ार करते रहे। — We waited for him all night.

hindi: प्रतिशोध — बदला लेने की कार्रवाई
definition: revenge taken by one's own hand for a wrong, the act a grudge finally produces; punishment is imposed by authority, this is settled privately
example: इंतिक़ाम से दिल कभी ठंडा नहीं होता — Revenge never cools the heart.

hindi: देहांत — किसी के मर जाने की ख़बर देने का शाइस्ता लफ़्ज़
definition: death stated in the polite register used for announcements, obituaries and official notice; where Hindi मौत names the blunt fact, this names the passing and softens it for the family hearing it
example: वालिद साहब का इंतिक़ाल कल रात हुआ — Father passed away last night.

hindi: चेत जाना — ग़फ़लत से जागने का पल
definition: the moment of waking up to what one has been ignoring, awareness arriving as a jolt rather than settling in as habit
example: उस हादसे ने उसे इंतिबाह दिया। — That accident gave him a rude awakening.

hindi: बिखराव — व्यवस्था का टूटकर छितरा जाना
definition: the scattering apart of what was held together, disorder as the collapse of an arrangement rather than as a fight between parties
example: जमात में इंतिशार फैल गया — Disarray spread through the group.

hindi: पराकाष्ठा — जहाँ जाकर बात ख़त्म हो
definition: the far end of a stretch beyond which nothing goes, used for a limit reached as much as for an ending
example: सब्र की भी कोई इंतिहा होती है। — Even patience has an end.

hindi: घाव भरना — ज़ख़्म का धीरे-धीरे मिट जाना
definition: the slow closing of a wound over time, the healing itself rather than the remedy applied to it
example: इस ज़ख़्म का इंदिमाल आसान नहीं। — The healing of this wound is not easy.

hindi: प्रविष्टि — किसी बात को रजिस्टर में दर्ज करना
definition: the entering of a fact into a register, the act of getting something written on record where it can later be cited
example: शिकायत का इंदिराज हो चुका है। — The complaint has been entered on record.

hindi: गद्य-रचना — विशेषकर पत्र लिखने की कला
definition: the art of composing prose, above all the letter-writing style once taught as a formal discipline in its own right
example: उन दिनों इंशा एक अलग फ़न समझा जाता था। — In those days prose composition was reckoned a separate art.

hindi: अलंकृत गद्य — ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा सजाकर लिखना
definition: elaborate ornamental prose composition, written style pursued well past the point where it helps the reader
example: इतनी इंशा-परदाज़ी में मतलब ही खो गया। — The meaning was lost in all that ornamental prose.

hindi: पतन — किसी क़ौम या ख़ानदान का ढलान
definition: the long historical decline of a nation, house or civilisation across generations; slower and wider than a fall in rank
example: उस सल्तनत का इंहितात एक दिन में नहीं हुआ — That empire's decline did not happen in a day.

hindi: तल्लीनता — काम में डूब कर लगे रहना
definition: engrossment in a task, attention plus the effort that keeps pouring into it; concentration is the aim, this is being consumed by the work itself
example: अपने काम में उसका इंहिमाक देखने लायक़ है — His absorption in his work is a sight.

hindi: मुकर जाना — तय रास्ते या बात से हट जाना
definition: turning away from a stated position or an agreed course, evasion by changing direction rather than by delay
example: उसने अपने बयान से इंहिराफ़ किया — He turned away from his own statement.

hindi: स्वीकारोक्ति — अपना जुर्म ख़ुद मान लेना
definition: the admission of one's own guilt before authority, the accused speaking against himself; unlike बयान it damages the speaker by definition
example: मुजरिम ने अदालत में इक़बाल कर लिया — The accused made his confession in court.

hindi: स्वीकारोक्ति — मान लेने का बयान
definition: an admission or avowal, covering both confessing a deed and binding yourself to a promise
example: उसने अपनी ग़लती का इक़रार कर लिया। — He admitted his mistake.

hindi: इक़रारनामा — लिखित रूप में की गई प्रतिज्ञा
definition: a written deed of agreement in which one party records what he undertakes to do
example: इक़रार-नामा पढ़े बग़ैर उस पर अँगूठा मत लगाना। — Do not put your thumb on that deed of agreement unread.

hindi: लिखित इक़रार — दोनों पक्षों की तय शर्तों का काग़ज़
definition: the written instrument in which both parties set down the terms they have accepted; a spoken promise put into a paper that can be produced later
example: काम शुरू करने से पहले इक़रारनामा लिखवा लो। — Get the agreement written up before starting the work.

hindi: भूखंड — एक जैसी जलवायु वाला इलाक़ा
definition: a clime, a region of the earth defined by the climate it shares, larger than a city and older than any political border
example: क़दीम किताबों में दुनिया सात इक़लीमों में बाँटी गई है। — Old books divide the world into seven climes.

hindi: पारस्परिक निरस्तीकरण — दोनों की रज़ा से सौदा वापस लेना
definition: the undoing of a contract by mutual consent, both parties agreeing to release each other from it
example: ख़रीदार पछताया तो बेचने वाले ने इक़ाला क़ुबूल कर लिया। — The buyer repented, and the seller accepted mutual rescission.

hindi: सत्ता — हुक्म चलाने की असल पकड़
definition: the grip on power itself, who can actually make a decision stick, separate from the office or title that supposedly carries it
example: ओहदा उनका था, इक़्तिदार किसी और के पास — The post was his; the real power lay elsewhere.

hindi: उद्धरण — किसी और की लिखी इबारत का हवाला देकर लिया गया हिस्सा
definition: a passage taken from another written work and set inside your own with attribution; the composed book is the source, this is a borrowed piece of one
example: उन्होंने अपनी तक़रीर में एक लंबा इक़्तिबास पढ़ा — He read out a long quotation in his address.

hindi: निष्कासन — बाहर निकाल देने की कार्रवाई
definition: the formal act of throwing someone out of an institution or place, expulsion ordered by authority rather than a quarrel
example: बग़ावत पर उसका इख़राज हुआ — He was expelled for the rebellion.

hindi: समापन — मुद्दत या मुआमले का अपने आप ख़त्म होना
definition: the coming to an end of a term or an affair, expiry by time rather than cancellation by anyone
example: मुआहदे के इख़्तिताम पर नया क़रार हुआ। — On the expiry of the treaty a new agreement was made.

hindi: अधिकार-क्षेत्र — फ़ैसला करने या रोकने की ताक़त
definition: the authority to decide or to act in a matter, the power law puts in someone's hands; an officer without it can order nothing
example: यह मामला मेरे इख़्तियार से बाहर है — This matter is outside my authority.

hindi: छिपाव — ज़रूरी बात दूसरे से छिपा लेना
definition: the concealing of a material fact from the other party, bad faith committed by silence rather than by lie
example: ऐब का इख़्फ़ा सौदे को कालअदम कर देता है। — Concealment of a defect makes the deal void.

hindi: बहकावा — किसी को ग़लत राह पर डालना
definition: leading a person astray by making the wrong path attractive, seduction into error rather than force
example: बुरी सोहबत के इग़वा में वो फँस गया। — He was caught in the seduction of bad company.

hindi: पेशी की बैठक — अदालत के बैठने का वह वक़्त जब मुक़दमा सुना जाए
definition: a single sitting or session of a court, the bounded occasion on which a case is actually heard, not the institution and not the building
example: अगले इजलास में गवाह पेश होंगे — The witnesses will appear at the next sitting.

hindi: विवाह — पति-पत्नी बनने की स्थिति और संबंध
definition: the married state considered as a lifelong relation between husband and wife, the condition rather than the ceremony or the contract; a formal word courts and sermons prefer
example: इज़दिवाज की ज़िंदगी में सब्र सबसे बड़ी पूँजी है — In married life patience is the greatest capital.

hindi: अभिव्यक्ति — मन की बात ज़ाहिर करना
definition: putting an inward feeling out in the open; used above all for declaring love to its object
example: साल भर लगा उससे इज़हार करने में। — It took him a year to say what he felt.

hindi: वृद्धि — लिखे या देय में जो और जोड़ा जाए
definition: an addition made to what is already written or already owed; the text or the amount grows rather than changes
example: मज़मून में दो सफ़्हों का इज़ाफ़ा किया गया। — Two pages were added to the essay.

hindi: व्याकुलता — भीतर की उथल-पुथल
definition: agitation that stops a person from settling anywhere, inner turmoil showing itself as an inability to stay still
example: इंतज़ार के आख़िरी घंटे में इज़्तिराब बढ़ गया — In the last hour of waiting the agitation grew.

hindi: विवशता की हद — मजबूरी में किया गया काम
definition: the compulsion of a person left no lawful option, used when a forbidden or unwanted act becomes unavoidable; the legal edge of helplessness
example: इज़्तिरार की हालत में उसने वो सौदा क़बूल किया — Under compulsion he accepted that bargain.

hindi: पट्टा — तय मुद्दत का किराया-हक़
definition: a lease giving use of a property for a fixed term, transferring possession without touching ownership
example: ज़मीन का इजारा दस साल के लिए हुआ — The lease of the land was for ten years.

hindi: किनारा करना — बुरी बात से पहलू बचाना
definition: steering clear of something wrong or risky, avoidance of an occasion rather than restraint from a craving
example: फ़ुज़ूल बहस से इज्तिनाब बेहतर है। — Avoiding pointless argument is better.

hindi: आज्ञापालन — जायज़ हुक्म को बिना सवाल मानना
definition: obedience owed to a rightful authority, carried out because the command is legitimate rather than because refusal would be dangerous
example: फ़ौज में इताअत पर ही सब कुछ टिका है — In an army everything rests on obedience.

hindi: सूचना — पहले से दी गई ख़बर
definition: notice given so that nobody is caught unaware; carries an official register that ordinary news lacks
example: पुलिस को इत्तिला दे दी गई थी। — The police had already been informed.

hindi: संयोग — बिना योजना घट गई बात; साथ ही आपसी सहमति
definition: coincidence, an event nobody arranged; the identical word also carries agreement between people
example: हम दोनों का एक ही ट्रेन में होना निरा इत्तेफ़ाक़ था। — Us both being on the same train was pure coincidence.

hindi: अभियोग — अदालत में औपचारिक रूप से लगाया गया दोष
definition: the formal charge as framed against an accused in a proceeding, the accusation in its legal dress rather than in ordinary speech
example: इत्तेहाम आयद होते ही मुक़दमा शुरू हुआ — The trial began as soon as the charge was framed.

hindi: तसल्ली — फ़िक्र हट जाने से आया दिल का ठहराव
definition: the settled ease that follows once a worry is answered, calm that comes from assurance rather than from distraction
example: उसकी ख़बर सुनकर इत्मीनान हुआ। — Hearing news of him brought me peace of mind.

hindi: बुरे दिन — क़िस्मत के उतार का दौर
definition: a long spell in which fortune has turned downward and everything a person touches goes wrong; the season of misfortune
example: इदबार के दिनों में अपने भी पहचानने से इनकार करते हैं — In days of bad fortune even one's own deny knowing you.

hindi: अनुभूति-बोध — किसी चीज़ को भीतर से पहचान लेना
definition: the mind's act of apprehending something directly, taking hold of it as it is; comprehension of meaning is worked out, while this arrives as a perception
example: उसे अपनी ग़लती का इदराक हो गया — He came to a full realisation of his mistake.

hindi: प्रतीक्षा-अवधि — तलाक़ या पति की मृत्यु के बाद का ठहराव
definition: the waiting period a woman observes after divorce or her husband's death, before she may marry again; a fixed span of law, not a private mourning of choice
example: इद्दत पूरी होने तक उसने घर से क़दम न निकाला — Until the waiting period was over she did not step out of the house.

hindi: अस्वीकार — साफ़ ना कह देना
definition: a refusal to do or accept something; the flat no said to a person, not the denial issued about a report
example: उसने मदद से साफ़ इनकार कर दिया। — He flatly refused to help.

hindi: अड़ियल विरोध — सही बात पर भी न मानने वाली दुश्मनी
definition: stubborn enmity that opposes a person on principle, refusing to agree with them even when they happen to be right
example: ये दलील नहीं, महज़ इनाद है — This is not argument, it is sheer stubborn opposition.

hindi: अनुग्रह — विशेष ध्यान और मेहरबानी
definition: favour shown by singling someone out for attention, warmer and more personal than a grace granted from on high
example: आपकी इनायत हमेशा याद रहेगी — Your favour will always be remembered.

hindi: हद से ज़्यादा — इतना कि बर्बाद हो जाए
definition: quantity gone past what plenty means, food or spending in excess that begins to be waste rather than abundance
example: खाने की इफ़रात ने आधा दस्तरख़्वान बर्बाद कर दिया। — The excess of food wasted half the spread.

hindi: आराम आना — बीमारी या नशे से उबरना
definition: the relief that comes as an illness or an intoxication lifts, recovery in progress rather than full soberness
example: दोपहर तक उसे कुछ इफ़ाक़ा हुआ। — By afternoon he felt some relief.

hindi: झूठ गढ़ना — बनावटी बात को सच की तरह फैलाना
definition: the act of concocting a falsehood and putting it about as truth, naming the fabricating rather than the charge produced; slander is the thing said, this is the making of it
example: इफ़्तिरा-परदाज़ी से किसी का भला नहीं होता — Nobody ever profited from fabricating lies.

hindi: फूट — एक इकाई का अलग-अलग हो जाना
definition: the splitting apart of what was once one body, used for communities and parties where separation means division rather than distance
example: क़ौम का इफ़्तिराक़ किसी दुश्मन से ज़्यादा नुक़सान करता है — A people's splitting apart harms them more than any enemy.

hindi: दिवालियापन — देने को कुछ न बचना
definition: poverty in the formal sense of having nothing left to settle with, the bankruptcy of a household after the money is gone
example: कारोबार डूबा और घर इफ़्लास तक पहुँच गया — The business sank and the household reached bankruptcy.

hindi: उपासना — तय किए हुए ढंग से की गई पूजा
definition: worship as the whole duty owed to God, performed in prescribed forms at prescribed times; a prayer may be improvised, this follows an order laid down
example: इबादत में दिल का हाज़िर होना ज़रूरी है — In worship the heart must be present.

hindi: शब्द-विन्यास — लिखे हुए वाक्य की भाषा और उसका चुना हुआ रूप
definition: the wording of a written passage, the phrasing actually chosen; what a text says on its surface as distinct from what it means
example: इबारत सख़्त थी, नीयत नहीं। — The wording was harsh; the intent was not.

hindi: आरंभ — किसी सिलसिले का पहला सिरा
definition: the beginning of a stretch of time or work, the point a thing starts from as against where it ends
example: कहानी की इब्तिदा उसी शहर से होती है। — The story's beginning is in that very city.

hindi: फँसाव — किसी बुरी चीज़ में उलझ जाना
definition: being caught up in an affliction or a vice that one cannot escape; names the entanglement itself, as a trial visited on a person
example: नशे की इब्तिला ने घर तबाह कर दिया। — Entanglement in drink destroyed the household.

hindi: शैतान — वह वजूद जिसने सजदे से इनकार किया
definition: the being who refused the command and became the tempter of humankind; named as one rebel, not evil in general
example: ग़ुरूर ने इब्लीस को गिराया था — Pride was what brought down the great rebel.

hindi: इनकार — ख़ुद रुक जाना, हिस्सा न लेना
definition: refusing to take part or proceed, a withholding chosen by the person rather than imposed on him
example: उसने वोट देने से इम्तिना किया। — He abstained from voting.

hindi: परीक्षा — जाँच, और जीवन की कठिन आज़माइश
definition: an examination, and beyond that any ordeal fate arranges; implies being tested rather than merely troubled
example: ये वक़्त हमारा इम्तिहान ले रहा है। — This period is putting us to the test.

hindi: रुक जाना — सुबह वो वक़्त जब खाना-पीना बंद हो जाता है
definition: the moment at dawn when eating and drinking must stop for the fast, and more widely the holding back of the hand from food
example: इम्साक से पहले पानी पी लो। — Drink water before the hour of abstaining.

hindi: फ़रमाइए — शायर से सुनाने की गुज़ारिश करने वाला शब्द
definition: the word the audience calls to invite a poet to begin or to continue reciting, an honorific request rather than an order; literally a bidding, used to hand the floor over
example: उस्ताद से सब ने कहा, इरशाद — Everyone said to the master poet, please begin.

hindi: दहशतगर्दी — डर फैलाकर लोगों को क़ाबू करना
definition: creating terror among people in order to control them; a threat scaled up from one person to a whole population
example: इरहाब से हुकूमत चलती नहीं, टिकती नहीं — Rule by terror neither runs nor lasts.

hindi: प्रेषण — भेजने की क्रिया
definition: the dispatching of something written or owed, the act of setting a letter or a sum on its way to another
example: रक़म का इर्साल कल कर दिया गया। — The sum was dispatched yesterday.

hindi: आरोप — किसी पर लगाया गया दोष
definition: a charge laid against someone, which may be true and still has to be proved; a fault is what a person did, this is what someone says they did
example: इल्ज़ाम लगाना आसान है, साबित करना मुश्किल — Levelling a charge is easy; proving it is hard.

hindi: गुहार — गिड़गिड़ाकर की गई विनती
definition: a pleading appeal made from helplessness; the word carries a tremble that an ordinary request does not
example: उसने जज के सामने इल्तिजा की कि बेटे को माफ़ कर दें। — She pleaded before the judge to forgive her son.

hindi: कृपा-दृष्टि — मुड़कर दी गई मेहरबान तवज्जोह
definition: the favour of turning to notice someone; attention given as a kindness by a person who was under no obligation to give it at all
example: उनके इल्तिफ़ात का शुक्रिया — Thank you for your kind notice of me.

hindi: विनम्र निवेदन — अदब के साथ की गई गुज़ारिश
definition: a request made softly and from below, asking a favour without claiming any right to it
example: मेरी इल्तिमास है कि एक बार सुन लीजिए। — My humble request is that you hear me once.

hindi: स्थगन — कार्यवाही को आगे की तारीख़ पर डालना
definition: the formal postponement of proceedings to a later date, an adjournment ordered by authority rather than an accidental delay
example: अदालत ने सुनवाई का इल्तिवा कर दिया — The court adjourned the hearing to a later date.

hindi: ज्ञान — सीख कर हासिल की हुई जानकारी का पूरा भंडार
definition: knowledge as a body of learning that someone has acquired and holds, not a single fact and not mere cleverness; where Hindi ज्ञान leans spiritual, this is the studied, teachable kind
example: उसे तारीख़ का गहरा इल्म है — He has deep knowledge of history.

hindi: अदृश्य का ज्ञान — जो हुआ नहीं या दिखता नहीं, उसकी ख़बर
definition: knowledge of what is hidden from sight and still to come, held to belong to the divine alone; not the guesswork people call foresight
example: मुझे इल्म-ए-ग़ैब नहीं कि कल क्या होगा — I have no knowledge of the unseen about tomorrow.

hindi: रोग की जड़ — वह ख़राबी जिससे बीमारी पैदा हो
definition: the underlying defect or cause that produces a disease, not the disease as felt; also an ingrained habit treated as an ailment of character
example: बुख़ार तो निशानी है, इल्लत कहीं और है। — The fever is a sign; the underlying ailment lies elsewhere.

hindi: अंतःप्रेरणा — दिल में अचानक डाली गई बात
definition: an inspiration cast into the heart from the unseen, lesser and far less binding than revelation given to a prophet
example: यह तरकीब उसे इल्हाम की तरह सूझी — The solution came to him like an inspiration.

hindi: भड़काना — ग़ुस्सा सुलगा देने की जान-बूझकर की गई कोशिश
definition: inciting a person or a crowd until their anger catches; the deliberate lighting of trouble that someone else will then burn in
example: उसकी तक़रीर इशतिआल के लिए काफ़ी थी — His speech was enough to incite them.

hindi: आंतरिक प्रकाश — दिल पर पड़ने वाली रोशनी जिससे हक़ीक़त खुले
definition: the inward illumination by which hidden truth becomes visible to the heart; light as the means of unveiling, not the unveiling itself
example: इशराक़ के बग़ैर ये मआनी नहीं खुलते — Without inward illumination these meanings do not open.

hindi: नख़रा — जान-बूझकर किया गया मोहक बहाना
definition: deliberate coquetry, the manner put on knowingly to draw someone in, where a charming gesture may be entirely unstudied
example: उसका इशवा किसी से छिपा नहीं है — Her studied coquetry is hidden from no one.

hindi: प्रकाशन — लिखी हुई चीज़ को जनता तक पहुँचाना
definition: publication, the putting out of written matter so that the public can read it; the issuing, not the machinery
example: किताब की इशाअत अगले महीने होगी। — The book will be published next month.

hindi: संकेत — बिना कहे समझाई गई बात
definition: a hint or gesture that carries meaning without words; also the nod that signals someone to begin
example: उसके इशारे पर सब खड़े हो गए। — At his signal everyone stood up.

hindi: प्रेम, अनुराग — जुनून की हद तक पहुँचा प्यार
definition: consuming love that reorganises an entire life around one person, pitched far past an English 'love' that also covers mangoes and weekends
example: उसको अपनी शायरी से इश्क़ है, लड़की से नहीं। — He's in love with his own poetry, not with the girl.

hindi: उत्कंठा — मिलने की बेचैन चाह
definition: keen eagerness to meet or to have something, the forward-leaning kind of wanting, more restless than a wish and more specific than appetite
example: उनसे मिलने का इश्तियाक़ बढ़ता जा रहा है — My eagerness to meet them keeps growing.

hindi: भूख की चाह — खाने की तबीयत, महज़ पेट का ख़ाली होना नहीं
definition: the appetite for food as a desire of the body, the wanting rather than the emptiness; hunger is a lack, this is the readiness to eat
example: दवा के बाद उसकी इश्तिहा लौट आई। — After the medicine his appetite for food came back.

hindi: विज्ञापन — सबके लिए निकाली गई सार्वजनिक सूचना
definition: a public notice put out for everyone to read, an advertisement or proclamation rather than a message meant for one person
example: अख़बार में गुमशुदगी का इश्तिहार छपा है। — A missing-person notice is printed in the paper.

hindi: अपव्यय — ज़रूरत और हक़ से आगे ख़र्च
definition: spending beyond what is needed or right, waste of money treated as a moral fault rather than poor budgeting
example: खाना फेंकना इसराफ़ है — Throwing away food is wasteful excess.

hindi: हठ — दलील सुनने के बाद भी अपनी बात पर अड़ना
definition: insisting on one's own position after the other side has given reasons against it; persistence that has stopped listening
example: उसके इसरार पर हम रुक गए — We stayed on at his insistence.

hindi: क्षमायाचना — ख़ुदा से माफ़ी माँगने का अमल
definition: the act of begging forgiveness from the almighty for one's sins, addressed upward rather than to the person wronged; repentance spoken as prayer
example: रात भर इस्तग़फ़ार में गुज़री — The whole night passed in seeking forgiveness.

hindi: अभियोग — अदालत में दायर किया गया इल्ज़ाम का दावा
definition: the prosecution's formal charge sheet filed before a magistrate; the written accusation that starts a criminal case, one step heavier than a complaint
example: पुलिस ने अदालत में इस्तग़ासा दाख़िल किया — The police filed the prosecution case in court.

hindi: रूपक — तुलना का शब्द हटाकर एक चीज़ को दूसरी कह देना
definition: a comparison with the likeness word removed, so the borrowed image stands in place of the thing itself and the reader must supply the link
example: यहाँ शमा इस्तिआरा है, सिर्फ़ मोमबत्ती नहीं — Here the candle is a metaphor, not merely a candle.

hindi: स्वागत — आने वाले को आगे बढ़कर लेना
definition: going forward to receive someone arriving, a welcome expressed as movement toward the guest rather than as words
example: पूरा गाँव उनके इस्तिक़बाल को निकला — The whole village came out to receive them.

hindi: दृढ़ता — काम पर लगातार टिके रहना
definition: constancy in pursuing a resolve over time, holding to a chosen course long after the first enthusiasm is gone
example: इस्तिक़लाल के बग़ैर कोई काम पूरा नहीं होता — Nothing is finished without constancy.

hindi: दृढ़ता — एक ही रास्ते पर जमे रहना
definition: steadfastness in holding to one course over a long time, a constancy that outlasts moments of courage
example: मुश्किल बरसों में उसकी इस्तिक़ामत नहीं डिगी — Through hard years his steadfastness did not waver.

hindi: मार्ग-निर्णय की प्रार्थना — कौन-सी राह बेहतर है, यह पूछने की दुआ
definition: a prayer asking God to show which of two choices is better, a request for guidance rather than for any thing one wants
example: रिश्ते से पहले उन्होंने इस्तिख़ारा किया — Before agreeing to the match they prayed for guidance.

hindi: निस्पृहता — किसी से कुछ न चाहने की हालत
definition: the state of needing nothing from anybody, a dignified refusal to depend on other people's money or favour
example: उसकी इस्तिग़ना ने उसे सबसे ऊँचा कर दिया — His self-sufficiency raised him above everyone.

hindi: क्षमा-याचना — बार-बार माफ़ी माँगना
definition: the practice of repeatedly asking God for forgiveness in words, a spoken devotion rather than the inner turning of repentance
example: वह इस्तिग़फ़ार पढ़ता रहा — He kept reciting the plea for forgiveness.

hindi: निमग्नता — इस क़दर डूबना कि आस-पास का होश न रहे
definition: total immersion in thought or contemplation to the point of losing the surroundings; engrossment still works, this has stopped noticing that it is working
example: वे इस्तिग़राक़ में थे, किसी की आवाज़ न सुनी — He was so immersed that he heard no one.

hindi: धोखे की करामत — बुरे आदमी से ज़ाहिर होने वाला ग़ैर-मामूली काम
definition: an extraordinary feat granted to a corrupt man as a slow trap rather than an honour; looks like a saint's wonder but leads its owner to ruin
example: उसकी ताक़त करामत नहीं, इस्तिदराज है — His power is no saintly wonder but a snare.

hindi: तर्क-प्रक्रिया — सुबूतों से नतीजा निकालना
definition: the act of reasoning from evidence to a conclusion, the method rather than the single argument; what a judgment performs on the material before it
example: जज ने अपने इस्तिदलाल में हर गवाही को तौला — In his reasoning the judge weighed every testimony.

hindi: याचना — विनम्रता से माँगने की क्रिया
definition: the making of a humble request in writing, the asking itself considered apart from the paper it is written on
example: मेरी इस्तिदुआ है कि एक बार सुन लीजिए। — My humble request is that you hear me once.

hindi: पूछताछ — साफ़ करने के लिए किया गया सवाल
definition: a formal asking for clarification about something already stated, seeking to understand rather than to trap; the polite register of questioning
example: अदालत ने वकील से इस्तिफ़सार किया — The court sought clarification from the lawyer.

hindi: निरंकुशता — एक ही हाथ में बेरोक-टोक ताक़त
definition: rule in which one authority answers to nobody, power without any check rather than power merely used harshly
example: इस्तिबदाद में सवाल पूछना ही जुर्म बन जाता है — Under despotism even asking a question becomes a crime.

hindi: विश्राम — इलाज के तौर पर पूरा आराम
definition: prescribed rest, lying still as part of a cure rather than for pleasure; the treatment given when the body must repair itself
example: तबीब ने हफ़्ते भर की इस्तिराहत लिखी है। — The physician has prescribed a week of rest.

hindi: पारिभाषिक शब्द — किसी फ़न में तय मानी वाला ख़ास लफ़्ज़
definition: a technical term whose meaning has been fixed by agreement inside one field of learning; an ordinary word drifts, this is pinned down by the discipline that uses it
example: तनक़ीद की अपनी इस्तिलाहें हैं — Criticism has its own technical terms.

hindi: साक्ष्य-आह्वान — गवाहों को बुलाना और पेश करना
definition: the calling of witnesses to attest a matter, producing testimony rather than giving it oneself
example: मुद्दई ने अपने दावे के लिए इस्तिशहाद किया। — The plaintiff called witnesses in support of his claim.

hindi: हक़दारी — किसी चीज़ पर बनता हुआ जायज़ दावा
definition: a claim to something the rules already grant you, an entitlement you may demand rather than a favour you must request
example: पेंशन उनका इस्तिहक़ाक़ है, एहसान नहीं — The pension is his entitlement, not a favour.

hindi: शोषण — किसी की मजबूरी या मेहनत से नाजायज़ फ़ायदा
definition: taking unfair profit from another's weakness or labour; exploitation dressed up as an arrangement both sides supposedly accepted
example: मज़दूरों का इस्तिहसाल यहाँ आम है — Exploitation of workers is common here.

hindi: व्यंग्यात्मक मज़ाक़ — गंभीर बनकर उड़ाया गया मज़ाक़
definition: mockery that pretends to take someone seriously while ridiculing them; scorn wearing a straight face so it cannot be answered
example: उसकी तारीफ़ में इस्तेहज़ा छुपा था — There was mockery hidden inside his praise.

hindi: पवित्रता — चरित्र और शील का अछूता रहना
definition: chastity and moral inviolability, purity guarded against violation by others rather than kept up by one's own effort; the word is defended, not practised
example: इस्मत की हिफ़ाज़त सबसे बड़ा फ़र्ज़ समझी जाती थी — Guarding chastity was held the highest duty.

hindi: सुधार — ग़लती को दुरुस्त करना
definition: the correcting of a fault in conduct, in writing or between people, done to put the thing right rather than to punish; reproach shames, this repairs
example: उस्ताद ने ग़ज़ल की इस्लाह की — The master corrected the ghazal.

hindi: बेअदबी — जिसका एहतराम बनता हो उसका अपमान
definition: insulting a person or thing that was owed respect; contempt aimed exactly where honour was due, which is what makes it grave
example: अदालत की इहानत पर उसे नोटिस मिला — He got a notice for contempt of court.

hindi: कष्ट पहुँचाना — किसी के दिए हुए दुख या चोट
definition: hurt inflicted by someone on another, pain that has an author; unlike ordinary pain, it points at whoever caused it
example: इलाज में थोड़ी ईज़ा तो होगी ही। — Some inflicted hurt is unavoidable in treatment.

hindi: प्रस्ताव और स्वीकृति — निकाह में कहा और माना जाने वाला वचन
definition: the spoken offer by one side and its acceptance by the other, the exact moment a marriage contract becomes valid; consent said aloud, not merely signed
example: ईजाब-ओ-क़बूल के बाद ही रजिस्टर पर दस्तख़त हुए — Only after the offer and acceptance were signatures put on the register.

hindi: प्रस्ताव और स्वीकृति — निकाह में की जाने वाली पेशकश और मंज़ूरी
definition: the offer and the acceptance spoken aloud that conclude a marriage contract, the moment it becomes binding
example: ईजाब-ओ-क़ुबूल के बाद सब ने मुबारकबाद दी। — After the offer and acceptance, everyone gave their congratulations.

hindi: पूर्ति — किए हुए वादे को पूरा करना
definition: the fulfilling of a promise, actually carrying out what the given word had undertaken
example: अहद का ईफ़ा ही आदमी की पहचान है। — Fulfilment of a promise is the measure of a man.

hindi: पृथक्ता की क़सम — शौहर का बीवी से दूर रहने का हलफ़
definition: a husband's sworn vow to abstain from his wife, an oath which the law itself times and then limits
example: ईला की मुद्दत गुज़र जाए तो निकाह ख़तरे में पड़ता है। — If the term of the abstinence vow passes, the marriage is at risk.

hindi: त्याग — अपनी ज़रूरत छोड़कर दूसरे को दे देना
definition: putting another's need above your own at real cost to yourself, sacrifice made in ordinary living rather than in death
example: भूखे रहकर मेहमान को खिलाना ईसार है — Staying hungry to feed a guest is self-sacrifice.

hindi: पुण्य-अर्पण — नेकी करके उसका सवाब मरने वाले को पहुँचाना
definition: performing a good deed and dedicating its reward to someone who has died, charity aimed past the living recipient at the dead
example: वालिदा के ईसाल-ए-सवाब के लिए खाना बाँटा गया — Food was distributed to send reward to his late mother.

hindi: गरुड़ — बड़ा और ताक़तवर शिकारी परिंदा
definition: the eagle among birds of prey, named for size and grip rather than the trained falcon's speed; it takes its game by force
example: उक़ाब ने झपट्टा मारा और शिकार उठा ले गया — The eagle swooped and carried off its prey.

hindi: मज़दूरी — काम या इस्तेमाल के बदले तय क़ीमत
definition: the price paid for labour or for borrowed equipment, charged per task rather than as monthly salary
example: मज़दूरों की उजरत शाम को दी जाती है — The workers' wages are paid in the evening.

hindi: सफ़ाई — माफ़ी के साथ पेश की गई वजह
definition: the reason offered alongside an apology to excuse a fault; the explaining half of saying sorry, which can also be refused
example: उसका उज़्र सुनकर बात रफ़ा-दफ़ा हो गई — His excuse was heard and the matter dropped.

hindi: माफ़ी माँगना — अदब के साथ ग़लती की पेशगी माफ़ी
definition: the act of apologising formally, the asking of pardon rather than the excuse or the regret itself
example: उसने सबके सामने उज़्र-ख़्वाही की। — He apologised before everyone.

hindi: मन का धुँधलापन — बिना ठोस वजह छाया सूनापन
definition: a low grey mood with no stated cause, plainly readable on the face; sadness needs a reason, this arrives without one
example: शाम होते ही एक उदासी सी छा जाती है — As evening falls a quiet gloom settles in.

hindi: शीर्षक — लिखे हुए के ऊपर दिया गया नाम या पता
definition: the heading written at the top of a written piece, the title under which it is addressed; it announces the letter before the letter speaks
example: मज़मून का उनवान ही सब कुछ कह देता है। — The heading of the essay says it all.

hindi: हेल-मेल की मिठास — साथ रहते-रहते पैदा हुआ लगाव
definition: the quiet fondness that grows from being around someone over time, gentler than love and warmer than mere acquaintance
