example: उस पुराने घर से एक उन्स है — I have a quiet fondness for that old house.

hindi: क्षितिज — जहाँ आसमान और ज़मीन मिलते दिखें
definition: the horizon where the sky appears to meet the earth, the far edge of what the eye can take in of the open sky
example: सूरज उफ़ुक़ के नीचे उतर गया। — The sun sank below the horizon.

hindi: छोटी तीर्थयात्रा — किसी भी समय की जाने वाली मक्का-यात्रा
definition: the lesser pilgrimage, which may be performed at any time of year and carries none of the fixed dates or obligation of the greater one
example: वह रमज़ान में उमरा कर आए — They performed the lesser pilgrimage during the fasting month.

hindi: बढ़िया — जिसकी बनावट और माल दोनों बेहतर हों
definition: of superior make and material, worth the higher price asked for it; praises the grade of a thing, where purity speaks only of what is mixed in
example: कपड़ा उम्दा है, इसीलिए दाम भी ज़्यादा हैं। — The cloth is of fine grade, which is why the price is higher too.

hindi: स्वाभाविक आयु — जितने साल इंसान सामान्यतः जीता है
definition: the natural span of years a life is expected to run, invoked when a death falls short of it or a life overruns it
example: उम्र-ए-तबई पूरी करके वो गए। — He went having completed his natural span of years.

hindi: बिन ढका — कपड़े या पर्दे के बग़ैर
definition: bare and uncovered by any garment; used of the body, and of a truth stripped of decoration
example: उसने उर्यां सच्चाई सबके सामने रख दी। — He laid the bare truth before everyone.

hindi: बे-लिबासी — ढके न होने की हालत
definition: the state of being uncovered by clothing; nakedness spoken of as a lasting condition, not a moment
example: ग़ुरबत की उर्यानी छुपाना मुश्किल है। — The nakedness of poverty is hard to hide.

hindi: संत का सालाना मेला — बुज़ुर्ग की मौत की सालगिरह पर मज़ार का जश्न
definition: the annual festival at a saint's shrine on the anniversary of his death, celebrated as a union with God rather than mourned as a loss
example: उर्स में हज़ारों लोग मज़ार पर जमा हुए — Thousands gathered at the shrine for the annual festival.

hindi: स्नेह, लगाव — धीरे-धीरे बना अपनापन
definition: gentle attachment grown out of nearness and habit, naming the affection that accumulated rather than the kind that struck
example: बरसों साथ रहते रहते दोनों में उल्फ़त हो गई। — Living side by side for years, a quiet fondness grew between them.

hindi: महारत — सिखाने लायक़ पक्का हुनर
definition: the standing of a master, the finished command that entitles one to teach a craft; the rank earned by skill, not the act of teaching itself
example: इतने बरसों की मश्क़ के बाद उसे उस्तादी मिली। — Mastery came to him after so many years of practice.

hindi: दृढ़ — मज़बूती से जमा हुआ और हिलने वाला नहीं
definition: firm and unshaken in a bond or resolve, steady in what one has undertaken to do
example: उनका रिश्ता बरसों से उस्तुवार है। — Their bond has stood firm for years.

hindi: भरोसा — किसी की बात पर यक़ीन कर लेना
definition: the everyday trust extended to a person's word, given easily and withdrawn once broken; the thing every deceit spends
example: एक बार एतबार टूटे तो जुड़ता नहीं — Once trust breaks it does not mend.

hindi: विश्वास — किसी पर टिक जाने लायक़ भरोसा
definition: considered confidence placed in someone's competence or character, the formal trust of institutions where एतबार is the trust of friends
example: हुकूमत को एतमाद का वोट मिला — The government won a vote of confidence.

hindi: स्वीकार — अपनी ग़लती ख़ुद मान लेना
definition: admitting one's own fault openly before anyone has forced it out; the confession an apology has to stand on to mean anything
example: उसने अपनी ग़लती का एतराफ़ कर लिया — He admitted his fault himself.

hindi: संतुलन — न ज़्यादा न कम, बीच का रास्ता
definition: the balanced middle in eating, spending, and feeling, held on purpose; a chosen proportion rather than a natural moderation
example: हर चीज़ में एतिदाल रखो, यही सेहत है। — Keep balance in everything; that is health.

hindi: परवाह — किसी बात को अहमियत देकर देखना
definition: the heed that treats a thing as worth minding; attention measured as concern, which is exactly why its absence is felt as an insult
example: किसी ने उसकी शिकायत पर एतिना नहीं की — Nobody paid his complaint any heed.

hindi: सम्मान — किसी का मान रखते हुए दिखाया गया आदर
definition: respect that must be visibly enacted, by standing, by softening the voice, by yielding the seat; esteem may stay private, this cannot
example: उस्ताद के एहतराम में सब खड़े हो गए — Everyone rose in respect for the teacher.

hindi: सावधानी — पहले से बरती गई हिफ़ाज़त
definition: caution exercised in advance to keep harm away; a deliberate practice rather than a nervous temperament
example: एहतियात के तौर पर दो कॉपियाँ रख लीं। — As a precaution I kept two copies.

hindi: श्रद्धा — किसी पर पक्का भरोसा और मान्यता
definition: firm confidence in the truth or holiness of someone, belief leaning toward personal trust rather than stated doctrine
example: उन्हें इस बुज़ुर्ग पर बड़ा ऐतिक़ाद है — He has great devotional trust in this elder.

hindi: दोष — जो किसी की क़दर घटाए
definition: a fault in a person or thing that lowers its worth in other eyes, moral or physical, and usually hidden by choice
example: हर शख़्स में कोई न कोई ऐब है — There is some fault in every person.

hindi: दोष ढूँढ़ना — दूसरों की कमियाँ खोजते रहने की आदत
definition: the habit of hunting for other people's faults and holding them up, the exact opposite of covering them; criticism responds to a fault, this goes looking for one
example: ऐब-जोई छोड़िए, अपना हिसाब कीजिए — Give up fault-finding and settle your own account.

hindi: विलासिता — भोग-विलास में दौलत उड़ाना
definition: spending money on pleasure and indulgence, dissipating wealth on appetite rather than on display or waste
example: बाप की कमाई ऐयाशी में उड़ा दी — He blew his father's earnings on indulgence.

hindi: पद — किसी को दिया गया दफ़्तरी दर्जा
definition: the post a person holds in an organisation, the seat with its duties rather than the honour that attaches to it
example: ओहदा छोड़ते ही उनकी सुनवाई कम हो गई — The moment he left the post he was heard much less.

hindi: संतगण — बुज़ुर्ग वलियों की जमात
definition: the saints taken together as a class of divine friends and the tradition they leave behind; a collective, not any one holy man
example: इस शहर में कई औलिया की ख़ानक़ाहें हैं — This city has the lodges of many saints.

hindi: मुक़दमेबाज़ी की जगह — वकीलों, मुहर्रिरों और तारीख़ों वाला दफ़्तर
definition: the courthouse as a place of paperwork, clerks and endless hearing dates; the daily grind of litigation rather than the majesty of justice
example: दस साल से कचहरी के चक्कर काट रहा हूँ — I have been trudging to the courthouse for ten years.

hindi: क़ब्र का पत्थर — जिस पर नाम और तारीख़ खुदी हो
definition: the inscribed headstone standing at a grave carrying the name, dates and a line of verse; the writing on the grave, not the grave beneath it
example: उसकी क़ब्र पर कतबा अब तक नहीं लगा — A headstone has still not been set on his grave.

hindi: भरण-पोषण की ज़िम्मेदारी — किसी का ख़र्च उठाना
definition: taking financial responsibility for someone's keep, standing surety for their food, clothing and schooling; money owed by undertaking, not affection given freely
example: दो यतीमों की कफ़ालत उन्होंने अपने ज़िम्मे ली — He took on the maintenance of two orphans.

hindi: ज़ामिन — जो किसी और की ज़िम्मेदारी उठाए
definition: the person who stands surety for another, answerable himself if the one he vouched for fails
example: क़र्ज़ के लिए एक कफ़ील का होना ज़रूरी था। — A surety was required before the loan could be given.

hindi: प्रायश्चित — टूटी हुई क़सम का बदला चुकाना
definition: the expiation owed for an oath once broken, paid in fasting or in feeding the poor to settle the lapse
example: क़सम तोड़ने पर उसने कफ़्फ़ारा अदा किया। — Having broken his oath, he paid the expiation.

hindi: जूता — अदबी ज़बान में पाँव का पहनावा
definition: a shoe for the feet, named in formal or literary Urdu where ordinary speech uses a plainer word
example: आस्ताने पर कफ़्श उतारकर दाख़िल हुआ। — He entered the shrine after taking off his shoes.

hindi: गहरा नीला — धुँधले आसमान जैसा रंग
definition: dark blue verging on grey; a colour named for the smoky sky rather than for any dye
example: कबूद आसमान के नीचे ख़ेमे लगे थे। — Tents stood under a dark blue sky.

hindi: नासमझी — अक़्ल की कमी से की गई भूल
definition: the shortfall of sense that leads to foolish behaviour, blamed as a lack rather than an illness; stupidity, never derangement
example: ये सौदा उसकी कम-अक़्ली का नतीजा था। — This deal was the result of his foolishness.

hindi: छिछला — थोड़ी सी बात से बहक जाने वाला
definition: unable to carry fortune or power gracefully, turning boastful or cruel the moment status arrives
example: पैसा आते ही वो कम-ज़र्फ़ निकला। — The moment money came, he showed how small he was.

hindi: अल्पवयस्क — बहुत छोटी उम्र का
definition: of too few years for what is being asked, marking a young person as under the age the situation needs
example: इतना बड़ा बोझ कम-सिन कंधों पर नहीं डाला जाता। — Such a load is not put on young shoulders.

hindi: फंदेदार रस्सी — जिससे घोड़ा पकड़ा या दीवार चढ़ी जाए
definition: the noosed rope thrown to catch a running horse or to scale a wall; a snare that is thrown by hand, where a net is laid and waited on
example: उसने कमंद फेंक कर जंगली घोड़े को क़ाबू किया — He threw the lasso and brought the wild horse under control.

hindi: ज़री का भारी कपड़ा — जिस पर सुनहरे बेल-बूटे बुने हों
definition: a heavy woven silk carrying raised patterns worked in gold thread; costlier than plain lustrous cloth because the design is woven, not printed
example: शादी का जोड़ा कमख़्वाब का बना था। — The wedding outfit was made of gold brocade.

hindi: पटका — कमर पर बाँधा जाने वाला पट्टा
definition: the band tied round the waist over a garment, holding it closed and carrying what the wearer needs
example: उसने कमरबंद में ख़ंजर छुपा रखा था। — He kept a dagger hidden in his waistband.

hindi: धनुष — तीर चलाने का झुका हुआ हथियार
definition: the archer's bow from which an arrow is shot, and by extension any curved arc; also the command a leader is handed
example: उसने कमान खींचकर निशाना साधा — He drew the bow and took aim.

hindi: घात की जगह — छिपकर वार करने का ठिकाना
definition: the hiding place from which an ambush is sprung, the position rather than the snare or the attack itself
example: दुश्मन कमीन-गाह में बैठा था — The enemy sat in ambush.

hindi: कृपा — बड़े की ओर से की गई मेहरबानी
definition: a kindness granted from a position of height, so accepting it acknowledges the giver's superiority, unlike help between equals
example: यह सब आपका करम है — All of this is your grace.

hindi: बुज़ुर्ग की करामात — वली के हाथों ज़ाहिर होने वाला ग़ैर-मामूली काम
definition: an extraordinary act appearing through a saint rather than a prophet, given as honour and not as proof; smaller in claim than a prophet's miracle
example: लोग उस दरवेश की करामतें सुनाते हैं — People recount that dervish's wonders.

hindi: उदार-चरित्र — जो बदले की उम्मीद बिना दे
definition: noble in giving, generous out of character rather than calculation and expecting nothing at all in return
example: करीम इंसान एहसान जताता नहीं — A truly generous man never reminds you of the favour.

hindi: गिद्ध — मरे हुए जानवर पर पलने वाला परिंदा
definition: the vulture among large birds, which feeds on carrion instead of hunting live game; it names a man who profits off others' ruin
example: लाश के गिर्द कर्गस मंडराने लगे — Vultures began circling the corpse.

hindi: पीड़ा — जान निकाल देने वाली तकलीफ़
definition: pain severe enough to occupy the whole person, agony of body or mind; deeper than the ordinary word for hurting
example: उस रात का कर्ब वो भूल नहीं सकता। — He cannot forget the agony of that night.

hindi: गोटे का तार — रेशम पर लिपटा सोने-चाँदी का तार
definition: gold or silver wire twisted around a silk core to make embroidery thread; the word names the thread's making
example: कारीगर कलाबत्तू से बेल बना रहा था। — The craftsman was working a vine in twisted gold thread.

hindi: खींचातानी — दो तरफ़ से खिंचाव, कोई फ़ैसला नहीं
definition: a pulling dispute between two sides, or between two urges inside one person, that neither can finish; names the tug, never the verdict
example: जाऊँ या न जाऊँ, इसी कशमकश में रात कट गई — Go or not go: the night passed in that tug of war.

hindi: खिंचाव — जो अपनी ओर खींचे
definition: the magnetic pull one person or place has on others, felt even when nothing in the appearance is beautiful; attraction as a force rather than a quality
example: उसकी बातों में एक अजीब कशिश है — There is a strange pull in the way he talks.

hindi: खेती करने वाला — जो फ़सल उगाता है
definition: one whose occupation is raising crops, naming the trade of cultivation rather than the village standing of a farmer
example: इस इलाक़े के कश्तकार गन्ना उगाते हैं। — The cultivators of this area grow sugarcane.

hindi: आंतरिक उद्घाटन — रियाज़त से दिल पर खुलने वाला अदृश्य ज्ञान
definition: an unveiling in which hidden truth opens directly on the heart without reasoning; inward disclosure, not information learned from outside
example: ये बात उन्हें कश्फ़ से मालूम हुई — This was disclosed to him by inward unveiling.

hindi: उधेड़बुन — दो तरफ़ खिंचती हुई हालत
definition: the struggle of being pulled two ways at once, inside the mind or between parties; a tug, where the others are a push
example: जाऊँ या न जाऊँ, इसी कश्मकश में रात गुज़र गई — The night passed in the struggle of whether to go.

hindi: हलकी टीस — मीठा-सा दर्द जो जाता नहीं
definition: a small ache that keeps returning and is half enjoyed, sweet rather than sharp; English 'pang' misses the affection inside it
example: पुराने घर की याद में आज भी कसक है — Remembering the old house still leaves a small ache.

hindi: आकाशगंगा — रात के आसमान में तारों की सफ़ेद पट्टी
definition: the galaxy seen as a band of countless stars laid across the night, rather than any single star or constellation
example: गाँव के आसमान पर कहकशाँ साफ़ दिखाई देती है। — The milky way is clearly visible in the village sky.

hindi: मिस्री की डली — साफ़ की हुई चीनी का सख़्त टुकड़ा
definition: a hard lump of refined sugar used to sweeten food or drink, and the stock image for anything sweet on the tongue
example: चाय में क़ंद की डली डाली। — He dropped a lump of sugar into the tea.

hindi: लालटेन — शीशे या काग़ज़ में ढकी हुई रौशनी
definition: a covered lantern whose flame is shielded from wind, made to be carried outdoors rather than set indoors
example: क़ंदील उठा कर वह आगे चला — Carrying a lantern, he walked ahead.

hindi: काल — मौत का वह फ़ैसला जो टाला नहीं जा सकता
definition: death arriving as a decree already passed, the sentence rather than the hour; used when a person is spoken of as caught by something they could not outrun
example: सफ़र में ही उसे क़ज़ा आ गई — Death overtook him while still travelling.

hindi: संबंध-विच्छेद — रिश्ता जान-बूझकर तोड़ देना
definition: the deliberate severing of a relationship, a chosen end to all contact rather than a separation imposed by distance or fate
example: एक बहस के बाद उसने क़तअ-ताल्लुक़ कर लिया — After one argument he severed the relationship entirely.

hindi: बूँद — पानी की एक अकेली बूँद
definition: a single drop of water counted one by one, the smallest unit rain or tears break into rather than the falling water as a whole
example: पसीने का एक क़तरा उसकी पेशानी से ढलक गया। — A single drop of sweat slid from his forehead.

hindi: जनसंहार — निहत्थी भीड़ को मार डालना
definition: a massacre, the mass killing of people who could not fight back, quite distinct from deaths in battle
example: शहर में क़त्ल-ए-आम की ख़बर आई — News came of a massacre in the city.

hindi: गुणग्राही — किसी हुनर की सही क़ीमत पहचानने वाला
definition: a listener who can recognise the worth of a performance and values it correctly; a fan is loyal to a person, this one is loyal to quality and would praise a rival for the same craft
example: फ़नकार को एक क़द्रदान चाहिए, भीड़ नहीं — An artist needs one discerning listener, not a crowd.

hindi: संतोष — जो है उसी में तृप्ति
definition: contentment with what one already has, practised as a discipline rather than felt as a passing mood
example: कम कमाई है, मगर क़नाअत भी है। — The income is small, but there is contentment too.

hindi: पिंजरा — जिसमें परिंदा बंद रखा जाए
definition: the cage that holds a bird, the opposite of both nest and flight; of a person it names comfortable confinement rather than a prison of stone
example: क़फ़स में रह कर भी वो उड़ान के ख़्वाब देखता है — Even in the cage he dreams of flight.

hindi: लंबा चोग़ा — कमर पर बँधने वाला दरबारी लिबास
definition: a long loose outer robe worn over other clothes and gathered at the waist; formal court dress rather than a wrap
example: अमीर ने ज़री की क़बा पहनकर दरबार में क़दम रखा। — The noble entered the court wearing a gold-threaded robe.

hindi: अधिकार जमाना — किसी जगह पर क़ाबिज़ हो जाना
definition: physical possession of a property whether or not ownership follows, holding a place by occupying it
example: ख़ाली मकान पर किसी ने क़ब्ज़ा कर लिया — Someone took possession of the empty house.

hindi: नेतृत्व — आगे बढ़कर राह दिखाना
definition: leadership as a function, the act and authority of commanding others, distinct from whichever person happens to hold it
example: तहरीक की क़यादत नौजवानों के हाथ आई — Leadership of the movement passed to the young.

hindi: ठहराव — कहीं कुछ वक़्त के लिए रुकना
definition: a temporary stay in a place one does not belong to, halting for a while rather than settling down
example: दिल्ली में उनका क़याम तीन दिन का था — Their stay in Delhi was of three days.

hindi: प्रलय — वह दिन जब सब उठाए जाएँगे और हिसाब होगा
definition: the last day on which the dead are raised and judged, and in ordinary speech any calamity that feels final; the word carries both the doctrine and the exclamation
example: उस ख़बर ने क़यामत ढा दी — That news brought down a catastrophe.

hindi: अनुमान — जो मालूम है उससे अंदाज़ा लगाना
definition: inference drawn by analogy from what is already known, a conclusion reached without direct proof; reasoning from evidence is safe, this leans on likeness and may mislead
example: यह सिर्फ़ मेरा क़यास है, यक़ीन नहीं — This is only my inference, not a certainty.

hindi: निकटता का संबंध — ख़ून या रिश्ते की नज़दीकी
definition: closeness of relation by blood or marriage, the degree that makes someone a near relative; measures nearness of kinship, where friendship measures affection
example: क़राबत का लिहाज़ करके उसने चुप्पी साध ली — Out of regard for kinship he kept silent.

hindi: स्थिरता — बेचैनी के बाद ठहर जाना
definition: the stillness that follows restlessness, a body or heart that has stopped tossing; relief shows in ease, this shows in stillness
example: दर्द थमा तो ज़रा क़रार आया। — When the pain stopped, some stillness came.

hindi: प्रस्ताव — किसी सभा में पारित रस्मी फ़ैसला
definition: a formal resolution passed by an assembly, recording a collective position rather than ordering anybody to move
example: इजलास ने अमन की क़रारदाद मंज़ूर की — The assembly passed a resolution for peace.

hindi: संकेत-चिह्न — जिससे बात का अंदाज़ा लगे
definition: a circumstantial indication pointing to a conclusion without proving it outright; a chain of these can convict where direct evidence is missing
example: कोई गवाह नहीं, बस एक क़रीना हाथ लगा है — There is no witness, only one circumstantial indication.

hindi: ऋण — लौटाने की शर्त पर लिया गया धन
definition: money borrowed under an obligation to return it, debt as a standing burden rather than a casual loan between friends
example: शादी का क़र्ज़ अब तक नहीं उतरा — The debt from the wedding is still not paid off.

hindi: ऋणदाता — जिसका क़र्ज़ लौटाना है
definition: the creditor, the one to whom money is owed and who has the standing to demand its return
example: क़र्ज़-ख़्वाह हर दूसरे दिन दरवाज़े पर आ जाता है — The creditor turns up at the door every other day.

hindi: रांगे की परत — बर्तन पर चढ़ाई जाने वाली चमकदार तह
definition: the thin bright coating laid over a vessel to protect it and hide the metal beneath; it covers, where burnishing brings out what is already there
example: देगची की क़लई उतर गई है, दोबारा करानी है। — The tinning of the pot has come off; it must be done again.

hindi: काटा हुआ — क़लम फेरकर रद्द किया गया
definition: struck out by the pen, describing written words cancelled with a stroke so they remain visible but no longer count
example: आख़िरी सतर क़लम-ज़द कर दी गई। — The last line was struck out.

hindi: अधिकार-क्षेत्र — जहाँ तक किसी का हुक्म चलता हो
definition: the reach of someone's rule or jurisdiction, the exact limit up to which their orders still have force
example: यह मामला हमारी क़लमरौ से बाहर है — This matter falls outside our jurisdiction.

hindi: हृदय — भावनाओं और नीयत का केंद्र
definition: the heart in its formal and religious register, the seat of intention and inner state, used where the everyday word would sound too light
example: क़ल्ब साफ़ हो तो बात असर करती है — If the heart is clean, words carry weight.

hindi: क़व्वाली गाने वाला — दरगाह पर मंडली के साथ गाने वाला
definition: a devotional singer who performs with a group, clapping and chorus behind him, at a shrine gathering rather than a concert hall
example: क़व्वाल ने आँख बंद करके गाना शुरू किया — The devotional singer closed his eyes and began.

hindi: सूफ़ी गायन — मंडली और तालियों के साथ गाया जाने वाला भक्ति-संगीत
definition: the devotional group singing performed at shrines, built on repetition and rising tempo so that listeners are carried into a state rather than merely entertained
example: क़व्वाली सुनते-सुनते आधी रात हो गई — It turned midnight as we went on listening to the qawwali.

hindi: झूठी क़सम — जान-बूझकर झूठ पर खाई गई क़सम
definition: a false oath sworn knowingly, perjury counted as sin quite as much as crime
example: क़सम-ए-दुरोग़ खाकर वो बच तो गया, चैन खो बैठा। — He escaped by a false oath, but lost his peace.

hindi: प्रशस्ति-काव्य — किसी की तारीफ़ में लिखी लंबी नज़्म
definition: a long formal poem written in praise of a patron or a saint, the composed and public form that open praise takes on the page
example: उसने अपने उस्ताद की शान में क़सीदा लिखा — He wrote an ode in his teacher's honour.

hindi: छोटा शहर — गाँव से बड़ा, शहर से छोटा
definition: a small town with a market of its own, larger than a settlement of farmers yet without a city's anonymity
example: वह पढ़ने शहर गया, पर क़स्बा नहीं भूला — He went to the city to study but never forgot the town.

hindi: महल — शाही या भव्य इमारत
definition: a palace, a dwelling built for display of power, where a house is built merely for living in
example: उसका मकान नहीं, क़स्र मालूम होता है — That is not a house, it looks like a palace.

hindi: क़साई — गोश्त काटने और बेचने वाला
definition: the butcher whose trade is cutting up and selling meat, named for the shop and the knife rather than for any ritual duty
example: क़स्साब से एक किलो गोश्त लिया। — He bought a kilo of meat from the butcher.

hindi: ठहाका — ज़ोर की खुली हँसी
definition: a loud burst of laughter that fills the room it happens in; the sound counted as one event rather than described as a mood
example: उसके जवाब पर क़हक़हा गूँज उठा — A burst of laughter rang out at his reply.

hindi: अकाल — अन्न-जल का घोर अभाव
definition: famine, the hunger that follows when drought has destroyed the crop; names the shortage of food, not of rain
example: क़हत के दिनों में अनाज सोने के भाव बिका। — In the famine days grain sold at the price of gold.

hindi: अकालग्रस्त — जिस इलाक़े पर अकाल पड़ा हो
definition: of a region or people struck by famine and needing relief; describes who the scarcity of food fell upon
example: क़हत-ज़दा इलाक़ों में राशन भेजा गया — Rations were sent to the famine-struck areas.

hindi: प्रकोप — टूट पड़ने वाला ग़ुस्सा या आफ़त
definition: wrath that falls on someone like a calamity, larger and more sudden than any single act of torment
example: उसकी बेरुख़ी क़हर से कम नहीं — Her coldness is nothing less than a calamity.

hindi: आश्वस्त — जो दलील मानकर सहमत हो गया हो
definition: convinced by another's argument and willing to admit it, persuaded through reasoning rather than pressure
example: आख़िर वो मेरी बात का क़ाइल हो गया। — In the end he was convinced by my argument.

hindi: शरई मुंसिफ़ — धार्मिक क़ानून के मुताबिक़ फ़ैसला करने वाला
definition: a judge who decides disputes under religious law, especially in marriage and inheritance; authority drawn from scripture rather than from the state
example: निकाह का झगड़ा क़ाज़ी के सामने रखा गया — The marriage dispute was placed before the qazi.

hindi: सर्वशक्तिमान — हर चीज़ पर क़ुदरत रखने वाला
definition: having absolute power over everything, said of God as the attribute invoked when nothing short of omnipotence will help
example: वह हर चीज़ पर क़ादिर है — He has power over every thing.

hindi: तुक — हर शेर में बदलता हुआ तुकांत शब्द
definition: the rhyming word that changes from couplet to couplet while keeping the same sound, standing just before the fixed refrain in every rhyming line
example: क़ाफ़िया तंग हो गया, शेर नहीं बन रहा — The rhyme has run short; the couplet will not come.

hindi: कारवाँ — साथ चलने वालों का जत्था
definition: a company of travellers moving together for safety, the group and its movement rather than the route they take
example: क़ाफ़िला रात होने से पहले पहुँच गया — The caravan arrived before nightfall.

hindi: क़द — खड़े होने पर शरीर की ऊँचाई
definition: stature, the height and the line of a standing body, praised in verse the way a cypress is praised
example: उसकी क़ामत सर्व जैसी है — His stature is like a cypress.

hindi: देह-ढाँचा — रूह के जाने के बाद बचा हुआ जिस्म का साँचा
definition: the body regarded as the mould the soul was poured into and has now left, an empty form rather than a dead person
example: रूह निकल गई, क़ालिब पड़ा रह गया — The soul left; the empty form lay behind.

hindi: संदेशवाहक — ख़बर लेकर आने-जाने वाला
definition: the messenger who carries word between separated people, a trusted person sent rather than any postal arrangement
example: क़ासिद अब तक लौटकर नहीं आया — The messenger has not come back yet.

hindi: खंड-कविता — कुछ शेरों की एक जुड़ी हुई छोटी नज़्म
definition: a short poem of a few verses making one continuous written statement, complete but smaller than a full composition
example: उसने इस मौक़े पर एक क़िता कहा। — He composed a short piece for the occasion.

hindi: उपासना-दिशा — जिस ओर मुँह करके इबादत की जाए
definition: the fixed direction a worshipper faces during ritual prayer, and by extension whatever a whole life is oriented toward
example: मुसाफ़िर ने क़िबला ढूँढ़कर नमाज़ पढ़ी — The traveller found the prayer direction and prayed.

hindi: वाचन-शैली — पढ़ने का स्वर और तरीक़ा
definition: the manner and melody of reciting scripture aloud, the technique of recitation rather than the act of doing it
example: उनकी क़िरअत सुनकर लोग रो पड़े — People wept at his manner of recitation.

hindi: पाठ — सही उच्चारण के साथ पढ़ कर सुनाना
definition: reading a text aloud with correct pronunciation and cadence, an art judged by the ear; private study takes in the meaning, this performs the words
example: उसकी क़िराअत सुन कर महफ़िल ख़ामोश हो गई — The gathering fell silent at his recitation.

hindi: कमी — किसी ज़रूरी चीज़ का कम पड़ जाना
definition: scarcity of a needed thing, shortage in the supply itself rather than lack of money to buy it
example: गाँव में पानी की क़िल्लत हो गई — A scarcity of water arose in the village.

hindi: पकी हुई चाशनी — जिसे गाढ़ा होने तक उबाला गया हो
definition: sugar syrup boiled down to a set thickness for sweets or paan, judged by consistency where plain syrup is judged by sweetness
example: क़िवाम सही तार पर आ गया है। — The thickened syrup has come to the right thread.

hindi: बदले का हक़ — क़ानूनन बराबर का दंड
definition: lawful retribution equal to the injury done, revenge regulated and awarded rather than seized privately
example: अदालत ने क़िसास का फ़ैसला सुनाया — The court awarded lawful retribution.

hindi: नसीब का पलटता पहलू — अच्छा या बुरा दौर
definition: luck as the thing that swings, generous one year and cruel the next; the everyday, negotiable face of fate
example: क़िस्मत ने आख़िरकार पलटी मारी। — Luck finally turned.

hindi: आस-भंग — रहमत तक से उम्मीद तोड़ लेना
definition: despair carried to the point of giving up on mercy itself, treated as a moral fault rather than a passing mood
example: क़ुनूत को गुनाह कहा गया है — Despairing of mercy has been called a sin.

hindi: ताला — दरवाज़े को बंद रखने वाला यंत्र
definition: the lock that keeps a door shut against others, security placed on the house rather than kept by a person
example: जाते वक़्त दरवाज़े पर क़ुफ़्ल लगा दो — Put the lock on the door when you leave.

hindi: स्वीकृति — पेशकश को मान लेना
definition: the acceptance that closes an offer, the answer which turns a proposal into a binding agreement
example: क़ुबूलियत के बाद पीछे हटना मुमकिन नहीं। — After acceptance, withdrawal is not possible.

hindi: फ़ाख़्ता जैसी चिड़िया — जिसकी बोली में विरह सुना जाता है
definition: the ring-dove of poetry, a songbird whose cooing is heard as mourning rather than courtship; it grieves where the nightingale pleads
example: सर्व के पेड़ पर क़ुमरी बोल रही थी — A ring-dove was calling from the cypress tree.

hindi: जायदाद रोकी जाना — अदालत के हुक्म से माल पर पाबंदी
definition: the court-ordered attachment of a debtor's property so that it cannot be sold or moved; seizure to secure a claim, not punishment
example: क़र्ज़ न चुकाने पर मकान की क़ुर्क़ी हो गई — The house was attached when the loan went unpaid.

hindi: नज़दीकी — दिलों या फ़ासले की निकटता
definition: nearness to someone, of distance or of feeling, a closeness short of full union but past mere acquaintance
example: इन दिनों उन दोनों में क़ुर्बत बढ़ी है — Closeness between the two has grown lately.

hindi: बलिदान किया हुआ — किसी के लिए अर्पित
definition: sacrificed for someone or something, carrying the older sense of an offering, so it weighs more than merely giving something up
example: माँ ने अपनी ख़ुशियाँ बच्चों पर क़ुर्बान कर दीं — The mother sacrificed her own happiness for her children.

hindi: तीजा — मौत के तीसरे दिन होने वाला दुआ का जमावड़ा
definition: the gathering held on the third day after a death for recitation and prayer, the first of the memorial dates a family must host
example: क़ुल इतवार को है, आप ज़रूर आइएगा — The third-day prayer is on Sunday, please do come.

hindi: रोज़ का खाना — बस उतना जितने से जान चले
definition: the plain daily food that keeps a person alive, subsistence rather than a meal enjoyed or a store laid by
example: मेहनत से अपना क़ूत कमाता है। — He earns his daily bread by labour.

hindi: बस जीने भर का खाना — इतना कि आदमी मरे नहीं
definition: food barely enough to keep one from dying, subsistence measured at its lowest point rather than merely modest daily bread
example: मज़दूर को क़ूत-ए-लायमूत भी मुश्किल से मिलता है। — The labourer barely gets food enough to stay alive.

hindi: बंदी अवस्था — आज़ादी छीनकर बंद रखना
definition: confinement imposed as a punishment or a restraint, being shut in rather than merely being watched or restricted
example: उसे तीन साल की क़ैद हुई — He was given three years' imprisonment.

hindi: दोपहर की झपकी — दिन में थोड़ी देर सोना
definition: the short midday sleep taken to restore the body, a brief and habitual doze; distinguished from rest ordered for an illness
example: क़ैलूला कर लें, शाम तक तबीअत सँभल जाएगी। — Take a midday nap; you will feel steadier by evening.

hindi: कही हुई बात — जिस पर आदमी क़ायम रहे
definition: one's given word, judged by whether the speaker stands by it, so it names the utterance rather than the ceremony of vowing
example: मर्द अपने क़ौल का पक्का होता है — A man stands by his given word.

hindi: वचन का धनी — जो कही हुई बात हर हाल में निभाए
definition: said of a person whose given word can be relied on, steadfast in keeping whatever he promised
example: वो क़ौल का पक्का है, लिखा-पढ़ी की ज़रूरत नहीं। — He is true to his word; no paperwork is needed.

hindi: वचन और इक़रार — बात तय करके पक्की कर लेना
definition: the settled word and agreement reached between two people, a promise talked through and fixed rather than blurted out
example: दोनों घरानों में क़ौल-ओ-क़रार हो चुका है। — The word and agreement between the two families is already settled.

hindi: इंद्रधनुष — बारिश के बाद आसमान पर बनी रंगीन कमान
definition: the rainbow, the coloured arc that appears in the sky when sunlight meets falling rain, a sign that the shower is ending
example: बारिश थमते ही मशरिक़ में क़ौस-ए-क़ुज़ह दिखाई दी। — A rainbow appeared in the east as soon as the rain stopped.

hindi: लिपिक — हाथ से लिखने वाला लेखक
definition: the scribe who writes a text out by hand, employed for his hand and not for his words; he copies, he does not compose
example: कातिब ने पूरी किताब तीन महीने में लिखी। — The scribe wrote out the whole book in three months.

hindi: कार्यकर्ता — किसी काम या तंज़ीम को चलाने वाला आदमी
definition: the person who carries out the running work of an office or organisation; works by charge and errand, not by the strength of his body
example: दफ़्तर का कारकुन सारे काग़ज़ात सँभालता है। — The office worker handles all the papers.

hindi: कार्यशाला — कारीगर के काम करने की जगह
definition: the room or bench where a craftsman actually works, with his tools around him; the workshop of a maker rather than a plant full of wage labour
example: उस्ताद की कारगाह में औज़ार क़तार से लगे थे। — In the master's workshop the tools stood in a row.

hindi: क़ाफ़िला — साथ चलने वाले मुसाफ़िरों का दल
definition: a company of travellers moving together for safety, a group whose journey is shared rather than solitary
example: कारवाँ शाम तक अगले पड़ाव पहुँच जाएगा — The caravan will reach the next halt by evening.

hindi: खेती — बीज बोकर उगाने का काम
definition: the act of putting seed into ground and raising it, cultivation as work done rather than as land held
example: इस ज़मीन पर गेहूँ की काश्त होती है। — Wheat is cultivated on this land.

hindi: लिपिकर्म — हाथ से लिखकर नक़ल उतारने का पेशा
definition: the craft of copying writing out by hand as a paid trade; the labour of transcription, judged by accuracy rather than by beauty of the letters
example: पुरानी किताबें किताबत से तैयार होती थीं। — Old books were prepared by hand-copying.

hindi: संकेत — सीधे कहे बग़ैर घुमा-फिराकर कही गई बात
definition: an indirect expression that points at its meaning without naming it, letting the listener arrive at what politeness or danger forbids saying outright
example: उन्होंने सीधे कुछ नहीं कहा, किनाया काफ़ी था — He said nothing directly; the indirect hint was enough.

hindi: मितव्यय — कम ख़र्च में काम चलाना
definition: economy in spending, making money go further by using less rather than by earning any more
example: किफ़ायत से चलाओ तो तनख़्वाह काफ़ी है — Run it economically and the salary is enough.

hindi: मितव्ययिता — सोच-समझकर ख़र्च करने की आदत
definition: thrift as a settled habit of life, the disposition to spend carefully rather than one occasion of economy
example: उसकी किफ़ायत-शिआरी ने बुरे दिनों में बचा लिया — His habitual thrift saved him in the bad days.

hindi: ज़री का रेशम — सोने-चाँदी के तार से बुना भारी कपड़ा
definition: heavy silk cloth woven through with gold or silver thread; brocade made for weight and display, not comfort
example: किमख़ाब का जोड़ा सिर्फ़ शादी में निकलता है। — The brocade outfit comes out only for weddings.

hindi: बैर — दिल में पाली गई पुरानी दुश्मनी
definition: a grudge kept alive quietly over years; hostility stored away rather than expressed, waiting for the occasion that will let it out
example: उसने बरसों से दिल में कीना पाल रखा था — He had nursed a grudge for years.

hindi: मैल — झगड़े के बाद दिल में बची तलछट
definition: the residue of bitterness left in a heart after a quarrel, clouding closeness without quite ending the relationship
example: माफ़ी के बाद भी थोड़ी कुदूरत रह गई — Even after the apology a little bitterness stayed.

hindi: परिवार का जत्था — साथ रहने वाले सब लोग
definition: the working household of relatives who live and eat together, smaller than a lineage and larger than parents with children
example: पूरा कुनबा एक ही छत के नीचे रहता है — The whole household lives under one roof.

hindi: ऊँची टोपी — पगड़ी के नीचे या अकेली पहनी जाती है
definition: a tall stiff cap worn on the head under a turban or by itself; a shaped cap, never a wound cloth
example: उसकी नुकीली कुलाह दूर से पहचानी जाती थी। — His pointed cap was recognisable from far off.

hindi: सूर्यग्रहण — सूरज का ढँक जाना
definition: a solar eclipse in which the sun's light is covered in the daytime sky, distinguished from the darkening of the moon at night
example: कुसूफ़ के वक़्त परिंदे ख़ामोश हो गए। — The birds went silent during the solar eclipse.

hindi: प्राचीन उम्र का — बहुत पुराना और बूढ़ा
definition: old with the weight of many years, applied to trees, houses, and institutions as readily as to an aged person
example: आँगन में एक कुहन-साल बरगद खड़ा है। — An aged banyan of many years stands in the courtyard.

hindi: कोहरा — हवा में लटकी हुई भाप की धुँध
definition: dense mist, moisture hanging thick enough to hide what stands near, unlike moisture that merely dampens surfaces
example: सुबह के कुहर में सामने की सड़क भी नहीं दिखी। — In the morning fog even the road ahead was invisible.

hindi: प्रस्थान — पड़ाव उठाकर आगे बढ़ जाना
definition: striking camp and moving on, a departure that leaves the place empty behind it; used for armies and caravans and, in elegy, for dying
example: कारवाँ ने सुबह होते ही कूच कर दिया — The caravan struck camp and moved on at first light.

hindi: तंग गली — मोहल्ले के अंदर का रास्ता
definition: a narrow residential lane inside a quarter, the neighbourhood's own passage rather than a road the city built
example: यह कूचा शाम को बिलकुल सुनसान हो जाता है — This lane becomes completely deserted by evening.

hindi: सुरूर — किसी चीज़ के असर से आया हल्का नशा
definition: the pleasurable intoxication a sound, a scent or a drink leaves behind, a mood settling over the senses rather than a feeling in the heart
example: उस धुन में अजीब कैफ़ था — There was a strange intoxication in that melody.

hindi: नशा लाने वाला — जो सुरूर पैदा करे
definition: producing a pleasant intoxication, said of a drink, a scent, or a voice; describes an effect rather than naming a substance
example: उसकी आवाज़ में कुछ कैफ़-आवर सा था। — There was something intoxicating in her voice.

hindi: अवस्था — भीतर की वह हालत जो चेहरे पर झलक जाए
definition: the felt condition of a person or a moment, the inner state that shows in a face; a mood described from inside rather than a fact reported
example: उस वक़्त की कैफ़ियत बयान नहीं हो सकती — The state I was in then cannot be described.

hindi: कुढ़न — मन का चिड़चिड़ा दुख
definition: the low grinding vexation left by repeated small troubles; sorrow soured into irritation, and unlike grief it has no dignity
example: रोज़ के तक़ाज़ों से कोफ़्त होने लगी है — The daily demands have started to grate on me.

hindi: कटार — छोटा दुधारा हथियार
definition: the dagger, a short blade meant for close and often treacherous use, unlike the sword drawn in open battle
example: उसने आस्तीन में ख़ंजर छिपा रखा था — He had a dagger hidden in his sleeve.

hindi: खाई — बचाव के लिए खोदी गई गहरी नाली
definition: the defensive trench dug across a battlefield, a ditch used to stop an advance rather than a wall built to block it
example: सिपाही रात भर ख़ंदक़ में पड़े रहे — The soldiers lay in the trench all night.

hindi: हँसी — खुलकर की गई हँसी
definition: laughter that has sound in it, and in verse the opening of a bud; louder and freer than तबस्सुम
example: उसका ख़ंदा दूर तक सुनाई दिया — His laughter was heard far off.

hindi: शर्मिंदगी — अपनी ग़लती पर होने वाली लाज
definition: the shame felt after doing something one should not have, backward-looking where inner modesty acts beforehand to prevent it
example: अपनी बात याद करके उसे ख़जालत हुई — Remembering what he had said, he felt ashamed.

hindi: पत्र-व्यवहार — दो लोगों के बीच चिट्ठियों का आदान-प्रदान
definition: correspondence carried on by letters between two people over time, the exchange as a whole rather than any one letter
example: बरसों उनसे ख़त-ओ-किताबत रही। — I kept up a correspondence with him for years.

hindi: भूल — अनजाने में हुई चूक
definition: a fault committed by mistake rather than by intent, a lighter thing than a sin chosen deliberately
example: यह ख़ता थी, बदनीयती नहीं — It was an error, not bad intent.

hindi: सुलेख-कला — अक्षरों को कलात्मक ढंग से लिखने की कला
definition: calligraphy as an art, the shaping of letters so that the script itself is the beautiful object; a discipline, not merely a tidy hand
example: मस्जिद की दीवार पर बेहतरीन ख़त्ताती की गई है। — Superb calligraphy has been done on the mosque wall.

hindi: तीर — शिकार और जंग में चलाया जाने वाला बाण
definition: the arrow shot at game or at an enemy, named for the hard wood of its shaft; a hunting weapon that strikes from a distance
example: ख़दंग सीधा निशाने पर जा लगा — The arrow struck the mark straight.

hindi: खटका — मन में उठा शक भरा डर
definition: a specific misgiving that pricks at you, narrower than general worry and usually attached to one named risk
example: हादसे का ख़दशा पहले ही ज़ाहिर किया गया था। — The risk of an accident had been flagged earlier.

hindi: धड़कन का बढ़ना — दिल का बेचैनी से तेज़ चलना
definition: the heart beating fast and hard enough to feel, palpitation treated as a complaint of the chest alongside breathlessness
example: सीढ़ियाँ चढ़ते ही ख़फ़क़ान शुरू हो जाता है। — Palpitations begin the moment he climbs stairs.

hindi: नाराज़गी — रूठ जाने वाली हल्की नाराज़ी
definition: the quiet displeasure of somebody who feels slighted; a sulk that shows in the face long before it is put into words
example: उसकी ख़फ़गी दो दिन तक रही — Her displeasure lasted two days.

hindi: सुध लेना — हाल पूछते रहना और ज़रूरत पूरी करना
definition: keeping track of how someone unwell is faring and meeting what they need, care shown by checking in rather than by bedside labour
example: बीमारी में सिर्फ़ उसी ने ख़बरगीरी की। — In the illness only he kept checking on me.

hindi: पागलपन की झक — एक अजीब सी ज़िद या धुन
definition: a crank's fixation that others find absurd but harmless, madness narrowed to one peculiar habit; comic where the deeper obsession is tragic
example: उसे किताबें जमा करने का ख़ब्त है। — He has a mania for collecting books.

hindi: झक्की — अपनी ही धुन में रहने वाला अजीब आदमी
definition: eccentric in a fixed, laughable manner that stops short of real madness; the mild word among names for a disordered mind
example: ख़ब्ती है, पर नुक़सान किसी का नहीं करता। — He is a crank, but he harms nobody.

hindi: मोड़ — किसी चीज़ का झुकाव
definition: a bend in a form, the curve that age puts into a body or a stick puts into a line
example: बुढ़ापे ने उनके क़द में ख़म डाल दिया। — Old age put a bend into his stature.

hindi: भुगतान — अपनी ग़लती का नुक़सान झेलना
definition: the price you personally pay for your own mistake, suffering borne as a result rather than imposed as a sentence
example: एक ग़लत फ़ैसले का ख़मियाज़ा सालों भुगता। — He paid for one wrong decision for years.

hindi: झुका हुआ — उम्र से कमर मुड़ी हुई
definition: bent over, said of a back that the years have curved rather than of a thing bent by force
example: ख़मीदा कमर के साथ वो लाठी टेककर चले। — With a bent back he walked leaning on a stick.

hindi: आटे का उठान — वो चीज़ जो गूँधे आटे को फुला देती है
definition: the leaven that makes kneaded dough rise before baking, and by extension the make-up a person is kneaded from
example: आटे में ख़मीर मिलाकर रात भर रखा। — He mixed leaven into the dough and left it overnight.

hindi: फूली हुई रोटी वाला — जिस आटे को उठाकर नरम किया गया हो
definition: made from dough that has been raised with leaven, describing bread that is soft and risen rather than flat and unleavened
example: नाश्ते में ख़मीरी रोटी और निहारी थी। — Breakfast was leavened bread and nihari.

hindi: मद्य — शराब का धार्मिक-क़ानूनी नाम
definition: wine as scripture and jurisprudence name it when forbidding it, a legal category rather than a poetic image; the courtroom word for the drink
example: फ़तवे में ख़म्र का ज़िक्र साफ़ था। — The ruling mentioned intoxicating wine explicitly.

hindi: विश्वासघात — सौंपी हुई चीज़ के साथ बेईमानी
definition: breach of a trust one was formally given, of money, secrets or a duty, which makes it the legal cousin of personal treachery
example: उसने रक़म में ख़यानत की — He committed a breach of trust with the money.

hindi: फूलों वाली चौड़ी सड़क — दरख़्तों की क़तार वाला रास्ता
definition: a broad tree-lined avenue, a road laid out to be pleasant rather than merely to carry traffic through
example: शाम को हम उस ख़याबान पर टहलते थे — In the evenings we strolled along that avenue.

hindi: कच्ची सोच — जो कभी पूरी न हो सकने वाली बेकार कल्पना हो
definition: a half-baked notion cherished though it can never come true; a false hope entertained, unlike a fear falsely believed
example: ये सब ख़याल-ए-ख़ाम है, हक़ीक़त कुछ और — All this is a vain notion; reality is otherwise.

hindi: दर्ज़ी — नाप लेकर कपड़े काटने-सीने वाला
definition: the tailor who cuts and stitches garments to measure; the trade named in formal Urdu
example: ख़य्यात ने नाप लेकर हफ़्ते का वादा किया। — The tailor took the measurements and promised a week.

hindi: खंडहर — गिरी हुई इमारत का ढाँचा
definition: a ruin of collapsed building, the physical wreckage left behind where desolation is the feeling it produces
example: उस हवेली का अब सिर्फ़ ख़राबा बचा है — Only a ruin of that mansion is left now.

hindi: मयख़ाने का मुहल्ला — बदनाम बस्ती जहाँ पीने वाले जुटते हैं
definition: the whole disreputable quarter of taverns rather than one drinking house; names a district and a manner of living outside respectability
example: वो शहर छोड़कर ख़राबात में जा बसा। — He left the city and settled in the tavern quarter.

hindi: खरोंच — ऊपरी सतह का छिल जाना
definition: a surface scrape that breaks skin without depth, the least of wounds; also the rawness felt in an inflamed throat
example: गले में ख़राश है, बोलना मुश्किल है। — There is a rawness in the throat; speaking is hard.

hindi: पाँव का भारी कड़ा — बिना घुँघरू के
definition: a heavy solid ring worn round the ankle, plain where lighter anklets are strung with sounding bells
example: चाँदी का ख़लख़ाल उसके टख़ने पर भारी था। — The silver anklet lay heavy on her ankle.

hindi: वंशज — पीछे आने वाली संतान
definition: the descendant who comes after and takes a forebear's place, named by succession rather than by affection
example: वो अपने बाप के सच्चे ख़लफ़ साबित हुए। — He proved a true successor to his father.

hindi: गड़बड़ी — दिमाग़ या किसी निज़ाम में आई ख़राबी
definition: a disorder in the working of the mind or of any system, something out of order rather than absent; the polite word for mental illness
example: सदमे के बाद दिमाग़ में ख़लल आ गया। — After the shock a disorder entered his mind.

hindi: रिक्तता — वह ख़ाली जगह जो कोई छोड़ जाए
definition: the void left where someone or something used to be, a gap felt as absence rather than as open room
example: उनके जाने से जो ख़ला बना, वह भरा नहीं — The void their going left has never been filled.

hindi: पीछा छूटना — किसी झंझट से जान बचना
definition: the informal getting-free from something troublesome, a person, a debt or an errand; release is granted by authority, this is escaping the nuisance at last
example: इस झगड़े से ख़लासी मिले तो चैन आए — If I could just be rid of this quarrel I would breathe.

hindi: खटक — मन में चुभा हुआ बारीक काँटा
definition: a persistent small prick of doubt or hurt lodged in the mind, too minor to raise aloud and too sharp to forget
example: उसके जवाब में एक ख़लिश रह गई — Something in his answer left a small thorn behind.

hindi: एकांत — जहाँ कोई तीसरा न हो
definition: private seclusion with nobody else present, valued as intimacy or freedom rather than suffered as loneliness
example: उन्हें दो घड़ी की ख़ल्वत भी नसीब न हुई — They did not get even a moment of privacy.

hindi: भड़का हुआ क्रोध — चेहरे और आवाज़ पर दिखता ग़ुस्सा
definition: hot flaring anger visible in the face and the voice; the boil of rage in the moment, before it cools or is hidden
example: उसकी आवाज़ में ख़शम साफ़ था — The flare of anger was plain in his voice.

hindi: तिनके और कूड़ा — सूखे पत्ते और घास-फूस
definition: dry leaf, straw and sweepings gathered as worthless litter, what the garden's greenness becomes once dead
example: आँधी ख़स-ओ-ख़ाशाक उड़ा ले गई। — The storm carried off the dry litter.

hindi: घाटा — सौदे में लगा हुआ नुक़सान
definition: financial loss in a venture, money gone out of a deal that turned out badly rather than damage of any other kind
example: इस बार के सौदे में ख़ासा ख़सारा हुआ — There was a considerable loss on this deal.

hindi: टूटन — जिस्म और दिल दोनों का थक कर बिखर जाना
definition: a worn-out brokenness after long strain, exhaustion that has damaged rather than merely tired
example: बरसों की ख़स्तगी चेहरे पर दिखती है — Years of exhaustion show on his face.

hindi: बदहाली — पैसा, सेहत और इज़्ज़त तीनों का एक साथ टूट जाना
definition: the worn-out condition of someone whose money, health and standing have decayed together; poverty that has become visible on the body
example: बीमारी के बाद उसकी ख़स्ता-हाली छुपाए नहीं छुपती — After the illness his worn-out condition cannot be hidden.

hindi: विश्वासघाती — भरोसे का चोर
definition: one who betrays a trust placed in him, a traitor to a duty or deposit rather than to a nation or an army
example: ख़ाइन को कोई दोबारा ज़िम्मेदारी नहीं देता — Nobody hands responsibility twice to a betrayer of trust.

hindi: धूल-मिट्टी — जिससे इंसान बना और जिसमें लौटता है
definition: dust as the substance a person is made from and returns to at burial, carrying the whole argument about human smallness in one word
example: आख़िर सब ख़ाक में मिल जाना है — In the end everything mixes into dust.

hindi: मुहरवाली अँगूठी — जिसके नग पर नाम खुदा हो
definition: a signet ring whose stone is engraved with a name, worn on the finger to stamp and seal documents
example: फ़रमान पर बादशाह के ख़ातम का निशान था। — The decree bore the mark of the king's signet ring.

hindi: आवभगत — मेहमान की देखभाल और मनुहार
definition: the attentive fussing over a visitor, refilling plates and asking after comfort; hospitality is the principle, this is the actual labour
example: पूरी शाम भाभी ख़ातिरदारी में लगी रहीं — All evening she was busy looking after the guests.

hindi: सेवक — घर में ख़िदमत करने वाला पुरुष
definition: a manservant attached to a household, serving the family with a loyalty closer than hire; older and warmer than the word for a salaried employee
example: पुराना ख़ादिम अब भी उसी घर में है — The old manservant is still in that house.

hindi: सेविका — घर की ख़िदमत करने वाली स्त्री
definition: a maidservant in a household, working inside the women's quarters where a manservant may not go; the female counterpart of the family's serving man
example: ख़ादिमा ने दस्तरख़्वान बिछा दिया — The maidservant laid out the dining spread.

hindi: सूफ़ी मठ — साधना और निवास का केंद्र
definition: the lodge where a spiritual master lives and disciples gather for training, a working institution rather than a grave
example: ख़ानक़ाह में रोज़ लंगर चलता है — A free kitchen runs daily at the lodge.

hindi: कुलीन — ख़ानदान से जुड़ा या ख़ानदान का ढंग रखने वाला
definition: belonging to a family and bearing its stamp, whether of good breeding, an ailment or a quarrel; ties the thing to the family, not to a generation count
example: उनकी शराफ़त ख़ानदानी है — Their decency runs in the family.

hindi: घर का ख़ानसामा — जो रसोई और सौदे का सारा इंतज़ाम सँभाले
definition: the household steward who runs the kitchen, buys the provisions and serves the meal; he commands the cooking rather than doing it
example: ख़ानसामाँ ने मेहमानों का खाना ख़ुद तय किया। — The steward himself decided the guests' meal.

hindi: घर उजड़ना — किसी लत या फ़ैसले से बरबादी
definition: the wrecking of a household from within, ruin measured by the family it breaks rather than by property lost
example: जुए ने उसकी ख़ाना-ख़राबी कर दी। — Gambling brought his household to ruin.

hindi: गृहयुद्ध — अपनों के बीच की लड़ाई
definition: fighting inside one's own house or nation; violence between people who belong to the same side, which is what makes it ruinous
example: पार्टी की ख़ाना-जंगी ने उसे हरा दिया — The party's internal war defeated it.

hindi: घर-जमाई — पत्नी के मायके में ही रहने वाला दामाद
definition: a son-in-law who lives in his wife's parents' household instead of taking her to his own; names an arrangement the culture treats as a comedown for him
example: वो ख़ाना-दामाद बनकर रहने पर राज़ी न हुआ — He would not agree to live as a live-in son-in-law.

hindi: गृहस्थी — घर चलाने का काम और सलीक़ा
definition: the daily running of a household, its budgeting, cooking, guests and repairs; the labour of keeping a home going, not the family that lives in it
example: ख़ानादारी उसने अकेले सँभाल रखी है — She has kept the running of the household on her own.

hindi: घुमंतू — जिसका घर उसके साथ ही चलता हो
definition: one whose dwelling travels with them, wandering as a way of life rather than because of exile or punishment
example: वे ख़ानाबदोश हैं, हर मौसम नया ठिकाना — They are nomads; every season brings a new camp.

hindi: कच्चा — जो अभी तैयार या पक्का न हुआ हो
definition: still raw and unworked, whether material, plan, or skill; not yet brought to the finished state, and so not fit to be used or judged
example: ये अभी ख़ाम माल है, कारख़ाने में तैयार होगा। — This is still raw material; it will be finished at the factory.

hindi: सरकंडे की क़लम — पुराने कातिब का लेखन-उपकरण
definition: the reed pen of the old scribe, the poetic word for the writing instrument itself; it evokes the craft where the plain word names the tool
example: उसका ख़ामा आज भी संभालकर रखा है। — His reed pen is still kept carefully even now.

hindi: मौन — वह चुप्पी जो खुद एक जवाब हो
definition: silence held on purpose; functions as an answer in its own right rather than the absence of one
example: उसकी ख़ामोशी इनकार से ज़्यादा भारी थी। — Her silence weighed more than a refusal.

hindi: जलन — काँटे की तरह चुभने वाला बैर
definition: the prickly resentment felt at someone's success, malice arising from envy rather than from injury
example: वह मुझसे ख़ार खाता है — He bears a thorny grudge against me.

hindi: प्रकृति-विरुद्ध — जो आम क़ायदे को तोड़कर हो
definition: breaking the settled habit of nature, so that the event cannot be explained by ordinary causes; the category into which miracles fall
example: ये वाक़या ख़ारिक़-ए-आदत था — This event broke the ordinary course of nature.

hindi: सृष्टिकर्ता — जिसने सब कुछ रचा
definition: a name of God as the maker who brought creation out of nothing, the attribute of origination rather than of sustaining what exists
example: ख़ालिक़ और मख़्लूक़ का फ़र्क़ मिटता नहीं — The difference between creator and created never dissolves.

hindi: शुद्ध — जिसमें कोई मिलावट न हो
definition: unmixed with any cheaper substance, said of metal, ghee, or intention; a claim about purity of content, not about quality of workmanship
example: ज़रगर ने कहा कि सोना ख़ालिस है, मिलावट नहीं। — The goldsmith said the gold is pure, with no adulteration.

hindi: स्वामी — पति, अधिकार और मालिकाना भाव के साथ
definition: a husband regarded as master of the household, carrying an older sense of authority over wife and home; weightier and more dated than the ordinary word for husband
example: पुराने ज़माने में ख़ावंद का हुक्म आख़िरी होता था — In the old days the husband's word was final.

hindi: पतझड़ — पत्ते झड़ने की ऋतु
definition: the autumn season when leaves fall and colour drains away, the exact reverse of spring and the season of decline
example: ख़िज़ाँ में यही बाग़ वीरान लगता है। — In autumn this same garden looks desolate.

hindi: पतझड़ का मारा — जिस पर ख़िज़ाँ गुज़र चुकी हो
definition: left in ruin by autumn, describing a garden or a life that the season of decline has already gone through
example: उसका चेहरा ख़िज़ाँ-रसीदा लगता था। — His face looked like something autumn had passed over.

hindi: बालों का रंग — सफ़ेदी छुपाने वाला रंग
definition: hair colouring put on head or beard to cover grey, mentioned in Urdu usually with a wink at the vanity behind it
example: उसने ख़िज़ाब लगाकर उम्र छुपा ली — He hid his age by dyeing his hair.

hindi: संबोधन — किसी को मुख़ातिब कर के कही गई बात
definition: a formal address directed at a named audience, the act of speaking to rather than merely speaking; a speech is the content, this is the turning towards listeners
example: सदर ने क़ौम से ख़िताब किया — The president addressed the nation.

hindi: बुद्धि — जज़्बे के मुक़ाबिल खड़ी ठंडी अक़्ल
definition: cold reason set in permanent opposition to passion, the wisdom that counsels caution; in Urdu poetry it is always the killjoy arguing against love, which no English word carries
example: इश्क़ ने ख़िरद की एक न सुनी — Passion refused to listen to reason.

hindi: कर — कमज़ोर राज्य से ताक़तवर को दी जाने वाली रक़म
definition: the tribute a subordinate ruler pays a stronger one to be left in peace; payment for submission rather than for land tilled or goods carried
example: छोटी रियासतें हर साल ख़िराज भेजती थीं। — The small states sent tribute every year.

hindi: मंद चाल — इतमीनान से चलने का सुंदर ढंग
definition: a slow graceful gait, walking treated as something worth watching; the noun verse uses where plain speech would only say चाल
example: उसका ख़िराम देखने लायक़ था — Her graceful walk was worth watching.

hindi: फ़क़ीर का गुदड़ी-चोग़ा — पीर से मिला हुआ लिबास
definition: the patched outer robe worn by a dervish and handed to him by his master; a robe that marks renunciation, not warmth
example: उसने दुनिया छोड़कर ख़िर्क़ा पहन लिया। — He left the world and put on the dervish robe.

hindi: अनाज का ढेर — कटी हुई फ़सल का अंबार
definition: the heap of cut crop gathered on the threshing floor, the harvest piled up after the field has been cleared
example: एक चिंगारी ख़िर्मन को जला सकती है। — A single spark can burn the whole heap of harvest.

hindi: सिरोपाव — सम्मान में दिया गया वस्त्र
definition: a robe of honour bestowed by a ruler or patron, clothing given as public reward rather than bought
example: बादशाह ने उसे ख़िलअत दी — The king gave him a robe of honour.

hindi: रचना — पैदाइशी बनावट और स्वभाव
definition: the constitution a body was created with, what belongs to a person from birth rather than from habit or illness
example: ये कमज़ोरी ख़िल्क़त में है, मरज़ नहीं। — This weakness is in his constitution; it is not a disease.

hindi: मनमानी — किसी की सलाह या जवाबदेही न मानना
definition: acting on one's own head and refusing to be answerable to anyone; wilfulness set against all counsel, however sound
example: ख़ुद-सरी ने उसका कारोबार डुबो दिया — Wilfulness sank his business.

hindi: स्वयंभू — जिसने ख़ुद ही अपना ओहदा गढ़ लिया हो
definition: self-appointed and self-styled, false because the title was assumed rather than conferred by anyone entitled to give it
example: ख़ुद-साख़्ता रहनुमाओं की कमी नहीं — There is no shortage of self-styled leaders.

hindi: स्वार्थी — अपने मतलब तक सीमित
definition: self-interested in a way that surfaces exactly when someone needs you; names the calculation behind the selfishness
example: ज़रूरत पर ग़ायब हो गया, सच में ख़ुदग़रज़ है। — He vanished when needed; he really is self-serving.

hindi: स्वाभिमानी — मदद माँगने से पहले भूखा रह जाने वाला
definition: self-respecting to the point of refusing help; dignity guarded at real cost, quite apart from ordinary pride
example: वो इतना ख़ुद्दार है कि उधार कभी नहीं माँगता। — He is so self-respecting that he never asks for a loan.

hindi: शीतल — ठंडा और राहत देने वाला
definition: cold in a pleasant way that cools and calms, the chill one welcomes rather than the freezing that harms
example: पहाड़ की ख़ुनुक हवा ने थकान उतार दी। — The cool mountain air took the tiredness away.

hindi: गुप्त — जो जान-बूझकर छिपाकर रखा गया हो
definition: kept secret by design, said of information, meetings or agents; concealment enforced as policy rather than mere privacy
example: ख़ुफ़िया बैठक रात को हुई — The secret meeting was held at night.

hindi: मटका — शराब पकाने-रखने का बड़ा पात्र
definition: the great clay cask in which wine ferments and waits, holding enough for a crowd; the cellar's vessel, never one drinker's goblet
example: ख़ुम अभी भरा है, महफ़िल लंबी चलेगी। — The vat is still full; the gathering will run long.

hindi: शराब-गोदाम — जहाँ मटके भरे रखे जाते हैं
definition: the cellar where wine vats are stored and matured, the tavern's back room rather than its floor; a place of supply, not of company
example: ख़ुमख़ाना खुला और पूरी गली महक उठी। — The wine cellar opened and the whole lane filled with scent.

hindi: नशे की ख़ुमारी — आँखों पर छाया हुआ भारीपन
definition: the heavy-lidded after-state of intoxication or of love, a lingering languor rather than the intoxication at its height
example: उसकी आँखों में अब तक ख़ुमार है — There is still a languor in her eyes.

hindi: खाने की मिक़दार — एक बार में जितना खाना या दवा ली जाए
definition: the measured portion of food or medicine taken at one time, an amount rather than a kind of nourishment
example: उसकी ख़ुराक दो रोटी से ज़्यादा नहीं। — His portion of food is no more than two rotis.

hindi: बेहूदा बातें — बेबुनियाद क़िस्से और अंधे यक़ीन
definition: baseless tales and beliefs repeated as though true, dismissed as nonsense by the speaker; a verdict on the stories, not their study
example: इन ख़ुराफ़ात पर यक़ीन मत करो — Do not believe these superstitions.

hindi: गबन — अपने ज़िम्मे के पैसे को चुपके से हज़म करना
definition: quiet misappropriation of money placed in one's charge, embezzlement done by degrees rather than by open theft
example: चंदे की रक़म ख़ुर्द-बुर्द कर दी गई — The subscription money was quietly embezzled.

hindi: हेराफेरी — सरकारी माल का थोड़ा-थोड़ा ग़ायब हो जाना
definition: quietly making public goods or funds disappear a little at a time, pilferage rather than one large visible theft
example: राशन की ख़ुर्दबुर्द आख़िर पकड़ी गई — The pilfering of rations was caught at last.

hindi: छोटी-छोटी बातों पर टोकना — बेजा मीन-मेख़
definition: criticism over trifles, the habit of correcting small things until nothing large gets said
example: इतनी ख़ुर्दागीरी से बच्चा डर जाएगा। — The child will be frightened by so much nit-picking.

hindi: भानु — तेज़ रौशनी वाला सूरज
definition: the daytime star named for its blazing light, used where the glare and heat of midday matter rather than its rising
example: ख़ुर्शीद की तेज़ी दोपहर तक बर्दाश्त से बाहर थी। — The sun's fierceness was past bearing by noon.

hindi: विवाह-मुक्ति — पत्नी की माँग पर, कुछ लौटाकर लिया गया विच्छेद
definition: a divorce the wife initiates, usually by returning her dower, dissolving the marriage at her instance; her way out of the contract rather than his
example: उसने अदालत से ख़ुला की डिग्री हासिल की — She obtained a decree of wife-initiated divorce from the court.

hindi: निष्कपटता — बिना किसी ग़रज़ के दिखाया गया अपनापन
definition: warmth offered with nothing wanted back, the exact opposite of ceremony; sincerity states a fact, this is felt across the room
example: उन्होंने बड़े ख़ुलूस से खाना खिलाया — They fed us with genuine warmth.

hindi: शुभ / सुखद — अच्छा या भाग्यवान बनाने वाला उपसर्ग
definition: the positive counterweight, prefixing a noun to make it pleasant or fortunate; English keeps no single joint that upgrades plain 'smell' into fragrance the way ख़ुशबू does in one syllable
example: वो ख़ुशनसीब है कि उसके दोनों बेटे एक साथ पास हो गए। — He is fortunate that both his sons passed together.

hindi: सद्व्यवहार — लोगों से मिलने-जुलने का ख़ुशगवार ढंग
definition: good-naturedness in dealing with people, keeping one's manner pleasant even under provocation from those one must serve
example: दुकानदार की ख़ुश-ख़ुल्क़ी से ग्राहक लौटकर आते हैं — Customers return because of the shopkeeper's good nature.

hindi: सास — पत्नी या पति की माता
definition: a mother-in-law, the mother of one's husband or wife, a courteous Persian term used where the plain word would sound blunt; the woman who runs the in-law household
example: ख़ुश-दामन ने बहू को अपने हाथों का कड़ा दिया — Her mother-in-law gave the bride a bangle of her own.

hindi: बनाव-सिंगार वाला — सलीक़े से कपड़े पहनने वाला
definition: well dressed; describes a person whose clothes are chosen with care, whatever they may have cost
example: वो ग़रीब है मगर ख़ुश-पोश आदमी है। — He is poor but a well-dressed man.

hindi: हँसमुख — मिलनसार और प्रसन्न तबीयत का
definition: cheerful by temperament, equally pleasant to deal with on a ruined day as on a good one
example: नया पड़ोसी बड़ा ख़ुश-मिज़ाज है। — The new neighbour is very good-natured.

hindi: सुलेखक — सुंदर लिखावट वाला लेखक
definition: the penman prized for beautiful handwriting, hired because his letters are lovely rather than because he writes fast
example: दावतनामे किसी ख़ुशनवीस से लिखवाओ। — Have the invitations written by a good penman.

hindi: सुंदर लिखावट — हाथ से साफ़ और सुंदर लिखने का हुनर
definition: fine handwriting as a personal skill, writing letters neatly and pleasingly by hand; a quality of one's hand rather than a formal art
example: उसकी ख़ुशनवीसी देखकर उस्ताद ख़ुश हुए। — The teacher was pleased to see his fine handwriting.

hindi: समृद्धि — जब सबके लिए काफ़ी हो
definition: prosperity of a household or a country, the visible well-being that arrives when money is enough for everyone
example: अच्छी फ़सल ने गाँव में ख़ुशहाली ला दी — A good harvest brought prosperity to the village.

hindi: चापलूसी — काम निकालने के लिए की गई तारीफ़
definition: flattery offered to obtain something, praise used as a tool rather than felt; deceit that pleases the person deceived
example: ख़ुशामद से काम निकलवाना उसकी आदत है — Getting work done by flattery is his habit.

hindi: चापलूस — जो हमेशा ख़ुशामद में लगा रहे
definition: given to flattery as a whole manner of living, describing the person around a patron rather than the praise itself
example: उसके गिर्द ख़ुशामदी लोगों की भीड़ थी — A crowd of flatterers surrounded him.

hindi: अनावृष्टि — बारिश न होने का साल
definition: a drought year in which the rains fail, dryness measured over a whole season rather than felt in a moment
example: लगातार दूसरी ख़ुश्क-साली ने किसानों की कमर तोड़ दी। — A second drought year in a row broke the farmers.

hindi: सूखापन — नमी का न होना
definition: dryness as the absence of moisture in air, skin, or soil, a condition of things rather than a failure of the rains
example: हवा की ख़ुश्की से होंठ फट रहे हैं। — The dryness of the air is cracking the lips.

hindi: श्वसुर — पति या पत्नी के पिता
definition: a father-in-law, the father of one's husband or wife, addressed with the deference owed to elders of the family one married into; the man at the head of the in-law household
example: ख़ुसर साहब ने उठकर दामाद का इस्तक़बाल किया — His father-in-law rose to welcome the son-in-law.

hindi: चंद्रग्रहण — चाँद का ढँक जाना
definition: a lunar eclipse in which the moon's light is covered at night, the night counterpart of the sun being darkened by day
example: ख़ुसूफ़ देखने के लिए सब छत पर जमा हो गए। — Everyone gathered on the roof to watch the lunar eclipse.

hindi: खुली अदावत — मान ली गई दुश्मनी, अक्सर मुक़दमेबाज़ी तक
definition: declared enmity between two parties, often carried into court; hostility with an openly acknowledged opponent on the other side
example: दोनों ख़ानदानों की ख़ुसूमत नस्लों पुरानी है — The enmity between the two families is generations old.

hindi: हिंसक — ख़ून बहाने पर उतारू
definition: bloodthirsty, said of a beast or a man who kills readily and takes pleasure in it, naming the temperament behind bloodshed
example: ख़ूँख़ार भेड़िया गाँव तक आ गया — The bloodthirsty wolf came right up to the village.

hindi: रक्तपात — बड़े पैमाने पर ख़ून बहाना
definition: bloodshed spread over many, killing counted as a condition of a place or a period rather than a single crime with a single victim
example: उस बरस शहर में बहुत ख़ूँरेज़ी हुई — There was much bloodshed in the city that year.

hindi: अभ्यस्त — जिसे किसी चीज़ की आदत पड़ चुकी हो
definition: grown accustomed to something until it no longer registers, said even of pain; habituation without the blame the affliction words carry
example: वो तन्हाई का ख़ूगर हो चुका है। — He has grown accustomed to loneliness.

hindi: रक्तमूल्य — जान के बदले दिया जाने वाला मुआवज़ा
definition: compensation paid to the family of a slain person in place of retaliation, the settlement that buys off revenge
example: ख़ून-बहा देकर मामला निपटा — The matter was settled by paying blood money.

hindi: रूपवान — जिसका चेहरा-मोहरा सुंदर हो
definition: good-looking specifically in the face, said of a person and not of a scene; where हसीन can praise anything, this praises features
example: उसका छोटा भाई बहुत ख़ूबरू है — His younger brother is very good-looking.

hindi: तंबू — कपड़े का अस्थायी घर
definition: a tent, a dwelling pitched to be struck again, the opposite of a building meant to outlast its residents
example: रात हमने नदी के किनारे ख़ेमा लगाया — That night we pitched a tent by the river.

hindi: स्वागत-वचन — आपका आना मुबारक हो
definition: a spoken welcome offered to one who has arrived, the formal greeting itself rather than the act of receiving them
example: मेहमानों का ख़ैर-मक़्दम किया गया — The guests were formally welcomed.

hindi: दान — ज़रूरतमंदों को दी जाने वाली स्वैच्छिक भेंट
definition: voluntary giving to the poor, offered when one is moved to it rather than owed by any calculated rule
example: उन्होंने चुपचाप ख़ैरात बाँट दी — He quietly distributed alms to the needy.

hindi: कुशल-क्षेम — सब ठीक होने की ख़बर
definition: the news that a person is safe and well, the reassurance asked for and sent between people living far apart
example: ख़त में सिर्फ़ ख़ैरियत लिखी थी — The letter said only that all was well.

hindi: टोप — सिर बचाने वाला लोहे का खोल
definition: the helmet of a soldier, armour for the head alone, part of the same battle kit as the coat and the shield
example: गोली ख़ोद से टकराकर निकल गई — The bullet glanced off the helmet.

hindi: डर — भय का सादा एहसास
definition: fear as a plain inner state, the ordinary dread of harm, without the panic or the spectacle the harsher words carry
example: उसे नाकामी का ख़ौफ़ खाए जा रहा है — The fear of failure is eating him.

hindi: खाने की तश्तरी — सजा हुआ थाल जिसमें खाना भेजा जाता है
definition: a large laden tray of food sent or set before guests, the loaded dish itself as distinct from the cloth it rests on
example: पड़ोस से मिठाई का ख़्वान आया। — A laden tray of sweets came from next door.

hindi: निद्राजनक — नींद ले आने वाली दवा या चीज़
definition: sleep-inducing, said of a medicine given against wakefulness; the remedy answering the ailment of sleepless nights
example: ख़्वाब-आवर दवा रोज़ लेना ठीक नहीं। — Taking a sleep-inducing medicine daily is not right.

hindi: बेख़बरी की नींद — ख़तरा सामने है और आदमी सोया हुआ है
definition: the sleep of heedlessness: dreaming on while danger gathers, blamed as a moral failure rather than described as ordinary rest
example: वो अब तक ख़्वाब-ए-ग़फ़लत में पड़ा है — He is still lying in the sleep of heedlessness.

hindi: शयन-कक्ष — सोने और ख़्वाब देखने के लिए रखा गया कमरा
definition: the room kept aside for sleep and dreaming, named for the dream rather than the bed; grander in tone than any ordinary bedroom
example: मेहमान को ऊपर की ख़्वाब-गाह में ठहराया गया — The guest was lodged in the upstairs sleeping chamber.

hindi: सोया हुआ — नींद और ख़्वाब में डूबा, जागा हुआ नहीं
definition: sunk in sleep and dreaming, or of a faculty lying dormant; says asleep in the sense of not yet awakened, unlike merely resting
example: क़ौम की ख़्वाबीदा ग़ैरत को जगाना आसान नहीं — Rousing a nation's slumbering pride is not easy.

hindi: ज़लील हाली — इज़्ज़त गँवाकर दर-दर भटकना
definition: the state of being disgraced and left low, moving about without respect; the condition that remains once honour has gone
example: क़र्ज़ ने उसे ख़्वारी तक पहुँचा दिया — Debt brought him to a state of disgrace.

hindi: रिश्ता माँगना — लड़की का हाथ औपचारिक रूप से माँगने की रस्म
definition: formally asking a family for their daughter's hand in marriage, the approach that comes before any engagement is agreed; a request made to elders, not a proposal made to her
example: उनके घर ख़्वास्तगारी के लिए बड़े-बूढ़े गए — The elders went to their house to ask for her hand in marriage.

hindi: स्वजन — अपना रिश्तेदार
definition: a relative of one's own, a kinsman counted as belonging to the family circle; a Persian word for kin, warmer than the legal listing of relations
example: ख़्वेश हों या ग़ैर, इंसाफ़ एक-सा होगा — Kin or stranger, justice will be the same.

hindi: भिक्षावृत्ति — माँगकर गुज़ारा करना
definition: begging as a way of living, asking strangers for money as a settled occupation rather than in one emergency
example: उसने भूखा रहना क़ुबूल किया, गदाई नहीं — He accepted hunger rather than begging.

hindi: चक्कर — आसमान का घूमना और उससे बदलती क़िस्मत
definition: the turning of the sky, and so the revolving of fortune that brings a man down and lifts another in his place
example: वक़्त की गर्दिश ने सब कुछ बदल दिया। — The turning of time changed everything.

hindi: रेवड़ — एक साथ चरने वाले जानवरों का झुंड
definition: a herd or flock of grazing animals kept together, counted as one property; it names the group, not any single beast in it
example: चरवाहा गल्ला लेकर पहाड़ी की तरफ़ चला — The shepherd took the flock toward the hill.

hindi: साक्ष्य — देखे-सुने का बयान
definition: testimony from someone who witnessed the thing themselves; evidence spoken aloud rather than filed on paper
example: पड़ोसी ने अदालत में गवाही दी। — The neighbour testified in court.

hindi: पालना — नवजात को सुलाने का झूला
definition: the cradle of infancy, used for the birthplace of a thing as often as for a real infant's bed
example: ये शहर उर्दू शायरी का गहवारा रहा है। — This city has been the cradle of Urdu poetry.

hindi: प्रकोप — बड़े या ख़ुदा का ग़ुस्सा जो सज़ा बनकर गिरे
definition: the anger of a superior or of God that falls as punishment; rage with power behind it, not a mere loss of temper
example: ऐसा न करो कि ख़ुदा का ग़ज़ब नाज़िल हो — Do not act so that divine wrath descends.

hindi: काव्य-विधा — एक ही बहर और क़ाफ़िए पर कहे अलग-अलग शेरों का सिलसिला
definition: a poem of independent couplets held together only by shared metre and rhyme, each couplet complete in itself, so the poem has no single argument running through it
example: उन्होंने एक ग़ज़ल तरन्नुम में सुनाई — He recited a ghazal in song.

hindi: चिकारा — रेगिस्तानी हिरन, नाज़ुक और तेज़
definition: the gazelle, the desert deer named for delicacy and swiftness; it is prized game where the common deer is merely hunted
example: रेगिस्तान में ग़ज़ाल छलाँगें भरता चला गया — The gazelle went bounding across the desert.

hindi: विद्रोह — हुक्मरानों के ख़िलाफ़ हथियारबंद उठान
definition: an armed rising against those in power; violence organised into revolt rather than left as a crowd's riot
example: सन सत्तावन के ग़दर की कहानियाँ मशहूर हैं — The stories of the 1857 revolt are famous.

hindi: विश्वासघात — अपनों के साथ की गई दग़ा
definition: betrayal of the side one belonged to, treachery worked from inside rather than harm done by an open enemy
example: ग़द्दारी हार से ज़्यादा चुभती है — Betrayal stings more than defeat.

hindi: लापरवाही — ध्यान चूक जाने की हालत
definition: the heedlessness of a person whose attention has slipped; negligence arriving through inattention rather than through any intention to harm
example: एक पल की ग़फ़लत भारी पड़ गई — One moment's lapse cost us dearly.

hindi: धन-अपहरण — अपने हवाले किया गया पैसा हड़प लेना
definition: embezzlement of funds entrusted to one's own keeping, stealing from within a position of trust rather than breaking in from outside
example: ख़ज़ांची पर ग़बन का मुक़दमा चला — The treasurer was tried for embezzlement.

hindi: दुख — भीतर बस गया शोक
definition: sorrow lived with rather than expressed, treated almost as a companion; grief names the event, this names the residence
example: ग़म छुपाने के लिए वो ज़्यादा हँसने लगा — To hide his sorrow he began laughing more.

hindi: हमदर्द — दुख में साथ खड़ा रहने वाला
definition: one who takes on another's sorrow and stays beside them through it, a sharer of grief rather than a well-wisher
example: मुसीबत में एक ग़मख़्वार काफ़ी है — In trouble one sharer of grief is enough.

hindi: ढाढ़स — दुख में साथ खड़े रहकर सँभालना
definition: the sustained caring for someone in grief by staying with them and easing their burden, sympathy turned into service; the feeling is expressed as company, not words
example: मुसीबत में उसकी ग़मख़्वारी नहीं भूलती — I cannot forget how he stood by me in trouble.

hindi: दुख बाँटने वाला — जिसकी मौजूदगी ग़म हल्का कर दे
definition: a companion whose presence lightens grief, comforting by simply being there rather than by advising or consoling in words
example: उन दिनों वही मेरा ग़मगुसार था — In those days he alone lightened my grief.

hindi: दुखी — जिस पर ग़म की मार पड़ी हो
definition: struck by grief, said of someone visibly carrying a loss; describes the person hit rather than the mourning they observe
example: ग़मज़दा माँ से कोई बात न हो सकी — Nothing could be said to the grief-struck mother.

hindi: नयन-कटाक्ष — आँख से किया गया इशारा
definition: a flirtatious sidelong movement of the eye, one specific weapon out of the beloved's repertoire of charming manners
example: उसका एक ग़म्ज़ा ही काफ़ी था — One flirtatious glance of hers was enough.

hindi: डूबना — पानी में समा जाने की हालत
definition: the state of being submerged and lost under water, the end that flood water brings rather than the swelling of the water
example: कश्ती की ग़र्क़ाबी की ख़बर शाम को पहुँची। — News of the boat's sinking arrived in the evening.

hindi: झूठा बयान — तथ्यों को तोड़-मरोड़कर पेश करना
definition: misrepresentation of facts in an account or statement, falsehood by distortion rather than by outright invention
example: अदालत में ग़लत-बयानी महँगी पड़ती है — Misrepresentation costs dearly in court.

hindi: प्रभुत्व — दूसरे पर हावी हो जाना
definition: dominance in which one side keeps the upper hand over another, ongoing ascendancy rather than a single victory
example: बहस में उनका ग़लबा साफ़ नज़र आ रहा था — His dominance in the debate was plain to see.

hindi: अनाज — खाने का दाना जो बाज़ार में तुलता है
definition: grain as the staple food traded and stored in bulk, the raw crop before any cooking, counted by weight and price
example: ग़ल्ला महँगा हुआ तो रोटी छोटी हो गई। — When grain grew costly the bread grew smaller.

hindi: गोताख़ोर — मोती के लिए समुंदर में उतरने वाला
definition: the diver who goes under the sea for pearls; a man who stakes the depth on a pearl he may not find
example: ग़व्वास ख़ाली हाथ भी लौट आता है। — The pearl diver sometimes returns empty-handed too.

hindi: मूर्छा — अचानक आया बेहोशी का दौरा
definition: a sudden faint that takes a person down for a short while, brought on by shock or drink; brief where deeper unconsciousness lasts
example: ख़बर सुनते ही उसे ग़श आ गया। — She fainted the moment she heard the news.

hindi: गाल की लाली — चेहरे पर लगाया जाने वाला सुर्ख़ रंग
definition: rouge applied to the cheeks, the paint that manufactures the glow a healthy face carries on its own
example: उसे ग़ाज़ा की ज़रूरत ही नहीं पड़ती — She has no need of rouge at all.

hindi: विजयी योद्धा — जंग जीतकर ज़िंदा लौटने वाला
definition: the fighter who survives the battle and comes back victorious, the counterpart of the one who is killed in it
example: गाँव ने ग़ाज़ी का इस्तक़बाल किया — The village welcomed the victorious fighter.

hindi: लूट-खसोट — नष्ट कर देना, बरबाद कर देना
definition: ruin brought by plunder or by squandering, ruin as something done to a thing; active where the state-words are passive
example: उसने अपनी सारी सलाहियत ग़ारत कर दी। — He laid waste to all his own ability.

hindi: ख़ुशबूदार लेप — मुश्क और अंबर मिलाकर बनाया गया उबटन
