definition: a thick perfumed paste of musk and ambergris applied to hair and beard; a costly scent of old courts
example: ग़ालिया की महक कमरे में भर गई। — The scent of the musk paste filled the room.

hindi: पोषक खाना — जिससे बदन को ताक़त मिले
definition: food considered as nourishment for the body, valued for what it builds rather than for its taste or its place in a meal
example: बीमार को हल्की ग़िज़ा दी जाए। — Give the patient light nourishing food.

hindi: पौष्टिकता — किसी खाने में ताक़त देने की सलाहियत
definition: the nourishing power held in a food, the quality that feeds the body as against the bulk that fills the belly
example: दाल में ग़िज़ाइयत गोश्त से कम नहीं। — Lentils have no less nourishment than meat.

hindi: ख़ोल — किसी चीज़ पर ऊपर से चढ़ाया जाने वाला कपड़ा
definition: the fitted cloth cover put over a thing to protect it, from a pillow to the Kaaba itself
example: क़ुरआन पर मख़मल का ग़िलाफ़ चढ़ा था। — A velvet cover was fitted over the Quran.

hindi: पीठ पीछे बुराई — सच्ची बात भी जो पीछे कही जाए
definition: speaking a true fault of someone behind their back; wrong because it damages their reputation, not because what is said is false
example: बात सच थी, फिर भी ग़ीबत ही थी — The thing was true, and still it was backbiting.

hindi: कली — बिना खुला फूल
definition: an unopened flower still folded shut, standing for beauty held back and for a mouth about to smile
example: ग़ुंचा खिलने को है — The bud is about to open.

hindi: ऊँघ — आँख लग जाने वाली हल्की नींद
definition: the drowsiness in which the eyes keep closing without sleep properly arriving; the narrow state lying between waking and sleeping
example: दोपहर की ग़ुनूदगी में उसने बात सुनी ही नहीं — In his afternoon drowsiness he simply did not hear.

hindi: उड़ती धूल — हवा में छाया हुआ गर्द का पर्दा
definition: dust risen and hanging in the air rather than settled earth; figuratively the residue of resentment a person carries in the chest
example: क़ाफ़िला गुज़र गया, सिर्फ़ ग़ुबार रह गया — The caravan passed; only the dust remained.

hindi: परदेस — अपने वतन से दूर पराई जगह रहने की हालत
definition: the condition of living far from one's homeland among strangers, the loneliness of being foreign rather than the plain fact of distance
example: ग़ुरबत में ईद का दिन सबसे भारी लगता है — In a foreign land the day of the festival feels heaviest.

hindi: अस्त — सूरज का डूबना
definition: the setting of the sun below the horizon, the exact counterpart of its rising and the marker that ends the day
example: ग़ुरूब से पहले घर लौट आना। — Come home before sunset.

hindi: घुटा हुआ ग़ुस्सा — जो बाहर न निकल सके
definition: choking anger held inside with no outlet; rage that burns the angry person more than it ever touches its target
example: ग़ैज़ में उसने होंठ काट लिए मगर कुछ न कहा — In choked rage he bit his lip and said nothing.

hindi: अदृश्य — इंद्रियों की पहुँच से बाहर का जगत
definition: the unseen world beyond human perception, knowledge of which belongs to God alone
example: ग़ैब का हाल कौन जानता है — Who knows the state of the unseen?

hindi: अदृश्य स्रोत से आया — जिसका सबब नज़र न आए
definition: coming from the unseen without any visible cause or agent; said of help or a voice, unlike anything merely unexplained so far
example: मुश्किल वक़्त में ग़ैबी मदद आ पहुँची — In hard times, help from the unseen arrived.

hindi: अनुपस्थिति — जहाँ होना था वहाँ न होना
definition: not being present where attendance was required, an absence marked against someone in a register rather than merely felt
example: लगातार ग़ैर-हाज़िरी पर नोटिस आया — A notice came over the continued absence.

hindi: आत्मसम्मान भरी जलन — अपनों को लेकर होने वाली टीस
definition: the protective jealousy of honour, which flares when what one loves is slighted or shared, and doubles as a word for self-respect
example: ग़ैरत ने उसे माफ़ी माँगने नहीं दी — His sense of honour would not let him apologise.

hindi: विचार — ठहरकर बारीकी से देखना और सोचना
definition: close attention that stops to examine detail; looking or thinking hard enough to notice what a passing glance would certainly miss
example: ग़ौर से देखो, दस्तख़त नक़ली हैं — Look closely; the signature is forged.

hindi: पकड़ — जकड़ लेने वाली मज़बूत मुट्ठी
definition: the grip that closes on prey and does not slip, the end of a chase; it names the holding, where escape names the slipping loose
example: वो क़र्ज़ की गिरफ़्त से निकल न सका — He could not get out of the grip of debt.

hindi: पकड़ा जाना — क़ैद में लिया जाना
definition: the act of being caught and taken, the moment a snare or a hand closes; where captivity is a state, this names the seizing itself
example: गिरफ़्तारी की ख़बर सुनते ही घर में सन्नाटा छा गया — Silence fell on the house at the news of the arrest.

hindi: बंधक — क़र्ज़ के बदले रखी गई चीज़
definition: property handed to a lender as security for money borrowed, held by him until the debt is paid off
example: माँ के ज़ेवर गिरवी रखने पड़े — Mother's jewellery had to be pledged.

hindi: भारीपन — बोझ का हद से ज़्यादा होना
definition: the crushing heaviness of a burden, the state of being loaded past what one can carry
example: क़र्ज़ की गिराँ-बारी ने उसे तोड़ दिया — The crushing weight of debt broke him.

hindi: महँगाई — दामों का चढ़ा रहना
definition: the condition of rates standing high across the market, felt as pressure on the household; names the state of dearness, not any single expensive item
example: गिरानी ऐसी है कि तनख़्वाह महीने के बीच में ख़त्म हो जाती है। — Dearness is such that the salary runs out mid-month.

hindi: रुदन — आँसुओं के साथ रोना
definition: weeping with actual tears, the wet member of this group of grief-sounds, often paired with the wailing cry in verse
example: गिरिया के बाद दिल हल्का हुआ — After weeping the heart felt lighter.

hindi: कपड़े का गला — जिसे ग़ुस्से में पकड़ा जाता है
definition: the opening of a garment at the throat and its collar; the part seized in anger or torn in grief
example: पहले अपने गिरेबाँ में झाँको। — First look inside your own collar.

hindi: बवंडर — चक्कर खाती हुई तेज़ हवा
definition: a whirlwind of storm air spinning in a column, lifting dust upward instead of blowing across the ground
example: मैदान में गिर्दबाद उठा और मिट्टी आसमान तक गई। — A whirlwind rose in the field and carried dust to the sky.

hindi: भँवर — पानी का घूमता हुआ ख़तरनाक चक्कर
definition: a whirlpool that pulls a vessel down, danger on water that traps rather than merely tosses
example: कश्ती गिर्दाब में जा फँसी — The boat got caught in a whirlpool.

hindi: उलाहना — अपनों से की गई नरम शिकायत
definition: a soft complaint made to the very person who hurt you, expecting the closeness to survive it; a grievance spoken as affection
example: उसका गिला था कि तुमने ख़बर तक न ली — His complaint was that you did not even ask after him.

hindi: समाई — किसी और चीज़ के लिए बची हुई जगह
definition: the room a situation can still absorb — of space, time, money, or tolerance; asks what a thing will hold rather than what it measures
example: इस बजट में एक और सफ़र की गुंजाइश नहीं है। — There's no room in this budget for another trip.

hindi: गोल छत / गुम्बज — इमारत के ऊपर का अर्धगोल
definition: the rounded dome crowning a building, a roof shaped to be seen from far off rather than merely to cover a room
example: दूर से मक़बरे का गुंबद चमक रहा था — From afar the tomb's dome was gleaming.

hindi: जीविका — रोज़ी कमाने का ज़रिया
definition: the means by which a household's living is earned, the trade or source rather than the managing itself
example: दर्ज़ी का काम ही उनकी गुज़र-औक़ात है — Tailoring is their whole livelihood.

hindi: गुज़ारा — जैसे-तैसे ज़िंदगी चलाना
definition: getting a living made from month to month with barely enough, the making-do that poverty forces
example: पेंशन से किसी तरह गुज़र-बसर हो रही है — Somehow a living is being managed on the pension.

hindi: गुज़रने की जगह — वह रास्ता जहाँ से लोग निकलते हैं
definition: a place people pass through on the way elsewhere, a thoroughfare valued for transit and never as a destination
example: यह चौक शहर की सबसे मसरूफ़ गुज़रगाह है — This square is the city's busiest thoroughfare.

hindi: निवेदन — अदब से रखी गई बात
definition: a request made in deferential register, softer than a demand and more mannered than simply asking
example: मेरी एक छोटी सी गुज़ारिश है, ज़रा ध्यान से सुनिए। — I have one small request; please listen carefully.

hindi: बीता हुआ — जो वक़्त निकल चुका
definition: belonging to the time already passed, pointing back at a stretch of days that cannot be entered again
example: गुज़िश्ता साल का हिसाब अभी बाक़ी है। — Last year's accounts are still pending.

hindi: पिघला हुआ — नर्म कर देने वाला, गलाने वाला
definition: melting or softening, said of a heart worn tender by grief or wine; describes yielding where the fiery word describes burning
example: उस नग़्मे में अजीब सा गुदाज़ था। — There was a strange melting quality in that song.

hindi: बातचीत — तहज़ीब के साथ हुई बात
definition: conversation of a considered kind; carries a decorum that plain talk never claims for itself
example: दो घंटे की गुफ़्तगू के बाद भी मसला वहीं का वहीं रहा। — After two hours of conversation the matter stood exactly where it began.

hindi: अज्ञातता — नाम के बग़ैर, बिना पहचाने रह जाना
definition: the condition of living or dying unknown, with no name attached to the work or the grave; privacy is chosen, this is usually simply what remains
example: बड़े फ़नकार ने गुमनामी में दम तोड़ा — The great artist died in obscurity.

hindi: भटका हुआ — सही राह से हट गया
definition: having lost the right road, said of someone led astray in conduct as much as in direction
example: ग़लत सोहबत ने उसे गुमराह कर दिया — Bad company led him astray.

hindi: पथभ्रष्टता — सही राह से भटके रहने की हालत
definition: the state of being off the right road, straying considered as a condition rather than a single wrong turn
example: यह गुमराही बरसों चलती रही — This straying went on for years.

hindi: अनुमान — बिना सबूत मन में बनी धारणा
definition: a supposition held without evidence, often about another's motives; also the quiet vanity of thinking well of oneself
example: मुझे गुमान था कि वो नाराज़ है। — I had a suspicion he was upset.

hindi: भूखा — जिसके पेट में दिनों से खाना न गया हो
definition: hungry in the settled, wearing sense of a body long without food, not the passing hunger felt before a meal
example: गुरसना मुसाफ़िर दरवाज़े पर खड़ा था। — A famished traveller stood at the door.

hindi: कतराना — सामना करने से बचकर निकल जाना
definition: deliberate avoidance of a subject or a person, evasion by keeping away rather than by offering a false reason
example: वह इस सवाल से गुरेज़ करता रहा — He kept avoiding this question.

hindi: भेड़िया — झुंड में शिकार करने वाला हिंसक जानवर
definition: the wolf among predators, which hunts in a pack and preys on the herd; of a man it names a disguised, patient threat
example: भेड़ों की खाल में कितने ही गुर्ग छुपे हैं — Many a wolf hides in sheep's clothing.

hindi: फूल — खिला हुआ पुष्प
definition: the flower as the standing emblem of beauty in Urdu verse, set always against the nightingale and the thorn
example: हर गुल के साथ काँटा है — With every flower there is a thorn.

hindi: फूल बरसाना — स्वागत में फूल बिखेरना
definition: the scattering of loose flowers over someone in welcome, an act done with blossoms rather than a blossom itself
example: दूल्हे पर गुल-अफ़्शानी की गई। — Flowers were scattered over the bridegroom.

hindi: गुलदाउदी — पतझड़ में खिलने वाला फूल
definition: the chrysanthemum, prized because it flowers when the rest of the garden is going bare
example: नवंबर में गुल-ए-दाऊदी ही बाक़ी बचता है। — In November only the chrysanthemum is left.

hindi: फूलपत्ती की कारीगरी — कपड़े या दीवार पर फूलों का काम
definition: floral work embroidered on cloth or carved on stone, flowers copied by a craftsman rather than grown
example: दरवाज़े पर बारीक गुल-कारी की गई है। — Fine floral work has been done on the door.

hindi: फूल तोड़ने वाला — बाग़ से फूल चुनने वाला
definition: one who picks the flowers off the plant, in verse the figure who ends a blossom's life rather than tends it
example: गुल-चीं आया और चमन ख़ाली हो गया। — The flower-picker came and the garden was left empty.

hindi: फूलों से भरा बाग़ — वह जगह जो खिली हुई हो
definition: a garden at the moment it is full of flowers; names the blooming state of a place rather than the walled plot itself
example: उसके आने से घर गुलज़ार हो गया। — With his arrival the house turned into a garden in bloom.

hindi: फूल-सा कोमल — जिसका बदन फूल जैसा नाज़ुक हो
definition: flower-bodied, praising softness and delicacy of the body rather than of the face
example: वह गुलबदन लड़की सबकी लाडली थी — That flower-soft girl was everyone's darling.

hindi: गुलज़ार — फूलों से भरा हुआ बाग़
definition: a rose garden as a whole world of blooming, the garden used for a community or a country rather than for a yard
example: इस गुलशन को बचाना हम सबका काम है — Protecting this rose garden is everyone's work.

hindi: फूलों का बाग़ — खिला हुआ बगीचा
definition: a flower garden taken as an image of flourishing, a planted place praised for its bloom rather than its produce
example: उसके आने से घर गुलिस्तान हो गया — With her arrival the house became a flower garden.

hindi: गायक — पेशे से गाने वाला
definition: a singer named for the throat that produces the sound, the neutral professional word used for a recording or stage vocalist
example: इस फ़िल्म के गुलूकार कौन हैं — Who is the singer for this film?

hindi: गले से चिपका हार — छाती तक नहीं लटकता
definition: an ornament worn tight against the throat, sitting on the neck instead of hanging down over the chest
example: दुल्हन ने मोतियों का गुलूबंद पहना था। — The bride wore a pearl choker at her throat.

hindi: धृष्ट — अदब की हद लाँघने वाला
definition: impertinent toward someone owed respect; the offence is against rank and courtesy, not against truth
example: बड़े बुज़ुर्गों के सामने इतना गुस्ताख़ मत बनो। — Don't be so impertinent in front of your elders.

hindi: धृष्टता — हद पार करने वाली बदतमीज़ी
definition: an overstepping of rank in speech, apologised for even when meant lightly; impertinence aimed specifically upward at a senior
example: गुस्ताख़ी माफ़, एक बात कहना चाहता हूँ — Forgive the impertinence, I want to say one thing.

hindi: क़ब्र — शाइरी में चलने वाला फ़ारसी लफ़्ज़
definition: the grave in its Persian poetic form, kept alive mostly inside verse and set phrases; means the same pit as क़ब्र but never appears in a burial permit
example: गोर-ओ-कफ़न की फ़िक्र किसे थी — Who was worrying about grave and shroud?

hindi: कान उमेठना — हल्की मगर याद रह जाने वाली सज़ा
definition: a rebuke sharp enough to be remembered, literally an ear-twisting; correction meant to humble a person mildly rather than punish them
example: एक बार की गोशमाली ने उसे सुधार दिया — One sharp correction set him right.

hindi: कोने में बैठ जाना — दुनिया से अलग रहना
definition: withdrawal into a corner away from public life, a chosen retirement rather than a moment of privacy
example: बुढ़ापे में उसने गोशा-नशीनी इख़्तियार कर ली — In old age he took to withdrawal from the world.

hindi: मोती — समुद्र से निकला बेदाग़ मोती
definition: a pearl, the standing emblem of flawless worth in Urdu verse, used of a rare person or quality more often than of jewellery
example: ऐसे लोग गौहर की तरह कम मिलते हैं — Such people are found as rarely as pearls.

hindi: जी घबराना — डर और हड़बड़ी की मिली-जुली हालत
definition: the fluttered panic that precedes something feared, felt in the chest and the stomach; nervousness is far calmer than this
example: इंटरव्यू से पहले हल्की घबराहट थी — There was a slight flutter of panic before the interview.

hindi: कुल-परिवार — अपनी रिवायत और तौर-तरीक़े वाला ख़ानदान
definition: a family known for its own traditions, manners or craft carried down the generations; the family as a school of style, not merely as a line of descent
example: उनका घराना इल्म और अदब के लिए मशहूर है — Their family is famous for learning and letters.

hindi: चंग — उँगलियों से बजाया जाने वाला वीणा-नुमा साज़
definition: the plucked harp-like instrument of tavern verse, sounded with the fingers where the rabab is bowed
example: चंग और सुबू, इससे ज़्यादा किसे चाहिए। — A harp and a wine flask; who needs more than this?

hindi: चिनार वृक्ष — बड़ा पेड़ जिसके पत्ते लाल हो जाते हैं
definition: the plane tree whose broad leaves burn red in autumn, a tree remembered for its colour rather than its fruit
example: चनार के पत्ते सुर्ख़ हो चुके थे। — The leaves of the plane tree had turned crimson.

hindi: बाग़ — फूलों से भरा उपवन
definition: a flower garden taken as a whole world, the setting Urdu poetry uses for community, season and loss
example: चमन उजड़ने के बाद भी हरा है — The garden is green even after being ruined.

hindi: दीया — तेल-बत्ती से जलने वाली छोटी रौशनी
definition: a small oil lamp giving just enough light to keep going, a modest flame rather than a bright source
example: रास्ते में एक चराग़ जल रहा था — A lamp was burning along the way.

hindi: चरने की जगह — जहाँ मवेशी घास चरते हैं
definition: the pasture where grazing animals are put to feed, ground valued for grass rather than for crops
example: गाँव की चरागाह अब सूख चुकी है — The village pasture has dried up now.

hindi: चरने वाला जानवर — घास पर पलने वाला जीव
definition: a grazing animal, the creature that lives off grass rather than flesh; it is paired with birds and beasts to divide the animal world by what it eats
example: चरिंदा हो या परिंदा, सब को रिज़्क़ मिलता है — Grazing beast or bird, every creature gets its sustenance.

hindi: नभचक्र — घूमता हुआ आसमान
definition: the heavens pictured as a turning wheel overhead, naming their revolution and so their habit of reversing a fortune
example: चर्ख़ की गर्दिश किसी के लिए नहीं रुकती। — The turning of the sky stops for no one.

hindi: आँख — देखने वाला अंग
definition: eyes named in the high literary register, appearing mostly inside compounds where plain Hindi would simply use आँख
example: चश्म-ए-बद दूर रहे, बच्चा बहुत प्यारा है — May the evil eye stay far; the child is lovely.

hindi: बुरी नज़र — जलन भरी वह नज़र जो नुक़सान करती मानी जाती है
definition: the envious eye believed to harm whatever it admires; the look itself is named here, not the misfortune that gets blamed on it
example: बच्चे को चश्म-ए-बद से बचाए रखना — Keep the child safe from the evil eye.

hindi: राह देखता हुआ — आँखें रास्ते पर टिकी होना
definition: with the eyes fixed on the road, waiting so attentively that watching for an arrival has become one's whole posture
example: हम कब से चश्म-ए-राह हैं, तुम आते ही नहीं — We have been watching the road for so long, and you never come.

hindi: आँख मूँदना — देखी हुई ख़ता को जान-बूझकर अनदेखा करना
definition: closing the eye on purpose to a fault one has already seen; not ignorance but a chosen refusal to notice, offered as kindness or as convenience
example: इस बार चश्म-पोशी कर लो, अगली बार नहीं — Overlook it this once; not the next time.

hindi: आँख का इशारा — पलक की वह हरकत जो चुपके से बात कह दे
definition: a small movement of the eye that carries a private message; a wink or flicker of understanding exchanged between two people without a word
example: उसने चश्मक से समझा दिया कि चुप रहो — A wink told me to stay quiet.

hindi: आँखों देखा — जो घटना के वक़्त मौजूद रहा हो
definition: seen with one's own eyes; said of a witness whose account rests on having been present, as against a report repeated at second hand
example: पुलिस को एक चश्मदीद गवाह मिल गया — The police found an eyewitness.

hindi: चालीसवाँ — मौत के चालीसवें दिन की रस्म
definition: the observance held on the fortieth day after a death, the point at which the heaviest stretch of mourning is formally closed
example: चहलुम के बाद घर कुछ सँभला — The house steadied a little after the fortieth-day rites.

hindi: कपड़े का चीरा — ग़म में फाड़ा गया गिरेबान
definition: the slit or tear in a garment; in verse the collar torn open by grief rather than worn through by use
example: ख़बर सुनते ही उसने गिरेबान चाक कर लिया। — On hearing the news he tore his collar open.

hindi: घोड़ा साधने वाला — जो कोड़े से घोड़े को सिखाए
definition: the rider who breaks and trains horses with the whip, working on the animal itself rather than riding it into battle
example: अच्छा चाबुक-सवार घोड़े को मारता नहीं, समझाता है — A good horse-breaker does not beat the horse, he teaches it.

hindi: घर की घेराबंदी — चारों ओर की दीवार
definition: the four walls enclosing a household, named less as masonry than as the privacy and honour those walls keep in
example: जो बात चार-दीवारी की है, बाहर न जाए — What belongs within the four walls should not go out.

hindi: उपाय — रोग या मुसीबत का इलाज
definition: the one available remedy for an illness or trouble, a cure spoken of as an escape; used most often when declaring that none exists
example: इस मरज़ का कोई चारा नहीं। — There is no remedy for this disease.

hindi: चालाकी भरी हरकत — दाँव चलकर काम बनाना
definition: the playing of moves against people, cunning shown in manoeuvre and countermove rather than in disguise or plain falsehood
example: दफ़्तर की चालबाज़ी से वह थक चुका था — He was tired of the manoeuvring at the office.

hindi: अभिलाषा — किसी को पाने की सादा इच्छा
definition: plain wanting of another person, the ordinary everyday register sitting beneath the grander vocabulary of passion
example: मेरी चाहत बस इतनी है कि तुम ख़ुश रहो। — All I want is for you to be happy.

hindi: तीलियों का पर्दा — जिसके पीछे से देखा जा सके
definition: a hanging screen of split reeds covering a doorway, letting those inside see out without being seen
example: चिलमन के पीछे से किसी ने झाँका और हट गया। — Someone peered from behind the reed screen and withdrew.

hindi: नाका कर — शहर में माल लाने पर वसूला जाने वाला कर
definition: the local toll taken on goods as they enter a town's limits; collected at the boundary by the municipality, not by the state on the whole trade
example: नाके पर चुंगी देकर गाड़ी आगे बढ़ी। — The cart moved on after paying the toll at the checkpost.

hindi: निश्चिंतता — नींद और रोटी वाला आराम
definition: ordinary restfulness, the plain ability to sleep and eat without worry gnawing; humbler than peace and missed far more sharply
example: जब तक ख़बर नहीं आई, चैन नहीं पड़ा — Until the news came, there was no rest.

hindi: चतुष्पद — चार पैरों वाला पालतू पशु
definition: a four-footed animal, the beast counted by its legs when livestock is listed; it distinguishes walking cattle from birds and fish
example: हर चौपाया गिन कर बाड़े में लाया गया — Every four-footed beast was counted into the pen.

hindi: लड़ाका — लड़ने पर हमेशा आमादा
definition: warlike, describing a fighter or a people always ready for battle; a temperament for war rather than a post in an army
example: वह क़बीला अपनी जंगजू फ़ितरत के लिए मशहूर था — That tribe was famous for its warlike nature.

hindi: युद्धविराम — लड़ाई फ़िलहाल रोक देना
definition: a ceasefire, fighting halted by agreement while the quarrel behind it remains unsettled
example: सरहद पर जंगबंदी का ऐलान हुआ — A ceasefire was declared at the border.

hindi: प्रतिफल — अच्छे काम का बदला
definition: the reward given for good deeds when they are finally judged, paired with punishment as the other half of the reckoning; recompense returns any deed, this one names the good return
example: आपकी मदद की जज़ा ख़ुदा दे — May God reward you for your help.

hindi: उमंग — कुछ कर गुज़रने वाला भावावेग
definition: emotion with drive behind it, the feeling that turns into action; sentiment sits still while this pushes somebody forward
example: टीम में जीतने का जज़्बा था — The team had real spirit to win.

hindi: पैतृक — दादा-परदादा से चला आया हुआ
definition: coming down from grandfathers and their fathers, said of property, trade or a house held for generations; stresses the ancestors, not the act of inheriting
example: ये जद्दी मकान बेचने को कोई तैयार नहीं — Nobody is willing to sell this ancestral house.

hindi: संघर्ष — लगातार चलने वाली लड़ाई
definition: a sustained struggle carried on over a long stretch against circumstances or opponents; the whole campaign, not one push
example: आज़ादी की जद्दोजहद कई नस्लों तक चली — The struggle for freedom ran across several generations.

hindi: बेवफ़ाई भरा सितम — प्रेम में दिया गया दुख
definition: the cruelty inflicted by the beloved specifically, faithlessness and unkindness together, which is what makes it a lover's word rather than a general one
example: इतनी जफ़ा के बाद भी वह वफ़ा करता है — Even after such cruelty from her, he stays faithful.

hindi: कष्ट सहना — मेहनत और तकलीफ़ दोनों झेलते जाना
definition: the endurance of steady hardship and hard labour over years without complaint; a working life borne, not a single blow survived
example: उसकी जफ़ा-कशी ने ही इस दुकान को खड़ा किया — It was his endurance of hardship that built this shop.

hindi: माथा — भौंहों के ऊपर का हिस्सा
definition: the forehead, taken as the surface on which fate, pride or humility can be read
example: उसकी जबीं पर शिकन तक नहीं थी — There was not even a crease on his forehead.

hindi: बलप्रयोग — ज़बरदस्ती करवाया गया काम
definition: coercion, forcing someone to act against his will; names the compulsion applied, where ज़ुल्म names the injustice of the whole situation
example: यह इक़बाल जब्र से लिया गया था — This confession was taken by coercion.

hindi: आमदनी और ख़र्च का हिसाब — क्या आया, क्या गया
definition: the running account of what came in against what went out, kept side by side; the ledger view of money, not a bank balance at one moment
example: दुकान का जमा-ख़र्च हर रात लिखकर ही वो सोता है। — He sleeps only after writing up the shop's income-and-expense account.

hindi: सौंदर्य — मुख की आभा और लावण्य
definition: beauty of face and bearing spoken of with reverence, the gentle radiance a person carries, as against beauty measured feature by feature
example: उसके जमाल की चर्चा हर तरफ़ थी — Talk of her radiant beauty was everywhere.

hindi: सुंदर एवं शालीन — जिसका सौंदर्य गरिमा लिए हो
definition: beautiful with a moral shine to it, the adjective belonging to जमाल, used where beauty carries dignity rather than mere charm
example: यह एक जमील ख़याल है — This is a beautiful and noble thought.

hindi: क़ाफ़िले की घंटी — ऊँट के गले में बँधा घुँघरू
definition: the bell of a caravan whose sound announces departure, a signal to move that travellers dread hearing
example: जरस बजी और क़ाफ़िला उठ खड़ा हुआ — The caravan bell rang and the company rose.

hindi: घाव — कटा-फटा ज़ख़्म जिसका इलाज हो
definition: an open wound regarded as a surgical case, the injury a knife made or a knife must treat; clinical where common speech is not
example: जराहत गहरी है, टाँके लगाने पड़ेंगे। — The wound is deep; it will need stitches.

hindi: शल्य चिकित्सक — चीर-फाड़ से इलाज करने वाला
definition: a physician who treats by cutting, the surgeon as opposed to the one who prescribes; skill of the hand, not of the prescription
example: जर्राह ने घंटे भर में गोली निकाल दी। — The surgeon removed the bullet within an hour.

hindi: छटा — चमक-दमक भरा प्रकटन
definition: a dazzling showing that briefly makes someone the centre of a room, naming the display rather than the beauty behind it
example: स्टेज पर उसका जलवा देखने लायक़ था। — His blaze on stage was worth seeing.

hindi: समारोह — बड़ी और खुली सार्वजनिक सभा
definition: a large public function or rally with a stage and an audience of strangers, scaled up and open, unlike the private company that fills a महफ़िल
example: जलसा शुरू हुआ तो हज़ारों लोग जमा थे — When the public function began, thousands had gathered.

hindi: प्रताप — भव्यता जिसमें भय भी हो
definition: awe-inspiring majesty, splendour of the kind that overwhelms rather than pleases; the standing counterweight to जमाल
example: उसके चेहरे पर जलाल था — There was majesty on his face.

hindi: बहादुर युवक — मर्दानगी दिखाने वाला जवान
definition: a young man judged by nerve and generosity rather than age, the ideal a youth is measured against
example: मुश्किल में उसने जवाँ-मर्द की तरह साथ दिया। — He stood by me like a true young man in trouble.

hindi: युवा उम्र का — कम सालों वाला
definition: young in the count of years, a neutral description of a young person's age with no praise attached
example: वो अभी जवाँ-साल है, वक़्त उसके पास है। — He is young in years; time is on his side.

hindi: मर्दानगी — डटकर खड़े रहने का हौसला
definition: the conduct expected of a young man under pressure, courage joined to fair dealing rather than mere strength
example: जवाँमर्दी ये है कि कमज़ोर पर हाथ न उठे। — Manly courage is that no hand is raised on the weak.

hindi: उत्तरदायित्व — अपने काम का हिसाब देना पड़ना
definition: the standing obligation to answer for your conduct, the condition that makes a reckoning possible at all
example: हर ओहदे के साथ जवाब-देही आती है। — Accountability comes with every office.

hindi: उत्तर-सहित — जिसमें जवाब की गुंजाइश पहले से रखी गई हो
definition: written expecting a reply, describing a letter or card sent with the return already arranged for; the reply is built into the sending
example: जवाबी कार्ड भेजा था, फिर भी जवाब नहीं आया। — I sent a reply-paid card and still got no answer.

hindi: क़ीमती नग — इकट्ठे बोले जाने वाले रत्न
definition: precious stones spoken of together as a class of wealth; gems in the plural, weighed as treasure
example: संदूक़ में जवाहर के अलावा कुछ न था। — There was nothing in the chest but precious stones.

hindi: बसंत का जश्न — बहार आने पर होने वाला उत्सव
definition: the public celebration held because the flowering season has arrived; the festival, not the season itself
example: शहर में जश्न-ए-बहाराँ की तैयारी हो रही है। — The city is preparing for the spring festival.

hindi: नरक — दोज़ख़ का अरबी नाम, कोसने में भी इस्तेमाल
definition: hell in its Arabic-derived form, weightier in religious speech and the one that turns up in curses telling someone where to go
example: जाओ जहन्नुम में, मुझसे कुछ न कहो — Go to hell, say nothing to me.

hindi: अज्ञान — इल्म से पूरी तरह ख़ाली होने की हालत
definition: ignorance as a settled condition of a person or an age, carrying blame with it; not knowing one thing is a gap, this is a whole mind left unlit
example: जहालत हर बुराई की जड़ है — Ignorance is the root of every evil.

hindi: दहेज — विदाई के समय लड़की के साथ भेजा जाने वाला सामान
definition: the goods a bride's family sends with her to her husband's household at the wedding; her family's outlay, opposite in direction to the dower the husband owes her
example: जहेज़ के नाम पर उन्होंने एक पैसा नहीं लिया — They took not a paisa in the name of dowry.

hindi: बलहीन बूढ़ा — कमज़ोर हो चुका बुज़ुर्ग
definition: weak with age, naming an old person by the strength they have lost rather than by the years they hold
example: ज़ईफ़ माँ-बाप को अकेला छोड़ना ठीक नहीं। — Leaving age-weakened parents alone is not right.

hindi: धर्म-दान — संपत्ति पर तय हिस्से का अनिवार्य दान
definition: the fixed yearly share of one's wealth owed to the poor, an obligation worked out by rule and not left to generosity
example: साल पूरा होते ही उसने ज़कात निकाल दी — As the year turned he set aside the obligatory alms.

hindi: जमा किया हुआ माल — अनाज या सामान का भंडार
definition: a hoard of grain or goods laid by for later, stored against scarcity and often for profit rather than for the next meal
example: गोदाम में गेहूँ का ज़ख़ीरा पड़ा था। — A store of wheat lay in the warehouse.

hindi: घाव खाया हुआ — जो पहले चोट खा चुका हो
definition: of someone already wounded once and wary because of it; the injury is past, its caution present
example: ज़ख़्म-ख़ुर्दा आदमी जल्दी भरोसा नहीं करता — A once-wounded man does not trust quickly.

hindi: प्रसूता — अभी-अभी बच्चा जनने वाली स्त्री
definition: a woman in the days just after giving birth, kept apart and specially fed; names the mother in that state, where birth names the child's arrival
example: ज़च्चा और बच्चा दोनों ख़ैरियत से हैं — Both the new mother and the child are well.

hindi: मारपीट — शरीर पर बार-बार वार
definition: beating a person physically, striking them repeatedly; the formal and legal name for a thrashing given to someone
example: पुलिस पर ज़द-ओ-कोब का इल्ज़ाम लगा — The police were accused of physical beating.

hindi: अंतःपुर — घर का वह हिस्सा जहाँ औरतें रहती हैं
definition: the inner part of a house reserved for the women of the family, closed to unrelated men; a household's private half, opposite to the quarters where guests are met
example: ज़नान-ख़ाना घर के पिछले हिस्से में था — The women's quarters were in the back part of the house.

hindi: जय — शानदार विजय
definition: victory in its literary register, triumph spoken of as an honour granted, the word poets and royal titles prefer
example: उसके नाम के साथ ज़फ़र जुड़ा हुआ था — Triumph was attached to his name.

hindi: सुहागरात — विवाह के बाद वर-वधू का पहला मिलन
definition: the wedding night on which the bride and groom are first brought together, completing the marriage in practice; the union itself, after the contract and the feast
example: ज़फ़ाफ़ की रात घर में ख़ामोशी छा गई — On the wedding night a hush settled over the house.

hindi: ज़ब्ह किया हुआ जानवर — जिसका गोश्त खाया जा सकता है
definition: the animal that has been ritually slaughtered, and so the meat itself as lawful food; names the result where slaughter names the act
example: दुकान पर सिर्फ़ ज़बीहा गोश्त मिलता है। — The shop sells only ritually slaughtered meat.

hindi: बुरी हालत — गिरी हुई और कमज़ोर दशा
definition: the reduced, feeble condition of someone once better off, where the decay shows in circumstances as well as in the body
example: पुराने रईस ख़ानदान की ज़बूँ-हाली देखी नहीं जाती — The fallen state of the old noble family is hard to look at.

hindi: आत्म-संयम — जज़्बे को भीतर ही रोक लेना
definition: the deliberate holding in of feeling so that none of it shows, self-control exercised against one's own face and voice
example: ख़बर सुनकर भी उसने ज़ब्त किया — Even on hearing the news he held himself in.

hindi: सरकारी छीन-लेना — माल या ज़मीन का हमेशा के लिए सरकार के क़ब्ज़े में जाना
definition: the confiscation of goods or land by the state, which keeps them for good; property lost outright, not merely frozen
example: मालगुज़ारी न देने पर ज़मीन की ज़ब्ती का हुक्म आया — An order to confiscate the land came for unpaid revenue.

hindi: हलाल तरीक़े से जानवर काटना — खाने के लिए ज़बह करना
definition: the ritual cutting of an animal's throat so its meat becomes lawful food, an act bound by rule rather than plain killing
example: बकरे का ज़ब्ह सुबह किया गया। — The goat was ritually slaughtered in the morning.

hindi: गुनगुनाहट — गले में घुलती हुई मीठी तान
definition: a soft rippling run of melody sung low in the throat, a humming ornament rather than a full song; a tune is composed, this is spun in the moment
example: वह काम करते हुए ज़मज़मा करता रहा — He kept humming softly while working.

hindi: लेप — गाढ़ी दवा जो बाँधकर लगाई जाए
definition: a thick medicinal paste bound over a swelling or fracture, heavier than an ointment and meant to stay in place under a bandage
example: टूटी हड्डी पर ज़माद बाँध दिया गया। — A medicinal paste was bound over the broken bone.

hindi: प्रतिभूति — किसी की देनदारी पूरी होने की गारंटी
definition: a formal guarantee that a debt or obligation will be met, security given on another person's behalf
example: क़र्ज़ के लिए मकान की ज़मानत देनी पड़ी — The house had to be given as security for the loan.

hindi: ज़मानत का काग़ज़ — लिखित ज़मानती दस्तावेज़
definition: the written bond in which a surety is recorded, turning a spoken guarantee into an enforceable document
example: अदालत ने ज़मानत-नामा जमा कराने का हुक्म दिया। — The court ordered the bail bond to be filed.

hindi: परिशिष्ट — मुख्य लेख के अंत में जोड़ा गया हिस्सा
definition: an appendix added at the end of a written work, supplementary matter the main text can be read without
example: पूरी तफ़सील का ज़मीमा आख़िर में लगा है। — An appendix with the full details is attached at the end.

hindi: अंतरात्मा — भीतर बैठा वह जो सही-ग़लत बताता है
definition: the inner faculty that judges your own act as right or wrong and will not be argued with; the law punishes from outside, this convicts from inside
example: ज़मीर ने रात भर सोने नहीं दिया — My conscience kept me awake all night.

hindi: पन्ना — हरे रंग का क़ीमती नग
definition: the green precious stone, emerald; named for its green where other gems are named for their fire
example: उसके गले में ज़मुर्रद का नग दमक रहा था। — An emerald shone at her throat.

hindi: स्वर्ण / नक़दी — सिक्के की शक्ल में धन
definition: money in its hard form, gold or coin, wealth you can weigh in the hand rather than holdings written in a ledger
example: ज़र के बग़ैर इस शहर में कोई नहीं सुनता — Without money nobody in this city listens to you.

hindi: ज़मानत राशि — ज़मानत के तौर पर जमा की गई रक़म
definition: money deposited as security for an obligation, returned once the undertaking has been performed
example: ठेकेदार से ज़र-ए-ज़मानत जमा कराया गया। — The security money was taken from the contractor.

hindi: धन-पूजा — पैसे को सबसे ऊपर रखना
definition: the worship of money, greed hardened into a whole value system in which wealth outranks people and principle
example: ज़र-परस्ती में दोस्ती भी सौदा बन जाती है — In the worship of money even friendship becomes a deal.

hindi: सुनार — सोने-चाँदी के गहने बनाने वाला
definition: the goldsmith who makes ornaments of gold and silver; he works metal, not cloth
example: ज़रगर ने कंगन तौलकर दाम बताए। — The goldsmith weighed the bangle and named a price.

hindi: सुनहरी कढ़ाई — कपड़े पर सोने के तार से किया गया काम
definition: the embroidering of gold thread onto finished cloth with a needle; laid on afterwards, where gold-woven cloth carries the metal in its weave
example: दुपट्टे के किनारों पर ज़रदोज़ी का काम है। — There is gold embroidery along the edges of the dupatta.

hindi: सुनहरा बुनाव — सोने के तार से बुना हुआ कपड़ा
definition: cloth woven through with gold thread on the loom itself; the gold lies in the weave, not laid on afterwards
example: ज़रबफ़्त का पर्दा दरबार में लटका था। — A gold-woven curtain hung in the court.

hindi: कृषि — खेती-बाड़ी का पूरा पेशा
definition: agriculture as a whole occupation and science, wider than the single season's act of cultivation
example: मुल्क की मईशत ज़राअत पर टिकी है। — The country's economy rests on agriculture.

hindi: सुनहरा तार — और उससे बना हुआ कपड़ा
definition: gold thread, and the cloth worked with it; the thread is what the word names, not the finished garment
example: दुपट्टे के किनारे पर ज़री का काम था। — There was gold thread work on the border of the wrap.

hindi: पीला रंग — डर या बीमारी से उतरा हुआ रंग भी
definition: yellow in colour, and the pale colour of a face drained by fear or by illness
example: ख़बर सुनकर उसका रंग ज़र्द पड़ गया। — His colour turned yellow at the news.

hindi: पात्रता — मन की गहराई, सहने और पचाने की क्षमता
definition: the capacity to carry praise, insult, or confidence without spilling any of it; measures depth of character, never ability
example: तारीफ़ सुनकर भी वो शांत रहा, ये उसका ज़र्फ़ है। — He stayed calm even at the praise; that is his depth.

hindi: चोट — मार पड़ने से बना आघात
definition: the blow itself and the internal injury it leaves, damage from impact rather than from cutting; a bruise has a cause here
example: सर पर ज़र्ब लगी है, टेस्ट कराना ज़रूरी है। — There is a blow to the head; a scan is necessary.

hindi: पतन — उठान के बाद का ढलना
definition: decline setting in after a peak, the downward half of a life, a body or an empire; a slow perishing rather than a sudden end
example: हर उरूज को ज़वाल है — Every rise has its decline.

hindi: तकलीफ़ — दूसरे पर पड़ने वाला बोझ
definition: the trouble that doing something costs the person who obliges you, named politely when asking a favour or apologising for one
example: आपने इतनी ज़हमत क्यों की, मैं ख़ुद आ जाता — Why did you take such trouble, I would have come myself.

hindi: स्वाद — खाने का वो मज़ा जो ज़बान पर उतरता है
definition: the taste of food as the tongue registers it, the particular flavour of a dish rather than the pleasure it gives the eater
example: इस सालन का ज़ाइक़ा भूलता नहीं। — The taste of this curry is unforgettable.

hindi: जन्म-कुंडली — पैदाइश के वक़्त सितारों की हालत का नक़्शा
definition: the chart of the stars drawn for the hour of a birth, from which a life's future is read; a diagram, not the prediction taken off it
example: पैदाइश के दिन उसका ज़ाइचा बनवाया गया — His birth chart was drawn up on the day he was born.

hindi: कौआ — अशुभ और लालची माना जाने वाला परिंदा
definition: the crow as a bird of ill omen and greed, set against the songbird in verse; calling a man this denies him all grace
example: गुलशन में बुलबुल नहीं, ज़ाग़ बोल रहे हैं — Not nightingales but crows are calling in the garden.

hindi: रास्ते का तोशा — सफ़र का ख़र्च और सामान
definition: the provisions carried for a journey, what a traveller takes along to survive the road rather than what waits at its end
example: उसके पास ज़ाद-ए-राह के नाम पर कुछ न था — He had nothing at all by way of provisions for the road.

hindi: केसर का फूल — बैंजनी फूल जिससे केसर मिलता है
definition: the crocus grown for saffron, a flower harvested for its thread rather than kept for its bloom
example: पंपोर के खेतों में ज़ाफ़रान उगता है। — Saffron grows in the fields of Pampore.

hindi: प्रक्रिया-नियम — काम करने का तय किया हुआ तरीक़ा
definition: the settled procedure or code by which something must be done, the how rather than the what; a case can fail on procedure though the law favours you
example: हर महकमे का अपना ज़ाबता होता है — Every department has its own procedure.

hindi: नियमावली — काम करने का तय किया हुआ तरीक़ा
definition: the fixed procedure an office or a court must follow, rules of method rather than rules of right and wrong
example: ज़ाब्ता पूरा किए बिना गिरफ़्तारी नहीं हो सकती — There can be no arrest without completing due procedure.

hindi: ज़मानतदार — जो किसी की जवाबदेही अपने सिर ले
definition: the person who stands surety for another and answers for the default if it comes; an intercessor asks for mercy, this one accepts the liability
example: मैं उसका ज़ामिन हूँ — I stand surety for him.

hindi: फूट-फूट कर — लगातार रोने के अंदाज़ में
definition: of weeping done aloud and without pause, the manner of a cry rather than the cry itself; describes how one laments
example: ख़बर सुनते ही वो ज़ार-ओ-क़तार रोने लगी — On hearing the news she wept bitterly and long.

hindi: गिड़गिड़ाकर रोना — रो-रोकर फ़रियाद करना
definition: weeping that pleads, grief poured out as an appeal to God or to whoever will listen; asks for something, where plain weeping only spends itself
example: क़ब्र पर उसकी आह-ओ-ज़ारी देखी न गई — His weeping and pleading at the grave was unbearable to watch.

hindi: ओला — आसमान से गिरने वाली बर्फ़ की गोली
definition: hail, ice falling from the cloud as hard pellets that damage crops, unlike the soft rain that waters them
example: ज़ाला गिरने से गेहूँ की फ़स्ल तबाह हो गई। — The wheat crop was ruined by falling hail.

hindi: संयमी — दुनिया से कटा हुआ धर्मपरायण आदमी
definition: the ascetic who abstains on principle and stands as the drinker's opposite in verse; refuses pleasure rather than merely preaching against it
example: ज़ाहिद को मयख़ाने की गली से भी डर लगता है। — The ascetic fears even the lane the tavern stands on.

hindi: प्रकट — जो सामने दिख रहा हो
definition: out in the open where the eye can reach it; the visible aspect of a thing, kept in permanent contrast with whatever stays inward and unseen
example: उसकी नाराज़गी चेहरे से ज़ाहिर थी — His displeasure was evident from his face.

hindi: ऊपरी दिखावा — मन के बिना निभाया गया शिष्टाचार
definition: keeping up appearances, the hollow courtesy performed without any feeling behind it; hypocrisy that is social habit rather than deliberate fraud
example: यह मोहब्बत नहीं, महज़ ज़ाहिर-दारी है — This is not affection, only keeping up appearances.

hindi: दिखावा — बाहर से बना रखा गया रूप
definition: the keeping up of appearances, courtesy maintained neatly on the surface with nothing standing behind it
example: उनकी मेहरबानी महज़ ज़ाहिरदारी थी — His kindness was mere show.

hindi: ऊपरी — जो सिर्फ़ दिखने भर का हो
definition: outward and surface-level only, false in the sense that nothing stands behind the appearance rather than that it imitates something real
example: यह ज़ाहिरी मेल-जोल है, दिल नहीं मिले — This is an outward friendliness; the hearts have not met.

hindi: कारागार — शायरी में जकड़ बंद कर देने वाली जगह
definition: the dungeon or prison spoken of as a place of suffering, the literary word a poet uses where a clerk would write जेल
example: ज़िंदाँ की दीवारें भी उसका हौसला न तोड़ सकीं — Even the prison walls could not break his spirit.

hindi: भला ज़िक्र — मरने वाले की अच्छी बातों का बयान
definition: speaking well of someone who has died, the convention of recalling only their good; also a polite way of saying a person came up in conversation
example: महफ़िल में उनका ज़िक्र-ए-ख़ैर होता रहा — He was remembered kindly all through the gathering.

hindi: हठी — अपनी बात पर अड़ जाने वाला
definition: stubborn the way a child is, digging in for the sake of not yielding rather than out of conviction
example: ज़िद्दी बच्चा खिलौना लिए बिना नहीं हिलता। — The stubborn child won't move without the toy.

hindi: हलाल करना — गला काट कर जानवर काटना
definition: the ritual slaughter of an animal by the throat, done for meat under religious rule rather than in a hunt
example: ईद पर जानवर का ज़िबह सुन्नत के मुताबिक़ होता है — On Eid the animal's slaughter follows the prescribed way.

hindi: उत्तरदायित्व — जिस काम की जवाबदेही अपने सिर हो
definition: the charge or liability a person takes upon himself, the duty he will have to answer for
example: बच्चों की तालीम का ज़िम्मा मैंने लिया है। — I have taken on the charge of the children's education.

hindi: हानि — किसी क़ीमती चीज़ का बरबाद होना
definition: loss or waste of something valuable, the damage side of a reckoning rather than money lost in trade
example: वक़्त का ज़ियाँ पैसे के ज़ियाँ से बड़ा है — The loss of time is greater than the loss of money.

hindi: भोज — मेहमानों के लिए खाने का इंतज़ाम
definition: a feast laid on for guests in one's house, hospitality served as food rather than as a social occasion
example: उसने पूरे मोहल्ले की ज़ियाफ़त की — He gave a feast for the whole neighbourhood.

hindi: दर्शन-यात्रा — किसी मज़ार या पवित्र स्थान पर हाज़िरी
definition: a devotional visit to a shrine or holy grave, a pilgrimage of affection rather than one commanded as a duty
example: हर जुमेरात वे दरगाह की ज़ियारत को जाते हैं — Every Thursday they go to visit the shrine.

hindi: कवच — लोहे की बनी लड़ाई की पोशाक
definition: body armour worn into battle, the metal coat that protects the wearer's own body, not a shield held in the hand
example: ज़िरह पहने बग़ैर वह मैदान में उतर गया — He entered the field without wearing armour.

hindi: छाया — किसी चीज़ के आड़ से बनी अँधेरी जगह
definition: the shadow cast when something blocks the sun, and by extension the protection a powerful person's shade provides
example: दरख़्त की ज़िल्ल में मुसाफ़िर सुस्ताने लगे। — Travellers rested in the shade of the tree.

hindi: अपमान — नीचा दिखाए जाने की हालत
definition: the humiliation of being made small in front of others; degradation actively inflicted, where disgrace is merely suffered as it spreads
example: उसने ज़िल्लत सहने से इनकार कर दिया — He refused to endure the humiliation.

hindi: तंगी — साँस या जगह का घुट जाना
definition: constriction that makes breathing hard, the chest closing in; also any narrowness of space or of circumstances that suffocates
example: सीने में ज़ीक़ महसूस हो तो फ़ौरन बताइए। — Tell me at once if you feel tightness in the chest.

hindi: काठी — घोड़े की पीठ पर कसी जाने वाली गद्दी
definition: the saddle strapped on a horse's back, the seat of the riding gear; being in it means a man is ready to ride, not merely owns the mount
example: उसने घोड़े पर ज़ीन कसी और निकल पड़ा — He tightened the saddle on the horse and set off.

hindi: शोभा — जो किसी चीज़ की सुंदरता बढ़ाए
definition: the added beauty that decoration lends a thing or an ornament lends its wearer; not the ornament itself but what it does
example: यह क़ालीन कमरे की ज़ीनत है — This carpet is the beauty of the room.

hindi: सीढ़ी — ऊपर की मंज़िल तक जाने का रास्ता
definition: the staircase inside a building, the part of a house that exists only to move people between its levels
example: ज़ीना अँधेरा था, मैं सँभल कर चढ़ा — The staircase was dark, so I climbed carefully.

hindi: संतान — किसी की आगे चलने वाली नस्ल
definition: the offspring that carry a person's line onward, spoken of as a whole rather than as individual children
example: उनकी ज़ुर्रियत आज भी इसी क़स्बे में आबाद है। — His offspring live in this same town even today.

hindi: केश-राशि — लंबी घुँघराली लट
definition: long curling hair as a standing poetic image, an apparatus of snares and shade rather than an anatomical detail
example: पुराने गानों में ज़ुल्फ़ का ज़िक्र हर दूसरे शेर में है। — In the old songs her tresses turn up in every second couplet.

hindi: अन्याय — ताक़त के बल पर किया गया अत्याचार
definition: oppression by someone who holds power over the sufferer, a moral and legal wrong where the lover's cruelty is a private one
example: कमज़ोर पर ज़ुल्म सबसे बड़ा गुनाह है — Oppressing the weak is the greatest sin.

hindi: ज़ुल्म की मार — ताक़तवर का लगातार सताना
definition: sustained physical and mental cruelty inflicted by the stronger side over a long time; oppression as a routine, not one act
example: ससुराल के ज़ुल्म-ओ-सितम से तंग आकर वो लौट आई — Worn down by her in-laws' cruelty, she came back.

hindi: अंधकार — घना अँधेरा
definition: thick darkness of night in which nothing can be seen, weightier than mere absence of lamps and often meaning moral darkness
example: बिजली गई तो पूरे मोहल्ले में ज़ुल्मत छा गई। — When the power went, darkness covered the whole neighbourhood.

hindi: सजावट — जो किसी चीज़ पर फबे और उसे संवारे
definition: the grace one thing lends to whatever carries it; ornament by fitness rather than by jewels or cost
example: यह अंगूठी उसके हाथ की ज़ेब है। — This ring is the grace of her hand.

hindi: फबता हुआ — जो शख़्स पर सजे
definition: becoming; said of dress or conduct that suits the person carrying it, rather than merely looking costly
example: ऐसी बात तुम्हें ज़ेबा नहीं देती। — Such a remark is not becoming in you.

hindi: सँवारने का अमल — किसी चीज़ को सजाना
definition: the work of adorning something so that it looks well; adornment as the act performed, not the ornament used
example: मकान की ज़ेबाइश में महीना लग गया। — The adorning of the house took a month.

hindi: नज़र के नीचे — जिस पर नज़र रखी जा रही हो
definition: under someone's eye, being watched or supervised; the standing of a person or a matter that is kept in view until it is settled
example: मामला अभी अदालत के ज़ेर-ए-नज़र है — The matter is still under the court's consideration.

hindi: एहसान या बोझ तले दबा — जो उऋण न हो सके
definition: of a person under a burden, especially the burden of a favour they cannot repay; being under the load, not the load itself
example: मैं आपकी मदद का ज़ेर-ए-बार हूँ — I am under the burden of your help.

hindi: होंठों में — दबी हुई आवाज़ या दबी हुई मुस्कान में
definition: under the lips, said of a smile or a remark held half back; visible or audible only to whoever happens to be watching closely
example: वह ज़ेर-ए-लब कुछ बुदबुदाया — He muttered something under his breath.

hindi: गहना — औरत की अपनी मिल्कियत समझा जाने वाला सोना
definition: gold ornaments held by a woman as her own property; jewellery counted as stored wealth, not decoration alone
example: मुसीबत में उसने अपना ज़ेवर गिरवी रख दिया। — In trouble she pawned her own gold ornaments.

hindi: मस्तिष्क-शक्ति — सोचने और पकड़ने वाला दिमाग़ी औज़ार
definition: the mind considered as a working instrument that grasps, holds and turns things over; not the organ and not the soul, but the apparatus a person thinks with
example: इस वक़्त मेरा ज़ेहन काम नहीं कर रहा — My mind is not working right now.

hindi: मन में बैठा हुआ — जो सुनते ही याद रह जाए
definition: so lodged in the mind that it stays without effort to memorise it; a memorised text is drilled in, this settles by itself and refuses to leave
example: उस्ताद की यह बात ज़ेहन-नशीन हो गई — That remark of the teacher lodged itself in my mind.

hindi: कुशाग्रता — दिमाग़ की तेज़ी और जल्दी पकड़ने की क़ुव्वत
definition: quickness of mind, the sharpness that grasps a thing before it has been fully explained; a property of the mental instrument rather than of the knowledge stored in it
example: बच्चे की ज़ेहानत उस्ताद को हैरान कर गई — The child's quickness astonished the teacher.

hindi: दुर्बलता — ताक़त का घट जाना
definition: loss of bodily strength as a medical condition, weakness that a physician treats; not laziness and not sorrow, but depleted power
example: ख़ून की कमी से ज़ोफ़ बढ़ गया है। — Anaemia has increased the weakness.

hindi: विरक्ति — दुनिया से बेरग़बती
definition: the piety of renunciation, deliberately abstaining from worldly comfort even when it is entirely lawful
example: उसके ज़ोहद में दिखावा नहीं था — There was no display in his renunciation.

hindi: शुक्र — शाम को दिखने वाला सबसे चमकीला ग्रह
definition: the planet Venus in the evening sky, the brightest of the wandering stars and the classical figure of beauty and music
example: शाम के आसमान पर ज़ोहरा सबसे पहले नुमायाँ हुई। — Venus appeared first in the evening sky.

hindi: रसिकता — चीज़ों का मज़ा समझने की तबियत
definition: the trained relish that lets a person taste quality in verse, music, or wine; a capacity for pleasure, not the pleasure itself
example: शेर का ज़ौक़ उन्हें विरासत में मिला है। — His taste for poetry came to him as an inheritance.

hindi: पति — क़ानूनी और धार्मिक भाषा का जीवनसाथी
definition: a husband in the language of law, contracts and religious texts, one half of a married pair; the formal counterpart to the ordinary word for husband
example: काग़ज़ात में ज़ौज का नाम दर्ज करना ज़रूरी है — Entering the husband's name in the documents is required.

hindi: पत्नी — निकाह में बँधी हुई स्त्री, औपचारिक शब्द
definition: a wife as named in documents, contracts and formal announcements, the female half of a married pair; a register word, not what a man calls her at home
example: मरहूम की ज़ौजा और तीन बच्चे हैं — The deceased leaves a wife and three children.

hindi: हद से बढ़ा हुआ बर्ताव — हक़ से आगे जाकर किया गया अन्याय
definition: excess in dealing with someone, going beyond what authority or fairness allowed; the everyday word for high-handedness short of outright oppression
example: पुलिस की ज़्यादती की शिकायत दर्ज हुई — A complaint of police high-handedness was registered.

hindi: जी-जान से मेहनत — अपने आप को खपा देना
definition: struggle in which a person spends their own health and life on the work; hard labour offered willingly, not extracted
example: उस्ताद की जाँ-फ़िशानी से ही ये स्कूल चला — This school ran only on the teacher's self-spending effort.

hindi: प्राणघातक कष्ट देने वाला — जान घिस देने वाला
definition: wearing life away by slow suffering, said of a pain or labour that grinds rather than kills outright
example: ये जाँकाह दर्द उसे रोज़ थोड़ा और तोड़ता है। — This soul-wearing pain breaks him a little more each day.

hindi: जान देने को तैयार — पूरी तरह वफ़ादार
definition: ready to lay down life for another, naming a loyalty proved by risk rather than by long service
example: वह उसका जाँनिसार दोस्त है — He is a friend who would give his life for her.

hindi: जी-तोड़ कोशिश — जान लगाकर काम करना
definition: the pouring of one's whole self into a piece of work, beyond what duty required; praises the effort's spirit, where hard labour names only its cost
example: उसने जाँफ़िशानी से काम किया और वक़्त पर पूरा कर दिया। — He worked with utter devotion and finished on time.

hindi: जान पर खेलने वाला — मौत से न डरने वाला
definition: brave to the point of risking death, said of a fighter or rescuer whose fearlessness is measured against being killed
example: जाँबाज़ दस्ते ने आग में घुसकर बच्चों को निकाला — The daredevil squad went into the fire and pulled the children out.

hindi: प्राण न्योछावर करना — जान दाँव पर लगा देना
definition: courage that stakes one's own life, bravery understood as a willingness to be killed for the task; the soldier's grade of daring, not the debater's
example: जवानों ने जाँबाज़ी से मोर्चा सँभाला — The men held the position at the risk of their lives.

hindi: अवलोकन — हालत परखने के लिए की गई नज़रसानी
definition: an appraising look taken over something to see where it stands, before any verdict; a review judges quality, this simply surveys the position
example: साल भर के काम का जाइज़ा लिया गया — A review of the year's work was taken.

hindi: आकर्षण-शक्ति — किसी चीज़ का अपनी ओर खींच लेने का गुण
definition: attractiveness treated as a measurable property of a thing, used of a proposal or a product as readily as of a face; more formal and colder than कशिश
example: इस पेशकश में जाज़िबियत तो है — There is real attractiveness in this offer.

hindi: उत्तराधिकारी — जो किसी की जगह लेता है
definition: the one who takes over a position when its holder goes, chosen or born to it rather than merely next in line
example: गद्दी का जानशीन बड़ा बेटा ठहरा। — The elder son was settled as successor to the seat.

hindi: उत्तराधिकार — जगह लेने का हक़ और क्रम
definition: the passing of a position from one holder to the next, the arrangement itself rather than the person who benefits
example: जानशीनी पर भाइयों में झगड़ा हुआ। — A quarrel broke out among the brothers over the succession.

hindi: जान जैसा प्रिय — जिसे संबोधन में जान कहा जाए
definition: the beloved addressed as one's own life, a term of address rather than description, warmer and more intimate than any word that merely names the loved person
example: सुनो जानाँ, यह ख़त तुम्हारे लिए है — Listen, my life, this letter is for you.

hindi: ओर — किसी की तरफ़ या पक्ष
definition: the side towards which something faces or from which it comes, used for direction and for a party in a matter
example: वह दरिया की जानिब बढ़ा — He moved towards the river.

hindi: प्याला — जिसमें शराब पी जाती है
definition: the goblet a drinker actually raises to the mouth, the smallest vessel in the tavern and the only one that touches the lips
example: एक जाम और, फिर घर चलेंगे। — One more cup, then we will go home.

hindi: अंगरखा — बदन पर चढ़ाया जाने वाला वस्त्र
definition: a long body-garment, and figuratively the form a thought is dressed into when it is finally expressed
example: उसका ख़याल लफ़्ज़ों का जामा पहन कर आया — His thought arrived dressed in words.

hindi: अचल संपत्ति — ज़मीन और मकान
definition: immovable property, land and buildings owned, the fixed holdings of a household rather than its cash or trading stock
example: जायदाद बँटी तो भाई अलग हो गए — When the property was divided the brothers parted.

hindi: फ़र्ज़ीवाड़ा — नकली काग़ज़ या दस्तख़त बनाना
definition: forgery of documents or signatures, fraud committed through fabricated paper rather than through spoken lies
example: ज़मीन के काग़ज़ों में जाल-साज़ी पकड़ी गई — Forgery was caught in the land papers.

hindi: कूटरचना — नक़ली काग़ज़ या दस्तख़त बनाना
definition: forgery, the manufacture of false documents or signatures to obtain what is not yours; deception given a paper body that a court can seize
example: वसीयत में जालसाज़ी साबित हो गई — Forgery in the will was proved.

hindi: गुप्तचरी — दुश्मन की ख़ुफ़िया जानकारी हासिल करना
definition: the trained gathering of an enemy state's secrets, covert work carried out on orders rather than casual snooping
example: उन पर जासूसी का मुक़दमा चला — He was tried for espionage.

hindi: वस्तु — बाज़ार में बिकने वाली एक क़िस्म की चीज़
definition: a commodity of a given kind, counted and priced as a class in the market; grain or cotton as a trading category, not one person's possessions
example: बाज़ार में हर जिंस के दाम चढ़ गए हैं। — The price of every commodity has risen in the market.

hindi: गंभीर अपराध — जान या जिस्म पर किया गया जुर्म
definition: a grave crime against life or body, the class of offence tried with the heaviest punishments; narrower and heavier than जुर्म in general
example: यह मामला जिनायत की अदालत में जाएगा — This matter will go to the criminal court.

hindi: प्रतिपरीक्षा — गवाह से कड़े सवाल करके उसे तोलना
definition: the cross-examination of a witness by the opposing side, questioning meant to break or test a statement already given
example: जिरह में गवाह की कहानी बिखर गई — The witness's story fell apart under cross-examination.

hindi: ओप — घिसकर लाई गई चमक
definition: the polish or lustre brought out by rubbing, brightness worked onto a surface rather than born in it
example: पुराने बर्तन पर फिर जिला आ गई — The old vessel regained its lustre.

hindi: देश-निकाला पाया हुआ — वतन से निकाल दिया गया
definition: exiled from one's homeland by another's order, unable to return where a migrant chose to leave
example: शायर बरसों जिला-वतन रहा — The poet remained exiled from his homeland for years.

hindi: देश-निकाला पाया हुआ — वतन से निकाल दिया गया
definition: banished from one's own country by order, exile imposed by power rather than chosen through migration
example: बादशाह ने उसे जिलावतन कर दिया — The king banished him from the country.

hindi: देशनिकाला — सज़ा के तौर पर वतन से निकाला जाना
definition: banishment imposed by power, being kept out of one's homeland as a punishment rather than leaving it by one's own choice
example: शायर ने अपनी उम्र का बड़ा हिस्सा जिलावतनी में काटा — The poet spent most of his life in banishment.

hindi: बंधाई — किताब की सिलाई-बंधाई, और एक बँधा हुआ खंड
definition: the binding that holds a book together, and thence a volume counted as one bound book among several
example: पहली जिल्द पढ़ चुका हूँ, दूसरी नहीं मिली। — I have read the first volume; I could not find the second.

hindi: उन्माद — पागलपन की हद तक की धुन
definition: obsessive intensity bordering on derangement, admired as proof of seriousness where English would reach for a diagnosis
example: क्रिकेट उसके लिए शौक़ नहीं, जुनून है। — Cricket isn't a hobby for him, it's a mania.

hindi: घूँट — एक बार में जितना पानी या मय गले से उतरे
definition: a single swallow of liquid, the drinking counterpart of a mouthful of food and the measure by which a cup is emptied
example: उसने एक ही जुरआ में प्याला ख़ाली कर दिया। — He emptied the cup in a single swallow.

hindi: अर्थदंड — सज़ा के तौर पर वसूला गया पैसा
definition: a monetary penalty imposed as punishment, paid to the state rather than to the person harmed; distinct from compensation for a loss
example: अदालत ने पाँच हज़ार का जुर्माना लगाया — The court imposed a fine of five thousand.

hindi: साहस — कुछ कर बैठने की हिम्मत, कभी धृष्टता भी
definition: the courage to actually do the forbidden or risky thing, edging into nerve and cheek; bravery measured at the moment of daring, and often thrown as an accusation
example: उसकी जुर्रत कैसे हुई कि मुझसे यूँ बात करे — How did he dare speak to me like that?

hindi: तलाश — पाने की लगन भरी खोज
definition: an ongoing search driven by longing rather than method, its worth lying in the seeking itself; investigation wants a finding, this can be its own reward
example: मंज़िल से ज़्यादा जुस्तजू का लुत्फ़ है — The pleasure of the search exceeds that of the destination.

hindi: डील-डौल — शरीर की बनावट और गठन
definition: the physical build of a body, its frame and bulk as a physician sizes it up; how much illness a constitution can carry
example: जुस्सा मज़बूत है, इसीलिए जल्दी सँभल गया। — The build is strong, which is why he rallied quickly.

hindi: छोटी नहर — बाग़ में बहने वाली पानी की धार
definition: a narrow running channel of water cut through a garden, moving water rather than the act of watering
example: बाग़ के बीच एक जू-ए-आब बहती है। — A small water channel runs through the garden.

hindi: अत्याचार — ताक़तवर की तरफ़ से जान-बूझकर की गई नाइंसाफ़ी
definition: the injustice done by the powerful to the weak, deliberate and unashamed; tyranny as it is felt by the one who bears it
example: हाकिम के जौर की शिकायत कहाँ करें — Where should one complain of the ruler's tyranny?

hindi: दौड़ता-फिरता — जो एक जगह टिके नहीं
definition: ranging and galloping about, said of a horse circling the field and of a mind that will not settle; it names motion without a destination
example: तसव्वुर हर वक़्त जौलाँ रहता है — The imagination is forever galloping about.

hindi: मुख्य द्वार का ढका हुआ हिस्सा — घर का पहला कमरा
definition: the covered entrance passage of a large house, a room-like threshold where outsiders are received without entering the household
example: मेहमान ड्योढ़ी में ही बिठा दिए गए — The guests were seated in the entrance passage itself.

hindi: संकीर्ण हृदय — देने और सोचने दोनों में छोटा
definition: narrow-hearted, mean in giving money because mean in spirit, stingy with feeling as much as with cash
example: तंग-दिल मेज़बान से दावत की उम्मीद फ़ुज़ूल है — Expecting a feast from a narrow-hearted host is pointless.

hindi: पैसे की तंगी — महीना काटना मुश्किल हो जाना
definition: poverty felt as a monthly squeeze on money rather than a permanent condition; the pinch that ends when the pay arrives
example: तंग-हाली के दिनों में उसने किसी से उधार नहीं लिया — In those pinched days he borrowed from nobody.

hindi: हाथ की तंगी — नक़दी की किल्लत
definition: poverty felt as a tight hand, the shortage of ready money that pinches daily spending without ruining a household
example: इन दिनों तंगदस्ती है, बाद में दे दूँगा — Money is tight these days; I will pay later.

hindi: व्यंग्य — नुकीली बात जो सीधे न कही जाए
definition: irony sharpened into a weapon; mocks by praising or understating rather than by open insult
example: उसके तंज़ पर महफ़िल हँसी, मगर सिर्फ़ एक आदमी चुप रहा। — The gathering laughed at his barb; only one man stayed quiet.

hindi: संगठन — बिखरी कोशिश को तरतीब देना या ऐसी बनी हुई संस्था
definition: organisation in both senses, putting scattered effort into order and the body that results from doing so
example: तंज़ीम के बग़ैर जोश बेकार जाता है — Without organisation, enthusiasm goes to waste.

hindi: चेतावनी-डाँट — ग़लती पर सख़्ती से आगाह करना
definition: a sharp reprimand meant to warn someone off a fault before it hardens; guidance leads gently, this is administered and stings on purpose
example: देर से आने पर उस्ताद ने तंबीह की — The teacher reprimanded him for arriving late.

hindi: देरी — तय वक़्त से पीछे रह जाने की हालत
definition: the state of falling behind the expected time, a bookish word for lag used in notices and official reports
example: काम में तअख़्ख़ुर की वजह साफ़ बताई जाए — State clearly the reason for the lag in the work.

hindi: विवेकाधीन दंड — जिसकी मात्रा मुंसिफ़ तय करे
definition: discretionary punishment whose measure the judge decides rather than scripture or statute fixing it; correction aimed at reform more than retribution
example: इस जुर्म की सज़ा तअज़ीर पर छोड़ी गई है — The punishment for this offence is left to the judge's discretion.

hindi: जल्दबाज़ी — बिना सोचे जल्दी करने की आदत
definition: haste that hurries a matter before its time, speed treated as a fault rather than as efficiency
example: तअज्जुल में फ़ैसला मत करो — Do not decide in haste.

hindi: सोच-विचार में ठहराव — फ़ैसले से पहले रुक कर सोचना
definition: the pause of considering before acting, thought that shows up as hesitation; deep reflection seeks understanding, this is holding back until the mind is made up
example: उसने कुछ तअम्मुल के बाद हाँ कही — He said yes after some deliberation.

hindi: बेजा दख़ल — दूसरे के हक़ में टाँग अड़ाना
definition: aggression as unprovoked interference, an attack on someone's rights or peace rather than a strike in a declared war
example: किसी की आज़ादी में तअर्रुज़ जायज़ नहीं — Interference in anyone's freedom is not justified.

hindi: पक्षपात — अपने गुट या अक़ीदे के लिए इंसाफ़ छोड़ देना
definition: prejudiced insistence on one's own group or belief, refusing fairness to the other side merely because it is the other side
example: फ़ैसले में तअस्सुब साफ़ झलकता है — The bias shows plainly in the verdict.

hindi: पीछा — लगातार पीछे लगे रहना
definition: the pursuit kept up behind a fleeing prey or person, a chase defined by not letting go rather than by catching
example: पुलिस का तआक़ुब रात भर जारी रहा — The police pursuit went on all night.

hindi: कहा-सुनी — बात पर अड़कर की गई खींचतान
definition: a squabble in which each side keeps repeating itself; less an argument than an argument's stubborn echo
example: छोटी सी बात पर घंटे भर की तकरार। — An hour of bickering over nothing.

hindi: औपचारिकता — मेहमानी वाला संकोच और तड़क-भड़क
definition: effortful ceremony, covering both the fuss made for guests and the shyness that stops a guest from asking; nearly always something to be waved away
example: तकल्लुफ़ मत करो, अपना ही घर है — Do not stand on ceremony; this is your own home.

hindi: समारोह — किसी ख़ास मौक़े का जलसा
definition: a formal occasion held to mark something, the gathering itself where a feast is only what is served at it
example: शादी की तक़रीब घर के अहाते में हुई — The wedding occasion was held in the house compound.

hindi: भाषण — जमा हुए लोगों के सामने की गई बात
definition: a speech delivered to an assembled audience by one speaker at length; dialogue goes both ways, this flows one way from a platform
example: उसकी तक़रीर ने मजमे को जगा दिया — His speech roused the crowd.

hindi: अनुकरण — किसी बड़े के अंदाज़ की नक़ल
definition: the deliberate following of an established master's manner, honourable while learning and a charge of emptiness once one should have a voice of one's own
example: शुरू में तक़लीद ठीक है, हमेशा नहीं — Imitation is fine at the start, not forever.

hindi: ईश-भय — गुनाह से बचाए रखने वाली सजगता
definition: the God-fearing caution that keeps a person back from sin, piety felt as inner watchfulness rather than performed as ritual
example: इल्म से ज़्यादा तक़वा चाहिए — What is needed is piety more than learning.

hindi: मज़बूती देना — कमज़ोर पड़ती चीज़ को ताक़त पहुँचाना
definition: strengthening something that had grown weak, reinforcement added to a position rather than praise added to a person
example: उसकी गवाही से हमारे मौक़िफ़ को तक़वियत मिली। — His testimony strengthened our position.

hindi: क़ुसूर — वह चूक जिसकी जवाबदेही मानी जाए
definition: a fault one formally owns and answers for, the wrong named as belonging to a specific person; sin describes the act, this word assigns it
example: मेरी तक़सीर है, सज़ा भी मुझे मिले — The fault is mine; let the punishment be mine too.

hindi: उगाही की माँग — बकाया चुकाने के लिए बार-बार कहना
definition: the repeated pressing demand made on someone who owes money or a promised act; asking that has hardened into insistence, short of a legal claim
example: क़र्ज़ का तक़ाज़ा रोज़ आता है और जेब ख़ाली है। — The demand for the loan comes daily and the pocket is empty.

hindi: कमी करना — सज़ा या बोझ हल्का करना
definition: reducing a punishment or a burden already imposed, mitigation granted rather than the fault forgiven
example: अच्छे चाल-चलन पर सज़ा में तख़फ़ीफ़ हुई। — The sentence was reduced for good conduct.

hindi: अनुमानित लागत — काम पर कितना ख़र्च आएगा उसका हिसाब
definition: a worked-out estimate of what a job or purchase will cost before it is begun; a costed forecast, unlike a guess, and not yet the final rate
example: मिस्त्री ने मरम्मत का तख़मीना पचास हज़ार लगाया है। — The mason has put the estimate for repairs at fifty thousand.

hindi: उपनाम — शायर का अपने लिए चुना हुआ काव्य-नाम
definition: the pen name a poet chooses and works into the closing couplet, functioning as a signature rather than a disguise; a pseudonym hides identity, this one advertises it
example: उनका तख़ल्लुस ही उन्हें मशहूर कर गया — It was his pen name that made him famous.

hindi: दौड़-धूप — बार-बार की भाग-दौड़ और कोशिश
definition: running to and fro after something, the horse-word for galloping turned into everyday effort; it names tiring pursuit, not achievement
example: सारी उम्र की तग-ओ-दौ के बाद भी हाथ ख़ाली रहे — Even after a lifetime of running about, the hands stayed empty.

hindi: परिवर्तन — हालत या मौसम का बदल जाना
definition: a change in the state of something, the shift in weather, mood, or fortune from what it was to something else
example: मौसम में अचानक तग़य्युर आ गया। — A sudden change came over the weather.

hindi: जान-बूझकर की गई अनदेखी — जानते-बूझते ध्यान न देना
definition: deliberate inattention, the studied neglect of a person whose claim on you is perfectly well known; indifference practised on purpose
example: इतने तग़ाफ़ुल के बाद भी वह इंतज़ार करती रही — Even after such deliberate neglect she went on waiting.

hindi: आभा — प्रकट होती हुई दिव्य चमक
definition: a radiance that reveals itself, light understood as a showing-forth; used where brightness carries meaning instead of being merely bright
example: उस लम्हे एक अजीब तजल्ली महसूस हुई — At that moment a strange radiance was felt.

hindi: प्रस्ताव — विचार के लिए रखी गई बात
definition: a proposal placed on the table for others to weigh; in a clinic, the course a doctor prescribes
example: कमेटी ने नई तजवीज़ पेश की। — The committee tabled a new proposal.

hindi: कौतूहल — जानने की चुभती हुई भूख
definition: the itch to find out, curiosity strong enough to make a person pry; disciplined investigation is a duty performed, this is an appetite that may be nobody's business
example: उसके तजस्सुस ने चैन नहीं लेने दिया — His curiosity would not let him rest.

hindi: अलंकरण — कलात्मक ढंग से सजाने की विधि
definition: ornamentation as a craft or formal art, the decorative work on a manuscript, a building or a dress; more technical than आराइश
example: इस मस्जिद की तज़ईन बेमिसाल है — The ornamentation of this mosque is without parallel.

hindi: अपमानित करना — सबके सामने नीचा दिखाना
definition: actively humiliating someone in front of others; contempt made public so that their dignity is stripped where it can be seen
example: भरी मजलिस में उसकी तज़लील की गई — He was humiliated before the whole gathering.

hindi: आत्मशुद्धि — मन को बुराइयों से साफ़ करने की मेहनत
definition: the deliberate work of purifying the self of greed, envy and pride over time; purity is the state, this is the slow labour that produces it
example: तज़्किया-ए-नफ़्स एक उम्र का काम है — Purifying the self is a lifetime's work.

hindi: चर्चा — किसी का ज़िक्र, या उसका स्मृति-वृत्तांत
definition: the bringing up of an absent person in talk, and in books a compiled memorial account of lives now gone
example: महफ़िल में उनका तज़्किरा छिड़ गया — Mention of him came up in the gathering.

hindi: नसीहत भरी याददिहानी — भूली हुई ज़िम्मेदारी की ओर ध्यान दिलाना
definition: reminding people of what they already know but neglect, admonition through recall rather than through new instruction
example: उसका ख़ुत्बा महज़ तज़्कीर था, कोई नई बात नहीं। — His sermon was pure reminder, nothing new.

hindi: उपहास — किसी को हँसी का पात्र बना देना
definition: reducing a person to a laughing-stock; mockery aimed not at a moment's laughter but at destroying their standing
example: अख़बार ने उसकी तज़्हीक का पूरा सामान कर दिया — The paper made a laughing-stock of him.

hindi: विश्लेषण — किसी बात को टुकड़ों में तोड़ कर जाँचना
definition: analysis that breaks a matter into its parts to see how each works; a survey looks at the whole from outside, this takes it apart
example: नताइज का तज्ज़िया अभी बाक़ी है — The analysis of the results is still pending.

hindi: छटपटाहट — विरह में मछली जैसी तड़प
definition: longing that shows up in the body as writhing, the flesh reacting to an absence; stronger and less dignified than yearning
example: बच्चे को देखने की तड़प उससे छुपी नहीं — Her longing to see the child could not be hidden.

hindi: अंत्येष्टि — दफ़नाने की पूरी रस्म और इंतज़ाम
definition: burial treated as a full rite with its arrangements and order of steps, the formal noun a notice or a religious text uses where speech would just say दफ़्न
example: तदफ़ीन का इंतज़ाम मस्जिद की कमेटी ने किया — The mosque committee arranged the burial rites.

hindi: उपाय — मुश्किल से निकलने की सोची-समझी तरकीब
definition: a contrived device for handling a situation, the practical stratagem itself as against the secret agreement of a plot
example: हर मुसीबत की कोई न कोई तदबीर होती है — Every trouble has some stratagem to meet it.

hindi: अध्यापन — पढ़ाने का पेशा और अमल
definition: the act and profession of teaching lessons, described from the teacher's side; education is what the student receives, this is the work that delivers it
example: उन्होंने ज़िंदगी तदरीस में गुज़ार दी — He spent his life in teaching.

hindi: संकलन-संपादन — बिखरी सामग्री को एक ग्रंथ में समेटना
definition: the editing and compiling of scattered written material into one settled volume; the work that turns papers into a book
example: उनके ख़तों की तदवीन एक शागिर्द ने की। — A pupil edited his letters into a volume.

hindi: आलोचना — खूबी-ख़ामी परख कर राय देना
definition: criticism as a discipline that weighs a work's merits and defects by standards; fault-finding attacks, this evaluates and is itself a branch of learning
example: उर्दू तनक़ीद में उनका नाम बड़ा है — His name is large in Urdu criticism.

hindi: अवनति — दर्जे का नीचे गिरना
definition: a fall in rank, quality or standing measured against what it used to be; decline you can point to on a scale
example: तालीम के मेयार की तनज़्ज़ुली साफ़ दिखती है — The decline in the standard of education is plain to see.

hindi: क्रियान्वयन — क़ानून या हुक्म को असल में लागू करना
definition: putting a statute or a sentence into actual force, the step at which words on paper begin to affect people
example: क़ानून बना तो सही, तनफ़ीज़ अब तक नहीं हुई — The law was passed, but it has not been enforced yet.

hindi: श्वसन — साँस लेने की क्रिया
definition: breathing regarded as a bodily function a physician measures, respiration as a system; not a single breath but the working of it
example: तनफ़्फ़ुस की रफ़्तार बढ़ी हुई है। — The rate of respiration is raised.

hindi: रद्दीकरण — मुआहिदे को रद्द कर देना
definition: the cancelling of an agreement by an act of one party, ending it before its term runs out
example: ठेके की तनसीख़ का नोटिस मिल चुका है। — Notice of cancellation of the contract has been received.

hindi: मिट्टी का भट्ठा — जिसकी दीवार पर रोटी चिपकाकर पकाई जाती है
definition: a deep clay oven whose hot walls bake bread stuck against them, heating food by its own body and not by a flame beneath
example: तनूर से गरम रोटियाँ निकल रही थीं। — Hot breads were coming out of the clay oven.

hindi: समालोचना — किसी रचना को परखकर उसकी अच्छाई-बुराई बताना
definition: the considered assessment of a work that weighs strengths against weaknesses, a discipline in its own right rather than an act of fault-finding
example: उनकी तन्क़ीद से शायरों को फ़ायदा हुआ — Poets benefited from his criticism.

hindi: सूनापन — अकेलेपन की चुभन
definition: aloneness felt as an ache rather than chosen as a rest; solitude can be pleasant, this word almost never is
example: शहर में भीड़ है, फिर भी तन्हाई है — The city is crowded, and still there is loneliness.

hindi: तपन — बेचैन कर देने वाली गर्मी
definition: the hot restlessness of longing, physical enough to be felt in the body, where the burning word stays inward and quiet
example: इंतज़ार की तपिश सही नहीं जाती — The heat of waiting cannot be borne.

hindi: मनन — गहरा और ठहरा हुआ सोच-विचार
definition: deep deliberate reflection carried on slowly, the mind dwelling on something to reach its bottom; ordinary thinking moves along, this stays put
example: क़ुदरत को देख कर तफ़क्कुर में डूब गया — Looking at nature, he sank into deep reflection.

hindi: पुलिस जाँच — जुर्म के बाद सबूत जुटाने का अमल
definition: the official investigation of a crime, the collecting of evidence by police before a case reaches court; hunting for facts rather than judging them
example: तफ़तीश अभी जारी है — The investigation is still under way.

hindi: न्यूनता — ज़रूरत से कम रह जाना
definition: the deficient side of imbalance, falling short of what a thing requires; the exact counterpart of excess in the same sentence
example: इफ़रात और तफ़रीत दोनों से बचना चाहिए। — One should avoid both excess and deficiency.

hindi: प्रत्यायोजन — अपना इख़्तियार किसी और को सौंपना
