definition: handing part of one's own authority down to someone else to exercise, while the final responsibility stays where it began
example: ज़िले के अफ़सरों को इख़्तियारात की तफ़वीज़ की गई — Powers were delegated to the district officers.

hindi: व्याख्या-भाष्य — मतन के मानी खोल कर बताने वाली शरह
definition: authoritative exposition of a sacred or classical text, unfolding its meanings at length; a plain explanation clears one point, this is a whole work built on the original
example: वे क़ुरआन की तफ़सीर पढ़ाते हैं — He teaches exegesis of the Quran.

hindi: ब्यौरा — एक-एक बात का विस्तार
definition: the itemised particulars of a matter; implies going point by point rather than merely elaborating
example: ख़र्च की पूरी तफ़सील भेज दीजिए। — Send the complete breakdown of expenses.

hindi: जाँच — जुर्म की तह तक पहुँचने की छानबीन
definition: the formal investigation of a crime by an officer, digging for evidence rather than merely watching or asking around
example: तफ़्तीश अभी मुकम्मल नहीं हुई — The investigation is not yet complete.

hindi: मुस्कान — बिना आवाज़ की हल्की हँसी
definition: a soundless smile that spreads on the lips only, the restrained cousin of open laughter
example: उसके होंठों पर हल्का तबस्सुम था — There was a faint smile on his lips.

hindi: मुद्रण — छापने की प्रक्रिया
definition: printing as a process, the mechanical impressing of written matter onto paper; the making of copies, not their release
example: तबाअत में काग़ज़ अच्छा इस्तेमाल हुआ है। — Good paper has been used in the printing.

hindi: बदहाली — बरबाद हो चुकी हालत
definition: the wrecked condition a person is left in after ruin, describing a present state rather than the event that caused it
example: उसकी तबाह-हाली देखकर तरस आया। — Seeing his ruined condition, one felt pity.

hindi: ग्रीष्म ऋतु — गर्मियों का मौसम
definition: the summer season as a stretch of the year, the hot months as a period rather than any single day's heat
example: तबिस्ताँ में दोपहरें बहुत लंबी लगती हैं। — In summer the afternoons feel very long.

hindi: चिकित्सक — रोगों का जानकार और इलाज करने वाला
definition: a physician viewed as a learned healer of diseases, the classical word carrying respect for the science, not just the practice
example: तबीब ने नब्ज़ देखकर मरज़ पहचान लिया। — The physician read the pulse and knew the disease.

hindi: पेशेवर रसोइया — जिसका हुनर ही पकाना है
definition: a cook by profession whose skill is the cooking of food itself, named for the craft and not for service in a household
example: शहर का सबसे माहिर तब्बाख़ बुलाया गया। — The city's most skilled cook was sent for.

hindi: समीक्षा — किसी किताब या घटना पर लिखी टिप्पणी
definition: a written review or commentary on a particular book, film or event, published for readers; the discipline of criticism sets the standards, this is one occasional piece
example: अख़बार में उनकी किताब पर तब्सिरा छपा — A review of his book appeared in the paper.

hindi: लालच — किसी से कुछ पाने की उम्मीद पर टिकी नीयत
definition: the covetous hope of gaining something from someone, which quietly corrupts a relationship by making the other person a means
example: उसकी हर मेहरबानी में तमअ छिपी है — Some covetous hope hides behind his every kindness.

hindi: ठसक — गरिमापूर्ण गंभीर मुद्रा
definition: composed stately bearing in the way one sits, walks and speaks, dignity made visible in the body; वक़ार is the standing, this is the posture
example: उसकी तमकनत से कमरा ख़ामोश हो गया — The room fell silent before his stately bearing.

hindi: अवधि-विस्तार — मुद्दत को आगे बढ़ाना
definition: the extension of an agreed term, pushing the deadline forward while the other conditions stand
example: लाइसेंस की तमदीद के लिए दरख़्वास्त दी है। — An application has been made for extension of the licence term.

hindi: इच्छा — खुलकर कही गई दिली ख़्वाहिश
definition: a wish avowed openly and without embarrassment, closer to a plea than a plan; the wanting is the point, not the getting
example: मेरी तमन्ना है कि एक बार समुंदर देखूँ — I wish, just once, to see the sea.

hindi: चिरौरी — गिड़गिड़ाकर की गई ख़ुशामद
definition: obsequious fawning before a superior, flattery that lowers the flatterer's dignity rather than merely praising falsely
example: उसके तमल्लुक़ पर तरस आता था — His fawning was pitiable.

hindi: नक़ल उतारना — दूसरों को हँसाने के लिए किसी की खिल्ली
definition: open ridicule of a person, mimicking their voice or walk for the laughter of others present
example: उस्ताद का तमस्ख़ुर करते हुए वो पकड़ा गया — He was caught mimicking the teacher in ridicule.

hindi: ऋण-पत्र — क़र्ज़ मानकर लिखकर दिया गया काग़ज़
definition: a written bond acknowledging a debt, the promissory paper itself rather than the money it stands for
example: उसने रक़म लेकर तमस्सुक लिख दिया। — He took the money and wrote out a promissory bond.

hindi: भूमिका — असली बात से पहले बिछाई गई ज़मीन
definition: the preamble laid down before the actual point; usually a signal that unwelcome news is coming
example: इतनी लंबी तमहीद के बाद असली बात बताओ। — After that long preamble, get to the point.

hindi: तपन — सूरज की चुभती हुई गर्मी
definition: the stinging heat of direct sunlight on skin, felt where the sun's rays land rather than the general warmth of the day
example: दोपहर की तमाज़त से चेहरा जल गया। — The face was burnt by the noon sun's sting.

hindi: शालीनता — क्या कहना-करना है और क्या नहीं, इसकी समझ
definition: the learned sense of what is simply not done, judged in an instant by everyone watching; about knowing the line rather than about warmth
example: इतनी तमीज़ तो होनी चाहिए कि बात काट कर न बोलो — Have the decency at least not to interrupt.

hindi: गीला और ताज़ा — जो अभी-अभी का और नम हो
definition: still damp and therefore still fresh, joining moisture to newness in a way neither word carries alone
example: सुबह के फूल तर-ओ-ताज़ा थे। — The morning flowers were damp and fresh.

hindi: तूणीर — तीर रखने का खोल
definition: the quiver slung on the back to hold arrows, the store a fighter draws his shots from
example: उसके तरकश में एक ही तीर बचा था — Only one arrow was left in his quiver.

hindi: छोड़ी हुई संपत्ति — बँटवारे से पहले का माल
definition: the estate a dead person leaves behind before it is divided, the property itself rather than the right to it
example: तरका अभी तक बँटा नहीं — The estate has still not been divided.

hindi: खंडन — बात को झूठा बताकर काटना
definition: a public refutation of something reported, going considerably further than declining to comment
example: कंपनी ने ख़बर की तरदीद कर दी। — The company denied the report.

hindi: लय में पढ़ना — शेर को गाकर सुनाने का ढंग
definition: the manner of reciting verse to a melody, half sung and half spoken, which carries a weak couplet further than plain reading ever could
example: वह हमेशा तरन्नुम में पढ़ते हैं — He always recites in song.

hindi: उल्लास — संगीत और महफ़िल की ख़ुशी
definition: the lively gladness that music and company raise in a gathering, shared aloud where the other pleasures are taken privately
example: साज़ बजा और बज़्म में तरब भर गई। — The instrument sounded and the gathering filled with joy.

hindi: परवरिश-संस्कार — आदत और अख़लाक़ बनाने की तालीम
definition: the training that forms a person's manners and character rather than his knowledge; education answers what he knows, this answers how he behaves
example: तालीम तो है, मगर तरबियत की कमी है — He is educated, but poorly brought up.

hindi: संशोधन — क़ानून या दस्तावेज़ में सोची-समझी तबदीली
definition: a deliberate change made to an existing statute or document by proper procedure, altering it rather than replacing the whole thing
example: क़ानून में तरमीम के बाद सज़ा हल्की हो गई — After the amendment the punishment became lighter.

hindi: समस्यापूर्ति वाला — एक दिए हुए मिसरे पर सबका शेर कहना
definition: describing a poetry gathering where every poet must build a composition on one line handed out in advance, so the audience hears the same constraint solved many different ways
example: इस बार तरही मुशायरा रखा गया है — This time a set-line poetry gathering has been arranged.

hindi: जोशीला गीत — जोश या रवानी से गाया जाने वाला गीत
definition: a song of spirited rhythm meant to lift a crowd, an anthem or a fast classical piece; a sweet melody soothes, this one drives
example: स्कूल में हर सुबह वही तराना गाया जाता था — The same anthem was sung at school every morning.

hindi: रमज़ान की रात की नमाज़ — लंबी सामूहिक इबादत
definition: the long night prayers offered in congregation through the month of fasting, additional to the daily obligatory ones
example: तरावीह में हाफ़िज़ साहब क़ुरआन सुनाते हैं — At the night prayers the reciter recites the whole scripture.

hindi: सालन का गाढ़ा रसा — रोटी से लपेटने वाला हिस्सा
definition: the thick gravy of a cooked dish, richer than broth and clinging to the bread rather than running off it
example: तरी में रोटी डुबोकर खाई। — He ate the bread dipped in the gravy.

hindi: त्याग — जान-बूझकर छोड़ देना
definition: the deliberate giving up of a place, a habit or a claim, abandonment arrived at as a decision rather than suffered as a loss
example: उसने शहर का तर्क कर दिया — He gave up the city for good.

hindi: संबंध-विच्छेद — रिश्ता ख़त्म कर देना
definition: the deliberate breaking off of a relationship, a decision announced rather than a separation suffered, which is what distinguishes it from ordinary parting
example: उसने चुपचाप तर्क-ए-ताल्लुक़ कर लिया — He quietly broke off the relationship.

hindi: छोड़ा हुआ माल — मरने वाले की बची हुई जायदाद
definition: the actual estate a dead person leaves for division, the countable property itself rather than the right to receive it
example: मरने वाले का तर्का बहुत मामूली था — The estate the dead man left behind was very modest.

hindi: प्रेरणा — किसी अच्छे काम की ओर उकसाने वाली बात
definition: persuasion that makes a good course look attractive, urging by showing reward rather than by warning of loss
example: उस्ताद ने पढ़ाई की तर्ग़ीब दी। — The teacher urged us toward study by showing its rewards.

hindi: तरीक़ा — किसी चीज़ का ख़ास ढंग या शैली
definition: the particular manner or pattern in which a thing is made or done, style as recognisable design rather than as personal bearing
example: यह मकान पुरानी तर्ज़ का है — This house is built in the old style.

hindi: अनुवाद — एक ज़बान की बात दूसरी ज़बान में उतारना
definition: translation, the carrying of a text from one language into another with its meaning intact; a dictionary gives you words, this must also deliver the sense
example: इस किताब का तर्जुमा उर्दू में हो चुका है — This book has already been translated into Urdu.

hindi: क्रम — सामग्री को व्यवस्थित क्रम में लगाना
definition: the ordering of written matter into an arranged sequence, deciding what comes first rather than what is said
example: मज़ामीन की तर्तीब तारीख़ के हिसाब से है। — The essays are ordered by date.

hindi: संप्रेषण — संदेश को आगे पहुँचाना
definition: the conveying of a message onward through a channel until it reaches its reader; delivery while in transit, not the first sending
example: पैग़ाम की तर्सील में देर हो गई। — There was a delay in conveying the message.

hindi: दीक्षा-उपदेश — बार-बार समझा कर बात बिठाना
definition: the patient instilling of a teaching by repetition until it settles in someone; teaching transmits a subject, this drives one lesson in until it takes root
example: बुज़ुर्गों ने सब्र की तलक़ीन की — The elders instilled the lesson of patience in him.

hindi: सारांश — लंबी बात को थोड़े में समेट देना
definition: the boiling down of a long text or argument to its essentials without adding anything; commentary expands the original, this compresses it
example: पूरी बहस की तलख़ीस एक सफ़्हे में कर दी — He summarised the whole debate in a single page.

hindi: उच्चारण — लफ़्ज़ को बोलने का सही ढंग
definition: pronunciation, the manner in which a word is sounded and whether it is sounded correctly; a term settles the meaning, this settles the tongue
example: उर्दू में तलफ़्फ़ुज़ की ग़लती फ़ौरन पकड़ी जाती है — In Urdu a mistake in pronunciation is caught at once.

hindi: माँग — जिसके बिना रहा न जाए
definition: a want that presses for satisfaction, the seeking kind of desire that sends a person after the thing, unlike a wish that merely sits in the heart
example: दिल में उसकी तलब बाक़ी है — The craving for her is still in my heart.

hindi: विवाह-विच्छेद — पति की ओर से निकाह तोड़ना
definition: the dissolution of a marriage pronounced by the husband, ending the contract and its obligations; the man's route out, where release bought by the wife is another word
example: तलाक़ के बाद भी बच्चों का ख़र्च उसी पर है — Even after the divorce the children's upkeep is on him.

hindi: भरपाई — नुक़सान की क्षतिपूर्ति
definition: making good the damage a wrong caused, by money, effort or apology; correcting the fault fixes the future, this repays the harm already done
example: इस नुक़सान की तलाफ़ी मुमकिन नहीं — There is no making good this loss.

hindi: कड़वा — जिसका ज़ाइक़ा गले में उतरना मुश्किल हो
definition: bitter in taste, of food or medicine hard to swallow, and of words whose truth is as hard to take
example: क़हवा तल्ख़ था मगर उसने पी लिया। — The coffee was bitter but he drank it.

hindi: कड़वी बातचीत — तीखे लहजे में हुई बहस
definition: an exchange in which both sides speak bitterly, harsh talk that sours a relationship without breaking it
example: दोनों में तल्ख़-कलामी हो गई। — Bitter words passed between the two.

hindi: कड़वाहट — ज़ाइक़े की या रिश्ते की
definition: bitterness as a taste left in the mouth, and by extension the bitterness left in a relation after harsh words
example: दवा की तल्ख़ी देर तक मुँह में रही। — The bitterness of the medicine stayed in his mouth.

hindi: संपन्न — जमी हुई दौलत वाला
definition: wealthy in the settled sense, a person described by holdings that have long stood rather than by sudden money
example: वो तवंगर है, मगर दिखावा नहीं करता — He is wealthy, but he makes no show of it.

hindi: संपन्नता — धनी होने की स्थायी अवस्था
definition: the condition of being wealthy, an ongoing state of holdings rather than a particular amount of money received
example: तवंगरी ने उसके लहजे तक को बदल दिया — Affluence changed even the way he spoke.

hindi: अपेक्षा — किसी से कुछ किए जाने की उम्मीद
definition: the expectation placed on another person that they will do or give something, closer to a claim on them than to hope
example: आपसे इतनी बेरुख़ी की तवक़्क़ो न थी — I had no expectation of such coldness from you.

hindi: ईश्वर-भरोसा — कोशिश के बाद नतीजा ख़ुदा पर छोड़ना
definition: reliance on God after doing what one can, a trust that acts first and then leaves the outcome, unlike fatalism that never acts
example: ऊँट बाँधो, फिर तवक्कुल करो — Tie the camel, then trust in God.

hindi: ध्यान — किसी ओर दिया गया ध्यान
definition: attention consciously directed at someone or something; notice that can be given, withdrawn or asked for, which is what makes it a currency between people
example: ज़रा इस मसले पर भी तवज्जोह दीजिए — Kindly give this matter some attention too.

hindi: मन का भ्रम — बेबुनियाद बात को सच मान बैठना
definition: taking a groundless notion for reality and then living by it; a false conviction formed in the mind, not a trick played on the eye
example: बीमारी नहीं, महज़ तवह्हुम है — There is no illness, only a delusion.

hindi: अंधविश्वास — बेबुनियाद डर और शगुन-अपशगुन की आदतें
definition: the whole body of groundless fears and omen-beliefs a community keeps; names them as unfounded convictions, not as tales told
example: गाँव में आज भी बहुत तवह्हुमात हैं — Many superstitions still hold in the village.

hindi: बनावटी वज्द — जान-बूझकर लाई गई मस्ती की हालत
definition: the deliberate inducing of ecstasy in oneself when the true state has not come; imitation of a mystical state, and suspect for that reason
example: क़व्वाली में कुछ लोग तवाजुद करने लगते हैं — At the qawwali some people work themselves into feigned ecstasy.

hindi: परिक्रमा — काबे के गिर्द चक्कर लगाना
definition: the circling of the sacred house on foot, the central rite performed during either pilgrimage
example: भीड़ में तवाफ़ पूरा करना मुश्किल था — Completing the circling in that crowd was difficult.

hindi: लंबाई — मामले का बेजा खिंच जाना
definition: the tiresome protraction of an affair well past what it deserved, drawn-out length felt by everyone as a burden
example: मुक़दमे की तवालत ने सबको थका दिया — The dragging on of the case exhausted everyone.

hindi: लंबा — वक़्त या बात में बहुत खिंचा हुआ
definition: long in duration or extent, used for periods and writings where an everyday word for long would sound too plain
example: एक तवील ख़ामोशी के बाद उसने कहा — After a long silence he spoke.

hindi: रोग-निर्णय — लक्षणों से बीमारी पहचानना
definition: naming the disease from its signs, the physician's judgement that turns complaints into a case; precedes any treatment
example: ग़लत तशख़ीस पर सही दवा भी बेकार है। — On a wrong diagnosis even the right medicine is useless.

hindi: हिंसा — दबाने के लिए किया गया शारीरिक बल-प्रयोग
definition: physical violence used to suppress people, force actually applied to bodies rather than held out as a threat
example: मुज़ाहिरे पर तशद्दुद की तहक़ीक़ात हो रही है — The violence at the demonstration is being investigated.

hindi: तसकीन — दिल को ठंडक देने वाली बात
definition: the relief given by words that settle a troubled heart, comfort described by the effect achieved rather than the effort made
example: उनकी बात से कुछ तशफ़्फ़ी हुई — His words brought some relief to the heart.

hindi: उपमा — एक चीज़ को दूसरी जैसी बताकर समझाना
definition: a comparison that openly likens one thing to another to make its quality vivid, keeping both things visible in the line
example: चेहरे को चाँद कहना पुरानी तशबीह है — Calling a face the moon is an old comparison.

hindi: पधारना — मेहमान का इज़्ज़त के साथ आ जाना
definition: the honoured arrival of an invited guest at a gathering or feast, treating the coming itself as a favour granted to the host
example: आपकी तशरीफ़-आवरी से महफ़िल रौशन हुई। — Your gracious arrival lit up the gathering.

hindi: व्याख्या — खोलकर समझाना
definition: an explanation that opens up a difficult text or idea so a listener can follow it; teaching, not defending
example: उस्ताद ने शेर की तशरीह इतनी ख़ूबसूरती से की। — The teacher explained the couplet so beautifully.

hindi: चिंता — आगे के अंदेशे से मन का उलझना
definition: worry about how a pending matter will turn out, anxiety tied to one specific outcome rather than to life at large
example: नतीजे की तशवीश में रात नहीं कटी — Worry about the result kept the night from passing.

hindi: बदनाम करना — ऐब को जान-बूझकर सबके सामने लाना
definition: making someone's fault public deliberately so their disgrace is widely known; publicising a fault as a punishment in itself
example: सज़ा से पहले उसकी तशहीर की गई — He was publicly exposed before being punished.

hindi: प्यास — कभी न बुझने वाली चाह
definition: thirst used for a desire that no amount of fulfilment settles, always naming what is still missing rather than what was received
example: मुलाक़ात के बाद तश्नगी और बढ़ गई — After the meeting the thirst only grew.

hindi: पुष्टि — सही होने की मुहर
definition: confirmation that a statement or document is genuine, given by someone with standing to vouch for it
example: दस्तावेज़ की तसदीक़ अफ़सर ने की। — The officer verified the document.

hindi: रचना — नई लिखी गई किताब या ग्रंथ
definition: an original composed work, a book written out of the author's own learning; compiling arranges other men's material, this brings new matter into being
example: यह उनकी आख़िरी तसनीफ़ है — This is his last composed work.

hindi: निपटारा — झगड़े का आपसी हल निकालना
definition: the settlement of a dispute by agreement, closing the matter without waiting for a court's verdict
example: पंचायत में मुआमले का तसफ़िया हो गया। — The dispute was settled in the village council.

hindi: ढाढ़स — मन को शांत करने वाला भरोसा
definition: the settled calm that follows reassurance; names both the comfort offered and the satisfaction felt
example: डॉक्टर से बात करके तसल्ली हो गई। — Talking to the doctor put my mind at ease.

hindi: सूफ़ीवाद — इबादत का आंतरिक मार्ग
definition: the inward mystical path within the faith, occupied with purifying the heart rather than with the outward rules of law
example: उन्होंने तसव्वुफ़ पर एक किताब लिखी — He wrote a book on the mystical path.

hindi: कल्पना-अवधारणा — मन में बनी हुई तस्वीर या धारणा
definition: a conception held in the mind, an image or idea of something not present; thinking is the activity, this is the picture that activity works with
example: आज़ादी का तसव्वुर हर दौर में बदला — The conception of freedom changed in every age.

hindi: संशोधन — लिखे हुए की ग़लतियाँ ठीक करना
definition: the correcting of errors in a written text before it is allowed to stand as final; repair, not removal
example: छपने से पहले तसहीह ज़रूरी है। — Correction is essential before printing.

hindi: ढील — सख़्ती न बरतकर छोड़ देना
definition: letting a rule slacken out of leniency, indulgence that risks becoming neglect rather than kindness
example: इतने तसाहुल से नज़्म बिगड़ जाएगी। — Such laxity will ruin the discipline.

hindi: तसल्ली — दिलासा जो बेचैनी को थाम ले
definition: the soothing that comes from outside and quiets a distress; consolation is aimed at grief, this is aimed at agitation
example: उसके दो लफ़्ज़ों से ही तस्कीन हो गई — Two words from him were enough to soothe me.

hindi: निपटारा — झगड़ा साफ़ करके कुछ बाक़ी न छोड़ना
definition: the clearing up and final settlement of a dispute so that nothing at all remains pending between both sides afterwards
example: हिसाब का तस्फ़िया आज ही हो जाए — Let the account be settled today itself.

hindi: जपमाला — गिनकर किया जाने वाला नाम-जप
definition: the counted repetition of God's praise, and also the string of beads used to keep that count
example: दादी की तस्बीह हाथ से नहीं छूटती — Grandmother's prayer beads never leave her hand.

hindi: समर्पण — हुक्म के आगे बिना बहस सिर झुकाना
definition: submission that accepts a divine decree without arguing, acceptance of a command rather than trust about what is to come
example: उसने तस्लीम में सिर झुका दिया — He bowed his head in submission.

hindi: प्याले की तली — आख़िरी बचा हुआ घूँट
definition: what remains at the bottom of the goblet after the drinking, the last mouthful nobody wants; the close of a round rather than its fullness
example: तह-ए-जाम में भी उसे मज़ा आता था। — Even the last drop in the cup gave him pleasure.

hindi: छानबीन — सच तक पहुँचने की कोशिश
definition: careful inquiry undertaken to establish what is actually true, in scholarship as much as in a case; concerned with truth where तफ़तीश is concerned with a crime
example: इस ख़बर की तहक़ीक़ किए बिना यक़ीन मत करो — Do not believe this news without inquiry.

hindi: अवमानना — किसी को गिना ही न जाना, हैसियत से नीचे रखना
definition: treating a person as beneath notice; contempt shown through manner, lowering their dignity without a single word being said
example: नौकरों के साथ तहक़ीर का बर्ताव उसकी आदत है — Treating servants with contempt is his habit.

hindi: सलीक़ेदारी — रहन-सहन और बोलचाल का तमीज़दार ढंग
definition: the inherited code of civilised conduct, covering how you greet, seat, feed and disagree; culture describes a people, this judges a person
example: उनकी तहज़ीब बात करने के अंदाज़ से ही पता चलती है — Their breeding shows in the way they speak.

hindi: सावधान करना — किसी ख़ास ख़तरे से बचने की ताकीद
definition: cautioning someone against a specific danger or person, warning that names the thing to be avoided
example: उसने बुरी सोहबत से तहज़ीर की। — He warned against bad company.

hindi: बिना लय के पढ़ना — शेर को बोलकर, गाए बिना सुनाना
definition: recitation of verse in plain speaking voice with no melody, where every effect must come from meaning and pause; the opposite mode to reciting in song
example: तहतुल्लफ़्ज़ में शेर की सारी बात लफ़्ज़ों पर होती है — In spoken recitation the whole burden of the couplet falls on the words.

hindi: धमकी — नुक़सान का डर दिखाकर बात मनवाना
definition: a stated threat of harm meant to force compliance from someone; the formal word used when a threat is put on record
example: उसे फ़ोन पर तहदीद की गई थी — He had been threatened over the phone.

hindi: सहनशीलता — बात या बोझ सह जाने की ताक़त
definition: the capacity to bear provocation and hardship without hitting back, forbearance shown outwardly rather than patience merely felt
example: इतने ताने सुनकर भी उसने तहम्मुल नहीं छोड़ा — Even after so many taunts he kept his forbearance.

hindi: उकसावा — किसी काम पर आमादा करने वाली प्रेरणा
definition: the prompting that sets someone in motion toward an act, the push behind a deed rather than the deed itself
example: इस झगड़े की तहरीक किसी और की थी। — The instigation of this quarrel came from someone else.

hindi: लिखावट — जो लिखा गया हो, लिखित सामग्री
definition: writing as the thing produced, the words once set down on paper; not the act of writing but the written matter left behind
example: उसकी तहरीर पढ़कर मामला साफ़ हो गया। — Reading his written statement made the matter clear.

hindi: लिखित — जो काग़ज़ पर लिखा गया हो, ज़बानी नहीं
definition: in writing, describing a thing set down on paper instead of merely said aloud, so that it can be produced later
example: तहरीरी माफ़ी माँगनी पड़ी। — He had to make a written apology.

hindi: विश्लेषण — किसी चीज़ को तोड़कर उसके अजज़ा जानना
definition: breaking a sample or a problem into its parts to learn what it holds, the laboratory analysis a diagnosis rests on
example: ख़ून की तहलील से मरज़ साफ़ हो गया। — The blood analysis made the disease clear.

hindi: प्रशंसा — किसी चीज़ को अच्छा ठहराते हुए की गई तारीफ़
definition: considered praise that declares a work good after weighing it, the appreciation of a judge rather than a delighted listener; a spontaneous shout is दाद, this is a verdict
example: उनकी ग़ज़ल को नक़्क़ादों की तहसीन मिली — His ghazal earned the critics' considered praise.

hindi: शुद्धि — इबादत से पहले की जाने वाली सफ़ाई
definition: ritual cleanness of body and clothes required before worship, a state achieved by a prescribed washing; purity of character is moral, this one is procedural
example: नमाज़ से पहले तहारत ज़रूरी है — Ritual cleanness is required before prayer.

hindi: प्रभाव — देखने-सुनने से मन पर पड़ी छाप
definition: the impression left on a mind by what it has seen or heard; the effect actually received, as against the effect that was intended
example: उसकी तक़रीर का ताअस्सुर देर तक रहा — The impression left by his speech lasted a long while.

hindi: समर्थन — किसी की बात की पुष्टि करना
definition: the backing given to another's statement or claim, confirming what he said without adding a new claim
example: दूसरे गवाह ने भी उसकी ताईद की। — The second witness also confirmed his account.

hindi: प्लेग — गिल्टियों वाला जानलेवा रोग
definition: the plague named as one specific killing epidemic, the disease of swellings; where the general word means any spreading illness
example: ताऊन ने पूरी बस्ती उजाड़ दी। — The plague emptied the entire settlement.

hindi: कड़ी हिदायत — दोहराकर दिया गया ज़ोर
definition: an emphatic instruction repeated so it cannot be forgotten; insistence with authority standing behind it
example: अम्मी ने ताकीद की थी कि देर न हो। — Mother insisted firmly that I not be late.

hindi: विलंब — तय वक़्त से काम का आगे खिसकना
definition: lateness in doing what was due, a delay laid at the doer's door rather than blamed on circumstance
example: जवाब में ताख़ीर के लिए माफ़ी चाहता हूँ — I apologise for the lateness of my reply.

hindi: शोक-संवेदना — दुख में शरीक होने की रस्म
definition: the visit or the words offered to the bereaved, condolence performed as a duty rather than an emotion felt
example: हम कल ताज़ियत के लिए उनके घर गए — We went to their house yesterday to offer condolences.

hindi: चाबुक — और मजाज़न चुभती हुई फटकार
definition: a lash or whip-stroke, named for the blow rather than the object; it is what urges a horse and what a rebuke does to a person
example: उसकी बात दिल पर ताज़ियाना बन कर लगी — His words fell on the heart like a lash.

hindi: सुधारात्मक दंड — जो सिखाने के लिए दिया जाए
definition: punishment set at a judge's discretion to correct the offender rather than to match a fixed penalty; it aims at reform where ordinary punishment aims at desert
example: यह ताज़ीर है, इंतिक़ाम नहीं — This is corrective punishment, not revenge.

hindi: व्यापारी — जमे हुए कारोबार का मालिक
definition: a merchant who deals in goods for profit, trading as a settled profession with an established house
example: कपड़े का बड़ा ताजिर है — He is a large cloth merchant.

hindi: अनुशासन सिखाना — सज़ा देकर सलीक़ा सिखाना
definition: disciplining someone in order to teach manners, correction whose purpose is training rather than revenge
example: बच्चों की तादीब मार से नहीं होती। — Children are not disciplined by beating.

hindi: उलाहना भरी चुभती बात — पुरानी बात याद दिलाकर कही गई
definition: a needling remark that reopens an old grievance; domestic and repeated where sarcasm is public and single
example: हर खाने की मेज़ पर वही पुराना ताना। — The same old jibe at every dinner table.

hindi: सहने का बल — झेल पाने की ताक़त
definition: the strength left in a person to withstand something, the stamina that bearing draws on
example: अब मुझ में और इंतिज़ार की ताब नहीं। — I no longer have the strength to wait.

hindi: प्रकाशमान — अपनी गर्मी लिए चमकता हुआ
definition: glowing with a warm light of its own; brilliance that radiates outward rather than merely reflecting what falls on it
example: चाँद पूरी रात ताबाँ रहा — The moon glowed all night.

hindi: आब-ताब — भीतर से फूटती चमक और तपिश
definition: the burning brightness a thing gives off, radiance that carries heat in it rather than mere polish
example: उसकी आँखों की ताबिश कम नहीं हुई — The fire in his eyes has not dimmed.

hindi: ख़्वाब का अर्थ — सपने में दिखी चीज़ का मतलब खोलना
definition: the reading of a dream's meaning, turning its images into a statement about waking life; interpretation of signs, not translation of words
example: इस ख़्वाब की ताबीर किसी जानने वाले से पूछो — Ask someone learned for the interpretation of this dream.

hindi: अधीन — जो किसी और के हुक्म के नीचे हो
definition: placed under another's command and bound to follow it, describing the position held rather than any willingness to obey
example: यह इलाक़ा सदियों उस रियासत का ताबेदार रहा — This region remained subject to that state for centuries.

hindi: आज्ञापालन — हुक्म मानते रहने का बरताव
definition: obedient loyalty shown by following orders, allegiance expressed as daily submission rather than as an oath
example: उम्र भर की ताबेदारी का यही सिला मिला। — This was the reward for a lifetime of obedient loyalty.

hindi: निर्माण — इमारत खड़ी करने का काम
definition: the act of building something up, construction named as a process where a building is the finished result
example: मस्जिद की तामीर तीन साल में पूरी हुई — The mosque's construction was completed in three years.

hindi: पखेरू — उड़ता हुआ पक्षी, प्रायः रूपक में
definition: the bird named for its flying, a loftier word than the everyday one and used of the soul or the mind as a creature that takes wing
example: ख़याल का तायर कहीं भी उड़ सकता है — The bird of thought can fly anywhere.

hindi: अँधेरा — जिसमें रोशनी न पहुँचे, या जिसका अंजाम बुरा दिखे
definition: unlit, and by extension without hope of a good outcome; the adjective for what darkness fills, not the darkness itself
example: उसका मुस्तक़बिल तारीक नज़र आता है — His future looks dark.

hindi: अँधेरा — रौशनी का न होना
definition: darkness as the condition a traveller must move through, absence of light rather than the time of night
example: तारीकी में रास्ता ढूँढना मुश्किल था — Finding the road in the darkness was difficult.

hindi: भाग्य — पैदाइश के सितारे से बँधी क़िस्मत
definition: the fortune a person is born under, held to rise with a star and govern how things turn out; luck seen as fixed at birth, not earned
example: तालिअ ने साथ दिया तो काम बन जाएगा — If fortune favours him the work will come off.

hindi: रचना — सामग्री जुटाकर किताब तैयार करना
definition: the composing of a book by gathering material and putting it together; assembling as much as inventing
example: यह लुग़त उनकी बरसों की तालीफ़ है। — This dictionary is the work of years of his compiling.

hindi: शिक्षा — पढ़ाने-सिखाने का पूरा सिलसिला
definition: education as the whole institutional business of imparting knowledge to the young; upbringing shapes character, this fills the mind with subjects
example: उसकी तालीम शहर के बाहर हुई — He received his education outside the city.

hindi: संबंध — दो लोगों या चीज़ों के बीच का जोड़
definition: a connection between people or matters, the neutral structural word that covers kinship, dealings and relevance alike
example: इस बात से मेरा कोई ताल्लुक़ नहीं — I have no connection with this matter.

hindi: क्षतिपूर्ति — अपनी ग़लती से हुए नुक़सान का भुगतान
definition: money paid to make good a loss one has caused, compensation exacted as a penalty on the person at fault
example: शीशा टूटा तो तावान भरना पड़ा — When the glass broke he had to pay compensation.

hindi: मनमानी व्याख्या — बात को अपने हक़ में मोड़ना
definition: bending the meaning of a rule or statement to justify yourself, interpretation used as a defence rather than a plea
example: हर ग़लती की उसके पास तावील है। — He has a justification for every mistake.

hindi: मोर — अपने पंखों पर इतराने वाला परिंदा
definition: the peacock, the bird whose beauty is display; it names showy pride where other birds name song, omen, or flight
example: वो तावूस की तरह अपने कपड़ों पर इतराता है — He struts over his clothes like a peacock.

hindi: अंतर्निहित गुण — किसी चीज़ में मौजूद असर करने की ताक़त
definition: the inherent power in a thing to produce an effect, belonging to the cause rather than the outcome; the effect happens once, this is always there
example: सच्ची बात में अपनी तासीर होती है — A true word carries a power of its own.

hindi: व्यापार — ख़रीद-फ़रोख़्त से धन बढ़ाने का पेशा
definition: trade as an occupation, the buying and selling by which money is deliberately made to grow
example: उसने नौकरी छोड़कर तिजारत शुरू की — He left his job and started trading.

hindi: बालक — छोटी उम्र का बच्चा
definition: a child of the years before understanding, invoked when the point is inexperience rather than affection
example: इस मामले में वो अभी तिफ़्ल है। — In this matter he is still a child.

hindi: बचकाना — बच्चों जैसा
definition: belonging to the manner of a child, used to fault grown behaviour that has not left playfulness behind
example: इस उम्र में ये तिफ़्लाना हरकतें अच्छी नहीं लगतीं। — Such childlike antics do not suit this age.

hindi: बचपन का ज़माना — जीवन का पहला दौर
definition: the early years of a life looked back on from later, naming the period a child passes through
example: तिफ़्ली के दोस्त अब कहीं और बस गए। — The friends of my early years have settled elsewhere.

hindi: विषनाशक — ज़हर का असर काट देने वाली दवा
definition: the antidote that cancels a poison already taken, medicine defined entirely by what it undoes; also anything that neutralises harm
example: वक़्त पर तिरयाक़ मिल जाए तो जान बच जाती है। — If the antidote comes in time, the life is saved.

hindi: पाठ — क़ुरआन का लयबद्ध पठन
definition: the measured reciting of scripture as an act of worship, reading done for devotion rather than for study
example: फ़ज्र के बाद तिलावत का मामूल है — After dawn there is a settled habit of scripture recitation.

hindi: जादुई घेरा — मोहिनी दुनिया जो सच लगे
definition: an enchanted construction that holds you inside it, a whole illusory world rather than a single spell; used of places and beauties that will not break
example: यह शहर एक तिलिस्म की तरह है — This city is like an enchanted world.

hindi: चपटा सुनहरा तार — तैयार कपड़े पर कढ़ाई के लिए
definition: the flattened gold thread laid onto cloth in embroidery; work added to finished cloth rather than woven in
example: जूती पर तिल्ला बड़ी बारीकी से टाँका गया था। — The gold thread was stitched onto the shoe very finely.

hindi: प्यास — पानी की या किसी चाह की तड़प
definition: thirst that stays unquenched, used for the body on a desert road and for unsatisfied longing alike
example: तिश्नगी बढ़ती गई, कुआँ न मिला — The thirst grew and no well was found.

hindi: प्यासे होंठ — जिसने पानी को तरसते हुए ही रुख़्सत ली
definition: having lips still thirsty, of one who left or died before the water or the wish reached him; thirst kept as an unfinished state
example: वो तिश्ना-लब ही इस दुनिया से चला गया। — He left this world with his lips still thirsty.

hindi: सेवक — बीमार के पास रहकर देखभाल करने वाला
definition: the person who stays with a patient and tends to them, usually family rather than staff; defined by presence, not by training
example: हर मरीज़ के साथ एक तीमारदार रह सकता है। — One attendant may stay with each patient.

hindi: सेवा — बीमार की देखभाल और ख़िदमत
definition: the sustained care given to a sick person, the feeding, washing and watching; the work itself, where the other word names the doer
example: महीनों की तीमारदारी ने उसे थका दिया। — Months of nursing care wore her out.

hindi: धनुर्धर — तीर चलाने में माहिर
definition: the archer skilled at loosing arrows at game or foe, named for the marksmanship rather than for owning the weapon
example: शाही तीर-अंदाज़ का निशाना कभी न चूकता — The royal archer's aim never missed.

hindi: धुँधलापन — रोशनी का मद्धम पड़ जाना, गहराता अँधेरा
definition: the dimming of light as darkness gathers, felt as gloom settling; a deepening shade, where full darkness is an established state
example: शाम की तीरगी फैलने लगी — The gloom of evening began to spread.

hindi: चिड़चिड़ा — ज़रा सी बात पर गरम हो जाने वाला
definition: sharp-tempered, flaring at small provocation; the heat is habitual rather than occasional
example: बॉस तुंद-मिज़ाज है, सुबह कुछ मत पूछो। — The boss is hot-tempered; don't ask him anything in the morning.

hindi: तेज़ी — मिज़ाज का जल्दी भड़क जाना
definition: sharpness of temper as a standing trait; the speed with which a person's anger rises, judged as character not as an incident
example: मिज़ाज की तुंदी ने उसके कई दोस्त छीन लिए — The sharpness of his temper cost him several friends.

hindi: बीज — जिससे पौदा उगता है
definition: the seed from which a plant begins, the origin of growth rather than any part that holds it in the ground
example: अच्छा तुख़्म ही अच्छी फ़सल देता है। — Only good seed gives a good crop.

hindi: उफान — नदी के पानी का सीमा तोड़कर चढ़ना
definition: the rising and swelling of water past its limit, the act of overflowing that precedes a flood rather than the flood itself
example: बारिश के बाद दरिया में तुग़्यानी आ गई। — After the rain the river came into spate.

hindi: बालपन — बचपन की अवस्था और उसका भोलापन
definition: childhood as a condition rather than a span of years, carrying the helplessness and simplicity that belong to a child
example: उसकी बातों में अब तक तुफ़ूलियत बाक़ी है। — A childhood quality still lingers in the way he talks.

hindi: खट्टा — जिसका ज़ाइक़ा ज़बान खींच ले
definition: sour in taste, of food sharp enough to pucker the tongue, and of a face or manner soured in the same way
example: अनार दाना ज़रा तुर्श था। — The pomegranate seeds were a little sour.

hindi: तुनकमिज़ाज — जिसके चेहरे पर हमेशा खटास रहती हो
definition: sour-faced, meeting people with an expression that puts them off before a word is spoken; the look worn as a habit, not as a passing mood
example: इतने तुर्श-रू आदमी से कौन बात करे — Who would talk to so sour-faced a man?

hindi: खटास — खट्टेपन का ज़ाइक़ा, या सिरके में डाला अचार
definition: sourness as a taste in food, and the pickle preserved in vinegar that carries it; the quality where the adjective names the thing
example: खाने के साथ थोड़ी तुर्शी रखी थी। — A little sour pickle was set out with the meal.

hindi: उदय — सूरज या चाँद का ऊपर आना
definition: the rising of the sun or moon above the horizon, the act of coming up rather than the light that follows it
example: आफ़ताब के तुलू से पहले हम निकल पड़े। — We set out before the rising of the sun.

hindi: तोता — जिसकी बोली मीठी और नक़ल भरी हो
definition: the parrot as a bird of sweet borrowed speech; when a man's parrot is said to speak, it means his word carries everywhere
example: आजकल उसी की तूती बोलती है — These days it is his word that carries everywhere.

hindi: लंबा लेखा — बहुत लंबा लिखा हुआ ब्योरा या पत्र
definition: a long rolled scroll of paper, and thence a written account that has grown unreasonably long; length itself is the complaint
example: शिकायतों का पूरा तूमार बाँध दिया। — He rolled out a whole scroll of complaints.

hindi: खिंचाव — बात या मामले का ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा लंबा होना
definition: the excessive stretching out of a matter, a length that has turned tedious rather than any physical measurement
example: बहस ने बेवजह तूल पकड़ लिया — The argument stretched out far beyond need.

hindi: तलवार — काटने वाला लंबा हथियार
definition: the sword in its literary and heroic use, the blade invoked in poetry and in oaths rather than listed in an inventory
example: तेग़ म्यान से बाहर आ गई — The sword came out of its scabbard.

hindi: तेज़ चलने वाला — जिसकी गति ज़्यादा हो
definition: moving at high speed, describing the traveller or vehicle rather than naming the speed itself
example: तेज़-रफ़्तार ट्रेन चार घंटे बचाती है — The fast train saves four hours.

hindi: आवेश — पल भर का ग़ुस्से का उबाल
definition: a flash of temper, anger that flares and passes, judged as a loss of control rather than as destructive power
example: तैश में आकर उसने काग़ज़ फाड़ दिए — In a flash of temper he tore up the papers.

hindi: सफ़र का खाना — रास्ते के लिए बाँधा हुआ भोजन
definition: the food packed to eat on a journey, provisions carried for the road as against stores kept at home
example: माँ ने रास्ते का तोशा बाँध दिया। — Mother packed food for the journey.

hindi: मिथ्या आरोप — बिना सबूत लगाया गया दोष
definition: an accusation made without evidence, damaging chiefly because it sticks to reputation; a charge can be tested, this is thrown to stain
example: बेगुनाह पर तोहमत लगाना बड़ा गुनाह है — Falsely accusing an innocent man is a grave sin.

hindi: गले का कड़ा — गहना भी और ग़ुलामी का पट्टा भी
definition: a rigid ring worn round the neck, serving either as a rich ornament or as a collar of servitude
example: इज़्ज़त का तौक़ भी कभी गले का बोझ बन जाता है। — Even the collar of honour can become a weight on the neck.

hindi: स्वीकृति-लेख — अर्ज़ी पर हाकिम का हाशिए में लिखा आदेश
definition: the sign-off an officer or ruler writes on a petition, an endorsement entered in the margin that turns a request into an order
example: अर्ज़ी पर तौक़ीअ हो गई तो काम बन गया। — Once the endorsement was written on the petition, the work was done.

hindi: पश्चात्ताप — गुनाह छोड़ने का पक्का इरादा
definition: repentance completed by a vow never to repeat the sin, turning away from the act rather than merely feeling bad about it; regret looks back, this looks forward
example: उसने शराब से तौबा कर ली — He renounced drink for good.

hindi: फटकार — रुतबे वाले की ओर से की गई कड़ी मलामत
definition: a formal reprimand from someone in authority, recorded or public where a plain rebuke is private
example: अफ़सर की तौबीख़ फ़ाइल में दर्ज हो गई। — The officer's reprimand was entered in the file.

hindi: सरकश घोड़ा — जो क़ाबू में न आए
definition: a spirited, hard-mouthed horse that resists the rider; it names the mount by its unruliness, where other horse-words name speed or beauty
example: ख़्वाहिशों का तौसन लगाम मानता ही नहीं — The wild horse of desire simply will not take the rein.

hindi: अनुसमर्थन — किसी दस्तावेज़ की तसदीक़ और पुष्टि
definition: the formal attesting of a document by an authority, confirming that it is genuine and now in force
example: मुआहदे की तौसीक़ पार्लियामेंट से होनी बाक़ी है। — The ratification of the treaty by parliament is still pending.

hindi: गुणगान — किसी के गुणों का बयान
definition: praise given by describing the qualities themselves, commendation that comes with its reasons attached
example: उसकी तौसीफ़ में कई सफ़्हे लिखे गए — Several pages were written in his praise.

hindi: एकेश्वरवाद — ईश्वर के एक होने का सिद्धांत
definition: the belief in divine oneness, that the creator is single and undivided, the doctrine on which every other article of the faith is built
example: सारा उपदेश तौहीद पर टिका था — The whole sermon rested on the oneness of God.

hindi: अनादर — जान-बूझकर किसी की इज़्ज़त गिराना
definition: an insult that deliberately lowers someone's dignity, an act done by another rather than a state you fall into; humiliation is suffered, this is inflicted
example: यह तौहीन मैं बर्दाश्त नहीं करूँगा — I will not tolerate this insult.

hindi: छल — भरोसा तोड़ने वाला धोखा
definition: treachery done to someone who trusted the doer, so the injury is to the trust rather than to the pocket
example: अपने ही दोस्त ने दग़ा दी — His own friend betrayed him.

hindi: ठगी — भरोसा तोड़कर बार-बार किया गया धोखा
definition: the practice of cheating those who trusted you, fraud repeated as a settled trade rather than a single betrayal
example: उसकी दग़ा-बाज़ी का शिकार कई लोग हुए — Many fell victim to his double-dealing.

hindi: धारा — क़ानून का कोई एक तय हिस्सा
definition: one numbered section of a statute, the exact clause under which a person is charged or a right is claimed
example: उन पर किस दफ़ा के तहत मुक़दमा है — Under which section has the case been filed against him?

hindi: दफ़नाना — मिट्टी में उतार देने की क्रिया
definition: the act of putting a dead body into the earth and covering it, the plain everyday word for burial as an action performed by hands
example: उन्हें उनके गाँव में दफ़्न किया गया — He was buried in his own village.

hindi: धाक — जिससे लोग दबे रहें
definition: the mixture of respect and fear a person's presence imposes so that others lower their voices, dignity with menace inside it
example: गाँव में आज भी उनका दबदबा है — His sway still holds in the village.

hindi: आख़िरी साँस — जीवन की सबसे अंतिम घड़ी
definition: the very last breath, used to date a promise or a regret to the final instant of a life
example: दम-ए-आख़िर तक उसे उसका इंतिज़ार रहा — He waited for her until his last breath.

hindi: इलाक़ा — किसी की अपनी नगरी या भूमि
definition: the region or town identified with a person or a people, an older word carrying attachment rather than plain geography
example: अपने दयार से निकले बरसों हो गए — Years have passed since I left my own country.

hindi: दर-दर भटकता — बेघर होकर एक दर से दूसरे दर तक
definition: driven from door to door without shelter, wandering forced by loss of home rather than chosen
example: बँटवारे ने उन्हें दर-ब-दर कर दिया — The partition left them wandering door to door.

hindi: आवेदन — दफ़्तर में जमा किया जाने वाला प्रार्थना-पत्र
definition: a written application submitted to an office; carries paperwork where a spoken plea carries only politeness
example: छुट्टी की दरख़्वास्त कल ही जमा कर दी थी। — I submitted the leave application yesterday.

hindi: जगमगाता — तेज़ चमकने वाला
definition: shining brilliantly, said of a star, a future or a face lit from within; a word of promise as much as of sight
example: उसका मुस्तक़बिल दरख़्शाँ है — His future is brilliant.

hindi: मज़ार — सूफ़ी बुज़ुर्ग का पूजनीय स्थान
definition: the shrine of a saint that people visit to petition, a tomb turned into a place of resort rather than of memory
example: हर गुरुवार दरगाह पर भीड़ लगती है — Every Thursday a crowd gathers at the shrine.

hindi: अनदेखी — दोष जानते हुए भी उसे जाने देना
definition: the deliberate letting-go of a fault you have every right to raise, pardon exercised as restraint rather than as a formal act; you forgive by choosing not to speak
example: बड़ों की दरगुज़र ही घर चलाती है — It is the forbearance of elders that keeps a house running.

hindi: दर-दर भटकता — हर जगह से टाला हुआ
definition: driven from door to door with no shelter, homeless in the sense of being turned away everywhere rather than merely being poor
example: मुक़दमा हारकर वह दरबदर हो गया — Losing the case left him wandering from door to door.

hindi: द्वारपाल — दरवाज़े पर तैनात आदमी
definition: the doorkeeper stationed at an entrance who decides who may enter, a person doing what a lock does blindly
example: दरबान ने बिना पूछे अंदर जाने नहीं दिया — The doorkeeper let nobody in unasked.

hindi: दीर्घायु — लंबी उम्र पाना
definition: the condition of living a long span of years, spoken of as a gift given rather than a health achieved
example: बड़ों ने उसकी दराज़-उम्री की दुआ दी। — The elders prayed for him a long span of years.

hindi: हैवानियत — जानवरों जैसी निर्दयता
definition: the beast's savagery when shown by a human being, cruelty that tears rather than merely harms; it judges the act, not the temper behind it
example: उस हमले में दरिंदगी की हद कर दी गई — That attack crossed every limit of savagery.

hindi: हिंसक जानवर — फाड़ खाने वाला जीव
definition: a beast that tears and eats flesh, the predator among animals; used of a person it accuses him of cruelty rather than mere anger
example: जंगल का हर दरिंदा रात में शिकार पर निकलता है — Every beast of prey in the forest goes out to hunt at night.

hindi: बड़े दिल वाला — पैसे और ख़ता दोनों में उदार
definition: large-hearted in money and in judgement alike, generous in overlooking faults as much as in giving
example: मालिक दरियादिल है, देर से आने पर कुछ नहीं कहता — The owner is large-hearted; he says nothing if you come late.

hindi: बड़े दिल का होना — देने और माफ़ करने में खुलापन
definition: large-heartedness in giving and in forgiving, generosity of spirit that spends on others without keeping count
example: उसने दरियादिली से पूरा हिसाब माफ़ कर दिया — With great large-heartedness he wrote off the whole account.

hindi: पीड़ा — दूसरों का दुख महसूस करने वाली टीस
definition: ache understood as feeling, especially the capacity to register another person's suffering; English 'pain' stops at the body
example: उसकी आवाज़ में दूसरों का दर्द है — There is other people's pain in his voice.

hindi: पाठ-कक्षा — उस्ताद के सामने पढ़ी जाने वाली नियमित शिक्षा
definition: a lesson given by a teacher to those seated before him, the classroom unit of study; private reading is solitary, this happens in a circle at fixed hours
example: सुबह का दर्स कभी नहीं छोड़ा — He never missed the morning lesson.

hindi: शिक्षा-स्थल — जहाँ दर्स दिया जाता है
definition: any place of instruction where lessons are given, used broadly and often figuratively; the religious school and the children's school are types, this is the category
example: दुनिया ख़ुद एक बड़ी दर्सगाह है — The world itself is a great school of instruction.

hindi: तर्क — बात मनवाने के लिए पेश किया गया कारण
definition: an argument offered to establish a point, reasoning rather than evidence; a lawyer builds दलील out of the सुबूत he has
example: उसकी दलील कमज़ोर थी — His argument was weak.

hindi: औषधालय — जहाँ दवा बनती और मिलती है
definition: the place where medicines are compounded and handed out, a dispensary rather than a hospital; no beds, only prescriptions filled
example: नुस्ख़ा लीजिए, दवाख़ाना सामने ही है। — Take the prescription; the dispensary is right opposite.

hindi: उजाड़ मैदान — सुनसान खुला इलाक़ा
definition: a bleak open wilderness with no settlement, wild country rather than sand desert specifically
example: दश्त पार करने में दो दिन लगे — Crossing the wilderness took two days.

hindi: चाल — छिपा हुआ धूर्त दाँव
definition: a cunning stratagem played against a rival, one crafty move rather than a whole standing conspiracy
example: यह उसका पुराना दसीसा है — This is an old trick of his.

hindi: याचना का हाथ — माँगने के लिए फैलाया हुआ हाथ
definition: the outstretched hand of asking, begging named by the gesture that shames the one asking for money
example: उसने कभी दस्त-ए-सवाल दराज़ नहीं किया — He never stretched out his hand to beg.

hindi: हाथ तंग होना — जेब में पैसा न होना
definition: shortness of ready money at a given moment, which makes even a small living hard to manage; a cash squeeze, not lifelong want
example: इन दिनों दस्त-तंगी है, बाद में दे दूँगा — Money is short these days; I will pay later.

hindi: हाथ उठाना — बात से आगे बढ़कर शरीर पर हाथ डालना
definition: putting hands on another person, from a shove to a blow; names the crossing over from words into physical wrong
example: बहस तक ठीक था, दस्त-दराज़ी नहीं करनी चाहिए थी — Argument was fine; he should not have laid hands on him.

hindi: परमुखापेक्षी — हर काम के लिए दूसरों का मोहताज
definition: dependent on another's hand for daily needs, unable to manage without help; names the consequence of incapacity, not the incapacity
example: बीमारी ने उसे बेटों का दस्त-नगर बना दिया। — Illness left him dependent on his sons for everything.

hindi: हस्तशिल्प — हाथ से चीज़ें बनाने का काम
definition: work made by hand rather than by machine, valued for the making itself; names the handwork, while industry names production at scale
example: कश्मीर की दस्तकारी दुनिया भर में जाती है। — Kashmir's handicraft travels all over the world.

hindi: हस्ताक्षर — काग़ज़ पर अपना नाम लिखकर उसे मानना
definition: the signature by which a person attests a document and accepts it as binding on him
example: हर सफ़्हे पर दस्तख़त करने पड़े। — A signature had to be put on every page.

hindi: कंगन — कलाई पर बाँधकर पहना जाने वाला गहना
definition: an ornament worn round the wrist and fastened there; a wrist ornament clasped on, not a bangle slipped over the hand
example: उसने सोने का दस्तबंद कलाई पर कस लिया। — She tightened the gold bracelet on her wrist.

hindi: खाने का बिछौना — ज़मीन पर बिछाकर खाना परोसने का कपड़ा
definition: the cloth spread on the floor on which a meal is laid out, and by extension the whole spread of food a household serves
example: दस्तरख़्वान बिछते ही सब बैठ गए। — Everyone sat down as soon as the meal cloth was spread.

hindi: पहुँच-पकड़ — किसी इल्म या ज़बान पर हुक्म चलाने की सलाहियत
definition: command over a field, the reach that lets someone use it freely at will; mastery is the depth attained, this is the range a person can actually operate across
example: उन्हें तीन ज़बानों पर दस्तरस है — He has command over three languages.

hindi: टुकड़ी — फ़ौज का छोटा हिस्सा
definition: a small detachment of an army sent out for one task, a squad rather than the whole force
example: एक दस्ता तलाशी के लिए भेजा गया — A squad was sent to search.

hindi: इज़्ज़त की पगड़ी — सिर पर बाँधी जाने वाली आबरू
definition: a turban wound on the head as a sign of honour and standing; head covering that carries reputation, not warmth
example: बुज़ुर्ग की दस्तार को हाथ लगाना गुस्ताख़ी थी। — Touching the elder's turban was an insolence.

hindi: पगड़ी बाँधने की रस्म — जानशीनी या सनद का ऐलान
definition: the ceremony of tying the turban on a man's head to declare him an heir or a finished scholar
example: मदरसे में फ़ारिग़ तलबा की दस्तार-बंदी हुई। — The graduating students were honoured with the turban ceremony.

hindi: लिखित काग़ज़ — जो हक़ या सौदे का सबूत हो
definition: a written paper that stands as proof of a right, a sale, or an agreement; carries evidentiary weight that an ordinary note or letter does not
example: ज़मीन का दस्तावेज़ बैंक की तिजोरी में रखा है। — The deed for the land is kept in the bank’s vault.

hindi: रीति — बरसों से चला आ रहा तयशुदा चलन
definition: established custom that governs conduct by long usage rather than by enactment; binding through habit and shame where क़ानून binds through courts
example: यहाँ का दस्तूर ही ऐसा है — Such is the custom of this place.

hindi: किसान — अपनी ज़मीन जोतने वाला
definition: a farmer who works the soil of a village for a crop, rooted in land rather than in a garden of flowers
example: दहक़ान सुबह से खेत में था। — The farmer had been in the field since morning.

hindi: मुँह — बोलने और खाने का अंग
definition: the mouth taken as an opening, used in verse chiefly to praise how small it is
example: उसका दहन ग़ुंचे-सा छोटा है — Her mouth is as small as a bud.

hindi: देहरी — दरवाज़े की नीचे वाली पट्टी
definition: the raised threshold of a doorway, the exact line where the street ends and the household's honour begins
example: वह दहलीज़ पर खड़ा रहा, अंदर नहीं आया — He stood at the threshold and did not come in.

hindi: आतंक — दहला देने वाला सामूहिक डर
definition: fear that has become terror, the panic a violent act spreads through a whole crowd rather than the private dread of one person
example: धमाके के बाद पूरे बाज़ार में दहशत फैल गई — After the blast, terror spread through the whole market.

hindi: वाहवाही — सुनकर दी गई सराहना
definition: the appreciation an audience calls out on the spot, praise as an immediate reaction rather than a considered verdict
example: महफ़िल ने खुलकर दाद दी — The gathering applauded openly.

hindi: प्रज्ञा — तजरबे से आई हुई अक़्ल
definition: wisdom earned from experience and used to judge well, praised without irony; practical understanding where the neighbouring word is only sanity
example: फ़ैसले में उनकी दानाई साफ़ दिखती है। — His wisdom shows plainly in the decision.

hindi: विवेक — सोच-समझ की परिपक्व शक्ति
definition: the reasoning faculty of a mature mind, wisdom as an intellectual capacity rather than a knack; it is what a thinker possesses, while practical wisdom is what a fixer uses
example: उसकी दानिश पर सबको भरोसा है — Everyone trusts his intellectual judgment.

hindi: समझदारी — सोच-समझ कर क़दम उठाने का बरताव
definition: wisdom shown in conduct, the sensible handling of a situation by someone with a reasoning mind; the visible behaviour where the reasoning faculty itself is the hidden capacity
example: चुप रहना उस वक़्त दानिशमंदी थी — Staying silent was the wise course then.

hindi: बुद्धिजीवी — सोच-विचार और लिखने-बोलने वाला विद्वान
definition: an intellectual whose learning goes into public thought and argument, the modern counterpart of the traditional scholar; he interprets the age rather than guarding a text
example: इस बहस में कई दानिश्वर शरीक हुए — Several intellectuals took part in this debate.

hindi: जाल — परिंदे या जानवर को फँसाने की फंदेदार जाली
definition: the net or snare a hunter spreads to catch a creature alive; unlike a weapon it works by concealment, and it names any trap laid for a person
example: वो अपने ही बिछाए दाम में उलझ गया — He got tangled in the snare he had spread himself.

hindi: कपड़े का निचला घेरा — जिसे पनाह माँगते वक़्त थामा जाए
definition: the lower hem and skirt of a garment; the part caught hold of when begging protection or laying blame
example: उसने बुज़ुर्ग का दामन थाम लिया। — He caught hold of the elder's hem.

hindi: धाय — बच्चे को दूध पिलाने और पालने वाली
definition: the woman who nurses and tends a child that is not her own, part of the raising though not the mother
example: बचपन में उसे दाया ने ही पाला। — In childhood it was the nurse who raised him.

hindi: आरोग्यशाला — मुफ़्त इलाज के लिए बनाया गया अस्पताल
definition: a house of healing founded as a charity, the endowed hospital of older cities where the poor were treated without payment
example: बादशाह ने शहर में दारुश्शिफ़ा बनवाया। — The king had a house of healing built in the city.

hindi: न्योते का काग़ज़ — लिखा हुआ बुलावा
definition: the written card by which people are invited to a feast, the paper that carries an invitation rather than the invitation spoken
example: दावत-नामा हर रिश्तेदार को भेजा गया। — The invitation card was sent to every relative.

hindi: बिना सबूत आगे रखी गई बात, या अदालत में ठोका गया हक़
definition: an assertion put forward as true, or a legal claim filed over what you say is yours; the burden of proof rides along with it
example: उसका दावा है कि पैसा उसने वापस कर दिया था। — He claims he returned the money.

hindi: क़िस्सागोई — जिन्न-परी की लंबी कहानियाँ सुनाने की कला
definition: the performed art of telling long tales of jinn, sorcery, and marvels before an audience; the telling as craft, not the tales themselves
example: दिल्ली में दास्तान-गोई की महफ़िलें फिर सजने लगीं — Storytelling gatherings began to be held in Delhi again.

hindi: क्षय रोग — धीमे धीमे सुखा देने वाला रोग
definition: a wasting fever of the lungs that consumes the body slowly, the classical name for consumption; disease measured in months, not days
example: दिक़ ने उसे साल भर में खोखला कर दिया। — Consumption hollowed him out within a year.

hindi: परेशानी — रोज़मर्रा में आने वाली रुकावट
definition: a practical difficulty small enough to be solved but large enough to delay you; everyday trouble, not an ordeal to be borne
example: काग़ज़ात में एक दिक़्क़त आ गई है — A hitch has come up with the papers.

hindi: रक्षा — हमले से बचाव का इंतज़ाम
definition: defence, the whole business of protecting a country or a position from attack, the other side of the coin to assault
example: मुल्क की दिफ़ा पर सबसे ज़्यादा ख़र्च होता है — The most is spent on the country's defence.

hindi: ईमानदारी — लेन-देन में खरा उतरना
definition: honesty in dealings, the integrity that keeps a person true to money and to trust alike
example: उसकी दियानत पर कभी उँगली नहीं उठी। — No finger was ever raised at his honesty in dealings.

hindi: ईमानदारी बरतना — मुआमले में खरा बरताव
definition: the practice of honest dealing, integrity shown in day-to-day conduct rather than held as an inner quality
example: उसने पूरी दियानतदारी से हिसाब दिखाया। — He showed the accounts with complete honesty of dealing.

hindi: दिल दुखाना — बात या बेरुख़ी से भीतर तक चोट पहुँचाना
definition: hurting another's feelings by a word or a slight; pain inflicted on the heart rather than on the body, and slower to heal
example: मज़ाक़ में की गई दिल-आज़ारी भी दिल-आज़ारी है — Hurting a heart in jest still hurts the heart.

hindi: मन का भारीपन — जी घुटा-घुटा रहना
definition: the constricted heaviness of heart that follows sorrow, felt physically as a tightening; a mood grief leaves, not grief itself
example: शाम होते ही एक दिल-गिरफ़्तगी सी छा जाती है — As evening falls a heaviness of heart comes over me.

hindi: मन का जमाव — बिखरे ध्यान का एक जगह टिकना
definition: collectedness of mind in which attention stops scattering, composure that lets you work rather than merely rest
example: दिल-जमई से बैठकर पढ़ो। — Sit and study with a collected mind.

hindi: दिलजोई — टूटे दिल को सहलाना
definition: attending to a disheartened person's feelings so they can carry on, comfort aimed at the heart rather than the task
example: हार के बाद उसकी दिल-दही ज़रूरी थी। — After the defeat, reassuring him was necessary.

hindi: हृदयग्राही — जो दिल में बैठ जाए
definition: settling into the heart and staying there quietly; pleasing in a way that outlasts the first look instead of striking at once
example: उसका अंदाज़-ए-बयान बड़ा दिल-नशीं था — His way of speaking was deeply agreeable.

hindi: दिल बहलाना — हँसी-मज़ाक़ या हल्की आशिक़ी
definition: light-hearted amusement or a flirtation not meant seriously, the opposite of a bond one intends to keep
example: उसके लिए यह सिर्फ़ दिल-लगी थी — For him it was only a bit of fun.

hindi: दिल तोड़ना — इनकार या बेरुख़ी से किसी को चोट पहुँचाना
definition: breaking someone's heart by a slight or a refusal; the small cruelty from which an estrangement usually begins
example: इतनी सी बात पर दिल-शिकनी अच्छी नहीं — Such heart-breaking over so small a thing is not right.

hindi: दिल टूटना — भरोसा तोड़े जाने का दुख
definition: the broken-heartedness caused by a person one relied on, where despair has an address and a name
example: दोस्त के इनकार से जो दिल-शिकस्तगी हुई, वो अलग थी — The heartbreak of a friend's refusal was its own thing.

hindi: मनमोहक — जो दिल में अटक जाए
definition: so attractive that it stays hanging in the mind afterwards, said of a voice, a manner or a picture rather than of raw physical beauty
example: उसका अंदाज़-ए-बयाँ बेहद दिलआवेज़ है — His way of speaking is deeply captivating.

hindi: मन खींचने वाला — जो देखते ही भा जाए
definition: beautiful in the way that actively pulls attention toward it, so the word describes beauty's grip rather than its calm quality
example: यह जगह बेहद दिलकश है — This place is extremely attractive.

hindi: दिल खींचने वाली बात — जो नज़र को अपनी ओर बाँध ले
definition: the pull a beautiful thing exerts on the beholder rather than the beauty itself; attractiveness measured by what it does to the heart, not by symmetry of features
example: इस पुरानी इमारत में एक अजीब दिलकशी है — There is a strange attractiveness in this old building.

hindi: दिलासा देना — किसी का मन रख लेना
definition: the act of soothing someone's heart by attending to them, done to keep their feelings whole rather than to solve their problem
example: उसने दो मीठी बातों से दिलजोई कर दी — He soothed her with two kind words.

hindi: दिल दे बैठा — जिसने मन सौंप दिया हो
definition: having handed one's heart over to someone or something, so the word stresses the surrender rather than the ache that follows it
example: वह उस शहर का दिलदादा है — He has given his heart to that city.

hindi: मोहक — जो दिल को धोखा दे दे
definition: so appealing that it deceives the heart; beauty carrying a hint of trickery, admired and mistrusted in the same breath
example: यह दिलफ़रेब वादा किसी काम न आया — That beguiling promise proved worthless.

hindi: दिल ले जाने वाला — जो मन चुरा ले
definition: the beloved described by the effect they have, literally the one who carries the heart away, so the word praises their pull rather than naming the bond
example: दिलबर की एक मुस्कान ने सब भुला दिया — One smile from the heart-thief made me forget everything.

hindi: दिल हरने वाली — मोहक सुंदरता वाली प्रिय
definition: the beloved whose beauty snatches the heart, used with more open admiration of looks than the plain word for the loved person
example: वह दिलरुबा महफ़िल में सबसे अलग दिखी — That heart-ravisher stood out in the whole gathering.

hindi: दिल चुराने का अंदाज़ — मोहक अदाओं का चलन
definition: the practised art of stealing hearts, charm exercised deliberately rather than possessed innocently; attraction with intent behind it
example: उसकी दिलरुबाई से कोई बच नहीं पाता — Nobody escapes his heart-stealing charm.

hindi: दर्दमंदी — दूसरे के दुख पर दिल का जलना
definition: compassion that burns in you at another's suffering and moves you to act, stronger than sympathy politely expressed; the word is literally the heart scorching
example: उसकी दिलसोज़ी हर लफ़्ज़ से झलकती थी — His compassion showed in every word.

hindi: ढाढ़स — दुखी को दिए गए तसल्ली भरे बोल
definition: the comforting words given to someone in grief, consolation offered by another rather than felt on your own
example: उसने माँ को दिलासा दिया। — He consoled his mother.

hindi: निडर — जो डरता ही नहीं
definition: brave in the everyday sense of not flinching, said of a person whose fearlessness is a temperament rather than a trained skill
example: लड़की दिलेर है, अकेले सफ़र कर लेती है — The girl is fearless; she travels alone.

hindi: निडरता — दिल का खुला और बेझिझक होना
definition: open-hearted bravery in facing danger, the courage that shows in bearing and manner rather than in one decisive act
example: उसने दिलेरी से भीड़ का सामना किया — She faced the crowd with open bravery.

hindi: दर्शन — देख पाने का सुख
definition: the act and privilege of seeing the beloved, valued as the reward itself, which is why it stands opposite separation in verse
example: एक दीद के लिए वह घंटों खड़ा रहा — He stood for hours just for one sight of her.

hindi: आँख — शे'र-ओ-अदब वाली आँख
definition: the eye in its literary register, used where a writer needs the organ that weeps, waits and stays open through the night
example: दीदा-ए-तर लिए वह सारी रात बैठा रहा — He sat the whole night with wet eyes.

hindi: दर्शन — प्रिय चेहरे को देख पाना
definition: the sight of a cherished face, framed as something granted to you rather than something you simply looked at
example: अम्मी का दीदार हुए महीने हो गए। — Months have passed since I last set eyes on my mother.

hindi: बूटेदार रेशमी कपड़ा — तख़्त और ख़िलअत का कपड़ा
definition: rich figured silk cloth woven with raised patterns; the cloth of thrones and robes of honour
example: तख़्त पर दीबा का ग़िलाफ़ बिछा था। — A brocaded silk cover was spread on the throne.

hindi: प्रस्तावना — मुख्य लेख से पहले लिखी गई भूमिका
definition: the preface written before the main text, where the author explains his approach to the reader before the work begins
example: दीबाचा किताब से ज़्यादा दिलचस्प है। — The preface is more interesting than the book.

hindi: काव्य-संग्रह — शायर की संपूर्ण ग़ज़लें एक किताब में, तुक के क्रम से
definition: a poet's collected verse arranged by the rhyming letter, the whole written body of work gathered into one book
example: उसका पहला दीवान बीस बरस की उम्र में छपा। — His first collected volume was printed when he was twenty.

hindi: पागलपन — प्रेम में सुध खो बैठना
definition: the madness of love, a state of losing ordinary judgement over someone, admired in poetry where plain madness would only alarm
example: उसकी दीवानगी हद पार कर गई — His love-madness crossed all limits.

hindi: पुत्री — बेटी, औपचारिक और अदबी शब्द
definition: a daughter, in the formal register of documents, poetry and respectful introduction; names the girl child where the collective word covers all offspring at once
example: वो एक शरीफ़ घराने की दुख़्तर हैं — She is the daughter of a respectable family.

hindi: रूखापन — बोलने और बरतने में सख़्ती
definition: harshness in speech and in manner, blunt to the point of wounding whoever is spoken to
example: उसकी दुरुश्ती से नए लोग घबरा जाते हैं — New people are unnerved by his harshness.

hindi: ठीक — जो सही हालत में हो या सही कर दिया गया हो
definition: in correct working order, either never faulty or set right again; a verdict on present condition, not on how well the thing was made
example: पुर्ज़ा बदलते ही घड़ी दुरुस्त हो गई। — The moment the part was changed, the watch was in order.

hindi: सुधार — ग़लती या ख़राबी को ठीक करना
definition: the setting right of a fault, in a machine, a document, or an account; corrects what is wrong rather than restoring what has decayed
example: काग़ज़ात में नाम की दुरुस्ती करानी है। — The name in the papers has to be corrected.

hindi: असत्य — जान-बूझकर कही गई झूठी बात
definition: a falsehood stated as fact, the untruth itself as utterance rather than the deceit it serves; the formal word courts and couplets employ
example: दुरोग़ की उम्र लंबी नहीं होती — A falsehood does not live long.

hindi: तलछट — शराब के नीचे बैठी गाद
definition: the sediment settled at the bottom of the wine goblet, which the seasoned drinker swallows rather than pours away; wine at its lowest and least flattering
example: जाम ख़ाली हुआ तो दुर्द भी पी गया। — When the cup emptied he drank the dregs too.

hindi: मोती — बहुत उजला और बेशक़ीमत मोती
definition: a pearl in the loftier Arabic-flavoured register, reserved for the highest praise of speech, teeth or worth
example: उसके मुँह से दुर्र झड़ते हैं — Pearls fall from his mouth when he speaks.

hindi: गाली — मुँह से निकली अपमानजनक बात
definition: abusive words hurled at a person; names the foul language itself as a thing, rather than the act of using it
example: बहस बढ़ी और बात दुश्नाम तक पहुँच गई — The argument grew until it reached abuse.

hindi: कठिनाई — काम में आने वाली अड़चन
definition: the difficulty a task or a road presents, measured by the effort it costs to get through; a property of the work itself
example: पहाड़ी रास्ते की दुश्वारी का अंदाज़ा नहीं था — I had no idea of the difficulty of the mountain road.

hindi: दूरदर्शिता — आगे की सोचकर क़दम उठाना
definition: the prudence of weighing distant consequences before acting, foresight applied to decisions rather than to prophecy
example: उसकी दूर-अंदेशी ने हमें नुक़सान से बचाया। — His foresight saved us from loss.

hindi: बड़ी हांडी — जिसमें सैकड़ों लोगों का खाना एक साथ पकता है
definition: the huge cauldron in which food is cooked for a crowd at a feast or shrine, sized for hundreds and never for a family
example: बिरयानी की देग चूल्हे पर चढ़ी थी। — The great cauldron of biryani was on the fire.

hindi: विलंब — तय समय से पीछे रह जाना
definition: lateness measured against an expected hour; names the shortfall without assigning blame for it
example: थोड़ी देर हो गई, माफ़ कीजिए। — I'm a bit late, forgive me.

hindi: ऋण — किसी पर चढ़ा हुआ क़र्ज़
definition: a debt owed by one person to another, the liability itself rather than the money once borrowed
example: मरने वाले का दैन वारिसों पर आता है। — The dead man's debt falls upon his heirs.

hindi: पारसियों का मठ — मयख़ाने का सूफ़ियाना नाम
definition: the tavern imagined as a temple of the fire-priests, where wine stands for a teaching the mosque refuses; a drinking house given the dignity of a shrine
example: दैर-ए-मुग़ाँ में सर झुकाना भी इबादत है। — Bowing the head in that tavern-temple is worship too.

hindi: दोहरापन — सामने कुछ, पीछे कुछ
definition: double-facedness, hypocrisy shown by keeping different faces for different audiences rather than by faking virtue
example: उसकी दो-रंगी सबके सामने आ गई — His double-dealing came out before everyone.

hindi: नरक — जलती हुई सज़ा की जगह
definition: the same place of fiery punishment named in the Persian word, the one poets reach for when speaking of torment
example: उसका घर उसके लिए दोज़ख़ बन गया — His home became a hell for him.

hindi: युग — किसी चीज़ का चलन-काल; साथ ही घूमकर आने वाली बारी
definition: an era named for whatever dominated it; also the turn that comes around and passes on
example: वो रेडियो का दौर था। — That was the age of radio.

hindi: कलंक — जो पूरे ख़ानदान की इज़्ज़त पर दाग़ बने
definition: a disgrace that stains a family's honour, so the shame is carried by all of them and not by the one who earned it
example: ऐसा काम मत करो कि ख़ानदान का नंग बन जाओ — Do not act so as to become your family's disgrace.

hindi: चप्पलों की जोड़ी — तस्मों वाली सादा पादुका
definition: a pair of flat strapped sandals for the feet, open rather than enclosing; the footwear of piety and travel
example: उनकी नअलैन आज भी अक़ीदत से याद की जाती हैं। — His sandals are remembered with devotion even today.

hindi: भीनी ख़ुशबू — हल्की महक जो हवा में तैरे
definition: a faint drifting fragrance noticed rather than smelled, the scent that reaches you before its source does
example: फूलों की नकहत कमरे में भर गई — The faint fragrance of flowers filled the room.

hindi: मुखौटा — चेहरा ढकने वाला कपड़ा या ओढ़ा हुआ झूठा रूप
definition: the cloth that hides a face, and by extension the false face a person wears in company; a covering that can always be lifted off
example: वक़्त ने उसका नक़ाब उतार दिया — Time pulled the mask off him.

hindi: कमज़ोरी — बीमारी या सफ़र के बाद की निढालता
definition: the weakness left in the body after illness or hard travel, feebleness during recovery rather than plain fatigue
example: बुख़ार उतर गया पर नक़ाहत बाक़ी है — The fever is gone but the weakness remains.

hindi: प्रतिलिपिकार — नक़ल उतारने वाला, नक़ल उतारने वाला अभिनेता
definition: the copyist who reproduces a manuscript line for line; also one who mimics another's manner for an audience
example: नक़्क़ाल ने पुराने नुस्ख़े की नक़ल तैयार की। — The copyist prepared a copy of the old manuscript.

hindi: अहद तोड़ना — मुआहिदे की खुली ख़िलाफ़वर्ज़ी
definition: the formal violation of a treaty or agreement, the term used when a pact between parties is legally broken
example: सरहद पर गोलीबारी को नक़्ज़-ए-अहद माना गया। — The firing at the border was held to be a violation of the pact.

hindi: छाप — सतह या ज़ेहन पर छूटा हुआ अक्स
definition: the impression left behind on a surface or in the mind, a mark that outlasts whatever pressed it there
example: उसकी बातों का नक़्श दिल पर रह गया — The impression of his words stayed on my heart.

hindi: पदचिह्न — चलने वाले के छोड़े हुए निशान
definition: the footprints left by someone who has gone ahead, a track to follow literally or an example to imitate
example: वह अपने वालिद के नक़्श-ए-क़दम पर चला — He walked in his father's footsteps.

hindi: कमी — बनावट में रह गई ख़राबी
definition: a defect of make or of completeness, a flaw in the thing itself rather than a blot on a reputation
example: इस काम में एक बड़ा नक़्स रह गया — One large defect remained in this work.

hindi: शिकार किया हुआ जानवर — हलाल कर दिया गया जानवर
definition: the hunted animal already brought down, the body of the game rather than the chase for it; a word that presumes the hunt is over
example: नख़चीर घोड़े की पीठ पर लाद कर वो लौटा — He returned with the fallen game loaded on his horse.

hindi: खजूर का पेड़ — ऊँचा तनकर खड़ा पेड़
definition: the date palm, a tree valued for standing tall in dry ground where no other tree survives
example: रेत के बीच एक तन्हा नख़्ल खड़ा था। — A lone date palm stood among the sands.

hindi: मरुद्यान — रेगिस्तान के बीच पानी और खजूरों वाली हरी जगह
definition: a green watered place surrounded by desert; a garden that owes its existence to being the only one for miles
example: यह कैफ़े शहर के शोर में एक नख़्लिस्तान है। — This cafe is an oasis in the noise of the city.

hindi: गीत — सुनने में मीठा लगने वाला गाया हुआ टुकड़ा
definition: a song considered as a sweet sounding piece of music, praised for the pleasure of hearing it rather than for its words
example: दूर से कोई नग़्मा सुनाई दे रहा था — Some song could be heard from far away.

hindi: रत्न — अँगूठी में जड़ा जाने वाला क़ीमती पत्थर
definition: a cut stone set into a ring or ornament, and by extension the one excellent person set among ordinary ones
example: इस अँगूठी का नगीना असली है — The stone set in this ring is genuine.

hindi: उपेक्षित — देखकर भी अनदेखा किया हुआ
definition: passed over although it was seen; describes what got noticed and then treated as if it had never come into view at all
example: उसकी मेहनत को नज़र-अंदाज़ कर दिया गया — His hard work was overlooked.

hindi: गृहबंदी — बिना मुक़दमा चलाए किसी जगह रोक देना
definition: detention that confines someone to a place without trial, an order of the state keeping a person out of circulation
example: उन्हें अपने ही घर में नज़रबंदी में रखा गया — He was kept under detention in his own house.

hindi: पुनरावलोकन — फ़ैसले को दोबारा देखना
definition: review of a decision already made, a second look by the same authority to correct error; less than an appeal to a higher court
example: अदालत ने अपने हुक्म की नज़रसानी की — The court reviewed its own order.

hindi: श्रद्धा-भेंट — बड़े के सामने पेश की गई भेंट
definition: money or a gift presented upward to a superior on being received by him, tribute wearing the dress of a gift
example: दरबार में नज़राना पेश करना लाज़िम था — Presenting tribute at court was obligatory.

hindi: विवाद — हक़ को लेकर दो पक्षों का झगड़ा जो तय हो सकता है
definition: a dispute between two sides over a claim or a right, of the kind a court or a panchayat can settle; unlike a private quarrel it has a subject
example: ज़मीन का नज़ाअ अदालत में तीन साल चला — The land dispute ran in court for three years.

hindi: कोमलता — बात और बर्ताव की नफ़ासत
definition: delicacy in handling a person or a situation, the light touch that avoids bruising anyone; tact is strategic, this is nearly aesthetic
example: ये मामला नज़ाकत माँगता है — This matter calls for delicacy.

hindi: स्वच्छता — साफ़-सुथरे रहने का सलीक़ा
definition: cleanliness kept as a discipline of person and place, refinement expressed as spotlessness rather than as taste
example: नज़ाफ़त उसके मिज़ाज का हिस्सा है — Cleanliness is part of his temperament.

hindi: क्षीण — बीमारी से सूखा हुआ शरीर
definition: wasted thin by illness rather than by nature, the body visibly reduced; describes what long disease does to flesh
example: इतना नज़ार हो गया है कि पहचाना नहीं जाता। — He has wasted so thin that he is unrecognisable.

hindi: दृश्य — देखने लायक़ नज़र आने वाला मंज़र
definition: a sight worth stopping for, the thing beheld rather than the act of beholding, and usually one that pleases
example: छत से डूबते सूरज का नज़ारा बेमिसाल था — The sight of the setting sun from the roof was matchless.

hindi: अंतिम अवस्था — जान निकलने के ठीक पहले का वक़्त
definition: the final stretch before death when the soul is being drawn out, the state a dying person is in rather than the moment of death
example: वो नज़्अ की हालत में थे और सब जमा हो गए — He was in his last throes and everyone gathered.

hindi: दृश्य — देखने लायक़ मंज़र
