definition: a sight worth stopping for, and the act of looking at it; a scene framed by the beholder's attention
example: पहाड़ों का नज़्ज़ारा भूलता नहीं — The sight of the mountains is not forgotten.

hindi: कविता — एक ही विषय पर सिलसिलेवार चलने वाली रचना
definition: a poem that develops one subject continuously from first line to last, unlike a ghazal whose couplets each stand alone and may contradict each other
example: यह नज़्म बँटवारे पर लिखी गई थी — This poem was written about the partition.

hindi: भेंट — मज़ार या बड़े को अर्पित की गई वस्तु
definition: the offering itself, presented at a shrine or to a superior in fulfilment of a vow or as homage
example: उसने चादर नज़्र की — He presented a sheet as an offering.

hindi: पछतावा — किए हुए पर होने वाली भीतरी शर्म
definition: the shame felt afterwards for what one has done; regret that includes the face falling, not merely the wish to have chosen differently
example: उसके चेहरे पर नदामत साफ़ थी — The remorse on his face was plain.

hindi: निर्वाह-व्यय — पत्नी और बच्चों का वाजिब ख़र्च
definition: the maintenance a husband or father is legally bound to pay for wife and children, claimable in court; an enforceable duty, not the care of rearing them
example: अदालत ने बच्चों का नफ़क़ा मुक़र्रर कर दिया — The court fixed maintenance for the children.

hindi: फटकार — नफ़रत के साथ की गई बद्दुआ
definition: a curse spoken out of disgust at what someone has done; expresses the speaker's revulsion, where condemnation invokes exclusion from mercy
example: उसके काम पर हर तरफ़ से नफ़रीन हुई — His deed drew curses from every side.

hindi: लाभ — लागत निकालने के बाद बचा हुआ
definition: the gain left after costs are met, profit as the plain excess of return over whatever was put in
example: इस सौदे में नफ़ा कम मगर पक्का है — The profit in this deal is small but certain.

hindi: प्रवर्तन — क़ानून या हुक्म को अमल में लाना
definition: the bringing of a law or order into actual force, the step at which a rule stops being paper and starts binding people
example: इस क़ानून का नफ़ाज़ अगले महीने से होगा — This law comes into force from next month.

hindi: नफ़ीसपन — रुचि और चुनाव की बारीकी
definition: refinement of taste seen in what a person chooses to wear, eat or own; fastidiousness that reads as class rather than as fuss
example: उसके घर की हर चीज़ में नफ़ासत है — There is refined taste in everything in his home.

hindi: उम्दा और बारीक — बढ़िया बनावट वाला
definition: of fine quality and delicate make, said of cloth, workmanship or taste; it praises craftsmanship rather than size or cost
example: यह बहुत नफ़ीस कपड़ा है — This is very fine cloth.

hindi: मन का निचला रुख़ — इच्छाओं वाला भीतरी स्व
definition: the appetitive self that pulls a person toward desire, spoken of as an inner opponent to be disciplined rather than as any single want
example: नफ़्स पर क़ाबू पाना सबसे मुश्किल है — Mastering the appetitive self is the hardest thing.

hindi: मिस्री — धागे पर जमी हुई साफ़ चीनी
definition: rock sugar crystallised into clear lumps, taken with drinks or medicine; sweeter to look at and slower to melt than loose sugar
example: दवा के साथ नबात चूसने को दी गई। — Rock sugar was given to suck with the medicine.

hindi: पैग़ंबर — ईश्वर का संदेश पाने वाला
definition: a prophet who receives revelation from God, whether or not he is also sent with a new scripture and law
example: हर क़ौम में नबी भेजा गया — A prophet was sent to every people.

hindi: पोता — बेटे का बेटा
definition: a grandson counted as the second step of offspring, the generation in which a line is felt to be secure
example: दादा का नबीरा उन्हीं की सूरत पर गया है। — The grandfather's grandson has taken his very face.

hindi: नाड़ी — कलाई पर धड़कती रग जिससे हाल जाना जाए
definition: the pulse read at the wrist as the chief sign a traditional physician examines; also the hidden state of any person or situation
example: हकीम ने नब्ज़ पर उँगली रखी और सिर हिलाया। — The physician laid a finger on the pulse and shook his head.

hindi: नमक खाने वाला — जो किसी के घर का खाया हुआ है
definition: one who eats another's salt and so lives by that household's food, naming the dependence itself without judging the loyalty
example: वो बरसों से इसी दर का नमक-ख़्वार है। — For years he has eaten the salt of this house.

hindi: कृतघ्नता — जिसका खाया उसी को नुक़सान पहुँचाना
definition: treachery by someone who lived off your kindness, betrayal sharpened by ingratitude rather than by broken oath or duty
example: इतने बरस बाद यह नमक-हरामी? — After all these years, this ingratitude?

hindi: नमक का हक़ अदा करना — जिसका खाया उसका वफ़ादार रहना
definition: staying loyal to whoever fed you, paying back shared food with faithfulness; duty owed for salt eaten, not wages taken
example: नौकर ने आख़िर तक नमक-हलाली निभाई। — The servant kept faith with the house that fed him.

hindi: एक सफ़ेद फूल — जिसकी उपमा ख़ूबसूरत आँख से दी जाती है
definition: the narcissus flower, conventionally likened to a beautiful eye; the flower poets reach for when writing about a gaze
example: उसकी आँखें नरगिस की तरह नीमबाज़ थीं। — Her eyes were half-closed like a narcissus.

hindi: भाव — बाज़ार में चल रहा तय दाम
definition: the going rate a commodity fetches in the market on a given day; a price fixed by the market rather than asked by one shopkeeper
example: आज गेहूँ का नर्ख़ पिछले हफ़्ते से ऊँचा है। — Today's rate for wheat is higher than last week's.

hindi: मुलायम तबीयत — जो छेड़ने पर भी तेज़ न हो
definition: a naturally soft temper that does not sharpen under provocation; disposition rather than the effort of holding anger back
example: उसकी नर्म-मिज़ाजी से घर का माहौल ठीक रहता है — His soft temper keeps the house calm.

hindi: स्वर — गाने या साज़ से निकली सुरीली आवाज़
definition: a musical voice or note considered for its tone, the sound a singer or an instrument makes rather than the words it carries
example: उसकी नवा में एक दर्द छुपा था — There was a hidden ache in his voice.

hindi: मेहरबानी भरा बर्ताव — इज़्ज़त बढ़ाने वाली कृपा
definition: kindness that lifts the receiver's standing in front of others, and in polite speech the word one uses to acknowledge being honoured
example: यह आपकी नवाज़िश है, वरना मैं किस लायक़ — This is your kindness; what am I worth otherwise?

hindi: लिखा हुआ — तक़दीर में जो लिख दिया गया
definition: what stands written for a person, fate spoken of as an unchangeable record rather than as an active will
example: जो नविश्ता है वही होगा। — Only what is written will come to pass.

hindi: शुभ सूचना — आने वाली ख़ुशी की ख़बर
definition: the announcement of good news still to come, a message that promises what is approaching rather than reporting what is done
example: यह बारिश अच्छी फ़सल की नवेद है। — This rain is the promise of a good harvest.

hindi: बैठक — कुछ लोगों की छोटी सी सभा
definition: a small sitting of a few people for talk or poetry, informal and unstaged; intimate where the grand assembly is arranged and adorned
example: आज शाम शायरों की नशिस्त है। — There is a sitting of poets this evening.

hindi: घोंसला — परिंदे का तिनकों से बना ठिकाना
definition: the bird's nest as a home built by its own labour, standing for a modest dwelling; it is loved because it is fragile, unlike a house
example: बिजली गिरी तो नशेमन जल गया — Lightning struck and the nest burned down.

hindi: विकास — बढ़ने और निखरने की प्रक्रिया
definition: the growth of a child or a thing from small to full, the visible increase that raising is meant to produce
example: अच्छी ग़िज़ा बच्चों की नशो-ओ-नुमा के लिए ज़रूरी है। — Good food is necessary for children's growth.

hindi: चीरा लगाने वाला औज़ार — बारीक धार का छोटा चाकू
definition: the surgeon's lancet, a fine blade that cuts in order to heal, used in verse for words that wound with precision
example: उसका हर जुमला नश्तर की तरह चुभा — Every sentence of his pricked like a lancet.

hindi: वंश — पिता की ओर से चली आती हुई पहचान
definition: descent traced through the father, the line by which a person's family identity and claims are reckoned; ancestry as legal standing, not as an emotional heritage
example: नसब के लिहाज़ से वो एक पुराने घराने से हैं — By descent he belongs to an old family line.

hindi: भाग्य — हिस्से में जो पहले से लिखा हो
definition: the portion allotted to a person; fate imagined as a share already assigned rather than a force pushing events
example: इतनी मेहनत की, मगर नसीब ने साथ नहीं दिया। — He worked that hard, and fortune still didn't stand by him.

hindi: मंद पवन — ठंडी नरम हवा जो राहत दे
definition: a soft cool breeze of moving air that soothes rather than chills, gentler than ordinary wind and never strong enough to disturb
example: नदी के किनारे नसीम चल रही थी। — A soft breeze was moving along the riverbank.

hindi: सुबह की ठंडी हवा — भोर के वक़्त की नरम बयार
definition: the cool breeze of the hour before sunrise, a wind fixed to that one time of day rather than to a season
example: नसीम-ए-सहर चेहरे से टकराई। — The dawn breeze struck against my face.

hindi: उपदेश — भले के लिए दी गई सीख
definition: advice given for someone's moral good by a person with standing to give it; a suggestion can be declined lightly, this arrives as a duty discharged
example: बड़ों की नसीहत बाद में समझ आती है — The advice of elders is understood only later.

hindi: जंगली गुलाब की झाड़ी — काँटों वाली बेल
definition: the thorny wild rose bush, named for the whole prickly shrub where other rose words name only the flower
example: नस्तरन की झाड़ी ने रास्ता रोक रखा था। — The wild rose bush had blocked the path.

hindi: ढलवाँ लिपि-शैली — उर्दू लिखने की झुकी हुई अक्षर-शैली
definition: the sloping, hanging script in which Urdu is properly written; a named style of letters, not a judgement on how good the handwriting is
example: उर्दू नस्तालीक़ में ही अच्छी लगती है। — Urdu looks right only in the hanging script.

hindi: सफ़ेद जंगली गुलाब — नाज़ुक सफ़ेद फूल
definition: the white wild rose, invoked for pale delicate beauty where the red rose would carry passion instead
example: बाग़ की दीवार पर नस्रीन फैली हुई थी। — White wild roses had spread over the garden wall.

hindi: मगरमच्छ — पानी का विकराल शिकारी जानवर
definition: the crocodile or sea-monster, the predator of water as the lion is of land; it names a danger one cannot see coming
example: दरिया में नहंग का ख़ौफ़ हर मल्लाह को होता है — Every boatman fears the crocodile in the river.

hindi: पौधा — नया लगाया हुआ छोटा पेड़
definition: a young tree newly set into the ground, past the seed stage but far from bearing anything
example: उसने बाग़ में दस नहाल लगाए। — He planted ten saplings in the garden.

hindi: नहीं / रहित — गुण के न होने को जताने वाला उपसर्ग
definition: negating prefix meaning 'not', bolted onto an adjective or noun to reverse it; उम्मीद becomes नाउम्मीद and राज़ी becomes नाराज़
example: उम्मीद के आगे ना- लगते ही लफ़्ज़ ना-उम्मीद बन जाता है — Putting ना- before उम्मीद turns the word into its hopeless opposite.

hindi: मतभेद — दो पक्षों का लगातार एकमत न हो पाना
definition: the failure of two sides to agree, taken as a standing condition; disunity rather than one particular disagreement between them
example: पंचायत की ना-इत्तेफ़ाक़ी से काम रुका पड़ा है — The work is stalled by the council's disunity.

hindi: अपरिपक्व — जो अभी मँजा न हो
definition: not yet matured by experience, said of judgement and work rather than of a person's count of years
example: फ़ैसला ना-पुख़्ता था, इसलिए बदलना पड़ा। — The decision was immature, so it had to be changed.

hindi: पराया मर्द — वह पुरुष जिससे पर्दा वाजिब है
definition: a man outside the barred degrees of kinship, before whom seclusion is required and marriage remains possible; the exact opposite of a close unmarriageable relative
example: ना-महरम के सामने वो दुपट्टा सँभाल लेती थी — Before an unrelated man she would draw her scarf close.

hindi: अभाग — मन की चाह उम्र भर पूरी न होना
definition: the misfortune of never getting the one thing wanted, however long it is waited for; failure of a wish, not of luck at large
example: सारी उम्र की ना-मुरादी उसकी आँखों में थी — A lifetime of unfulfilled longing was in his eyes.

hindi: अनजानपन — किसी ख़ास बात की जानकारी न होना
definition: unfamiliarity with one particular matter, a gap in acquaintance rather than a defect of mind; the blameless kind that a single explanation can cure
example: क़ानून से ना-वाक़फ़ियत उज़्र नहीं — Unfamiliarity with the law is no excuse.

hindi: असहमति — राय का न मिलना, फूट
definition: disagreement that splits a family into camps over a decision or a share; a division of opinion, where discord is a mood that persists between people
example: जायदाद पर नाइत्तेफ़ाक़ी ने कुनबा बाँट दिया — Disagreement over the property split the extended family.

hindi: उपाधिकारी — असल के बदले काम करने वाला
definition: the deputy who acts for a superior, holding delegated authority only for as long as the principal allows
example: साहब की ग़ैर-हाज़िरी में नाइब ने दस्तख़त किए। — In the officer's absence the deputy signed.

hindi: आशाहीनता — आगे कुछ अच्छा होने की उम्मीद न बचना
definition: having no expectation left that things will improve, hopelessness pointed at what is still to come rather than at what happened
example: नाउम्मीदी में भी उसने कोशिश नहीं छोड़ी — Even in hopelessness he did not stop trying.

hindi: ऊँटनी — मादा ऊँट, जो सवारी के लिए बेहतर मानी जाती है
definition: the she-camel, distinguished from the male as the smoother mount for a traveller; poetry seats the beloved's litter on her
example: नाक़ा की चाल में महमिल झूल रहा था — The litter swayed with the she-camel's gait.

hindi: मल्लाह-सरदार — नाव या जहाज़ चलाने वाला
definition: the one who steers a vessel and answers for its passengers, a boatman with command rather than a mere rower
example: नाख़ुदा ने रुख़ बदल दिया — The boatman changed course.

hindi: अचानक — बिना किसी पूर्व सूचना के, एकदम
definition: all at once and without any warning sign beforehand; marks trouble arriving unannounced, unlike something merely quick
example: नागहाँ एक शोर बुलंद हुआ — All at once a clamour rose.

hindi: आकस्मिक — बिना किसी आहट के आने वाली
definition: of a calamity or death that arrives with no warning at all, allowing no preparation; describes the suddenness, not the damage
example: नागहानी मौत ने पूरे मोहल्ले को हिला दिया — The sudden death shook the whole neighbourhood.

hindi: अनबन — घर या रिश्ते में चलती हुई खटपट
definition: an ongoing lack of accord in a household or marriage, visible in daily friction; the state of not getting along, where a grievance names its cause
example: सास-बहू की नाचाक़ी सारे मोहल्ले को मालूम थी — The discord between mother-in-law and daughter-in-law was known to the whole neighbourhood.

hindi: इतराना — चाहे जाने के भरोसे पर की गई अदा
definition: the sweet self-importance of one who knows they are loved, showing as small demands and refusals rather than as pride toward strangers
example: उसके नाज़ उठाना आसान नहीं — Indulging her airs is not easy.

hindi: नाज़ वाली — कोमल और नख़रीली सुंदरी
definition: a delicately beautiful woman whose charm lies in her airs, beauty defined by नाज़ rather than by features
example: उस नाज़नीन ने पलट कर देखा तक नहीं — That delicate beauty did not even look back.

hindi: निर्बल — जिसमें ताक़त बाक़ी न हो
definition: having no strength left for effort, feeble from sickness or advanced years; describes the person, where the noun names the condition
example: इतना नातवाँ है कि बिना सहारे उठ नहीं सकता। — He is so feeble he cannot rise unaided.

hindi: बेबसी की कमज़ोरी — ताक़त न होने की हालत
definition: the settled condition of having no strength left, spoken of as a state one lives in rather than a moment of weakness
example: नातवानी ने उन्हें बिस्तर तक महदूद कर दिया। — Strengthlessness confined him to the bed.

hindi: निर्धन — जिसके पास कोई संपत्ति न हो
definition: owning no property or means at all, poor in the sense of having no wealth to fall back upon
example: अदालत ने उसे नादार मानकर फ़ीस माफ़ कर दी — The court treated him as without means and waived the fee.

hindi: निर्धनता — कुछ भी अपना न होने की हालत
definition: the state of owning no property or means at all, the word a court or a form uses; poverty as a status, not a mood
example: अदालत ने उसकी नादारी मान कर फ़ीस माफ़ कर दी — The court accepted his lack of means and waived the fee.

hindi: लज्जित — अपनी ग़लती मानकर भीतर से शर्मिंदा
definition: feeling the sting of one's own fault after admitting it; remorseful, and usually too quiet about it to say so aloud
example: वो अब नादिम है, उसे माफ़ कर दो — He is remorseful now; forgive him.

hindi: रोटी-ख़र्च — खाने-पहनने का पूरा इंतज़ाम
definition: food and living expenses together, the whole cost of keeping a household fed and clothed; a wider phrase than the legally fixed maintenance figure
example: उनके नान-ओ-नफ़क़ा का बंदोबस्त बड़े भाई ने किया — The eldest brother arranged their board and keep.

hindi: रोटी और नमक — साथ खाया हुआ खाना, जिससे रिश्ता बनता है
definition: bread and salt shared at one table, standing for the bond that eating together creates between host and guest
example: हमारा नान-ओ-नमक का रिश्ता है। — Ours is a bond of shared bread and salt.

hindi: हुक्म-उदूली — कहा हुआ न मानना
definition: disobedience to a specific order, the smallest of the defiance words and the one used of children and subordinates
example: बच्चों की नाफ़रमानी उन्हें चुभती थी — The children's disobedience pricked him.

hindi: मृगनाभि — हिरन की नाभि की कस्तूरी की थैली
definition: the musk pod carried in the deer's navel, the source the hunter kills for; it names the vessel, not the scent inside
example: नाफ़ा खुला तो सारा ख़ेमा महक उठा — The musk pod opened and the whole tent grew fragrant.

hindi: अवयस्क — जो अभी क़ानूनी उम्र तक न पहुँचा हो
definition: still under the legal age, a status that limits what a young person may sign, own, or be charged with
example: नाबालिग़ होने की वजह से मुक़दमा अलग चला। — Being under legal age, his case ran separately.

hindi: नेत्रहीन — जिसे दिखाई न देता हो
definition: without sight, unable to see; the formal and courteous word chosen where the blunt everyday one would wound the person it names
example: नाबीना बच्चों के लिए अलग किताबें छपती हैं — Separate books are printed for blind children.

hindi: नाम और चिह्न — बचा हुआ कोई सुराग़ या पहचान
definition: the name and any trace of a person or family, invoked almost always to say that neither is left behind
example: उस ख़ानदान का अब नाम-ओ-निशान नहीं मिलता — Not a name or trace of that family is found now.

hindi: नाम लेने वाला — जो पीछे नाम ज़िंदा रखे
definition: the one left behind to keep a family name alive, usually a descendant, named by the remembering they do
example: उनके बाद घर में कोई नाम-लेवा न रहा। — After him no one was left to keep the name alive.

hindi: ख्याति — अपने काम की बदौलत बना हुआ बड़ा नाम
definition: the standing of being known and respected for genuine achievement in a field, distinguished from mere fame by the work that earned it
example: उन्हें यह नामवरी चालीस साल में मिली — He earned this standing over forty years.

hindi: लेख-पत्र — पत्र या लिखित विवरण, प्रायः समास में
definition: a letter or written account, used mostly inside compounds; it dignifies the written thing as a document rather than a passing note
example: उसने अपना अहद-नामा लिखकर मेज़ पर रख दिया। — He wrote out his written pledge and left it on the table.

hindi: संवाददाता — किसी जगह से रिपोर्ट लिखकर भेजने वाला
definition: the correspondent who writes reports from a place and sends them to a paper; he writes for readers, not for one addressee
example: हमारे नामा-निगार ने मौक़े से यह रिपोर्ट भेजी है। — Our correspondent has sent this report from the spot.

hindi: पत्रवाहक — चिट्ठी पहुँचाने वाला
definition: one who carries a written letter to its addressee, a bearer of documents rather than of spoken news
example: नामा-बर ने ख़त हाथ में दिया — The letter-carrier put the letter in my hand.

hindi: पत्रवाहक — चिट्ठी पहुँचाने वाला
definition: the letter-carrier who delivers written word, named for the letter in his hand rather than for the news it carries
example: नामाबर ने चिट्ठी चुपचाप थमा दी — The letter-carrier quietly handed over the letter.

hindi: मान-मर्यादा — जिसकी हिफ़ाज़त की जाती है
definition: the honour of a family or a woman held to be defended, honour as property to guard rather than a feeling to obey
example: उसने नामूस की ख़ातिर लड़ाई मोल ली — He took on a fight for the sake of family honour.

hindi: खुरी की पट्टी — घोड़े के खुर पर ठोकी जाने वाली लोहे की कमान
definition: the iron shoe nailed to a horse's hoof, the gear that protects the animal rather than serving the rider; its loss lames the mount
example: घोड़े की नाल रास्ते में ही निकल गई — The horse's shoe came off right on the road.

hindi: करुण पुकार — दर्द भरी सदा
definition: the drawn-out wailing cry of one in pain, a sustained sound rather than a single sigh or a shouted lament
example: रात भर उसका नाला गूँजता रहा — His wailing echoed all night.

hindi: शिकायत की अर्ज़ी — किसी के ख़िलाफ़ अदालत में की गई फ़रियाद
definition: a formal complaint lodged against someone before a court or officer, the act of taking a grievance to authority rather than settling it privately
example: उसने पड़ोसी के ख़िलाफ़ नालिश कर दी — He lodged a complaint against his neighbour.

hindi: बाण — पतला और तेज़ चलने वाला तीर
definition: the arrow in its poetic register, the shaft loosed from a bow, spoken of as piercing a heart more often than a body
example: निगाह का नावक सीधा दिल पर लगा — The arrow of her glance struck the heart.

hindi: प्रकाशक — जो लिखी हुई चीज़ छापकर पाठकों तक पहुँचाए
definition: the publisher who takes on written work and issues it to readers; he risks the money the author does not
example: नाशिर ने दूसरा एडीशन निकालने का फ़ैसला किया। — The publisher decided to bring out a second edition.

hindi: अस्वस्थ — तबीअत ठीक न होना
definition: unwell in a passing manner, indisposed without a diagnosis; used of health the same way it is used of a machine running badly
example: आज तबीअत कुछ नासाज़ है, कल बात करेंगे। — I am somewhat unwell today; we will talk tomorrow.

hindi: तबीअत का बिगड़ना — हल्की सी बीमारी
definition: a mild disorder of health that stops short of real disease, the polite word for feeling slightly unwell; lighter than any diagnosed illness
example: नासाज़ी की वजह से वो जलसे में नहीं आ सके। — Owing to indisposition he could not attend the gathering.

hindi: रिसता घाव — जो कभी भरता नहीं और बार-बार बहता है
definition: a wound that refuses to close and keeps discharging, used of old quarrels that never heal; the opposite of a scar
example: ये झगड़ा अब ख़ानदान का नासूर बन चुका है — This quarrel has become a festering wound in the family.

hindi: उपदेशक — जो बिन माँगे नसीहत देता रहे
definition: the well-meaning adviser who keeps counselling reform, a private nuisance rather than a public authority; advises where the preacher proclaims
example: नासेह की बात सुन ली, मानी नहीं। — I heard the adviser out and did not obey.

hindi: विवाह-अनुबंध — गवाहों के सामने तय होने वाला वैवाहिक क़रार
definition: the marriage contract itself, agreed before witnesses with terms and consent, not the festivity around it; a wedding is an event, this is the binding agreement
example: निकाह दो गवाहों की मौजूदगी में पढ़ा गया — The marriage contract was read in the presence of two witnesses.

hindi: विवाह-पत्र — निकाह की शर्तें लिखने वाला दस्तावेज़
definition: the written document recording a marriage contract, its witnesses, dower and any conditions the couple set; the paper that survives when memory of the ceremony fades
example: निकाह-नामा में तलाक़ का हक़ भी दर्ज था — The marriage document also recorded her right of divorce.

hindi: निरीक्षण — लगातार नज़र रखना
definition: keeping continuous watch over a person or a process, supervision that may protect quite as easily as it controls
example: क़ैदी को सख़्त निगरानी में रखा गया — The prisoner was kept under strict watch.

hindi: रक्षक — जो नज़र रखकर हिफ़ाज़त करे
definition: one who guards by watching over; a keeper whose whole duty is attention rather than force or authority
example: वह इस घर का निगहबान है — He is the keeper of this house.

hindi: निगरानी — नज़र रखकर की जाने वाली हिफ़ाज़त
definition: watchful guarding by keeping an eye on a place, protection through observation rather than by standing at its door
example: रात भर खेत की निगहबानी करनी पड़ी — The field had to be watched over all night.

hindi: दृष्टि — इरादे भरी नज़र
definition: a look freighted with intent, whether favour, appraisal or injury, where a glance carries no purpose at all
example: बॉस की निगाह अभी भी उस फ़ाइल पर है। — The boss still has his eye on that file.

hindi: व्यवस्था — चीज़ों को चलाने का पूरा ढाँचा
definition: the whole system by which something is governed, the arrangement itself rather than the people currently staffing it
example: तालीम का निज़ाम बदले बिना कुछ नहीं होगा — Nothing will change without changing the education system.

hindi: मुक्ति — गुनाह और अज़ाब से छुटकारा
definition: deliverance from sin and its punishment, salvation in the final sense and relief from any long torment in ordinary speech; release frees the body, this frees the record
example: इस अज़ाब से निजात कब मिलेगी — When will I be delivered from this torment?

hindi: निर्वाह — रिश्ता जैसे-तैसे चलाते रहना
definition: keeping a relationship going through friction and disappointment rather than ending it; endurance in marriage, not the fondness that started it
example: मोहब्बत न सही, निबाह तो हो ही रहा है — Love aside, they are at least keeping the marriage going.

hindi: अर्पण — बुज़ुर्गों के नाम चढ़ाया जाने वाला भोग
definition: an offering of food devoted in a saint's name and then shared out, devotion expressed as giving rather than as prayer
example: ग्यारहवीं की नियाज़ बाँटी गई — The offering made in the saint's name was distributed.

hindi: प्रतिनिधित्व — किसी की जगह पर काम करना
definition: acting in another's place under delegated authority, deputyship rather than owning the right yourself
example: वो अपने वालिद की नियाबत में हाज़िर हुआ। — He appeared as deputy on his father's behalf.

hindi: न्योछावर — किसी पर वार दिया गया
definition: given away entirely for someone's sake, used of a life or a self offered up, and it takes the person as its object rather than standing alone
example: उस पर सब कुछ निसार है — Everything is laid down for her sake.

hindi: गुप्त — भीतर छिपा हुआ, ऊपर से न दिखने वाला
definition: concealed within and not showing on the surface; the word poetry reaches for when the heart is hiding something behind the face
example: दिल में निहाँ दर्द किसी को नहीं दिखता — The pain hidden in the heart is visible to no one.

hindi: आधी रात — रात का ठीक बीच का पहर
definition: the middle hour of the night when the darkness is deepest, a point in the night rather than the night as a whole
example: नीम-शब तक चराग़ जलता रहा। — The lamp burned until midnight.

hindi: खुली बोली से बिक्री — क़र्ज़ वसूलने को जायदाद बेच देना
definition: the public auction of seized property to recover a debt, the last step after attachment and confiscation
example: मिल की नीलामी की तारीख़ छप गई — The date for the auction of the mill was published.

hindi: नैन-नक़्श — चेहरे की बनावट की रेखाएँ
definition: the features of a face taken together as drawn lines, and also the impressions that marks leave behind
example: उसके नुक़ूश माँ से मिलते हैं — His features resemble his mother's.

hindi: बारीक बात — बहस या शेर में छिपा हुआ महीन मुद्दा
definition: a fine point that decides an argument or unlocks a couplet, small enough to be missed and sharp enough to change the meaning once seen
example: आपने एक अहम नुक्ता उठाया है — You have raised an important fine point.

hindi: मीनमेख — छोटी-छोटी ख़ामियाँ ढूँढ़ते रहना
definition: the habit of picking at small faults for their own sake, which uses the vocabulary of criticism without its purpose of judging a work fairly
example: हर बात में नुक्ताचीनी मत कीजिए — Do not pick at every little thing.

hindi: ज्योतिष — सितारों की चाल से आने वाले वक़्त का हिसाब
definition: the science of reading the future from the movement of stars; a calculated method, unlike an omen taken from a chance sign
example: उस दौर में नुजूम का बड़ा चर्चा था — Astrology was much discussed in that age.

hindi: उभरा हुआ — जो दूर से ही सबसे पहले दिखे
definition: standing out so as to be seen before anything else around it; prominent to the eye rather than merely present in the picture
example: नतीजों में उसका नाम सबसे नुमायाँ था — His name stood out most in the results.

hindi: मदद से मिली जीत — ऊपर से आई सहायता
definition: victory understood as help granted from above, the aid that decides a battle rather than the strength that wins it
example: मज़लूम को नुसरत मिली — The oppressed were granted victorious help.

hindi: पर्चा — दवाओं और मात्रा की लिखी हुई तरतीब
definition: the written prescription naming medicines and their doses, the physician's instruction on paper; also any tried formula for a result
example: नुस्ख़ा जेब में रखिए, दवाख़ाने से दवा मिल जाएगी। — Keep the prescription; the medicine is available at the dispensary.

hindi: आभा, तेज — चेहरे से फूटती रोशनी
definition: luminous glow seen in a face or a place, understood as light coming out of something rather than falling on it
example: नई माँ के चेहरे पर एक नूर सा आ गया है। — A kind of glow has settled on the new mother's face.

hindi: सद्भावना — नीयत का साफ़ होना
definition: good intention behind a dealing, honesty of purpose rather than honesty of the account books
example: ग़लती हुई, मगर नेक-नीयती में कोई शक नहीं। — A mistake was made, but there is no doubt of the good intention.

hindi: शुभ शगुन वाला — जिसका आना अच्छे वक़्त का इशारा माना जाए
definition: reckoned a good omen, whose arrival is read as a sign of coming fortune; said of a person or hour, not of luck already received
example: उसका आना हमारे घर के लिए नेक-फ़ाल साबित हुआ — His coming proved a good omen for our house.

hindi: भाग्यवान — जिसकी क़िस्मत अच्छी हो, ख़ासकर बीवी के लिए
definition: carrying good fortune with one, often said of a wife whose arrival brings luck to a house; blesses the person, not a single lucky event
example: बहू बहुत नेक-बख़्त निकली — The bride proved most fortunate.

hindi: सहृदय — भला मन रखने वाला
definition: good-hearted in intention as much as in deed, praising what a person wishes others rather than what they manage to achieve
example: मास्टर साहब नेकदिल आदमी थे। — The schoolmaster was a good-hearted man.

hindi: भाला — लंबा नुकीला हथियार
definition: the spear carried by a rider or hunter, a weapon thrust or thrown at close range rather than shot from a bow
example: उसने नेज़ा उठाया और घोड़े को एड़ लगाई — He raised the spear and spurred his horse.

hindi: डंक — साँप या बिच्छू का ज़हरीला नुकीला अंग
definition: the sting or fang through which venom is delivered, the creature's weapon rather than the creature; words are said to carry it
example: उसकी बातों में नेश छुपा होता है — There is a sting hidden in his words.

hindi: नामोनिशान मिटा — पूरी तरह ख़त्म
definition: wiped out so completely that no trace of it remains, the strongest word in this group and never a matter of degree
example: एक रात में सारी दौलत नेस्त-ओ-नाबूद हो गई। — In one night all the wealth was wiped out.

hindi: जादू-सा असर — चीज़ों का हैरान कर देने वाला बदलता रूप
definition: an enchantment or strange turn that transforms what it touches, worked by fate or beauty rather than by a magician's hands
example: ये वक़्त का नैरंग है कि आज वो मोहताज है — Such is the enchantment of time that today he is destitute.

hindi: रंग-बदली — हालात या क़िस्मत के अजीब पलटे
definition: the quality of shifting bewitchingly from one state to another; describes fate's or the world's changeability, not a single magical act
example: ज़माने की नैरंगी पर हैरत होती है — One marvels at the shifting spell of the times.

hindi: पीना — घूँट भरकर पीने का अमल, ख़ास तौर पर मज़े से
definition: the act of drinking something with relish, whether water, sherbet or wine; names the pleasure in drinking, not the thirst behind it
example: उन्होंने शरबत का नोश किया और मुस्कुरा दिए। — He drank the sherbet down and smiled.

hindi: ख़ुशी से खाइए — मेज़बान की तरफ़ से खाने की इजाज़त और दुआ
definition: said to someone eating, wishing the food may go down as life itself; a host's blessing over a meal, not a mere invitation
example: यह सब आपके लिए है, नोश-ए-जाँ कीजिए। — All this is for you, may it nourish your life.

hindi: नन्हा पौधा — क़ौम के नौजवान बच्चे
definition: a young sapling used for the children of a community, naming them as the growth the future depends on
example: क़ौम के नौ-निहाल ही कल की उम्मीद हैं। — The young saplings of the community are tomorrow's hope.

hindi: नई बहार — वसंत का पहला हिस्सा
definition: the earliest part of the flowering season, when the first buds open; spring at its freshest rather than at its fullest
example: नौ-बहार में बाग़ की हवा बदल जाती है। — In early spring the air of the garden changes.

hindi: नवोदित — जो अभी-अभी उठ रहा हो
definition: just sprouting into youth, said of a young person or thing at the very start of its rise
example: वो एक नौख़ेज़ शायर है, मगर लहजा पक्का है। — He is a just-risen young poet, but his voice is settled.

hindi: नवजात — जिसका जन्म अभी हुआ हो
definition: newly born, said of a child in the first days of life when it still needs everything done for it
example: नौज़ाइदा बच्चे को धूप से बचाकर रखो। — Keep the newly born child out of the sun.

hindi: नन्हा पौधा — और आगे बढ़ने वाला बच्चा
definition: a fresh sapling, used almost always for children as the young growth a community is raising
example: क़ौम के नौनिहालों को तालीम चाहिए। — The young saplings of the nation need education.

hindi: नया-नया — जो अभी कच्चा और ताज़ा हो
definition: young and freshly formed, holding the tenderness of the early stage before ripening sets in
example: नौरस उम्र में ऐसे फ़ैसले भारी पड़ते हैं। — Such decisions weigh heavily at a fresh young age.

hindi: दूल्हा — निकाह के दिन का वर
definition: the bridegroom on the day of the wedding, freshly married and dressed for it; pairs with the bride as a ceremonial title, not a term for a husband afterwards
example: नौशा घोड़ी पर सवार होकर निकला — The bridegroom set out mounted on a mare.

hindi: विलाप-गीत — शोक में पढ़ा जाने वाला मर्सिया
definition: a lament recited or sung for the dead, grief given fixed words and a rhythm so a crowd can carry it
example: औरतें बैठकर नौहा पढ़ रही थीं — The women sat reciting a lament.

hindi: उपदेश — बड़ों की सिखाने वाली सीख
definition: counsel given from experience and age, meant to shape conduct over a lifetime; guidance aimed at character, not at a single decision
example: बुज़ुर्गों की पंद कभी बेकार नहीं जाती। — The counsel of elders is never wasted.

hindi: मुरझाया हुआ — जिसकी ताज़गी सूख गई हो
definition: withered and gone limp, naming the state of the single flower or face rather than the season that caused it
example: गुलदान में पज़मुर्दा फूल पड़े थे। — Withered flowers lay in the vase.

hindi: शरण — ख़तरे से बचने की जगह
definition: refuge given against danger, a place valued for the safety it offers rather than for being anyone's home
example: बारिश में हमने एक दुकान की छत तले पनाह ली — In the rain we took refuge under a shop's roof.

hindi: शरणार्थी — किसी की पनाह में आ जाने वाला
definition: one who has taken refuge under another's pledge of protection, sheltered by a promise given him
example: गाँव में सैकड़ों पनाह-गुज़ीं ठहरे हुए थे। — Hundreds of refugees were sheltering in the village.

hindi: पला-बढ़ा — जिसे किसी ने पालकर बड़ा किया हो
definition: raised and shaped by a particular household or hand, naming a person by whose upbringing formed them
example: वो इसी घराने का परवरदा है। — He was raised in this very household.

hindi: पालनकर्ता — सारी सृष्टि का पोषण करने वाला ईश्वर
definition: a name of God as the sustainer who feeds and rears all creation, warmer and more ceremonial than the plain word for lord
example: ऐ परवरदिगार, हमें राह दिखा — O sustainer of all, show us the way.

hindi: लालन-पालन — बच्चे को खिला-पिलाकर बड़ा करना
definition: the feeding, sheltering and rearing of a child through the years of dependence; the daily work of raising, distinct from the money that pays for it
example: उसकी परवरिश दादी के हाथों हुई — He was raised by his grandmother's hands.

hindi: उड़ान — पंख फैला कर उड़ने की क्रिया
definition: flight as an act of wings, a bird's rising rather than a journey by any means; of ambition it means how high a man dares aim
example: उसके ख़यालात की परवाज़ बहुत बुलंद है — The flight of his ideas is very lofty.

hindi: पतंगा — शमा पर जल मरने वाला कीड़ा, समर्पित प्रेमी का प्रतीक
definition: the moth that circles a flame until it burns, poetry's figure for the lover whose devotion ends in his own destruction and asks nothing back
example: शमा जलती रही और परवाना जल गया — The candle kept burning and the moth was consumed.

hindi: परिचारक — इलाज के दौरान मरीज़ की देखभाल करने वाला
definition: an attendant trained to look after patients under a physician's orders, the nurse; care as a duty of office, not of kinship
example: परस्तार ने वक़्त पर दवा दी। — The nurse gave the medicine on time.

hindi: पथ्य — बीमारी में कुछ चीज़ों से बचना
definition: the deliberate avoidance of foods or acts that would worsen an illness, restraint prescribed as part of treatment; abstaining, not dieting to slim
example: दवा से ज़्यादा ज़रूरी परहेज़ है। — The dietary restraint matters more than the medicine.

hindi: संयम — हराम और संदिग्ध चीज़ों से दूरी
definition: the piety of abstaining, keeping away from what religion forbids and even from what is merely doubtful
example: उसकी परहेज़गारी मशहूर थी — His abstemious piety was well known.

hindi: परी जैसी देह वाला — अलौकिक सुंदर
definition: fairy-formed, praising a beauty that seems not quite human; stronger and more otherworldly than हसीन
example: उसने किसी परीपैकर का ख़्वाब देखा — He dreamt of a fairy-formed beauty.

hindi: पर्दे में रहने वाली — ग़ैरों के सामने न आने वाली
definition: living in seclusion behind a curtain and covered before men outside the family; said of a woman's whole manner of life
example: वो पर्दा-नशीं ख़ातून कभी बाज़ार नहीं गईं। — That secluded lady never went to the market.

hindi: दोष छिपाना — किसी की कमज़ोरी पर पर्दा डालना
definition: the covering up of another's fault so it never reaches other people, treated as a virtue rather than a lie; forgiving cancels the wrong, this hides it from view
example: बड़ों की पर्दा-पोशी घर की इज़्ज़त बचा लेती है — Elders covering a fault can save a family's honour.

hindi: भंडाफोड़ — छिपी हुई बात का खुल जाना
definition: the tearing away of a cover so a hidden wrong becomes public, exposure done to someone rather than a fact merely coming out
example: अख़बार ने सारे खेल का पर्दा-फ़ाश कर दिया — The paper exposed the whole game.

hindi: तेंदुआ — घात लगा कर झपटने वाला हिंसक जानवर
definition: the leopard among predators, feared for the ambush and the leap rather than the lion's open strength
example: पहाड़ी पर पलंग की आहट सुनी गई — A leopard was heard moving on the hillside.

hindi: मच्छर — नन्हा उड़ता कीड़ा
definition: the gnat or mosquito, the tiny creature invoked to show how small a thing can trouble the mighty
example: पशा भी हाथी को बेचैन कर सकता है — Even a gnat can unsettle an elephant.

hindi: पछतावा — जो किया उस पर मन का मुरझा जाना
definition: the deflated regret of wishing an act undone, softer and more everyday than remorse before God; you feel it after a harsh message as much as after a sin
example: जल्दबाज़ी की पशेमानी बाद में होती है — The regret for haste comes later.

hindi: पीछे छूटे लोग — मरने वाले के बचे हुए घरवाले
definition: those a dead person leaves behind, the surviving family taken together as the party a condolence is addressed to
example: पस-मांदगान से इज़हार-ए-ताज़ियत किया गया — Condolences were expressed to the bereaved family.

hindi: पीछे हटना — मैदान छोड़कर लौट आना
definition: retreat, falling back from a position under pressure, a step towards defeat rather than the defeat itself
example: फ़ौज को पसपाई इख़्तियार करनी पड़ी — The army had to retreat.

hindi: हौसले का टूटना — हिम्मत का गिर जाना
definition: the sinking of morale, courage collapsing under strain; not a coward's nature but the low point a brave side can also fall to
example: लगातार हार से फ़ौज में पस्ती आ गई — Repeated defeats brought low morale into the army.

hindi: पहलू बचाना — ज़िम्मेदारी से किनारा कर लेना
definition: sidestepping a responsibility that is properly yours, evasion of duty rather than of a question or a person
example: अपने फ़र्ज़ से पहलू-तिही मत करो — Do not sidestep your duty.

hindi: टिकाऊपन — दबाव में भी क़ायम रहना
definition: the quality of holding firm under pressure over time, of a wall, a promise or a people; endurance that resistance depends on
example: इस इमारत की पाइदारी सौ साल से आज़माई जा रही है — This building's durability has been tested a hundred years.

hindi: पवित्रता — भीतरी और बाहरी दोनों तरह की शुद्धता
definition: purity that is moral as much as physical, the unstained quality praised in a character or an intention
example: उसके इरादे की पाकीज़गी पर शक नहीं — There is no doubting the purity of his intention.

hindi: प्रतिफल — किए का बदला, अक्सर बुरे काम का
definition: the return a deed earns its doer, retribution that arrives by consequence rather than by a court
example: बेवफ़ाई की पादाश उसे मिल गई। — He received the retribution for his faithlessness.

hindi: जूती — जिसे सबसे हक़ीर चीज़ के तौर पर बोला जाता है
definition: footwear regarded as the lowest thing a person owns; the shoe invoked in insult and contempt, not in admiration
example: ऐसी दौलत मेरी पापोश के बराबर भी नहीं। — Such wealth is not worth even my shoe.

hindi: पाँव का घुँघरूदार गहना — चलने पर बजता है
definition: an ornament worn round the ankle whose small bells sound as the wearer walks
example: आँगन में पायज़ेब की आवाज़ गूँजी। — The sound of anklet bells rang in the courtyard.

hindi: गोश्त का टुकड़ा — बोटी, कटा हुआ हिस्सा
definition: a cut piece of meat as it goes into the pot, the portion separated from the carcass rather than the whole animal or the dish
example: हर पारचा नरम और रसीला था। — Every piece of meat was tender and juicy.

hindi: सदाचारी — जिसका चरित्र गुनाहों से पाक हो
definition: describing a person of clean, blameless conduct, especially in matters of chastity; God-fearing care is the inner state, this is the reputation it earns
example: वह पारसा औरत थी — She was a woman of blameless conduct.

hindi: पवित्राचरण — चरित्र की निर्मलता
definition: the piety of a clean life, purity of conduct that others can see rather than a caution felt inwardly
example: पारसाई का दावा वह कभी नहीं करता — He never lays claim to saintly purity.

hindi: रक्षा — क़ौल और रिश्ते का लिहाज़ रखना
definition: the upholding of a promise or a trust, guarding what was given rather than merely performing it once
example: उसने आख़िर तक दोस्ती की पासदारी की। — He upheld the trust of friendship to the end.

hindi: पहरेदार — दरवाज़े पर पहरा देने वाला
definition: a sentry posted to keep watch at one place; the guard defined by his post at the door rather than by whom he is protecting
example: दरवाज़े का पासबान रात भर जागता रहा — The gate's sentry stayed awake all night.

hindi: रखवाली — किसी चीज़ की हिफ़ाज़त का ज़िम्मा
definition: the sworn duty of protecting something entrusted to you, an obligation where watching over is merely the act
example: इस अमानत की पासबानी हमारा फ़र्ज़ है — Guarding this trust is our duty.

hindi: पितृवत — बाप जैसा, बुज़ुर्गाना शफ़क़त के साथ
definition: done in the manner of a father, mixing authority with indulgence toward someone younger; describes conduct in a family role, not the man's actual paternity
example: उन्होंने पिदराना अंदाज़ में समझाया — He explained it in a fatherly manner.

hindi: पुत्र — बेटा, फ़ारसी लहजे का शब्द
definition: a son in Persianate style, the male child paired with the formal word for daughter in couplets and courtly speech; older-sounding than the everyday term for a son
example: बाप का हुनर पिसर में उतर आया — The father's craft came down into the son.

hindi: आध्यात्मिक गुरु — मुरीदों का मार्गदर्शक
definition: a spiritual master who guides disciples along the mystical path, a teacher of the heart rather than of texts
example: पीर के बग़ैर यह राह कठिन है — Without a master this path is hard.

hindi: मयख़ाने का बुज़ुर्ग — शराब बाँटने वाला गुरु
definition: the aged master of the tavern who dispenses wine as a teacher dispenses doctrine; the cupbearer's elder, an authority rather than a server
example: पीर-ए-मुग़ाँ ने इशारा किया और जाम भर गया। — The tavern's old master gestured and the cup was filled.

hindi: बुढ़ापे का असर — उम्र ढलने की हालत
definition: the state of being far along in old age, stressing what the years have done to the body more than the count
example: पीराना-साली के बावजूद वो रोज़ चलते हैं। — Despite advanced old age he walks daily.

hindi: वृद्धावस्था — बुढ़ापे का दौर
definition: old age as the closing stage of a life, named for the loss of strength that comes with the years
example: पीरी में सफ़र भारी लगने लगता है। — In old age travelling begins to feel heavy.

hindi: परिपक्वता — सोच और काम का पक्कापन
definition: the ripeness that experience gives to judgment and work, maturity of handling rather than length of practice
example: उसकी बातों में अब पुख़्तगी आ गई है। — There is maturity in his words now.

hindi: पक्का — जो तैयार, मज़बूत और भरोसे लायक़ हो
definition: brought to a finished, firm state that will hold up in use; the settled opposite of raw, said equally of brickwork, of a plan, and of skill
example: उसका इरादा पुख़्ता है, अब वो पीछे नहीं हटेगा। — His resolve is firm; he will not step back now.

hindi: अनुभवी — जो काम में मँज चुका हो
definition: seasoned by long practice, describing someone whose maturity shows in the work rather than in their bearing
example: इस काम के लिए कोई पुख़्ता-कार आदमी चाहिए। — A seasoned man is needed for this work.

hindi: मातमपुर्सी — शोक वाले घर जाकर बैठना
definition: the condolence visit itself, going to the mourning house and sitting with the family; a physical call paid, where condolence can be sent in words
example: शाम को पुरसा देने बहुत लोग आए — Many came in the evening to pay their condolence visit.

hindi: पीढ़ी — वंश की एक कड़ी
definition: one generation counted along a line of descent, the unit ancestry is measured in when going back or forward
example: तीन पुश्त से यही काम चला आ रहा है। — This same work has continued for three generations.

hindi: ख़ानदानी — पीढ़ी दर पीढ़ी चला आ रहा
definition: handed down through generations of one family, said of a trade, house, or tool; inheritance as continuing practice, not merely property received once
example: ये पुश्तैनी काम है, दादा भी यही करते थे। — This is a hereditary trade; grandfather did the same.

hindi: प्रस्ताव — सामने रखी गई बात
definition: an offer placed before the other side, still waiting on acceptance to become a binding agreement
example: उनकी पेशकश मुनासिब थी, हमने सोचने का वक़्त लिया। — Their offer was reasonable; we took time to consider.

hindi: अग्रिम — काम शुरू होने से पहले दिया गया पैसा
definition: money paid ahead of the work or delivery it is owed for; funds the doing, where earnest money only proves the bargain will be kept
example: मिस्त्री ने आधी पेशगी माँगी है। — The mason has asked for half the payment in advance.

hindi: अगवानी — मेहमान को रास्ते में जाकर लेना
definition: going out ahead to meet an arriving traveller on the road, receiving them before they ever reach the door
example: बेटे की पेशवाई के लिए वह स्टेशन तक गया — He went to the station to meet his son on arrival.

hindi: माथा — जिस पर लकीरें और तक़दीर लिखी मानी जाती है
definition: the forehead as the plain surface where lines gather and fate is imagined to be written; the workaday word beside the poetry of जबीं
example: पेशानी पर पसीना साफ़ दिख रहा था — The sweat on his forehead was plainly visible.

hindi: भविष्यवाणी — आने वाले वक़्त के बारे में पहले से कही गई बात
definition: a statement made in advance about what the future will bring, judged later by whether it came true; a claim spoken, not a method of reading signs
example: उनकी पेशीनगोई हर्फ़-ब-हर्फ़ सच निकली — His prediction came true word for word.

hindi: रणसंग्राम — डटकर होने वाली लड़ाई
definition: battle in the elevated poetic register, hand-to-hand struggle spoken of as an ordeal rather than reported as news
example: शायर ने ज़िंदगी को पैकार कहा — The poet called life a battle.

hindi: संदेश — रिश्ते का प्रस्ताव जो एक घर से दूसरे घर भेजा जाए
definition: a message carried between two families proposing a marriage, sent through a go-between rather than spoken face to face; the proposal in transit, before any answer
example: उनकी तरफ़ से पैग़ाम आया है, जवाब सोच कर देंगे — A marriage proposal has come from their side; we will answer after thinking.

hindi: उपज — ज़मीन से जो निकले
definition: what the cultivated ground finally yields, the measurable output of farming rather than the labour of it
example: इस साल पैदावार कम रही। — The yield was low this year.

hindi: क़रार — दो पक्षों के बीच का वचनबद्ध बंधन
definition: a pledge made between two people who bind each other, mutual where a solemn undertaking may be taken alone
example: दोनों ने साथ जीने-मरने का पैमान बाँधा — The two pledged to live and die together.

hindi: वफ़ा का पैमान — साथ निभाने का पवित्र वचन
definition: the covenant of fidelity sworn between lovers, a pledge of constancy rather than a bargain over terms
example: पैमान-ए-वफ़ा बाँधकर वो चला गया। — He bound a covenant of fidelity and then went away.

hindi: वचन-भंग — बंधे हुए पैमान को तोड़ देना
definition: the breaking of a solemn pact once sworn, naming the act itself rather than the character that produced it
example: इस पैमान-शिकनी के बाद भरोसा लौटना मुश्किल है। — After this breaking of the pact, trust is hard to recover.

hindi: प्याला या माप — जिससे नापा जाए, और जिसमें शराब पी जाए
definition: a measuring cup, doing double duty as the drinking vessel of the tavern and as the standard by which anything is measured
example: सबके लिए एक ही पैमाना ठीक नहीं — One single standard is not right for everyone.

hindi: मुक़दमे की देखभाल — तारीख़ों पर लगातार पीछा करना
definition: the sustained following-up of a case or a request until it moves; the legwork of pursuing a matter rather than the arguing of it
example: मुक़दमा अच्छा है, पर पैरवी कोई नहीं करता — The case is strong, but nobody follows it up.

hindi: वस्त्र — तन ढकने वाला कपड़ा
definition: a garment worn on the body, chosen in verse where the thinness or tearing of the cloth carries the feeling
example: उसका पैरहन तार-तार था — His garment was in shreds.

hindi: अंदाज़ — जिस रूप में कोई बात सजाकर पेश हो
definition: the outward form in which something is dressed and presented; adornment as manner of presentation rather than jewellery
example: उसने सख़्त बात को नर्म पैराया दे दिया। — He gave the hard remark a soft guise.

hindi: थिगली — फटे कपड़े पर लगाया गया टुकड़ा
definition: a patch stitched onto a garment where the cloth has gone; a repair that shows, unlike invisible darning
example: उसकी क़मीज़ पर तीन पैवंद लगे थे। — There were three patches on his shirt.

hindi: जोड़ा — किसी एक मौक़े के लिए चुने हुए कपड़े
definition: a complete outfit of clothing put together for one occasion; the chosen set of garments, never clothing in general
example: शादी की पोशाक दो महीने पहले सिलवाई गई थी। — The wedding outfit was tailored two months in advance.

hindi: ढकने वाला कपड़ा — जो छुपाने के लिए पहना जाए
definition: a garment regarded as covering rather than display; clothing valued for what it hides, not for what it shows
example: ग़रीबी की पोशिश उसकी हँसी थी। — His laughter was the covering over his poverty.

hindi: गोपनीयता — चीज़ का नज़रों से ओझल रहना
definition: the state of being hidden from view, concealment as a condition of the thing rather than something anybody performs
example: सारा कारोबार पोशीदगी में चलता रहा — The whole business ran in concealment.

hindi: छिपा हुआ — जिसे ढककर नज़रों से बचाया गया हो
definition: kept covered and out of sight deliberately; hidden by somebody's act rather than merely lying around unnoticed
example: यह बात उनसे पोशीदा रखी गई — This matter was kept hidden from them.

hindi: निस्पृह साधक — दुनिया से बेनियाज़ दरवेश
definition: one who has chosen poverty on the mystical path, a renunciant rather than merely a man who has no money
example: बादशाह उस फ़क़ीर के आगे झुक गया — The king bowed before that renunciant.

hindi: वायुमंडल — खुली हवा और उसका माहौल
definition: the open atmosphere one moves and breathes in, and by extension the mood that fills a place
example: बारिश के बाद फ़ज़ा साफ़ हो गई। — The air cleared after the rain.

hindi: किरकिरी — सबके सामने हुई भद्द
definition: a messy public embarrassment in which someone's fault is paraded and laughed at, noisier and less dignified than disgrace; the scene matters as much as the shame
example: बीच बाज़ार में फ़ज़ीहत हो गई — There was a public scene right in the market.

hindi: अनुग्रह — बिना हक़ के मिली ईश्वरीय बख़्शिश
definition: divine favour given far beyond what one has earned, grace that exceeds desert rather than mercy that merely pardons
example: यह सब उसके फ़ज़्ल से हुआ — All this happened by His unearned favour.

hindi: भोर — सूरज निकलने से पहले की सफ़ेदी
definition: the first whitening of the sky before sunrise, the hour of the dawn prayer rather than the moment the sun clears the horizon
example: फ़ज्र के वक़्त परिंदे बोलने लगते हैं। — At dawn the birds begin to call.

hindi: धर्मादेश — किसी सवाल पर विद्वान का शास्त्रीय निर्णय
definition: a formal opinion issued by a qualified religious scholar in answer to a question, advisory rather than enforceable by itself
example: इस मसले पर फ़तवा माँगा गया — A formal ruling was sought on this matter.

hindi: विजय — लड़ाई या मुक़ाबले में हासिल की गई जीत
definition: a victory taken by force or contest, the winning of something that had to be seized rather than quietly earned
example: क़िले की फ़तह पर शहर में जश्न हुआ — The city celebrated the capture of the fort.

hindi: कला — सीखा और साधा हुआ हुनर
definition: a whole artistic discipline with its own rules and lineage, something one enters rather than merely does; talent is given, this is built over years
example: गाना उसके लिए शौक़ नहीं, फ़न है — Singing is not a hobby for him but an art.

hindi: कलाकार — किसी हुनर को कला के दर्जे तक ले जाने वाला
definition: a practising artist in any performing or fine discipline, singer, actor, calligrapher alike, named for mastery of a craft rather than for a medium
example: स्टेज पर एक सच्चा फ़नकार खड़ा था — A true artist stood on the stage.

hindi: विनाश — हस्ती का मिट जाना
definition: annihilation, the passing out of existence of a thing or a self; in mystic use the willing dissolution of the ego rather than a body's death
example: इश्क़ में फ़ना हो जाना ही मंज़िल है — To be annihilated in love is itself the destination.

hindi: बहुत उदार — हैसियत से बढ़कर देने वाला
definition: lavish in giving, generous on a scale that outruns both the need and the giver's own means
example: मेज़बान इतना फ़य्याज़ था कि शरम आने लगी — The host was so lavish that we felt embarrassed.

hindi: उदार दानशीलता — ज़रूरत से कहीं ज़्यादा देना
definition: generosity that pours out in abundance, giving lavishly far beyond what the occasion actually asks for
example: फ़य्याज़ी ऐसी कि जेब हमेशा ख़ाली — Such lavish generosity that his pocket is always empty.

hindi: आज्ञाकारिता — हुक्म मानने का सधा हुआ स्वभाव
definition: the settled habit of carrying orders through, a quality of the person rather than any single instance of obedience
example: बच्चों की फ़रमाँबरदारी पर उन्हें नाज़ था — He was proud of his children's obedience.

hindi: शासक — जिसका हुक्म पूरे मुल्क में चलता हो
definition: the ruler whose word runs as binding order across a realm, named by the reach of his command rather than by crown, lineage or election
example: उस दौर का फ़रमाँरवा शायरों को दरबार में बिठाता था — The ruler of that age seated poets in his court.

hindi: मनचाही माँग — कोई ख़ास चीज़ मँगवाना
definition: a request for something specifically wanted — a song, a dish, a favour; asks from affection or entitlement rather than need
example: नानी की फ़रमाइश पर आज गाजर का हलवा बना। — Carrot halwa was made today at grandmother's request.

hindi: शाही आदेश — लिखा हुआ और न टलने वाला हुक्म
definition: a written order issued by a ruler that is not open to discussion, carrying the whole weight of sovereign authority behind it
example: बादशाह का फ़रमान सुबह चौक में पढ़ा गया — The king's decree was read out in the square at dawn.

hindi: खुलाव — तंगी के बाद आई हुई माली आज़ादी
definition: an easing of means, the roominess in spending that appears once money stops being tight
example: नौकरी लगते ही घर में फ़राख़ी आ गई — With the job the household found some room to breathe.

hindi: निवृत्ति — काम से छूटकर मिली खाली घड़ी
definition: the free time left once a duty or a working stretch is finished, leisure earned rather than idleness chosen
example: काम से फ़राग़त मिली तो वो बाग़ में बैठे। — Once free of work he sat in the garden.

hindi: विस्मरण — याद रखी हुई बात का छूट जाना
definition: the failing away of what memory once held, forgetting treated as a condition rather than an accident; the faculty is what keeps, this is what it loses
example: यह एहसान फ़रामोशी की हद है — This is the limit of ingratitude and forgetting.

hindi: भाग निकलना — पकड़ से बच कर निकल जाना
definition: escape by running from a chase or a captivity, the prey's answer to pursuit; it names getting away, not hiding in place
example: मुल्ज़िम अदालत से फ़रार हो गया — The accused escaped from the court.

hindi: बहुतायत — खाने या माल की इतनी मिक़दार कि कमी का ख़याल न आए
definition: plenty of food or goods in such supply that scarcity is not felt, abundance as a settled condition rather than a windfall
example: फ़सल अच्छी हुई तो अनाज की फ़रावानी हो गई। — A good harvest brought plenty of grain.

hindi: गुहार — तकलीफ़ में की गई पुकार
definition: a cry for redress raised by someone suffering a wrong, addressed to whoever can help; carries pain where a petition carries procedure
example: उसकी फ़रियाद कोई सुनने वाला नहीं था — There was nobody to hear his cry for redress.

hindi: पक्ष — झगड़े या मुक़दमे के दो तरफ़ों में से एक
definition: one of the two parties to a dispute or a case; names a side rather than any particular person standing on it
example: दोनों फ़रीक़ अदालत में हाज़िर थे — Both parties were present in court.

hindi: अनिवार्य कर्तव्य — मज़हब या ओहदे से बंधा हुआ फ़र्ज़
definition: an ordained duty laid down by faith or by office, an obligation assigned to you rather than chosen
example: हज हर साहिब-ए-इस्तिताअत पर फ़रीज़ा है। — The pilgrimage is an ordained duty on everyone able to afford it.

hindi: धोखा — झूठ से बनाया गया भ्रम
definition: a deception built to make someone believe something false, working on the mind, where treachery works on trust already given
example: यह सब एक ख़ूबसूरत फ़रेब था — All of it was a beautiful deception.

hindi: दृष्टि-भ्रम — आँख का धोखा, जो दिखा वह था नहीं
definition: a deception of vision in which something appears that is not really there; the senses misled, where delusion is the mind convinced
example: वो साया नहीं, फ़रेब-ए-नज़र था — That was no shadow but a trick of the eye.

hindi: छल-कपट का धंधा — लगातार धोखा देते रहना
definition: the systematic working of deception, fraud considered as a trade complete with technique and victims
example: यह कारोबार नहीं, सरासर फ़रेब-कारी है — This is not a business but sheer fraud.

hindi: बिक्री — माल किसी और को दाम लेकर देना
definition: the selling side of a transaction, the handing over of goods for money; used where Hindi says selling but with the formality of a deed or notice
example: मकान की फ़रोख़्त बिना वारिसों की रज़ामंदी के नहीं हो सकती। — The selling of the house cannot happen without the heirs' consent.

hindi: चमक — रौशनी का बढ़ना और फैलना
definition: the increase and spread of light, growing brightness that also means the flourishing of a name or a language
example: उर्दू के फ़रोग़ के लिए ये अंजुमन बनी थी। — This society was formed for the flourishing of Urdu.

hindi: कर्तव्य — जिसका करना हर हाल में ज़रूरी हो
definition: a duty binding on a person whether or not he ever agreed to it, obligation that comes before any promise
example: माँ-बाप की ख़िदमत हमारा फ़र्ज़ है। — Serving one's parents is our duty.

hindi: पुत्र — आदर से कहा गया बेटा या संतान
definition: a son or child spoken of with formality and pride, in letters, speeches and dedications; dignified where the ordinary word for offspring is merely factual
example: अपने फ़र्ज़ंद के नाम उन्होंने ये किताब मंसूब की — He dedicated this book in his son's name.

hindi: पुत्रवत — बेटे जैसा, अदब और फ़रमाँबरदारी के साथ
definition: behaving as a son should toward his elders, obedient and deferential; names the child's side of the family relation, where fatherly names the elder's side
example: उसने फ़र्ज़ंदाना अदब से सिर झुकाया — He bowed his head with a son's deference.

hindi: बुद्धिमानी — होशमंदी, जो दीवानगी के मुक़ाबिल हो
definition: the sanity and good sense that the tavern's poetry treats as a loss rather than a virtue; wisdom weighed against the freedom of madness
example: फ़र्ज़ानगी बेच कर दीवानगी ख़रीदी है। — I sold my sanity and bought madness.

hindi: समझदार — दीवाने का उल्टा, होश वाला
definition: sane and sensible, named chiefly as the opposite of the madman in the same breath; wisdom defined against madness rather than against ignorance
example: दीवाने की बात फ़र्ज़ाना कहाँ समझे। — How would a sane man grasp what a madman says?

hindi: अति वृद्ध — बुढ़ापे से जर्जर
definition: so far gone in years that body and mind have both given way, harsher than any respectful word for the aged
example: उन्हें फ़र्तूत कहना बदतमीज़ी है। — Calling him decrepit is bad manners.

hindi: ब्योरा-पत्र — एक काग़ज़ पर लिखा गया विवरण
definition: a single written sheet setting out particulars, a statement drawn up item by item for one purpose
example: ज़मीन की फ़र्द निकलवा लो। — Get the land statement issued.

hindi: जीर्णता — इस्तेमाल से घिस जाना
definition: the worn-out state of a thing or a mind after long use, decay by friction rather than by any single blow
example: इस इमारत की फ़र्सूदगी अब मरम्मत से आगे है — This building's decay is now past repair.

hindi: घिसा-पिटा — पुराना पड़ चुका
definition: of a thing, custom or argument so worn by long use that it no longer works; the adjective for what decay has finished
example: ये फ़र्सूदा दलील अब कोई नहीं मानता — Nobody accepts this worn-out argument any more.

hindi: आकाश — सिर के ऊपर फैला हुआ आसमान
definition: the heavens as the vault overhead, and in Urdu the vault treated as the agent that deals out fortune and misfortune
example: फ़लक ने कभी उसे चैन से बैठने नहीं दिया। — The heavens never let him sit in peace.

hindi: कल्याण — दोनों जहान की भलाई
definition: the flourishing that follows deliverance, well-being in this world and success in the next; deliverance removes the danger, this names the good that comes after
example: इसी में सबकी फ़लाह है — Everyone's welfare lies in this.

hindi: दंगा-झगड़ा — फूट का खुला रूप
definition: the open quarrel or riot into which discord finally breaks, the visible fighting rather than the mischief that sowed it
example: छोटी बात पर फ़साद हो गया — A riot broke out over a small thing.

hindi: भाषा-शुद्धि — साफ़, सही और सुनने में सुथरी ज़बान
definition: purity and clarity of language, where every word is correct and easy on the ear, judged at the level of diction rather than of persuasion
example: उनकी उर्दू की फ़साहत मशहूर थी — The purity of his Urdu was famous.

hindi: परकोटा — क़िले या शहर की बाहरी दीवार
definition: the rampart wall running around a fort or city, the outer defence that a siege must breach
example: फ़सील पर पहरेदार टहल रहे थे — Sentries paced the rampart.

hindi: विच्छेद — क़रार या निकाह का क़ानूनी तौर पर तोड़ा जाना
definition: the judicial annulment of a contract or marriage, unmaking it as though it had never bound anyone
example: अदालत ने निकाह का फ़स्ख़ मंज़ूर किया। — The court granted annulment of the marriage.

hindi: रक्तमोक्षण — रग खोलकर ख़राब ख़ून निकालना
definition: opening a vein to draw blood away as a cure, the standard remedy when humours were held to stand in excess
example: पुराने ज़माने में हर बुख़ार पर फ़स्द खोली जाती थी। — In older times a vein was opened for every fever.

hindi: ऋतु — साल का एक हिस्सा और उसकी उपज
definition: a season of the year marked off from the others, and the crop that season yields; a division of time rather than the weather in it
example: आम की फ़स्ल इस बरस देर से आई। — The mango season came late this year.

hindi: फूलों का मौसम — जिस दौर में गुल खिलते हैं
definition: the flowering season counted as a fixed stretch of the year, spring named by its crop of flowers rather than by its weather
example: फ़स्ल-ए-गुल गुज़र गई और वो न आया। — The season of flowers passed and he did not come.

hindi: बोध — किसी बात का असल मतलब पकड़ लेने की ताक़त
definition: the mind's power to comprehend what a thing actually means, deeper than speed and narrower than knowledge; you can be quick without it and learned without it
example: आयत का फ़हम लफ़्ज़ों से आगे की चीज़ है — Grasping the verse's meaning goes beyond its words.

hindi: भूखा दिन — पैसे न होने से खाना न मिलना
definition: going without food because there is no money, hunger as the sharp daily face of poverty rather than fasting by choice
example: दो दिन का फ़ाक़ा था, फिर भी माँगने नहीं गया — He had gone two days without food, yet he did not go begging.

hindi: भूखे रहना — दिनों तक खाना न मिलना
definition: going without food day after day as a way of life, the household experience of scarcity; hunger endured, not a region's famine
example: फ़ाक़ा-कशी के दिन उसने किसी को नहीं बताए — He told no one about the days of going hungry.

hindi: पंडुक — सादगी और बेफ़िक्री की प्रतीक चिड़िया
definition: the dove taken as an image of plain contentment among birds; in speech its calm face names someone unbothered by ruin around him
example: सब कुछ लुट गया और वो फ़ाख़्ता की तरह बैठा है — Everything is lost and he sits calm as a dove.

hindi: विद्यावान — इल्म और फ़ज़ीलत दोनों रखने वाला
definition: learned in a way that carries distinction and excellence, used as an honorific before a name; a scholar is measured by mastery, this word adds the standing that mastery earned
example: जनाब फ़ाज़िल साहब का ख़ुतबा सुनने लायक़ था — The learned gentleman's address was worth hearing.

hindi: दुआ-पाठ — मरने वाले की बख़्शिश के लिए पढ़ी जाने वाली दुआ
definition: the prayer recited for a dead person's forgiveness, said at the grave or at home; a religious act done for the dead, not sympathy shown to the living
example: क़ब्र पर खड़े होकर फ़ातिहा पढ़ी गई — The prayer was recited standing at the grave.

hindi: नाशवान — जिसका मिट जाना तय है
definition: perishable by nature, destined to end; applied to the world and to life itself to mark them as the opposite of what lasts
example: यह दुनिया फ़ानी है, यहाँ कुछ नहीं ठहरता — This world is perishable; nothing here stays.

hindi: झाड़-फ़ानूस — शीशे का लटकता हुआ रौशनदान
definition: a glass chandelier or lamp-shade hung in a hall, housing a flame for display where a candle stands bare
example: छत से पुराना फ़ानूस लटका हुआ था — An old chandelier hung from the ceiling.

hindi: घुड़सवार योद्धा — जंग में घोड़े पर लड़ने वाला
definition: the mounted warrior, a rider whose horsemanship is for battle rather than sport; it names the fighting cavalryman, not the trainer
example: मैदान में सिर्फ़ एक फ़ारिस डटा रहा — Only one mounted warrior held the field.

hindi: शकुन — किसी घटना से आने वाले वक़्त का अंदाज़ा
definition: an omen taken from a chance sign, or a divination drawn by opening a book at random; reads the future from an accident, not from calculation
example: उसने दीवान खोलकर फ़ाल निकाली — He opened the poetry collection and drew an omen.

hindi: शकुन-पोथी — जिसमें फ़ाल निकालने के अर्थ लिखे होते हैं
definition: the book consulted to read an omen, listing what each chance sign is taken to foretell; a manual of divination, not a diary of predictions
example: बुज़ुर्गों के पास एक पुराना फ़ाल-नामा रखा था — The elders kept an old book of omens.

hindi: दूरी — दो चीज़ों या दो लोगों के बीच का अंतर
definition: the distance separating two points or two people, applied to coolness between persons as readily as to miles
example: दोनों के बीच फ़ासला बढ़ गया — The distance between the two increased.

hindi: चुटीले जुमले कसना — महफ़िल में तीखी बात उछालना
definition: throwing sharp mocking remarks at someone in company; ridicule delivered as clever one-liners so it passes for wit
example: महफ़िल में उसकी फ़िक़रा-बाज़ी सबको चुभती है — His mocking one-liners sting everyone in the gathering.

hindi: चिंतन — किसी मसले पर लगातार चलने वाली सोच
definition: sustained thought about a matter, the intellectual work a mind puts in; in Hindi the word has narrowed to worry, but the Urdu register keeps it as thinking itself
example: उनकी फ़िक्र ने कई नौजवानों को बदला — His thought changed many young people.

hindi: फूट — लोगों में फ़साद और बैर डालने वाली चीज़
definition: mischief that sets people against one another, the discord sown between them rather than the fighting that follows
example: यह ख़बर फ़ितना फैलाने के लिए छोड़ी गई थी — This news was floated in order to sow discord.

hindi: फूट डालना — शांत लोगों में झगड़ा खड़ा करना
definition: stirring up trouble between people who were at peace; incitement aimed specifically at causing discord where there was none
example: अफ़वाह फैलाना भी फ़ितना-अंगेज़ी है — Spreading rumour is also stirring up discord.

hindi: ईद-दान — ईद की नमाज़ से पहले हर सदस्य की ओर से दिया दान
definition: the small fixed charity paid for each member of a household before the festival prayer that closes the month of fasting
example: ईद से पहले सबका फ़ितरा अदा कर दिया — The festival alms were paid for everyone before the holiday.

hindi: मुग्ध और क़ुर्बान — जो किसी पर मिट जाए
definition: so taken with someone that one would give oneself up for them, and in everyday speech simply crazy about something
example: वह उसकी सादगी पर फ़िदा है — He is smitten with her simplicity.

hindi: आत्मबलिदान — दूसरे के लिए अपना नुक़सान उठाना
definition: sacrificing one's own comfort, money or safety for another person; devotion paid in loss, and not necessarily in death
example: माँ की फ़िदा-कारी का हिसाब कोई नहीं रखता — Nobody keeps an account of a mother's sacrifices.

hindi: उच्चतम स्वर्ग — जन्नत का सबसे ऊँचा दर्जा
definition: the highest level of the promised garden, a ranked summit of paradise rather than paradise in general
example: कश्मीर को ज़मीन का फ़िरदौस कहा गया — Kashmir has been called the highest paradise on earth.

hindi: विरह — जुदाई की तड़प भरी अवधि
definition: a stretch of parting measured in time, carrying the restless ache that a neutral word like absence quietly discards
example: दो साल के फ़िराक़ के बाद वो शहर लौटा। — He returned to the city after two years apart.

hindi: पारखी नज़र — आदमी को देखते ही भाँप लेने की सूझ
definition: shrewd perception that reads people and situations at a glance and is usually right; inner sight studies a matter deeply, this judges instantly and moves on
example: उसकी फ़िरासत ने पहली मुलाक़ात में ही ताड़ लिया — His shrewdness sized the man up at the first meeting.

hindi: आसमानी नीला पत्थर — अंगूठी में शगुन के लिए पहना जाता है
definition: the opaque sky-blue stone, turquoise; worn in a ring for luck rather than kept as costly treasure
example: दादा हमेशा फ़िरोज़ा की अंगूठी पहनते थे। — Grandfather always wore a turquoise ring.

hindi: अभाव — किसी ज़रूरी चीज़ का बिल्कुल न होना
definition: the complete absence of something needed, naming the missing thing formally as a loss the situation suffers from
example: यहाँ भरोसे का फ़ुक़्दान है — There is a complete absence of trust here.

hindi: फ़रियाद — ज़ोर से किया गया विलाप
definition: a loud cry of lament raised for others to hear, the outward and public form of grief where a sigh stays private
example: उसकी फ़ुग़ाँ किसी ने न सुनी — No one heard his loud lament.

hindi: व्यर्थ व्यय — बेकार चीज़ों पर पैसा उड़ाना
definition: spending money on what serves no purpose at all, wasteful expenditure on trifles rather than on grand excess
example: फ़ुज़ूल-ख़र्ची छोड़ो तो महीना निकल जाएगा — Give up wasteful spending and the month will see you through.

hindi: जुदाई — महबूब से बिछड़े रहने की अवधि
definition: the long stretch of separation from a beloved, naming the period that has to be endured rather than the moment of parting
example: फ़ुरक़त के दिन गिनते-गिनते साल बीत गया — Counting the days of separation, a whole year went by.

hindi: अवकाश — काम से खाली मिला हुआ समय
definition: leisure carved out of obligation; free time you must be given or seize, never time you simply own
example: फ़ुर्सत मिले तो एक चक्कर लगा लेना। — Drop by if you get a free moment.

hindi: जादू-सा असर — जो होश खींच ले
definition: the spell-like effect a beautiful presence casts, attraction described as enchantment rather than as ordinary liking
example: उसकी आँखों का फ़ुसूँ अब तक याद है — The spell of her eyes is remembered even now.

hindi: सूची — क्रम से लिखी गई चीज़ों की सूची
definition: a list of items written out in order, an index telling a reader what a collection or a demand contains
example: उसने ज़रूरतों की लंबी फ़ेहरिस्त थमा दी। — He handed over a long list of needs.

hindi: आध्यात्मिक लाभ — किसी बुज़ुर्ग की सोहबत से मिलने वाला असर
definition: the unseen benefit that flows from a saint or teacher onto whoever stays near; a bounty received by nearness, not by effort or study
example: उनकी सोहबत का फ़ैज़ आज तक महसूस होता है — The blessing of his company is felt even today.

hindi: मृत्यु — क़ानूनी काग़ज़ों में मरने का सादा दर्ज
definition: death as a bare recorded fact, the word of registers, court papers and pension files; carries no comfort and makes no reverence, only states that the person is no longer alive
example: काग़ज़ में लिखा था कि मालिक फ़ौत हो चुका है — The papers stated the owner was deceased.

hindi: इस्पात — आग में कड़ा किया गया लोहा
definition: iron hardened by working and tempering until it holds an edge; the finished, strengthened metal, where plain iron is what the smith starts from
example: इस तलवार का फ़ौलाद आज भी नहीं मुड़ता। — The steel of this sword still does not bend.

hindi: दासभाव — ख़ुद को बंदा मानकर की गई इबादत
definition: worship coloured by servanthood, the devotion of someone who defines himself first as God's servant
example: बंदगी में सिर झुकाना सीखो — Learn to bow the head in servant's worship.

hindi: पाबंदी — आज़ादी पर लगी रोक
definition: a restriction placed on someone's movement or speech, captivity in a lighter form that still holds
example: उसके सफ़र पर बंदिश लगा दी गई — A restriction was placed on his travel.

hindi: इंतज़ाम — काम के लिए किया गया प्रबंध
definition: practical arrangements made so something can happen, the doing of provision rather than an ongoing order
example: मेहमानों के ठहरने का बंदोबस्त हो गया — The arrangement for the guests' stay is done.

hindi: दूरस्थ — बहुत दूर, और इसलिए असंभव-सा
definition: distant to the point of being unlikely, used when remoteness makes something hard to believe or expect
example: उसका लौटना अब बईद लगता है — His returning now seems remote.

hindi: अमरता — बाक़ी रह जाना, कभी न मिटना
definition: permanence, the state of remaining after everything perishable has gone; the exact counterweight to annihilation and the property claimed only for God
example: फ़ना के बाद बक़ा की बात होती है — After annihilation one speaks of permanence.

hindi: शेष — बाक़ी रह गई देय रक़म
definition: the arrears left owing after part of a debt has been cleared, the balance still due
example: पिछले साल का बक़ाया अब तक नहीं चुकाया। — Last year's arrears have still not been paid.

hindi: सिलाई की टाँकों की क़तार — कपड़े का जोड़
definition: the row of stitches joining a garment; the seam itself, which can be sewn firm or unpicked to expose what it held
example: उसने महफ़िल में मेरा बख़िया उधेड़ दिया। — In company he unpicked my seams and exposed me.

hindi: कंजूस — रखते हुए भी न देने वाला
definition: withholding money he can well afford to give, a miser judged by what he keeps rather than by what he lacks
example: बख़ील आदमी अपने ऊपर भी ख़र्च नहीं करता — A miser will not spend even on himself.

hindi: क़िस्मत — किसी के हिस्से में आया अच्छा या बुरा नसीब
definition: the share of good or bad fortune allotted to a person, spoken of as something that wakes or sleeps; the Persian register of luck
example: बख़्त जागा तो सब रास्ते खुल गए — When his fortune woke, every road opened.

hindi: माफ़ी या उदार भेंट — सज़ा देने वाले की ओर से छूट
definition: pardon handed down freely by one with the power to punish, and by extension any open-handed gift
example: उसने सज़ा नहीं, बख़्शिश दी — He gave not punishment but pardon.

hindi: गले लगने वाला — मिलते ही आलिंगन में
definition: embracing at the moment of meeting, describing a reunion by the arms that close around it rather than by anything said
example: बरसों बाद दोनों दोस्त बग़लगीर हुए — After years the two friends fell into an embrace.

hindi: विद्रोह — क़ायम हुकूमत के ख़िलाफ़ खुला उठ खड़ा होना
definition: an open rising against established authority that aims to throw it off rather than to reform it from within
example: सिपाहियों की बग़ावत तीन दिन में फैल गई — The soldiers' revolt spread within three days.

hindi: कपड़े का व्यापारी — थान बेचने वाला
definition: the cloth merchant who sells woven fabric by length rather than finished garments
example: बज़्ज़ाज़ ने थान खोलकर दिखाया। — The cloth merchant unrolled the bolt to show it.

hindi: मजलिस — शेर-ओ-सुख़न और मय की सजी हुई सभा
definition: the assembly gathered for wine, music, and verse, placed opposite the battlefield in classical usage; a company convened for pleasure
example: बज़्म सजी और साक़ी ने दौर शुरू किया। — The gathering was set and the cupbearer began the round.

hindi: बुरा / ख़राब — किसी चीज़ को दूषित बताने वाला उपसर्ग
definition: prefix that spoils a noun rather than deleting it, marking the thing as gone wrong; बदनाम means disgraced, not nameless, so it carries moral judgement where बे- only reports a vacancy
example: एक ग़लत ख़बर छपी और पूरा ख़ानदान बदनाम हो गया। — One false story was printed and the entire family was disgraced.

hindi: अशांति — इलाक़े का अमन टूट जाना
definition: the disorder that follows incitement, with peace broken across a whole place rather than between two named people
example: अफ़वाहों से शहर में बद-अमनी फैल गई — Rumours spread disorder through the city.

hindi: वचन-भंग — अहद का लिहाज़ ही न करना
definition: faithlessness towards a promise given, breaking one's word as a settled habit of bad faith
example: बद-अहदी ने उसका सारा कारोबार डुबो दिया। — Faithlessness to his word sank his whole business.

hindi: भ्रष्टाचार — ओहदे को पैसे के लिए इस्तेमाल करना
definition: corruption in office, exploiting a position systematically for money rather than one isolated bribe taken
example: महकमे में बद-उनवानी जड़ तक फैली है — Corruption in the department runs to the root.

hindi: मुँहफटपन — मुँह से बुरी बात निकालने की आदत
definition: the habit of foul or wounding speech, a standing failing of the tongue rather than one angry outburst
example: बद-ज़बानी से बड़े रिश्ते टूट जाते हैं। — Foul speech breaks even large relationships.

hindi: बेईमानी — लेन-देन में ईमान का न होना
definition: dishonesty in dealings, the settled unreliability of a person in money and duty rather than a single broken promise
example: बद-दियानती से कमाया माल टिकता नहीं — Wealth earned by dishonesty does not last.

hindi: मन का उचाट होना — शिकायतें ख़त्म होने के बाद बचा ठंडापन
definition: the settled ill-feeling left after a person stops making complaints at all; a heart gone reluctant towards someone it once favoured
example: अब शिकायत भी नहीं, बस बद-दिली है — There is not even complaint now, only a heart gone cold.

hindi: दुर्भाग्य — क़िस्मत का साथ न देना
definition: misfortune understood as fate turning against a particular person, so that effort keeps failing to pay
example: मेहनत में कमी नहीं थी, बद-नसीबी थी — There was no lack of effort; it was misfortune.

hindi: अपशकुन मानना — हर बात में बुरा शगुन ढूँढ़ने की आदत
