definition: the habit of reading a bad omen into ordinary signs and expecting the worst from them; superstitious foreboding, not reasoned caution
example: बिल्ली रास्ता काट गई तो उसने बद-फ़ाली शुरू कर दी — A cat crossed the road and he began seeing bad omens.

hindi: अपच — खाना न पचने की तकलीफ़
definition: the discomfort of food that will not digest, an upset of the belly caused by eating rather than by any illness
example: दावत के बाद उसे बद-हज़्मी हो गई। — After the feast he had indigestion.

hindi: होश उड़ जाना — डर में सुध-बुध खोना
definition: the loss of one's senses under fright, so that speech and action stop making sense; panic visible from outside
example: बद-हवासी में वो अपना ही पता भूल गया — In his panic he forgot his own address.

hindi: भ्रष्टाचार — पूरे निज़ाम में फैली बेईमानी
definition: corruption as a condition of a whole system rather than a single bribe, where office is routinely traded for private gain
example: महकमा बदउनवानी में डूबा हुआ है — The department is sunk in corruption.

hindi: बदतमीज़ी से बोलना — बिना गाली दिए भी चुभती बात
definition: speaking to someone in an offensive, ill-mannered way without necessarily using foul abuse; rudeness of address rather than obscenity
example: गाली नहीं दी, मगर बदकलामी तो की — He gave no abuse, but he did speak offensively.

hindi: अहितचिंतक — जो चुपचाप बुरा चाहे
definition: one who wishes you harm without ever fighting you openly, an enemy in intention while passing as a well-wisher
example: बदख़्वाह दोस्त के भेस में आता है — An ill-wisher comes in the guise of a friend.

hindi: बुरा गुमान — बिना वजह किसी को बुरा समझना
definition: the habit of assuming the worst about people, suspicion settled as an attitude rather than doubt raised by any evidence
example: बदगुमानी ने पुराना रिश्ता ख़त्म कर दिया — Suspicion ended an old relationship.

hindi: बुराई करना — किसी की छवि दूसरों के सामने ख़राब करना
definition: speaking ill of a person to others, true or false, until their reputation is soiled in the mouths of everyone who listens
example: उसने दफ़्तर भर में मेरी बदगोई की — He spoke ill of me across the whole office.

hindi: मुँहफटपन — गाली-गलौज की आदत
definition: the habit of using abusive, foul language against people; names the speaker's tongue as the fault rather than any single outburst
example: उसकी बदज़बानी की वजह से कोई उससे बात नहीं करता — Nobody speaks to him because of his foul tongue.

hindi: अशिष्ट — बात करने के ढंग में शिष्टता से कोरा
definition: ill-mannered in everyday dealings, missing the basic training in how one speaks to people
example: इतना बदतमीज़ लड़का किस स्कूल से आया है? — Which school did such a rude boy come from?

hindi: बुरी नीयत वाला — जिसका इरादा ही ख़राब हो
definition: having a corrupt intention behind an apparently fair action, describing the person whose motive the suspicion concerns
example: बदनीयत साझेदार से बचकर रहना — Keep clear of an ill-intentioned partner.

hindi: भद्दा — देखने में बुरा लगने वाला
definition: ugly in the sense of spoiling the look of something, said of a stain, a scar or a badly placed object
example: दीवार पर एक बदनुमा दाग़ था — There was an ugly stain on the wall.

hindi: कुपथ्य — मना की हुई चीज़ें खा लेना
definition: breaking the restraint a physician imposed, eating exactly what the illness forbids; the named cause of most relapses
example: एक दिन की बदपरहेज़ी ने महीने का इलाज बिगाड़ दिया। — One day of indiscipline undid a month of treatment.

hindi: दुर्भाग्य — लगातार बुरी क़िस्मत का साथ रहना
definition: a settled stretch of misfortune that dogs a person through unrelated events; ongoing wretched luck, not a single unfortunate accident
example: ये मेरी बदबख़्ती है कि हर बार यही होता है — It is my ill fortune that this happens every time.

hindi: बेस्वाद — जिसका ज़ाइक़ा बिगड़ा हो
definition: of food whose taste has gone wrong and gives no pleasure, spoiled in flavour rather than merely bland or unseasoned
example: नमक ज़्यादा होने से सालन बदमज़ा हो गया। — Too much salt made the curry taste bad.

hindi: उद्दंडता — नशे में की गई बदतमीज़ी
definition: drunkenness that turns into rowdiness and insult, the state judged by the harm it causes others; drink gone wrong rather than drink enjoyed
example: बदमस्ती करने पर उसे महफ़िल से निकाल दिया। — He was thrown out of the gathering for drunken rowdiness.

hindi: घबराहट — होश और तरतीब का जाता रहना
definition: the loss of composure in which the mind stops ordering itself, panic that shows in speech and movement; acute where other disorders are settled
example: ख़बर सुनते ही बदहवासी तारी हो गई। — On hearing the news, a wild distraction took hold.

hindi: निजी कापी — अपने हाथ से शेर और काम की बातें उतारने की कापी
definition: a personal notebook in which verses and useful matter are copied out by hand; a private anthology, never meant for a reader
example: उसकी बयाज़ में सैकड़ों शेर लिखे थे। — Hundreds of couplets were written in his notebook.

hindi: पेशगी रक़म — सौदा पक्का करने के लिए दी गई थोड़ी रक़म
definition: the token sum handed over to bind a bargain and take the goods off the market; secures the deal, where an advance merely starts the payment
example: ज़मीन का बयाना देकर वो लौट आया। — He paid the earnest money on the land and came back.

hindi: बीहड़ — निर्जन और डरावना विस्तार
definition: a trackless wilderness far from any settlement, wild and unwelcoming rather than merely uninhabited
example: रास्ता भटककर हम बयाबान में जा निकले — Losing the road, we came out into the wilderness.

hindi: दोषमुक्ति — इल्ज़ाम से पाक होने की हालत
definition: the clearing itself, the established freedom from a charge that an acquittal confers; the noun for the state बरी describes as an adjective
example: उसकी बरअत की ख़बर देर से पहुँची — News of his exoneration arrived late.

hindi: बढ़ोतरी — थोड़े में भी छिपी ईश्वरीय वृद्धि
definition: the divine increase hidden inside a small thing so that it goes further than it should, blessing measured as sufficiency
example: कमाई कम है मगर उसमें बरकत है — The earnings are small, but there is blessing in them.

hindi: खुला हुआ — बदन, सिर या तलवार जो ग़िलाफ़ से बाहर हो
definition: stripped of its covering; used of a body, of a head without its turban, and of a sword out of its sheath
example: उसके हाथ में बरहना तलवार थी। — In his hand was an unsheathed sword.

hindi: नंगे पाँव — बिना जूते के चलने वाला
definition: barefoot, walking with no covering on the feet; a mark of grief, penance, or destitution
example: वो बरहना-पा दरगाह तक गया। — He walked barefoot all the way to the shrine.

hindi: ख़फ़ा — बिगड़ा हुआ और खुलकर नाराज़
definition: displeased and letting it show, with the calm of the face visibly disturbed; annoyance that has come up to the surface
example: साहब इस ख़बर पर बहुत बरहम हुए — The sahib was much annoyed at this news.

hindi: भ्राता — भाई, औपचारिक और अदबी शब्द
definition: a brother in formal or literary speech, and by extension a man of one's own community; the dignified counterpart to the sister term in the same register
example: बरादर-ए-कलाँ होने के नाते सारा बोझ उस पर आया — Being the elder brother, the whole burden fell on him.

hindi: भाईचारे का — भाइयों जैसा, अपनापन लिए हुए
definition: conducted in the spirit of brothers, warm and equal rather than official; describes conduct between men, where the noun names the brother himself
example: दोनों मुल्कों के बरादराना ताल्लुक़ात रहे — The two countries kept brotherly relations.

hindi: दोषमुक्त — इल्ज़ाम से छूटा हुआ
definition: cleared of a charge by a formal decision, which says the offence was not proved rather than that the person never sinned; acquittal is a legal outcome, innocence is a fact
example: अदालत ने उसे बरी कर दिया — The court acquitted him.

hindi: बिजली — बादल में कौंधने वाली चमक
definition: the flash of lightning in a storm cloud, the sudden light itself as distinct from the sound that follows it
example: बर्क़ चमकी और पूरा मैदान एक पल के लिए रौशन हो गया। — Lightning flashed and the whole field lit up for an instant.

hindi: पत्ता — पेड़ का एक पत्ता
definition: a single leaf on a branch, the smallest countable part of a tree's green covering
example: हवा से एक बर्ग गिर पड़ा। — A single leaf fell in the wind.

hindi: पत्ते और फल — पेड़ की पूरी हरियाली और पैदावार
definition: the leaf and fruit of a tree taken together as the whole of what it produces and shows
example: इस दरख़्त का बर्ग-ओ-बार देखने लायक़ है। — The leaf and fruit of this tree are worth seeing.

hindi: पत्ते झड़ना — पेड़ों से पत्तों का गिरना
definition: the shedding of leaves from the trees, the process autumn performs rather than the season or the withered thing
example: बर्ग-रेज़ी शुरू हो चुकी थी। — The shedding of leaves had already begun.

hindi: मध्यलोक — मौत और क़यामत के बीच की ठहरी हुई हालत
definition: the interval between death and resurrection in which the dead wait, neither in this world nor yet judged; a waiting state, not a destination
example: उन्हें बर्ज़ख़ का ज़िक्र करते हुए सुना — I heard him speak of the state between death and judgement.

hindi: कफ़ — ठंडा और तर समझा जाने वाला रस
definition: phlegm among the humours, held cold and moist, blamed for sluggishness and coughs; the humour opposite in nature to bile
example: बलग़म ग़ालिब हो तो सुस्ती छाई रहती है। — When phlegm dominates, lethargy settles in.

hindi: दंगा — भीड़ की हिंसा से इलाक़े का अमन टूटना
definition: a violent riot by a crowd, with order broken across a locality; violence without organisation or a stated aim
example: अफ़वाह पर बलवा फूट पड़ा — A riot broke out over a rumour.

hindi: आपदा — जो टले नहीं, चिपक जाए
definition: an affliction that attaches itself to a life and keeps returning; unlike a sudden trouble, this one refuses to leave
example: ये मुक़दमा हमारे गले पड़ी बला है — This case is an affliction hung around our necks.

hindi: वाग्मिता — बात को असरदार और मौक़े के मुताबिक़ कहने की क़ुव्वत
definition: eloquence that fits the words exactly to the occasion and moves the listener, built on top of clean diction but judged by effect rather than correctness
example: फ़साहत ज़बान की है, बलाग़त असर की — Purity belongs to the language, eloquence to the effect.

hindi: वयस्कता — बालिग़ होने की अवस्था
definition: the reaching of the age at which a person becomes answerable in law and religion, a threshold rather than a slow ripening
example: बलूग़त के बाद ये फ़र्ज़ उस पर आ जाता है। — After reaching legal age this duty falls on him.

hindi: शुभ सूचना — किसी अच्छे आने वाले वाक़ये का पहले से मिला इशारा
definition: good news of something still to come, often received in a dream or as a sign; announces coming relief, unlike praise for what already happened
example: उस ख़्वाब को उसने बेटे की बशारत समझा — He took that dream as glad tidings of a son.

hindi: प्रफुल्लता — चेहरे पर खिली हुई ख़ुशी
definition: the visible cheerfulness that makes a face look like something in bloom, an inner brightness rather than colour
example: उसके चेहरे पर अजीब बशाशत थी। — There was a strange cheerfulness on his face.

hindi: अंतर्दृष्टि — ऊपरी बात के पीछे देख लेने वाली नज़र
definition: inner sight that perceives what is behind the surface of a matter; sharp perception reads the visible, this reads what the visible is hiding
example: इस मसले में बसीरत चाहिए, जल्दबाज़ी नहीं — This matter needs insight, not haste.

hindi: छंद — शेर का तयशुदा लयात्मक साँचा
definition: the fixed metrical pattern a whole poem is built on, chosen before the first line and never varied; rhyme governs the ends of lines, this governs every syllable
example: यह शेर बहर से बाहर है — This couplet falls outside the metre.

hindi: वाद-विवाद — दलीलों से चलने वाली चर्चा
definition: a dispute conducted through reasons and evidence; argues a position, however loudly, instead of merely repeating one
example: चाय की दुकान पर सियासी बहस कभी ख़त्म नहीं होती। — Political argument at the tea stall never ends.

hindi: बहार की सरज़मीन — हमेशा खिली रहने वाली जगह
definition: a region held to be in perpetual spring; names a whole country or valley as green, not one meadow or garden
example: कश्मीर को लोग बहारिस्तान कहते हैं। — People call Kashmir a land of eternal spring.

hindi: पुनर्स्थापन — खोई हुई ताक़त या हैसियत का लौटना
definition: the restoring of strength or function that illness took away, putting a body or a post back as it was; process, not the health itself
example: हादसे के बाद उसकी बहाली में छह महीने लगे। — His restoration after the accident took six months.

hindi: पशुवत जड़ता — बिना सोचे-समझे जानवर जैसा बर्ताव
definition: brute dullness, the animal in a man as stupidity rather than cruelty; the beast that grazes, not the beast that tears
example: ये ज़ुल्म नहीं, महज़ बहीमियत है — This is not tyranny, only brute stupidity.

hindi: उसूल वाला — जो अपने उसूलों पर क़ायम रहे
definition: describing a person bound by his own principles, keeping a commitment because rules govern him rather than profit
example: बा-असूल आदमी हैं, रिश्वत की बात मत कीजिए। — He is a principled man; do not speak of a bribe.

hindi: ढका हुआ — ग़ैरों की नज़र से बचाकर रखा गया
definition: kept covered from the sight of outsiders; said of a woman, a room, or an arrangement made private
example: मेहमानों के लिए बा-पर्दा इंतज़ाम किया गया। — A covered arrangement was made for the guests.

hindi: अवशेष — पीछे बचा हुआ हिस्सा
definition: what remains of a person, a house, or an age after the rest has gone, remembered as leftovers rather than keepsakes
example: पुरानी हवेली की बाक़ियात अब भी खड़ी हैं। — The remains of the old mansion still stand.

hindi: बाग़ का रखवाला — फूलों की देखभाल करने वाला
definition: the one who keeps a garden alive by tending and guarding it, a caretaker rather than a man who farms for a crop
example: बाग़बाँ ने हर पौदे को अपने हाथ से सींचा। — The gardener watered every plant with his own hand.

hindi: विद्रोही — जो खुलकर हुक्म मानने से इनकार कर दे
definition: one who defies authority openly, refusing rather than betraying; where the traitor hides, this one declares himself
example: वह बचपन से बाग़ी तबीयत का था — He had a rebel temperament from childhood.

hindi: फिर से / वापस — लौटने का भाव जोड़ने वाला उपसर्ग
definition: prefix meaning 'back' or 'again', turning a noun into a returning; गश्त becomes बाज़गश्त and याफ़्त becomes बाज़याफ़्त
example: गश्त के आगे बाज़- लगाकर बाज़-गश्त बनता है — Prefixing बाज़- to गश्त gives the word for an echo returning.

hindi: वापसी — लौटकर आना, और लौटती हुई गूँज
definition: the act of coming back to where one started, and by extension the echo that travels back to its own source
example: उन आवाज़ों की बाज़गश्त आज भी सुनाई देती है — The echo of those voices still comes back to me.

hindi: पूछताछ — जो किया उसका हिसाब माँगती सवाल-जवाब
definition: the questioning that precedes a rebuke, demanding an account of what was done; interrogation by someone entitled to ask for it
example: उससे बाज़पुर्स हुई तो सारी कहानी खुल गई — When he was questioned, the whole story came out.

hindi: बाज़ू पर बाँधा गहना — कोहनी से ऊपर
definition: an ornament bound round the upper arm above the elbow, often holding an amulet inside it
example: बाज़ूबंद में ताबीज़ सिला हुआ था। — An amulet was stitched inside the armlet.

hindi: बहार की हवा — वसंत के मौसम की हवा
definition: the wind belonging to the flowering season, a breeze named by its time of year rather than by its softness
example: बाद-ए-बहारी ने कलियाँ खोल दीं। — The spring wind opened the buds.

hindi: विपरीत हवा — सामने से आती हुई रोकने वाली हवा
definition: a headwind blowing against the direction of travel, the wind that slows a boat or a plan rather than carrying it
example: बाद-ए-मुख़ालिफ़ में कश्ती आगे नहीं बढ़ रही थी। — The boat made no headway against the contrary wind.

hindi: हवा जैसे पाँव वाला — बेहद तेज़ दौड़ने वाला
definition: wind-footed, said of a horse whose speed is its whole worth; it praises the running rather than the animal's temper or colour
example: उसका बादपा घोड़ा किसी से पकड़ा न जाता था — His wind-footed horse was caught by none.

hindi: पाल — नाव पर तना कपड़ा जो हवा पकड़े
definition: the sail spread on a boat to catch the wind, the cloth that turns moving air into movement over water
example: मल्लाह ने बादबान खोल दिया। — The boatman unfurled the sail.

hindi: मदिरा — शायरी की शराब, पीने की चीज़ नहीं एक प्रतीक
definition: wine as poetry names it, the drink itself rather than the drinking of it; carries surrender and defiance where the ordinary word carries only alcohol
example: बादा पीने वाले को हिसाब की आदत नहीं होती। — One who drinks wine keeps no habit of accounting.

hindi: पियक्कड़ी — जमकर शराब पीना
definition: heavy wine-drinking carried past measure, the word used when the drinking has become the whole evening; excess where the neighbouring words stay neutral
example: रात भर की बादा-ख़्वारी ने सुबह बिगाड़ दी। — A night of heavy drinking ruined the morning.

hindi: मदिरापान — शराब पीने का चलन
definition: wine-drinking treated as a practice with its own manners and company; names the custom, where the plain word names one night's drinking
example: उनकी बादा-नोशी शायरी के साथ ही शुरू हुई थी। — His wine-drinking began along with his poetry.

hindi: अध्याय — किताब का एक नामवाला हिस्सा
definition: a chapter, one titled division of a written work, marking where its argument turns to a new matter
example: तीसरे बाब में सारा क़िस्सा खुलता है। — The whole story opens up in the third chapter.

hindi: छत — मकान का सबसे ऊपरी खुला हिस्सा
definition: the flat roof of a house used as living space, the upper level where the household goes to breathe rather than to shelter
example: गर्मियों में हम बाम पर सोया करते थे — In summer we used to sleep on the roof.

hindi: फलदार — जिस पर फल आया हो, जो नतीजा दे
definition: bearing fruit, of a tree heavy with produce and of an effort that has finally yielded a result
example: उसकी कोशिश आख़िरकार बार-आवर हुई। — His effort finally bore fruit.

hindi: ढुलाई — माल एक जगह से दूसरी जगह पहुँचाने का काम
definition: the carriage of goods from place to place, and the charge for it; names the whole business of haulage, not the man who lifts the load
example: बारबरदारी का ख़र्च दाम में जोड़ लिया गया। — The cost of haulage has been added to the price.

hindi: वर्षा — आसमान से गिरता पानी, बरसात
definition: rain as falling water named in the Persian register, the event itself rather than the season or the wet ground it leaves
example: रात भर बाराँ होती रही और सड़कें भर गईं। — Rain fell all night and the streets filled up.

hindi: सूक्ष्म-दृष्टि — छोटी-छोटी तफ़सील पकड़ने वाली निगाह
definition: the fine-grained perception that notices the small detail everyone else passes over; insight goes deep into one matter, this goes minutely across the whole surface
example: उसने बारीक-बीनी से हिसाब जाँचा — He examined the accounts with minute attention.

hindi: पंख — उड़ने का साधन, और मजाज़न ताक़त
definition: the wings and feathers together, the equipment of flight; taken from someone it means the means of rising were removed, not the wish
example: हौसला था मगर बाल-ओ-पर न थे — The courage was there but not the wings.

hindi: मलाई — दूध के ऊपर जमने वाली परत
definition: the cream that settles on the top of milk and is lifted off, named for lying above rather than for being rich
example: नाश्ते में बालाई और शहद रखा था। — Cream and honey were set out for breakfast.

hindi: वयस्क — जो क़ानूनन बड़ा हो चुका हो
definition: having crossed the legal age of adulthood, said of the status a court recognises and not of maturity of mind
example: बालिग़ होते ही उसने अपना फ़ैसला ख़ुद किया। — The moment he reached legal age he decided for himself.

hindi: रसोईघर — घर का वो हिस्सा जहाँ रसोइया काम करता है
definition: a household kitchen thought of as the cook's working quarters, with its staff and smells, not merely a room for cooking food
example: बावर्चीख़ाना सुबह से गोश्त की ख़ुशबू से भरा था। — The kitchen quarters were full of the smell of meat since morning.

hindi: निवासी — उस जगह का पक्का रहने वाला
definition: an inhabitant who belongs to a place by long living there, unlike someone merely staying for now
example: वह इसी शहर का पुराना बाशिंदा है — He is an old inhabitant of this very city.

hindi: बिरादराना समूह — एक ही तबक़े के लोग
definition: the kin-community whose approval a household lives under, wider than a family and narrower than a neighbourhood
example: बिरादरी क्या कहेगी, यही सोचकर वह चुप रहे — Fearing what the community would say, they kept quiet.

hindi: बेशर्त — बिना किसी शर्त लगाए
definition: given with no condition attached, so the promise stands whatever the other side later does
example: उसने बिला-शर्त माफ़ी दे दी। — He granted forgiveness with no condition attached.

hindi: बिछौना — जिस पर महफ़िल जमे, और आदमी की हैसियत भी
definition: the spread laid out for a gathering, and by extension the means a person has to offer; names the setting and the capacity behind it
example: मेरी बिसात इतनी ही है, माफ़ कीजिए। — This is all my means allows; please forgive it.

hindi: देखने वाला — जिसकी आँख काम करती हो
definition: possessing working sight, able to see; the plain opposite of blind, and by extension able to perceive what other people walk past
example: आँख का बीना होना और नज़र का होना अलग बात है — Having a seeing eye and having vision are two things.

hindi: दृष्टि-शक्ति — आँख की देखने की ताक़त
definition: the eye's power of sight considered as a faculty that can weaken, fade or fail; the capacity itself rather than any single act of looking
example: उम्र के साथ उनकी बीनाई कमज़ोर हो गई — His eyesight weakened with age.

hindi: कृपणता — देने के वक़्त हाथ का बंद हो जाना
definition: miserliness as a flaw of character, the inability to part with money even where giving is plainly owed
example: बुख़्ल ने उसे रिश्तेदारों में अकेला कर दिया — Miserliness left him alone among his relatives.

hindi: द्वेष — दिल में छिपाई हुई नफ़रत
definition: concealed malice towards someone, carried behind an ordinary and friendly face; hatred that takes care never to announce itself
example: मुस्कुराते हुए भी दिल में बुग़्ज़ था — Even while smiling there was malice in his heart.

hindi: कायर — डरपोक, मौक़े पर पीछे हट जाने वाला
definition: cowardly, said of a person who backs off from a risk that duty demanded; the standing insult opposite to brave, aimed at character and not at one lapse
example: बुज़दिल आदमी दोस्त के लिए भी नहीं बोलता — A coward will not even speak up for a friend.

hindi: कायरता — डर के मारे पीछे हट जाना
definition: cowardice as the act itself, a failure of nerve on one occasion rather than the coward's fixed character
example: मैदान छोड़ना बुज़दिली थी — Leaving the field was cowardice.

hindi: आदरणीय बड़े — बड़ों के लिए सम्मानसूचक संबोधन
definition: an elder addressed with honour, the form used to a senior's face where plainly naming their age would be rude
example: बुज़ुर्गवार, आपकी राय सबसे पहले चाहिए। — Respected elder, your opinion is needed first.

hindi: बड़प्पन — उम्र से आया हुआ रुतबा
definition: the standing that age confers on an elder, the seniority itself and not the conduct that may or may not match it
example: उनकी बुज़ुर्गी का लिहाज़ सबने किया। — Everyone showed regard for his seniority.

hindi: नींव — जिस पर पूरी इमारत टिकी हो
definition: the foundation a structure rests on, the buried part that decides whether the construction above it survives
example: बुनियाद कमज़ोर हो तो मंज़िलें बेकार हैं — If the foundation is weak the floors above are useless.

hindi: मीनार — क़िले की दीवार पर बना ऊँचा गोल ठिकाना
definition: the tower or bastion rising from a fort wall, the raised point from which defenders watch and shoot
example: बुर्ज से पूरा मैदान दिखाई देता था — The whole field was visible from the bastion.

hindi: सहनशीलता — छेड़छाड़ पर भी जवाब न देना
definition: the capacity to absorb provocation without answering it; the patience that keeps a quarrel from ever starting in the first place
example: उसकी बुर्दबारी ने झगड़ा टाल दिया — His forbearance headed off the quarrel.

hindi: गान-पक्षी — बाग़ में गाने वाली चिड़िया
definition: the singing bird of the garden, cast in verse as the flower's lover and the standard voice of longing
example: बुलबुल गुल के लिए रातभर गाती रही। — The nightingale sang all night for the flower.

hindi: फूल की ख़ुशबू — गुल से उठने वाली महक
definition: the scent that rises specifically from a flower, the fragrance poets pair with the morning breeze
example: बू-ए-गुल हवा के साथ आई। — The scent of flowers came with the breeze.

hindi: बिना / रहित — किसी गुण की गैरमौजूदगी जोड़ने वाला उपसर्ग
definition: negating prefix meaning 'without', attached to a noun to name the absence itself; where English needs a separate adjective, this bolts onto the quality and hollows it out — क़रार becomes बेक़रार, शरम becomes बेशरम
example: क़रार से बेक़रार, सब्र से बेसब्र — 'बे' लगाते ही चीज़ ग़ायब हो जाती है। — From calm to restless, patience to impatience: add be- and the thing itself vanishes.

hindi: बेइज़्ज़ती — समाज में इज़्ज़त गिर जाना
definition: the loss of honour a person suffers in the eyes of their community, whether or not anyone insulted them; the result, not the act
example: बे-आबरूई के डर से उसने मामला दबा दिया — For fear of lost honour he buried the matter.

hindi: निराश्रित — जिसे कोई सहारा न मिले
definition: without any prop to lean on in need, describing a person left without the support a family would give
example: बुढ़ापे में वो बिल्कुल बे-आसरा रह गए। — In old age he was left entirely without support.

hindi: अविश्वास — भरोसा उठ जाने की हालत
definition: the state in which trust has gone, the consequence left in the wronged person rather than the deed that destroyed it
example: एक झूठ ने बरसों की बे-एतबारी दे दी — One lie gave years of distrust.

hindi: असंतुलन — तवाज़ुन का बिगड़ जाना
definition: the loss of balance itself, the condition in which excess or shortfall has taken hold; names the disorder rather than either side of it
example: उसकी ज़िंदगी में बे-एतिदाली साफ़ नज़र आती है। — The lack of balance in his life is plainly visible.

hindi: बेपरवाही — किसी को अहमियत ही न देना
definition: the refusal to treat someone or something as worth minding; a coldness expressed by giving no attention whatsoever rather than by any harsh act
example: उसकी बे-एतिनाई सबसे ज़्यादा चुभी — Her indifference stung the most.

hindi: अनिद्रा — नींद न आने का रोग
definition: the inability to sleep treated as an ailment, nights spent awake against one's will; a complaint brought to a physician
example: बे-ख़्वाबी ने चेहरा उतार दिया है। — Sleeplessness has drained his face.

hindi: मन न लगना — बिना जी लगाए काम करना
definition: the flat unwillingness of a heart that has stopped investing in anything; despair thinned into indifference, without its sharpness
example: वो बे-दिली से काम निपटाता रहा — He kept finishing the work half-heartedly.

hindi: बेपर्दा — जिसका असली चेहरा सामने आ गया हो
definition: unmasked, said of a person whose pretence has been stripped off; the state left behind after exposure
example: आख़िर वह बे-नक़ाब हो ही गया — In the end he was unmasked.

hindi: बेपरवाही — दूसरे जो दे सकते हैं उससे बेपरवाह
definition: indifference to whatever others could give, freedom from need shown as unconcern rather than as wounded pride
example: अमीरों की महफ़िल से वो बे-नियाज़ी से उठ गया — He rose from the rich men's gathering with complete unconcern.

hindi: बिना ढके — खुला हुआ, चाहे राज़ हो या चेहरा
definition: with the covering taken off; said of a woman appearing uncovered, and of a secret laid open to view
example: उसकी चाल आख़िर बे-पर्दा हो गई। — His scheme was at last laid open.

hindi: पत्ता-रहित — जिस पर एक भी पत्ता न बचा हो
definition: stripped of every leaf, describing a branch or tree left bare rather than the fallen leaf itself
example: सर्दियों में वो पेड़ बिल्कुल बे-बर्ग हो जाता है। — In winter that tree goes completely bare.

hindi: निर्दयता — दया का बिलकुल न होना
definition: cruelty as the plain absence of mercy, shown by someone who could have relented and did not
example: बे-रहमी से पिटाई की ख़बर ने सबको हिला दिया — News of the merciless beating shook everyone.

hindi: बेसहारा — जिसका कोई सँभालने वाला न बचा हो
definition: having lost the person who used to provide support, said after a protector dies rather than of one never had
example: शौहर के बाद वो बे-सहारा हो गईं। — After her husband she was left with no support.

hindi: बेफ़ायदा — जिसका कोई लाभ न हो
definition: of an act that brings no benefit or profit to anyone, weighed by gain rather than by outcome
example: इस मरहले पर माफ़ी माँगना बे-सूद है — Apologising at this stage is of no use.

hindi: निःसंतान — जिसकी कोई संतान न हो
definition: having no children, a marriage that has produced no offspring to carry the family on; describes issue, where being unmarried describes having no spouse
example: बेऔलाद होने का दुख उन्हें आख़िर तक रहा — The sorrow of childlessness stayed with them to the end.

hindi: बेकरारी — चैन न पड़ने की हालत
definition: the inability to settle anywhere, restlessness shown in the body and the pacing rather than in the mind's madness
example: ख़बर सुनते ही उसकी बेकली बढ़ गई — On hearing the news his restlessness grew.

hindi: बेसहारापन — कोई अपना पास न होना
definition: helplessness that comes from having nobody at all to turn to, where the lack is of people rather than of power
example: परदेस में बीमार पड़ना और बेकसी में रातें काटना, दोनों साथ थे — Falling ill in a foreign land and passing nights with no one of one's own came together.

hindi: बेदोष — जिसकी कोई ग़लती न हो
definition: free of fault in a particular matter, blameless for what went wrong; used of everyday blame where बेगुनाह answers a criminal charge
example: इस झगड़े में बच्चा बिलकुल बेक़ुसूर है — In this quarrel the child is entirely blameless.

hindi: जड़ — पौदे का ज़मीन के अंदर का हिस्सा
definition: the root holding a plant in the ground, the anchor of growth as against the seed that started it
example: दरख़्त की बेख़ बहुत गहरी है। — The root of the tree runs very deep.

hindi: जड़ उखाड़ना — किसी चीज़ को जड़ से मिटाना
definition: the tearing out of a thing by its root so nothing can grow back, destruction aimed at the source not the branch
example: बुराई की बेख़-कनी ज़रूरी है। — Uprooting the evil at its source is necessary.

hindi: आत्म-विस्मृति — अपने होश में न रहने की हालत
definition: self-forgetting absorption in which a person loses track of themselves through music, joy or love; ecstasy sounds religious, this need not be
example: गाते गाते वो बेख़ुदी में खो गया — Singing, he lost himself entirely.

hindi: निर्भय — जिसे कोई डर छू भी न सके
definition: brave in the sense of feeling no fear at all, naming the absence of dread rather than the mastering of it
example: वह बेख़ौफ़ होकर गवाही देने आया — He came to testify without any fear.

hindi: परायापन — अपने को ग़ैर की तरह बरतना
definition: the distance of treating a close person as a stranger; estrangement expressed through manner and silence rather than through words
example: एक ही घर में रहकर भी बेगानगी बरती — They kept up the strangeness while living in one house.

hindi: दयनीयता — दूसरों की नज़र में गिरी हुई हालत
definition: helplessness as it looks from outside, inviting pity from onlookers; names how the condition appears more than how it feels
example: उसकी बेचारगी देख कर सबका दिल पसीज गया — Everyone's heart melted at his pitiable state.

hindi: अकुलाहट — जहाँ बैठो वहीं चैन न पड़े
definition: the inability to settle anywhere, mind and limbs both fidgeting; anxiety is diagnosed, this is simply suffered
example: फ़ोन के इंतज़ार में रात भर बेचैनी रही — Waiting for the call, I could not settle all night.

hindi: बेक़रारी — जल्द मिलने की तड़प
definition: impatient eagerness while waiting, restlessness aimed at one expected arrival rather than a general unease
example: उसकी बेताबी हर ख़त में साफ़ थी — His impatience was plain in every letter.

hindi: बेदख़ल किया जाना — क़ब्ज़े या हक़ से हटा दिया जाना
definition: the stripping away of someone's possession of land or a house, eviction from a right rather than from a mere room
example: किसानों की बेदख़ली का हुक्म आया — An order came for the eviction of the farmers.

hindi: बेहाल — साँस और ताक़त दोनों जवाब दे जाएँ
definition: drained to the point where breath and strength both fail, weakness at its last stage; stronger than merely tired
example: दो सीढ़ियाँ चढ़कर ही बेदम हो जाता है। — Two steps of stairs leave him without breath or strength.

hindi: निर्दयता — दूसरे का दर्द महसूस न करना
definition: the absence of any feeling for another's pain, a defect in the person rather than an act done to someone
example: उसने बड़ी बेदर्दी से रिश्ता तोड़ दिया — He broke off the relationship with great callousness.

hindi: अन्यायी शासन — इंसाफ़ से ख़ाली हुकूमत
definition: rule in which justice has simply stopped being given, injustice as the settled condition of a state rather than one wrong verdict
example: उस दौर की बेदाद पर शायरों ने बहुत लिखा — Poets wrote a great deal about the injustice of that age.

hindi: जागा हुआ — नींद से खुली आँखों वाला
definition: awake with the eyes open, especially through a night that should have been slept away; and by extension alert to what others sleep through
example: वह सारी रात बेदार रहा — He stayed awake the whole night.

hindi: जागरण — जागते रह जाने की हालत
definition: the state of staying awake, whether out of grief, worry or watchfulness; wakefulness as a condition that lasts, not as a single moment
example: बेदारी ने आँखें सुर्ख़ कर दीं — The sleeplessness had reddened his eyes.

hindi: विवशता — देख सकना पर कुछ कर न सकना
definition: helplessness felt while watching harm happen that one has no power to stop; about lack of power, not lack of choice
example: बच्चे को तड़पते देखना और कुछ न कर पाना, यही बेबसी है — Watching the child suffer and being able to do nothing is helplessness.

hindi: निडर — बेझिझक सच कह देने वाला
definition: outspoken without fear of consequence; the same plainness that earns condemnation as insolence is admired here
example: उस रिपोर्टर के सवाल हमेशा बेबाक होते हैं। — That reporter's questions are always fearless.

hindi: उपेक्षा — मुँह फेर लेने वाली रुखाई
definition: studied coldness shown by turning the face away, an act performed at somebody rather than a mere absence of warmth
example: इतनी बेरुख़ी क्यों, कम से कम बात तो करो। — Why so cold? At least speak to me.

hindi: बेघरी — कोई वतन ही न बचने की हालत
definition: having no homeland left to return to at all, a step beyond exile because no place is waiting on the other side
example: जंग ने पूरे शहर को बेवतनी दे दी — The war left a whole city with no homeland.

hindi: विश्वासघात — साथ निभाने का वादा तोड़ना
definition: the breaking of promised constancy, spoken as an accusation with moral heat that unfaithfulness delivers flatly
example: उसकी बेवफ़ाई का ग़म गाने से नहीं जाता। — Grief at her betrayal doesn't leave with a song.

hindi: विधवा — जिसका शौहर मर चुका हो
definition: a woman whose husband has died, named by the loss itself; the register of forms and formal speech rather than a slur or an endearment
example: बेवा का वज़ीफ़ा हर महीने आता है — The widow's pension arrives each month.

hindi: साधनहीनता — घर में कुछ भी न बचना
definition: having no belongings or provision left, destitution described by the empty house rather than by the empty purse
example: बेसरोसामानी में भी उसने मेहमान को खाना खिलाया — Even with nothing in the house he fed his guest.

hindi: निष्ठा-शपथ — किसी को अपना पेशवा मान लेने की क़सम
definition: the pledge of allegiance by which followers formally accept someone as their leader, a binding oath rather than a private feeling
example: सरदारों ने नए बादशाह की बैअत की — The chiefs pledged allegiance to the new king.

hindi: विलाप — मरने वाले का नाम लेकर ज़ोर से रोना
definition: wailing that names the dead person aloud and recounts what they were, the rawest and least composed of the mourning sounds
example: माँ बैन करती रही और किसी से चुप न हुई — The mother kept wailing and no one could quiet her.

hindi: जीर्ण — पुराना पड़कर गल-सड़ चुका
definition: worn out and crumbling with age, past the point where mending will hold; describes slow decay, not sudden breakage that a repair could fix
example: बोसीदा दीवार को गिराकर नई बनानी पड़ी। — The decayed wall had to be pulled down and rebuilt.

hindi: सुगंधित बाग़ — ख़ुशबू और फल वाला बग़ीचा
definition: a garden praised for scent and fruit together, the literary ideal of a garden rather than any ordinary plot of flowers
example: उसकी शायरी एक बोस्ताँ है जिसमें हर लफ़्ज़ महकता है। — His poetry is a scented garden where every word gives off fragrance.

hindi: लांछन — जान-बूझकर गढ़ा गया झूठा आरोप
definition: a slander known to be false by the person spreading it, invented rather than merely unproven; a baseless accusation may be careless, this one is manufactured
example: यह बोहतान है, इसका कोई सिरा नहीं — This is a fabrication; it has no basis at all.

hindi: दृश्य — सामने घट रहा नज़ारा, चाहे भला हो या बुरा
definition: a scene laid out before the eyes, neutral about whether it pleases, so it takes disaster and beauty alike
example: हादसे का मंज़र भुलाया नहीं जाता — The scene of the accident cannot be forgotten.

hindi: अनुमोदन — ऊपर से मिली स्वीकृति
definition: the sanction granted by an authority, approval from above rather than acceptance between two equals
example: फ़ाइल पर साहब की मंज़ूरी अभी बाक़ी है। — The officer's sanction on the file is still awaited.

hindi: उच्च पद — दरबार या हुकूमत का ऊँचा ओहदा
definition: a high office of rank granted by a ruler, carrying dignity and a following as much as it carries duty
example: उन्हें दरबार में बड़ा मंसब मिला — He was granted a high office at court.

hindi: रद्द — जो निरस्त किया जा चुका हो
definition: describing an order or agreement already cancelled, no longer in force from that day onward
example: पुराना हुक्मनामा अब मंसूख़ हो चुका है। — The old order now stands cancelled.

hindi: योजना — सोच-समझकर बनाई गई आगे की तरतीब
definition: a worked-out plan of action with steps and intent behind it, more deliberate than an idea and often said of schemes
example: सड़क का मंसूबा दो साल से काग़ज़ पर है — The road plan has been sitting on paper for two years.

hindi: असमर्थ — जो किसी कमी की वजह से काम न कर सके
definition: unable to do something because of a bodily limitation, and so excused from it; carries the excusing along with the incapacity
example: वो चलने से मअज़ूर है। — He is unable to walk.

hindi: असमर्थता — शरीर की वह कमी जो काम रोक दे
definition: the lasting bodily incapacity itself, disability named as a condition; where the adjective describes the person, this names the state
example: हादसे के बाद की मअज़ूरी पर पेंशन मिलती है। — A pension is given for disability following an accident.

hindi: नतीजा — जिस अंजाम तक बात लौटती है
definition: what a matter comes back to at last, the outcome seen as its true meaning rather than its final event
example: इस ज़िद का मआल तन्हाई है। — The upshot of this stubbornness is loneliness.

hindi: अर्थव्यवस्था — आमदनी और ख़र्च का पूरा इंतज़ाम
definition: the arrangement by which a household or country lives, livelihood as a whole system of income and spending
example: घर की मईशत उसी की तनख़्वाह पर टिकी है — The household economy rests on his salary alone.

hindi: प्राथमिक पाठशाला — बच्चों को पढ़ाने की छोटी जगह
definition: the small elementary school where children are given their first lessons in reading; the larger institution teaches advanced learning, this teaches the alphabet
example: मोहल्ले के मकतब में हर्फ़ पहचानना सीखा — He learned his letters at the neighbourhood school.

hindi: लिखित पत्र — जो लिखकर भेजा गया हो
definition: a letter regarded as a formal written piece, the thing that has been set down and sent; used where the plain word for letter would sound too casual
example: उनके मकतूब आज भी अदब में पढ़ाए जाते हैं। — His letters are still taught in literature today.

hindi: समाधि-भवन — पत्थर की इमारत में बनी शाही या बड़ी क़ब्र
definition: a built tomb, a domed monument raised over a grave for kings and grandees; the architecture is the point, where a plain grave is only earth
example: शहर के बाहर एक टूटा हुआ मक़बरा खड़ा है — A ruined tomb stands outside the city.

hindi: लोकप्रियता — लोगों के दिलों में क़बूल हो जाना
definition: the acceptance and liking of ordinary people for a work or a person, measured in affection rather than in reach; fame can be cold, this cannot
example: इस गाने की मक़बूलियत आज तक क़ायम है — This song's popularity holds to this day.

hindi: ऋणी — जिस पर क़र्ज़ चढ़ा हो
definition: carrying debt, a person defined by the money he owes rather than by what he borrowed it for
example: वो पहले ही तीन जगह से मक़रूज़ है — He is already in debt to three different people.

hindi: उद्देश्य — जिसके लिए सफ़र या काम किया जाए
definition: the purpose for which one travels or acts, the reason behind the journey as distinct from its endpoint
example: इस सफ़र का मक़सद सिर्फ़ आराम था — The purpose of this journey was only rest.

hindi: स्थान / पड़ाव — जहाँ पहुँचकर रुका जाए
definition: a located place one arrives at and halts in, carrying position and standing where a plain place carries neither
example: यह वही मक़ाम है जहाँ हम पहली बार मिले थे — This is the very place where we first met.

hindi: समापन शेर — ग़ज़ल का आख़िरी शेर जिसमें शायर का तख़ल्लुस आता है
definition: the closing couplet of a ghazal in which the poet names himself, signing the poem from inside it; the opening declares the rhyme, this one signs the work
example: इस ग़ज़ल का मक़्ता सबसे उम्दा है — The closing couplet of this ghazal is the finest.

hindi: मारा गया व्यक्ति — जिसका क़त्ल हुआ हो
definition: the person who was killed, named from the receiving end of the act; a court word that fixes who suffered the killing rather than who did it
example: मक़्तूल की शिनाख़्त कपड़ों से हुई — The victim was identified from his clothes.

hindi: सिला हुआ सिर-ढकाव — ठोड़ी के नीचे बंद होता है
definition: a stitched head covering that closes under the chin, covering hair and neck but leaving the face open
example: उसने मक़्ना ठीक किया और दरस देने लगी। — She adjusted her head covering and began the lesson.

hindi: छली — जिसकी हर बात के पीछे कोई चाल हो
definition: habitually deceitful, describing a person whose cunning is settled character rather than a single deed of trickery
example: इतना मक्कार आदमी मैंने नहीं देखा — I have never seen so deceitful a man.

hindi: पत्र-प्राप्तकर्ता — जिसके नाम पत्र लिखा गया हो
definition: the addressee, the person a letter is written to; the name on the envelope rather than the hand that wrote it
example: मक्तूब-इलैह का पता ग़लत निकला। — The addressee's address turned out to be wrong.

hindi: कपट — चालाकी भरी योजना
definition: cunning scheming worked out in advance, naming the craft behind the deception rather than the false belief it produces
example: उसके मक्र को समझने में देर हो गई — It took me too long to see through his cunning.

hindi: भंडार-गृह — जहाँ माल सँभालकर रखा जाता है
definition: the storehouse in which goods are kept safe until they are needed or sold; a place of keeping, not a place of making or selling
example: अनाज मख़ज़न में महफ़ूज़ रखा है। — The grain is kept safe in the storehouse.

hindi: छिपा हुआ — जान-बूझकर नज़र से दूर रखा गया
definition: kept hidden from sight on purpose, so that only the concealer knows it; deliberately covered, not simply unnoticed
example: ये बात आप से मख़फ़ी नहीं — This matter is not hidden from you.

hindi: रोएँदार मोटा कपड़ा — छूने में मुलायम
definition: thick cloth with a raised soft pile; velvet, named for the nap you feel rather than for any shine
example: मख़मल के डिब्बे में अँगूठी रखी थी। — The ring lay in a velvet box.

hindi: नशे में डूबा — जिसकी आँखें ख़ुमार से भारी हों
definition: drunk in the heavy-lidded, unhurried manner, said admiringly of eyes and of bearing; describes how drunkenness looks, never how badly it acts
example: मख़मूर निगाहों ने महफ़िल का रुख़ बदल दिया। — Those wine-heavy eyes changed the mood of the gathering.

hindi: मस्त-नशा — आँखों में उतरा हुआ ख़ुमार
definition: the languid drunkenness that shows in the eyes and the voice, admired for its beauty rather than pitied; drunkenness as an appearance
example: उसकी आँखों की मख़मूरी शराब से नहीं थी। — The languor in her eyes did not come from wine.

hindi: क्षमा — ईश्वर द्वारा गुनाहों का ढँक दिया जाना
definition: forgiveness granted by God that covers over sin, the thing repentance hopes to obtain and cannot compel
example: मरहूम की मग़फ़िरत की दुआ की गई — Prayers were said for the deceased's forgiveness.

hindi: बख़्शा हुआ — जिसके गुनाह माफ़ हो चुके हों
definition: said of a dead person whose sins are hoped or believed forgiven, a title that adds a prayer to the respect the plain 'late' already carries
example: मग़फ़ूर बुज़ुर्ग की क़ब्र यहीं कहीं है — The forgiven elder's grave is somewhere here.

hindi: पश्चिम — वह दिशा जहाँ सूरज डूबता है
definition: the west as the quarter of the sky where the sun sets, and the prayer named for that hour of sunset
example: मग़रिब की तरफ़ बादल सुर्ख़ हो रहे थे। — The clouds were turning red toward the west.

hindi: घमंडी — अपने को सबसे ऊपर समझने वाला
definition: haughty in bearing, carrying an assumed superiority into every room; visible in manner long before it reaches speech
example: शोहरत के बाद वो मग़रूर हो गया। — After fame he became arrogant.

hindi: मस्त फ़क़ीर — जो ख़ुदा की मुहब्बत में होश खो बैठा हो
definition: a holy man drawn out of his senses by divine attraction, indifferent to how he appears; lost in the divine rather than disciplined in worship
example: दरगाह के बाहर एक मजज़ूब बैठा रहता था — A God-intoxicated man used to sit outside the shrine.

hindi: विवशता — कोई चारा न होने की हालत
definition: the condition of having no choice left, usually invoked to explain a decision one would never otherwise defend
example: मजबूरी में ही घर बेचना पड़ा। — We had to sell the house out of sheer compulsion.

hindi: घायल — जिस पर ज़ख़्म लगा हो
definition: of a person or a feeling that has been wounded, used equally for a body and for pride; the formal report word for injured
example: हादसे में तीन लोग मजरूह हुए — Three people were wounded in the accident.

hindi: सभा — किसी तय मक़सद से बैठा हुआ जमावड़ा
definition: a formal sitting convened for a stated purpose, mourning, council or recitation; the same assembled company as a महफ़िल but with an agenda rather than pleasure holding it together
example: मजलिस में सब ख़ामोशी से बैठे रहे — Everyone sat in silence through the assembly.

hindi: विषय-वस्तु — किसी लेख या शेर में बाँधी गई बात
definition: the content a piece of writing carries, the idea a poet has managed to fit inside a couplet; the theme is what it is about, this is what it actually says
example: मज़मून नया है, ज़बान पुरानी — The content is new, the language old.

hindi: समाधि — किसी बुज़ुर्ग की क़ब्र
definition: the grave of a revered person, the tomb itself rather than the shrine and courtyard raised around it
example: मज़ार पर चादर चढ़ाई गई — A sheet was laid on the tomb.

hindi: अधिकृत — जिसे क़ानूनन इजाज़त हासिल हो
definition: legally competent, said of the officer or body whose decision will count because the rules allow it
example: सिर्फ़ मजाज़ अफ़सर ही यह काग़ज़ जारी कर सकता है — Only an authorised officer may issue this paper.

hindi: चिकित्सालय — तबीब के बैठकर मरीज़ देखने की जगह
definition: the room where a physician sits to see patients at fixed hours, his consulting practice; the smallest of these places and the most personal
example: हकीम साहब का मतब शाम को खुलता है। — The physician's clinic opens in the evening.

hindi: छापाख़ाना — जहाँ किताबें छापी जाती हैं
definition: the printing press as a place, the establishment where written matter is printed; the workshop rather than the trade
example: यह किताब लखनऊ के एक पुराने मतबा में छपी थी। — This book was printed at an old press in Lucknow.

hindi: आरंभिक शेर — ग़ज़ल का पहला शेर जिसके दोनों मिसरे तुकांत हों
definition: the opening couplet of a ghazal, the one whose both lines carry the rhyme and so announce to listeners what the rhyme scheme will be
example: मतला सुनते ही क़ाफ़िया समझ आ गया — The rhyme became clear the moment we heard the opening couplet.

hindi: पूँजी-माल — जो कुछ किसी के पास क़ीमती हो
definition: the goods and worth a person actually possesses, whether traded or treasured; can be turned on the abstract, as when life itself is called one's whole stock
example: किताबें ही उसकी सारी मता हैं। — Books are his entire stock of worth.

hindi: मूल पाठ — किताब का असल लेख, हाशिए और व्याख्या से अलग
definition: the main body of a text as against its commentary and marginal notes; the words being explained, not the explanation
example: मत्न छोटा है और शरह लंबी। — The text is short and the commentary long.

hindi: रसोई — वो जगह जहाँ खाना पकता है
definition: the room where food is cooked, the formal word for a kitchen as a place in a building rather than as a household's cooking
example: महल के मत्बख़ में रात भर आग जलती रही। — The fire burned all night in the palace kitchen.

hindi: बुलाया गया मेहमान — जिसे दावत में न्योता मिला हो
definition: the person who has been invited to a feast, named by the invitation received rather than by arriving or being hosted
example: मदऊ मेहमानों की फ़ेहरिस्त लंबी थी। — The list of invited guests was long.

hindi: दफ़्न होने की जगह — किसी ख़ास शख़्स का दफ़्न-स्थान
definition: the specific spot where a particular person lies buried, named to answer where someone is rather than to name a public ground
example: उनका मदफ़न दिल्ली में है — His burial place is in Delhi.

hindi: पाठशाला — दीनी तालीम देने वाला संस्थान
definition: a school where traditional religious learning is taught by resident teachers; the word names a whole system of study, not merely a building with classes
example: यह मदरसा सौ साल पुराना है, वे यहीं पढ़े — This madrasa is a hundred years old; he studied right here.

hindi: स्तुति — किसी की खुली प्रशंसा
definition: open praise spoken of someone, aimed at the person rather than at any single quality they possess
example: दरबार में शाह की मदह होती रही — Praise of the king went on in the court.

hindi: बेसुधी — नशे में होश का जाता रहना
definition: the drunkenness in which awareness itself goes, the drinker no longer following what happens around; deeper than the pleasant lift
example: मदहोशी में उसने वो कह दिया जो कभी न कहता। — In his drunken stupor he said what he never would have.

hindi: मनौती — मुराद पूरी होने पर कुछ चढ़ाने का वचन
definition: a promise made to God on condition that a wish is granted, paid only after the prayer has been answered
example: बेटे की सेहत के लिए उसने दरगाह पर मन्नत मानी थी। — She had vowed an offering at the shrine for her son's health.

hindi: आशय — जो कुछ कहने वाले का मतलब समझ में आया
definition: the sense a listener takes from what was said, the understood import rather than the dictionary meaning of the words used
example: अल्फ़ाज़ छोड़िए, मफ़्हूम पर आइए — Leave the words aside and come to the sense of it.

hindi: हक्का-बक्का — हैरत से जिसकी ज़बान बंद हो जाए
definition: struck dumb by astonishment, unable to answer or move; names the effect on the person, not the wonder that struck him
example: ये मंज़र देखकर सब मबहूत रह गए — Seeing that sight, everyone was left dumbstruck.

hindi: राज्य-भूमि — बादशाह के क़ब्ज़े में आया सारा इलाक़ा
definition: the whole country seen as a holding under a sovereign, land and people together as one possession rather than as an administration
example: सारी ममलकत में सोग का ऐलान हुआ — Mourning was declared across the entire realm.

hindi: मदिरा — शायरी की शराब, अक्सर नशे और बेख़ुदी का प्रतीक
definition: wine as poetry uses it, less a drink than a standing image for intoxication and release from the self; the ordinary word names a liquid, this one names a whole idea
example: मय के बग़ैर उर्दू शायरी अधूरी है — Urdu poetry is incomplete without wine.

hindi: शराबख़ोरी — पीने की आदत
definition: the ordinary habit of drinking wine, said of a person's routine rather than of any gathering or creed
example: डॉक्टर ने मय-नोशी छोड़ने को कहा है। — The doctor has told him to give up drinking.

hindi: मधुशाला — शराब पीने-पिलाने की जगह
definition: the drinking house treated as a rival to the mosque, a place of its own doctrine; a tavern spoken of with reverence rather than shame
example: मस्जिद से निकला तो मयकदा सामने था। — He stepped out of the mosque and the tavern stood before him.

hindi: पीने वाला — जिसे शराब की आदत और तमीज़ दोनों हैं
definition: a habitual drinker described by his practice rather than his philosophy; the word notices how often he drinks, not what he believes
example: पुराना मयकश है, कभी लड़खड़ाते नहीं देखा। — He is an old drinker; I have never seen him stumble.

hindi: मधुशाला — शराब पीने-पिलाने की जगह, कविता में उदारता का ठिकाना
definition: the tavern of poetry, set against the mosque and the preacher as the place where no one is turned away and pretension is dropped
example: मस्जिद से निकाला तो मयख़ाना मिल गया — Thrown out of the mosque, he found the tavern.

hindi: मद्यप — शराब पीने का शौक़ीन
definition: one who drinks wine, said plainly and often with disapproval; the flat descriptive term where the tavern's other names carry romance
example: मोहल्ले में उसकी शोहरत एक मयख़्वार की है। — In the neighbourhood his reputation is that of a wine-drinker.

hindi: मृत शरीर — नहलाने-कफ़नाने के लिए रखा हुआ जिस्म
definition: the dead body regarded as something owed washing, shrouding and respect, not the anatomical corpse of a report; the word said in the house where it lies
example: मय्यत को सुबह तक घर में रखा गया — The body was kept at home until morning.

hindi: शयन-स्थल — क़ब्र, जिसे सोने की जगह कहकर बयान किया गया हो
definition: the grave described as a resting place where the dead sleep, a softened literary word that avoids naming the pit
example: उस मरक़द पर हर साल चराग़ जलाया जाता है — A lamp is lit at that resting place every year.

hindi: रोग — शरीर में बैठी हुई कोई निश्चित बीमारी
definition: a named disease with a known course, the thing a physician diagnoses; unlike feeling unwell, this is the illness itself as an entity
example: उसका मरज़ पुराना है, दवा से दबता है मिटता नहीं। — His disease is old; medicine suppresses it but does not erase it.

hindi: मूँगा — समुंदर में उगने वाला सुर्ख़ रत्न
definition: red coral, a gem grown in the sea instead of dug from rock; strung as beads more often than set
example: मरजान की माला उसकी माँ की निशानी थी। — The coral necklace was a keepsake of her mother.

hindi: ठुकराया हुआ — जिसे रद्द करके अलग कर दिया गया हो
definition: rejected and cast out, describing a person or a petition turned away for good rather than merely refused once
example: उसकी दरख़्वास्त मरदूद ठहरी — His petition was rejected outright.

hindi: मलहम — घाव पर लगाने वाली दवा
definition: a healing ointment spread on a wound from outside, medicine that is applied rather than swallowed; the standard image for consolation
example: ज़ख़्म पर मरहम लगाते ही जलन कम हुई। — The burning eased as soon as the ointment touched the wound.

hindi: पड़ाव — सफ़र या काम का एक चरण
definition: one stage of a long journey or undertaking, a leg that must be finished before the next one begins
example: पहला मरहला तय हो चुका है — The first stage has been completed.

hindi: स्वर्गीय — जिस मर्द का इंतिक़ाल हो चुका हो
definition: the late, placed before a dead man's name as a mark of respect and of mercy asked for him; a title attached to the name, not a statement about death
example: मरहूम अहमद साहब की याद में यह हॉल बना — This hall was built in memory of the late Ahmad.

hindi: स्वर्गीया — जिस औरत का इंतिक़ाल हो चुका हो
definition: the late, in its feminine form, used before a dead woman's name; identical in force to its masculine pair and wrong if the two are swapped
example: मरहूमा वालिदा के नाम पर स्कूल रखा गया — The school was named after his late mother.

hindi: पत्राचार — चिट्ठियों का आना-जाना
definition: the ongoing exchange of letters between two parties, correspondence as a continuing relation rather than a single message sent
example: दोनों के बीच बरसों मरासलत रही — Correspondence continued between them for years.

hindi: चरागाह — हरी घास का खुला मैदान
definition: an open stretch of green grass wide enough to graze on, greenness as landscape rather than as a tended garden
example: पहाड़ के नीचे एक हरा मर्ग़ज़ार फैला था। — Below the mountain a green meadow lay spread out.

hindi: पदवी — इज़्ज़त का ऊँचा दर्जा
definition: an elevated degree of honour on a recognised scale, a station a person reaches rather than a post he occupies
example: इल्म ने उन्हें यह मर्तबा दिलाया — Learning brought him this station.

hindi: बैठक-भाग — घर का वह हिस्सा जहाँ मर्द और मेहमान बैठते हैं
definition: the outer part of a house where men sit and male guests are received, kept apart from the family's inner rooms; the household's public face
example: मर्दान-ख़ाना मेहमानों से भरा हुआ था — The men's quarters were full of guests.

hindi: शोक-काव्य — मरने वाले की तारीफ़ और ग़म में लिखी नज़्म
definition: an elegy composed for the dead, praising the person and grieving their loss in verse; written literature where the chanted lament is oral rite
example: उसने अपने उस्ताद पर मर्सिया लिखा — He wrote an elegy for his teacher.

hindi: अभिशप्त — जिस पर लानत पड़ चुकी हो
definition: already fallen under a curse and shut out from mercy; describes the state of the cursed one, not the curse spoken against him
example: उस मलऊन का नाम भी न लो — Do not even name that accursed one.

hindi: फ़रिश्ता — शास्त्रीय अरबी लफ़्ज़ जो किसी नामी दूत के लिए आता है
definition: the formal word for an angel, used where the being is named or given an office in scripture; weightier in register than everyday usage
example: मलक ने आकर उन्हें ख़ुशख़बरी दी — The angel came and gave them the good news.

hindi: मौत का फ़रिश्ता — जान क़ब्ज़ करने आने वाला फ़रिश्ता
definition: the angel who comes to take the soul at the appointed hour, death imagined as a visitor with a face rather than an event
example: बीमारी में उसे लगा मलक-उल-मौत सिरहाने खड़ा है — In his illness he felt the angel of death standing at his pillow.

hindi: फ़रिश्तों का जहान — नज़र से ओझल आलम जहाँ हुक्म चलता है
definition: the unseen realm of angels and command that lies above the visible world; a whole order of being, not a single heavenly place
example: सूफ़ी आलम-ए-मलकूत की बातें करते हैं — The Sufis speak of the realm of the unseen.

hindi: टिड्डी — झुंड में फ़सल चट कर जाने वाला कीड़ा
definition: the locust, a small creature harmless alone and ruinous in swarms; it names a devouring crowd rather than a single pest
example: मलख़ का दल खेत पर टूट पड़ा — A swarm of locusts fell upon the field.

hindi: पहने हुए — किसी ख़ास कपड़े में ढका हुआ
definition: clothed in a particular garment; describes the wearer as dressed, where other clothing words name the cloth itself
example: वो सफ़ेद कपड़ों में मलबूस दरवाज़े पर खड़ा था। — He stood at the door clothed in white.

hindi: लानत-मलामत — दोष पर की गई खरी फटकार
definition: open reproach aimed at someone for a wrong, delivered to shame them into stopping; conscience reproaches privately, this does it in front of others
example: उसे हर तरफ़ से मलामत सहनी पड़ी — He had to bear reproach from every side.

hindi: खेद — मामला निपटने के बाद बचा अफ़सोस
definition: the mild residue of regret left once a matter is finished, lasting far longer than it deserves; apology relieves it, time rarely does
example: कोई मलाल नहीं, जो हुआ ठीक हुआ — No regrets; whatever happened was for the best.

hindi: पालतू पशुधन — गाय, भैंस, बकरी वग़ैरह
definition: the household's cattle taken as wealth, the grazing animals a family owns rather than any wild beast
example: बाढ़ में उसके सारे मवेशी बह गए — All his cattle were swept away in the flood.

hindi: मशाल — हाथ में उठाई जाने वाली बड़ी लौ
definition: a burning torch held up to light a road for many, brighter and more public than a lamp
example: जुलूस में मशअलें जल रही थीं — Torches were burning in the procession.

hindi: कड़ी मेहनत — जिस काम में जिस्म टूट जाए
definition: hard bodily labour that costs the worker in sweat and strain; names the toil as a burden borne, not the wage earned from it
example: दिन भर की मशक़्क़त के बाद वो चुपचाप सो गया। — After a day of hard labour he fell asleep without a word.

hindi: सशर्त — जो किसी शर्त से बंधा हो
definition: describing a promise or grant that holds only if a stated condition is met
example: उसकी मदद मशरूत थी, बे-ग़रज़ नहीं। — His help was conditional, not free of interest.

hindi: सलाह — पूछकर ली गई राय
definition: advice sought and given in consultation; implies two people talking a matter through, not a verdict handed down
example: बड़े भाई से मशवरा ले लो। — Take your elder brother's advice.

hindi: ईश्वरेच्छा — जो ऊपर वाला चाहे
definition: the divine will behind events, the deciding intent rather than the allotted share it produces
example: मशीयत के आगे किसी का बस नहीं। — No one has power against the divine will.

hindi: अभ्यास — बार-बार दोहरा कर हाथ बिठाना
definition: repeated practice done to make a skill sure, the drill that stands between ability and mastery; the doing here matters more than the result of any one attempt
example: रोज़ की मश्क़ के बिना हाथ बिगड़ जाता है — Without daily practice the hand goes off.

hindi: अभ्यस्त — लगातार अभ्यास से हाथ पका हुआ
definition: so practised at a skill that the hand no longer hesitates; describes fluency bought by repetition, below the standing of a master who can teach it
example: वो इतना मश्शाक़ कातिब है कि लकीर टेढ़ी नहीं होती। — He is so practised a scribe that the line never goes crooked.

hindi: कथा-काव्य — तुकांत द्विपदियों में लिखी लंबी कथा-कविता
definition: a long narrative poem written in rhymed couplets, telling a story where other verse forms only hold a mood
example: मीर हसन की मसनवी आज भी पढ़ी जाती है। — Mir Hasan's narrative poem is still read today.

hindi: यात्रा-दूरी — जो दूरी तय करनी पड़े
definition: the length of road that actually has to be covered, distance considered as travelling rather than as separation
example: इतनी मसाफ़त पैदल तय की गई — That whole distance was covered on foot.

hindi: मसविदा-प्रारूप — किताब या दस्तावेज़ का कच्चा लिखित रूप
definition: the draft of a written work or document, complete enough to read and not yet fixed; the finished composition is public, this is the version still being cut about
example: मसौदा तैयार है, नज़रसानी बाक़ी है — The draft is ready; the revision remains.

hindi: निवास — रहने का ठिकाना
definition: the dwelling place where one actually lives and returns to each night, less grand than homeland and more settled than shelter
example: उनका मस्कन अब शहर के किनारे है — Their dwelling is now at the edge of the city.

hindi: मस्त-सा — नशे जैसी बेफ़िक्र चाल या अंदाज़
definition: carrying the manner of drunkenness without necessarily the drink, careless and swaying; describes a bearing where its siblings describe a condition
example: वो मस्ताना चाल से भीड़ के बीच से गुज़र गया। — He walked through the crowd with that carefree, drunken gait.

hindi: ढका हुआ — जिस पर पर्दा पड़ा हो, सामने न आया हो
definition: veiled over so that its fault or nature stays out of sight; hidden by a covering placed over it, rather than by anyone's intent to deceive
example: उसके ऐब अब तक मस्तूर हैं — His faults are veiled to this day.

hindi: कृत्रिम — जो बना हुआ हो, प्राकृतिक न हो
definition: artificial, made rather than natural; false without any intent to defraud, as of a manufactured limb or a rehearsed smile
example: उसकी हँसी मस्नूई लगी — Her laugh seemed artificial.

hindi: हित की बात — जो मौक़े के लिहाज़ से ठीक हो
definition: the course that serves everyone's interest in the circumstances, wisdom of expediency rather than of principle
example: अभी ख़ामोश रहने में ही मस्लहत है। — Staying silent for now is the prudent course.

hindi: सलाहियत भरी सावधानी — नफ़ा-नुक़सान देखकर चुप रह जाना
definition: choosing your words and moves by what is expedient, prudence that can shade into avoiding the truth
example: मस्लहत-अंदेशी में उसने सच नहीं कहा। — Out of expediency he did not tell the truth.

hindi: मंत्रमुग्ध — जो देखकर सुध-बुध खो बैठे
definition: held spellbound by something beautiful, describing the state of the beholder rather than of the beautiful thing; far stronger than merely impressed
example: उसका रक़्स देखकर सब मस्हूर रह गए — Everyone was left spellbound watching her dance.

hindi: चाँदनी चबूतरा — बाग़ में बना खुला चौकोर मंच
definition: a raised open platform in a garden built for sitting out under the moon, an ornament of ground rather than of water
example: महताबी पर बिछावन लगा दिया गया। — Bedding was laid out on the moonlit terrace.

hindi: जमघट — शेर, संगीत या बातचीत के लिए जुटी बैठक
definition: a gathering assembled for poetry, music or fine talk, where the pleasure of the company is itself the occasion; a party has food at its centre, this has performance
example: आज रात उनके घर महफ़िल जमेगी — There will be a gathering at his house tonight.

hindi: प्रियतम — जिससे प्रेम किया जाता है, प्रेम का पात्र
definition: the person who is loved, named from the lover's side as the object of that love; where English 'beloved' sounds archaic, this is the ordinary word a letter or a song reaches for
example: उसका महबूब उसी शहर में रहता है — Her beloved lives in the same city.

hindi: ऊँट पर बँधी पालकी — जिसमें बैठ कर सफ़र किया जाए
definition: a curtained litter mounted on a camel for travelling, a conveyance that hides its passenger from the road
example: महमिल में बैठी सवारी नज़र न आई — The passenger in the litter was not visible.

hindi: निकट संबंधी — वह रिश्तेदार जिससे पर्दा नहीं
definition: a relative so close by blood or marriage that marriage between them is barred and seclusion need not be kept; kinship defined by the veil it lifts
example: सफ़र में उसके साथ कोई महरम नहीं था — On the journey she had no close male relative with her.

hindi: वंचना — पाने से रह जाने की हालत
definition: the state of being deprived of what others have or what one was promised, a lack imposed from outside rather than chosen
example: उसकी सारी उम्र महरूमी में गुज़री — His whole life passed in deprivation.

hindi: तल्लीनता — किसी में इस क़दर डूब जाना कि अपना होश न रहे
definition: absorption so complete that the self is effaced into what is contemplated; being dissolved in it, not merely concentrating hard on it
example: नमाज़ में उनकी महवियत देखने लायक़ थी — His absorption in prayer was worth seeing.

hindi: हश्र का मैदान — जहाँ सब मुर्दे जमा किए जाएँगे
definition: the ground on which all the dead are gathered for judgement, naming the place and its crowd where क़यामत names the day
example: मैदान-ए-महशर का नक़्शा उसने खींच दिया — He painted a picture of the gathering ground.

hindi: शुल्क — माल या सेवा पर ली जाने वाली सरकारी फ़ीस
definition: the duty charged on goods or a service by an authority, freight and postage included; levied on the transaction, unlike revenue tied to land
example: ख़त पर महसूल कम लगा था, इसलिए वापस आ गया। — Too little postage was paid on the letter, so it came back.

hindi: निपुणता — किसी फ़न पर पूरी पकड़
definition: mastery of a craft or subject built up until the doing looks effortless; ability is the raw capacity, this is capacity that practice has finished
example: उसे ख़त्ताती में महारत हासिल है — He has attained mastery in calligraphy.

hindi: बारीक — पतला और झीना
definition: thin and finely spun, describing thread, cloth or a drawn line; the physical fineness that लतीफ़ names abstractly
example: यह महीन जाली हाथ से बुनी है — This fine mesh is woven by hand.

hindi: थकावट — चलते-चलते आई हुई थकान
definition: the tiredness that settles in after long travel or effort, weariness of the body rather than sleepiness
example: मांदगी की वजह से आगे न चल सके — Because of weariness we could go no further.

hindi: क्षमायाचना — ग़लती मानकर माफ़ी माँगना
definition: an apology that admits the fault, regret expressed to the wronged person rather than a reason for the act
example: देर के लिए माज़रत चाहता हूँ। — I offer my apology for the delay.

hindi: अतीत — बीत चुका समय
definition: the past as a settled country nobody may re-enter; doubles as the past tense in grammar
example: माज़ी को छोड़ कर आगे बढ़ो। — Leave the past behind and move on.

hindi: पदच्युति — ओहदे से हटा दिया जाना
definition: being removed from an office before one would have left it, an end to working life imposed rather than reached
example: माज़ूली की ख़बर उन्हें अख़बार से मिली। — He learned of his removal from the newspaper.

hindi: शोक — मौत पर होने वाला सामूहिक विलाप
definition: public grieving after a death, the mourning performed together with others rather than the sorrow felt privately
example: पूरे मोहल्ले में मातम छाया रहा — Mourning hung over the whole neighbourhood.

hindi: मातृवत — माँ जैसा, ममता भरा
definition: done in the manner of a mother, protective and tender toward someone in one's care; the female counterpart of fatherly conduct in the same family register
example: नर्स ने मादराना शफ़क़त से बच्चे को थपका — The nurse patted the child with motherly tenderness.

hindi: अर्थ — किसी लफ़्ज़ या शेर के भीतर छिपा मतलब
definition: the meaning carried inside a word or line, often layered so that a couplet yields more on a second hearing; the words are visible, this has to be reached
example: इस शेर के कई मानी निकलते हैं — Several meanings come out of this couplet.

hindi: निराशा — उम्मीद टूट जाने की हालत
definition: the settled state of having given up hope of a good outcome; despair as a condition, not a single moment of disappointment
example: बार-बार नाकामी के बाद मायूसी घर कर गई — After repeated failure despair set in.

hindi: साँप — ज़हरीला रेंगने वाला जीव
definition: the snake as a creature of venom and stealth, the Persian word kept for verse and compounds; it names treachery in a person
example: आस्तीन का मार सबसे ख़तरनाक होता है — The snake in one's sleeve is the most dangerous.

hindi: भिड़ंत — निर्णायक मुक़ाबले का मौक़ा
definition: a single decisive battle or contest inside a larger war, the encounter people later name and remember
example: यह मारका तारीख़ में दर्ज हो गया — This battle went down in history.

hindi: धनवान — बहुत सामान-संपत्ति रखने वाला
definition: wealthy in goods and property owned, rich in things held rather than in rank, lineage or influence
example: मालदार लोग भी यहाँ मोल-भाव करते हैं — Even wealthy people bargain here.

hindi: मालिक जैसा — मालिक होने का हक़ रखने वाला
definition: proprietorial, belonging to or behaving like the owner of a property rather than its occupant
example: किरायेदार होकर भी उसका रवैया मालिकाना है — Though a tenant, his manner is proprietorial.

hindi: उन्माद-विषाद — गहरी उदासी से पैदा हुआ मानसिक रोग
definition: melancholia as a diagnosed illness of the mind, sustained darkness with fixed ideas; sadness that has crossed into disease
example: तनहाई ने उसे मालीख़ूलिया तक पहुँचा दिया। — Solitude carried him into melancholia.

hindi: जानकारी — इकट्ठा की हुई ब्योरेवार सूचनाएँ
definition: information a person has collected about things, plural in form and shallow by nature; knowledge stripped of understanding, the facts without the learning that would organise them
example: मालूमात बहुत हैं, मगर समझ कम — He has plenty of information but little understanding.

hindi: प्रेमपात्र — जिस पर आशिक़ मरता हो
definition: the loved one seen strictly as the counterpart of the lover, a role word from the grammar of romance rather than a tender name
example: हर आशिक़ अपने माशूक़ को बेमिसाल समझता है — Every lover thinks his loved one is without equal.

hindi: नाफ़रमानी — हुक्म तोड़ने वाला पाप
definition: sin understood as disobedience to a command, the wrong of refusing an order rather than of harming anyone; the religious weight sits on defiance, not damage
example: मासियत का मतलब है हुक्म से मुँह मोड़ना — Disobedience means turning your face from the command.

hindi: भोलापन — बुराई से अनजान होने की हालत
definition: the untouched quality of a child who has not yet learned deceit, praised in a child and pitied in an adult
example: उसके चेहरे की मासूमियत अब भी नहीं गई। — The childlike innocence on his face has still not gone.

hindi: चाँद-सा माथा वाली — अत्यंत सुंदर स्त्री
definition: a woman whose forehead is likened to the moon, the standard verse epithet for a great beauty
example: उस माहजबीं का ज़िक्र हर महफ़िल में है — That moon-browed beauty is spoken of in every gathering.

hindi: चंद्रमा — रात में चमकने वाला चाँद
definition: the moon as the shining light of the night sky, named for the glow it casts rather than for its shape or phase
example: माहताब की रौशनी में सारा सहन चमक रहा था। — The whole courtyard shone in the moonlight.

hindi: मछली — पानी में रहने वाला जीव
definition: the fish as the creature of water, used in verse for anything that cannot live outside its element
example: माही बे-आब तड़पती है — The fish writhes without water.

hindi: मछुआरा — जाल डाल कर मछली पकड़ने वाला
definition: the fisherman who takes fish with a net, the water's hunter as the trapper is the forest's
example: माहीगीर सुबह होते ही जाल लेकर निकल गया — The fisherman set out with his net at dawn.

hindi: मात्रा — कितना है, इसका नापा हुआ हिसाब
definition: the measured amount of something, stated as a figure; answers how much is present, not how heavy it is or how long it runs
example: दवा की मिक़दार डॉक्टर से पूछकर तय करो। — Fix the quantity of the medicine after asking the doctor.

hindi: मिज़राब — तार छेड़ने का धातु का पंजा
definition: the metal plectrum worn on the finger to strike the strings, a tool of playing rather than an instrument itself
example: मिज़राब पहनते ही उसकी उँगलियाँ चलने लगीं। — The moment he wore the plectrum his fingers began to move.

hindi: स्वभाव — तबीयत और मन का रुख़
definition: the standing temperament of a person, and in greetings the state of their health; treats disposition as something with its own weather
example: आज उनका मिज़ाज ठीक नहीं लग रहा। — He doesn't seem to be in good spirits today.

hindi: पलकें — आँख के किनारे के बाल
definition: the eyelashes taken as a set, named in verse for the shade they cast and the arrows they stand for
example: उसकी मिज़्गाँ पर आँसू ठहरा रहा — A tear stayed resting on her lashes.

hindi: ख़ुशामद भरी विनती — गिड़गिड़ाकर मनाना
definition: pleading that drops all pride to move someone, entreaty repeated until the listener softens
example: बहुत मिन्नत की, तब जाकर वो माने। — I pleaded a great deal before he agreed.

hindi: अवधि — तय की हुई मुद्दत
definition: the fixed term set for something, a period with a stated end rather than an open stretch of waiting
example: क़ैद की मियाद पूरी हो गई — The term of imprisonment has been completed.

hindi: संयम — कंजूसी और फ़ुज़ूलख़र्ची के बीच का रास्ता
definition: keeping to the middle in spending, moderation held between miserliness on one side and waste on the other
example: ख़र्च में मियाना-रवी सबसे मुश्किल है — Moderation in spending is the hardest thing.

hindi: स्वामित्व — किसी चीज़ पर मालिकाना हक़
definition: ownership itself, the recognised right over property rather than the property that is owned
example: मकान पर उसकी मिल्कियत काग़ज़ों में साबित है — His ownership of the house is proved on paper.

hindi: पंक्ति — शेर की एक अकेली लाइन
definition: a single line of verse, half of a couplet, which sets up or completes the thought but rarely stands alone; a couplet is the whole, this is either of its halves
example: पहला मिसरा भूल गया, दूसरा याद है — I forgot the first line; I remember the second.

hindi: मुक़दमे की फ़ाइल — एक मामले के सारे काग़ज़ एक जगह
definition: the assembled file of papers belonging to one case, the record a court keeps bound together from start to judgement
example: मिसल अदालत में तलब कर ली गई। — The case file was summoned to the court.

hindi: दंत-मंजन — दाँतों और मसूड़ों पर लगाया जाने वाला काला चूर्ण
definition: the dark powder once applied to women's teeth and gums as a mark of the married and adorned face
example: पुराने ज़माने में दुल्हन मिस्सी ज़रूर लगाती थी। — In older times a bride always applied tooth-dye.

hindi: अवधिबद्ध — तय मुद्दत तक चलने वाला
definition: describing an agreement fixed to a stated term, which lapses on its own once the period ends
example: यह मीआदी क़रार तीन बरस बाद ख़त्म होगा। — This fixed-term agreement ends after three years.

hindi: तराज़ू — भले-बुरे कर्मों को तौलने वाला पैमाना
definition: the scale on which good and bad deeds are weighed against each other, the image behind final justice; the audit lists the deeds, this weighs them
example: मीज़ान में नेकियाँ भारी हों — May the good deeds weigh heavier in the scale.

hindi: शीशे की सुराही — काँच का नाज़ुक मय-पात्र
definition: the glass decanter prized for its delicacy and colour, valued as an object where the clay flask is valued only for service
example: मीना टूटी तो शराब से ज़्यादा उसका अफ़सोस हुआ। — The glass decanter broke, and it grieved us more than the wine.

hindi: रंगीन इनैमल का काम — धातु पर रंग भरने का हुनर
definition: the craft of filling engraved metal ornament with coloured enamel; colour fused into jewellery rather than stones set upon it
example: इस कंगन की मीनाकारी जयपुर की है। — The enamel work on this bangle is from Jaipur.

hindi: बुर्ज / लाट — ऊँची पतली इमारत
definition: a tall slender tower built to be seen or to call from, height being its whole purpose where a building's is enclosure
example: शहर की हर गली से वह मीनार दिखती है — That tower is visible from every lane in the city.

hindi: वारिसी हिस्सा — क़ानूनन मिलने वाला भाग
definition: the share of an estate that falls to an heir by legal right, inheritance as an entitlement rather than as a bequest
example: बहनों ने अपनी मीरास माँगी — The sisters asked for their lawful share.

hindi: गंभीर प्रतिज्ञा — बहुत पक्का और मुक़द्दस अहद
definition: a solemn covenant of the weightiest kind, sworn before God and held binding on later generations
example: यह मीसाक़ क़ौमों के दरमियान बाँधा गया था। — This solemn covenant was bound between nations.

term: मुँह पर कुछ, पीठ पीछे कुछ
hindi: आगे तारीफ़, पीछे बुराई — दोहरे मुँह वाला बर्ताव
definition: saying something to a person's face and the opposite behind their back, the everyday shape hypocrisy and flattery take together
example: उसका उसूल है, मुँह पर कुछ, पीठ पीछे कुछ — His rule is one thing to your face, another behind your back.

hindi: प्रतीक्षारत — जो इंतज़ार में टिका हो
definition: actively waiting for someone expected, describing the person who waits rather than the waiting, and implying they have not given up
example: माँ दरवाज़े पर मुंतज़िर खड़ी थी — Mother stood at the door, waiting.

hindi: संलग्न-पत्र — पत्र के साथ नत्थी करके भेजा गया काग़ज़
definition: a paper attached to a letter and sent along with it, an enclosure that the covering letter merely announces
example: मुंसलिका देखकर ही रक़म का हिसाब समझ आएगा। — The account will be clear only from the enclosure.

hindi: इंसाफ़ करने वाला — जो बिना पक्षपात फ़ैसला सुनाए
definition: one who judges fairly, the person trusted to decide between two sides without leaning; stresses even-handedness where हाकिम stresses power
example: तुम ख़ुद मुंसिफ़ बनकर बताओ, ग़लती किसकी थी — Be the fair judge yourself and tell me whose fault it was.

hindi: न्यायसंगत — जिसमें किसी की तरफ़ झुकाव न हो
definition: even-handed, describing a decision or treatment that gives each side its due; praises the manner of judging, where इंसाफ़ names the thing itself
example: बँटवारा बिलकुल मुंसिफ़ाना था — The division was entirely even-handed.

hindi: महकता हुआ — जो ख़ुशबू से भर गया हो
definition: made fragrant by something else's scent, describing the air or cloth that has taken on a smell rather than the source
example: फूलों से सारा कमरा मुअत्तर था। — The whole room was made fragrant by the flowers.

hindi: ख़्वाब का अर्थ बताने वाला — जो सपनों की व्याख्या करता है
definition: the person who reads dreams and states their meaning for waking life; a specialist in signs, not a general fortune-teller
example: बादशाह ने अपने मुअब्बिर को बुलवाया — The king summoned his dream-interpreter.

hindi: दीर्घजीवी — बहुत साल जी चुका
definition: having lived a long span of years, a respectful word for someone old that counts the years without calling them frail
example: गाँव के सबसे मुअम्मर बुज़ुर्ग यही हैं। — This is the longest-lived elder of the village.

hindi: लेखक — किताब जोड़कर लिखने वाला
definition: the author who compiles and composes a book, credited for the whole made thing rather than for a single piece of writing
