example: मुअल्लिफ़ ने दीबाचे में सबका शुक्रिया अदा किया। — The author thanked everyone in the preface.

hindi: शिक्षक — इल्म सिखाने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: one whose work is imparting knowledge to a learner, the teacher named by the act of teaching; formal and role-based, without the reverence or mastery an ustad carries
example: मुअल्लिम ने पहला सबक़ दोहराया — The teacher repeated the first lesson.

hindi: जवाबतलबी — ग़लती पर पकड़ और हिसाब माँगना
definition: calling a person to account for a fault and rebuking them for it; the answerability inside a rebuke, not the anger of it
example: देर से आने पर किसी का मुआख़ज़ा नहीं होता यहाँ — Nobody is held to account here for coming late.

hindi: क्षमा-याचना — विधिवत माफ़ी माँगना
definition: formally asking to be excused for a fault, an apology offered with due form and wording rather than out of felt remorse
example: कंपनी ने तहरीरी मुआज़रत की — The company issued a written apology.

hindi: जाँच — मरीज़ को देख-परखकर हाल जानना
definition: the hands-on examination of a patient, looking and testing to gather the signs; the work that a diagnosis is drawn from
example: तबीब ने मुआयना करके रिपोर्ट मँगवाई। — The physician examined him and called for reports.

hindi: चिकित्सा — दवा और तदबीर से रोग का इलाज
definition: the physician's specific course of treatment for a diagnosed disease, the medicines and measures chosen; narrower than the effort of healing
example: मुआलजा शुरू होते ही बुख़ार टूटने लगा। — Once treatment began, the fever started to break.

hindi: उपचारक — जो किसी मरीज़ का इलाज कर रहा हो
definition: the physician actually treating a given patient, defined by the relationship rather than by learning or degree; the attending doctor
example: मुआलिज की इजाज़त के बग़ैर दवा न बदलें। — Do not change the medicine without the attending physician's leave.

hindi: प्रतिकर — छोड़ी या झेली हुई चीज़ के बदले रक़म
definition: money paid in return for something given up or suffered, recompense rather than payment for work performed
example: ज़मीन के बदले मुआवज़ा मिला — Compensation was paid for the land.

hindi: संधि — लिखित और पक्का समझौता
definition: a formal treaty binding two sides to terms, the written instrument in which peace or alliance is recorded
example: जंग के बाद मुआहदा हुआ — A treaty was signed after the war.

hindi: संधि — दो पक्षों के बीच तय हुआ पक्का समझौता
definition: a binding agreement between two states or parties, written and formal rather than an understanding resting on goodwill
example: दोनों मुल्कों के बीच पानी का मुआहिदा हुआ — A treaty on water was concluded between the two countries.

hindi: फिर से — सुनाए हुए शेर को दोहराने की माँग
definition: called out by listeners to demand that a poet repeat the couplet just recited, the audience's highest compliment; an encore asks for more, this asks for the same thing again
example: पहला शेर सुनते ही सब ने मुकर्रर कहा — The moment they heard the first couplet, everyone called for a repeat.

hindi: नियति — पहले से तय लिखावट
definition: destiny understood as written in advance; heavier and more final than luck, which can still turn tomorrow
example: मुक़द्दर का लिखा कौन मिटा सका है। — Who has ever erased what destiny wrote?

hindi: ताक़त देने वाला — जो खाना बदन को मज़बूत करे
definition: strengthening, of food or medicine that builds the body up; praises what nourishment does rather than how it tastes
example: डॉक्टर ने मुक़व्वी ग़िज़ा तजवीज़ की। — The doctor prescribed strengthening food.

hindi: सामने — जो ठीक सामने या टक्कर पर खड़ा हो
definition: positioned directly opposite, whether facing someone across a room or standing against them in a contest
example: मुक़ाबिल खड़ा आदमी चुप था — The man standing opposite was silent.

hindi: पड़ाव या दर्जा — सफ़र या ज़िंदगी में पहुँचा हुआ स्थान
definition: a point reached along the way, a station in a journey or in life that marks how far one has come
example: वह अपने पेशे में ऊँचे मुक़ाम पर है — He is at a high station in his profession.

hindi: प्रतिरोध — दबाव के आगे न झुकना
definition: organised resistance offered against a stronger force, whether an army, a disease or a policy; standing against, not merely surviving
example: क़ब्ज़े के ख़िलाफ़ मुक़ावमत बरसों चली — Resistance against the occupation lasted years.

hindi: ठहरा हुआ — जो फ़िलहाल किसी जगह रह रहा हो
definition: staying or resident somewhere at present, describing the person rather than naming the residence itself
example: वह इन दिनों लाहौर में मुक़ीम है — These days he is resident in Lahore.

hindi: कर्मफल — किए का बदला, चाहे भला हो या बुरा
definition: the requital that returns a deed to its doer, good or bad, without a judge ordering it; punishment is imposed, this is understood to arrive on its own
example: मुकाफ़ात-ए-अमल से कोई नहीं बचता — No one escapes the recompense of his own deeds.

hindi: संवाद — दो पक्षों के बीच बातचीत का सिलसिला
definition: dialogue between two sides that exchanges positions instead of trying to defeat; disputation aims to win, this aims to understand and continue
example: जंग नहीं, मुकालमा चाहिए — What is needed is dialogue, not war.

hindi: दर्शन — जब कोई छिपी हक़ीक़त साफ़ सामने आ जाए
definition: the moment in which a hidden reality is unveiled and stands plain before the seeker; the event of disclosure, where unveiling is the faculty
example: उस रात उन्हें एक मुकाशफ़ा हुआ — That night a disclosure came to him.

hindi: मादक द्रव्य — होश सुन्न कर देने वाली चीज़
definition: any narcotic substance that numbs the senses, the clinical and legal class-name covering many drugs at once
example: पुलिस ने मुख़द्दर के साथ दो लोग पकड़े। — The police caught two men with narcotics.

hindi: संज्ञाहारी — बेहोश या सुन्न कर देने वाली दवा
definition: a drug that numbs sensation or removes consciousness for surgery, medicine that abolishes feeling rather than easing it
example: मुख़द्दिर देने के बाद जर्राह ने चीरा लगाया। — After the anaesthetic was given the surgeon made the incision.

hindi: भेद देना — किसी की बात चुपके से अफ़सरों तक पहुँचाना
definition: informing on people to the authorities from inside their own circle, betrayal of trust rather than professional spying
example: पकड़े जाने की वजह किसी की मुख़बिरी थी — Someone's informing was the reason for the arrest.

hindi: विरोधी — जो ख़िलाफ़ खड़ा हो
definition: opposed, standing against a position or a person; an opponent by stance rather than an enemy by enmity
example: हवा मुख़ालिफ़ थी और कश्ती धीमी — The wind was against us and the boat slow.

hindi: शत्रुता — वह दुश्मनी जो झगड़ा ख़त्म होने पर भी बनी रहे
definition: settled hostility between two sides that outlives the dispute which began it; a quarrel hardened into a standing position against a person
example: मुक़दमा ख़त्म हुआ मगर दोनों घरों की मुख़ासमत बाक़ी रही — The case ended but the hostility between the two houses remained.

hindi: अधिकृत प्रतिनिधि — जिसे किसी के बदले काम करने का हक़ दिया गया हो
definition: an agent given written power to act in another's place, signing and deciding as though he were the principal himself, beyond merely speaking for him
example: जायदाद का सौदा मुख़्तार ने किया — The property deal was done by his authorised agent.

hindi: अधिकार-पत्र — अपनी ओर से काम करने का लिखित अधिकार
definition: the written deed granting one person authority to act on another's behalf in stated matters
example: भाई के नाम मुख़्तार-नामा लिखवा दिया। — A power of attorney was drawn up in his brother's name.

hindi: भ्रम-कुतर्क — ग़लत दलील से पैदा की गई ग़लतफ़हमी
definition: a fallacy or deliberate misleading that makes a wrong conclusion look sound; a mistaken belief may be innocent, this one is manufactured by faulty argument
example: यह मुग़ालता उसने ख़ुद अपने आप को दिया — This was a fallacy he sold to himself.

hindi: अपराधी — जिस पर जुर्म साबित हो चुका हो
definition: the person a court has found guilty of an offence, not merely accused of it; the word is a verdict, and Urdu also uses it for anyone who feels condemned before a loved one
example: मैं तुम्हारे सामने मुजरिम खड़ा हूँ — I stand before you as a guilty man.

hindi: अविवाहित — जिसने शादी न की हो
definition: unmarried and living alone by choice or circumstance, without wife or household of one's own; a standing status, not a temporary state of being childless
example: वो उम्र भर मुजर्रद रहे — He remained unmarried all his life.

hindi: वार्ता — मसला हल करने की रस्मी बातचीत
definition: formal negotiations held to settle a disputed matter, structured talks between sides rather than ordinary conversation
example: सरहद पर मुज़ाकरात फिर से शुरू हुए — Negotiations on the border began again.

hindi: उपनगर — शहर से लगे हुए इलाक़े
definition: the outlying areas attached to a city, settlements that live off the city without being counted inside it
example: किराया सस्ता है, इसलिए वह मुज़ाफ़ात में रहता है — Rent is cheap, so he lives in the outskirts.

hindi: बटाईदार — दूसरे की ज़मीन जोतने वाला किसान
definition: a farmer who works someone else's land for a share of the crop, defined by tenancy and not by owning soil
example: मुज़ारे को आधी फ़सल मिलती है। — The tenant farmer gets half the crop.

hindi: प्रतिरोध — रास्ता रोककर अड़ जाना
definition: resistance offered against a force pressing forward, standing in its way rather than guarding something behind you
example: भीड़ ने पुलिस की मुज़ाहमत की — The crowd resisted the police.

hindi: शुभ समाचार — जो अच्छी ख़बर लाई जाए
definition: news of a good thing that has already happened, brought to the hearer by someone hoping to be rewarded for bringing it
example: मुज़्दा हो, बेटा इम्तिहान में कामयाब हुआ। — Glad news: your son has passed the examination.

hindi: जीर्ण — बरसों से जमी हुई पुरानी बीमारी
definition: chronic, settled in the body over years and flaring by turns; says how long an illness stays, not whether it can be cured
example: ये मुज़्मिन क़ब्ज़ है, फ़ौरी दवा से नहीं जाएगा। — This is chronic constipation; a quick medicine will not clear it.

hindi: दंड — किए की सज़ा के तौर पर मिलने वाला बदला
definition: punishment given as the exact requital of a deed, recompense measured against the offence rather than chosen at will
example: जुर्म का मुजाज़ात क़ानून तय करेगा। — The law will decide the punishment for the crime.

hindi: संघर्षकर्ता — किसी बड़े मक़सद के लिए लड़ने वाला
definition: one who struggles and fights for a cause held sacred, a soldier by conviction rather than by enlistment
example: आज़ादी के मुजाहिदों को याद किया गया — The freedom fighters were remembered.

hindi: आत्म-संघर्ष — अपने नफ़्स से लड़ कर पाबंदी निभाना
definition: the inner struggle of forcing oneself to keep at a discipline against one's own inclination; practice is the exercise, this is the fight to get to it at all
example: सुबह उठना ख़ुद एक मुजाहिदा है — Rising early is itself a struggle against oneself.

hindi: संक्रामक — छूत से दूसरे को लग जाने वाला
definition: able to pass from one body to another, said of a disease that spreads by contact; the property behind an epidemic
example: ये मरज़ मुतअद्दी है, अलग कमरे में रखिए। — This disease is contagious; keep him in a separate room.

hindi: मनोरंजक गायक — महफ़िल में गाकर समाँ बाँधने वाला
definition: a singer who performs to delight a gathering, the old word for the musician of a court or private assembly rather than of a stage or studio
example: महफ़िल में मुतरिब ने अपना साज़ उठाया — At the gathering the singer took up his instrument.

hindi: माँग — हक़ के तौर पर की गई माँग
definition: a demand pressed as a right, claiming what is owed rather than reminding someone that it is due
example: मज़दूरों का मुतालबा जायज़ है। — The workers' demand is legitimate.

hindi: अध्ययन — किताबों को ग़ौर से पढ़ने का अमल
definition: sustained reading undertaken to learn from a text, the study a serious reader does; ordinary reading passes the time, this leaves the reader changed
example: उनका मुतालिआ बहुत वसीअ है — His reading is very wide.

hindi: परहेज़गार — गुनाह से बचकर चलने वाला
definition: scrupulously god-fearing in daily conduct, avoiding what is doubtful; describes an inner carefulness rather than the ascetic's withdrawal or the preacher's office
example: वो मुत्तक़ी आदमी है, शक की चीज़ भी नहीं खाता। — He is a scrupulous man; he will not even eat what is doubtful.

hindi: अध्यापक — मदरसे या कॉलेज में पढ़ाने वाला
definition: a teacher appointed to give lessons at an institution, defined by the post rather than by any bond with the student; the salaried counterpart of a personal master
example: वे उस मदरसे में तीस साल मुदर्रिस रहे — He served thirty years as a lecturer at that school.

hindi: नरमी से निभाना — नाराज़ को समझा-बुझाकर साथ रखना
definition: handling a difficult or offended person gently to keep the peace, accommodation chosen over confrontation
example: उसने मुदारात से मामला ठंडा कर दिया। — He cooled the matter by gentle handling.

hindi: निरंतरता — बिना नागा किसी काम को जारी रखना
definition: unbroken continuity in doing something, the virtue of never skipping a day; hard practice is about intensity, this is about not stopping
example: थोड़ा पढ़ो मगर मुदावमत से — Read a little, but without a break.

hindi: उपचार — बीमारी दूर करने की कोशिश
definition: the whole effort of treating an illness over time, the attempt at a cure; names the process where another word names the act of curing
example: सालों का मुदावा भी काम न आया। — Years of treatment came to nothing.

hindi: वादी — जो दावा करके मुक़दमा लाए
definition: the party who brings the case, claiming that a wrong was done to them and asking the court to set it right
example: मुद्दई ने अपना बयान दर्ज कराया — The complainant recorded his statement.

hindi: निर्धारित अवधि — तय की गई समय-सीमा
definition: a defined term with a beginning and an end; the contractual, legal cousin of a vague long while
example: कॉन्ट्रैक्ट की मुद्दत अगले महीने ख़त्म हो रही है। — The term of the contract ends next month.

hindi: प्रतिवादी — जिस पर मुक़दमा किया गया हो
definition: the party the case is brought against, who must answer the claim made in court by the other side
example: मुद्दा-अलैह पेश नहीं हुआ — The defendant did not appear.

hindi: ज्योतिषी — सितारों का हिसाब लगाकर भविष्य बताने वाला
definition: the man who calculates the stars and states from them what the future holds; works by reckoning, not by dreams or inspiration
example: बादशाह ने सफ़र से पहले मुनज्जिम से पूछा — Before the journey the king consulted his astrologer.

hindi: बहसा-बहसी — दलील का जवाब दलील से देते हुए झगड़ा
definition: an argued dispute in words, each point answered by a counter-point; the debating form of a quarrel rather than the fighting form
example: मीटिंग में तनख़्वाह पर लंबा मुनाक़शा हुआ — There was a long argued dispute over pay in the meeting.

hindi: गिड़गिड़ाहट भरी प्रार्थना — तन्हाई में ख़ुदा से बातचीत
definition: an intimate whispered prayer, closer to complaint and private conversation with God than to the plain asking of an ordinary prayer
example: रात के आख़िरी पहर वह मुनाजात में लगा रहता है — In the last watch of the night he stays in whispered prayer.

hindi: कपट-भाव — भीतर कुछ और, बाहर कुछ और होना
definition: hypocrisy as an inner state, the settled split between what a person believes and what he professes, the condition rather than any single show
example: मुनाफ़क़त दोस्ती को अंदर से खा जाती है — Hypocrisy eats a friendship from inside.

hindi: व्यापारिक लाभ — कारोबार से लगातार मिलने वाला
definition: profit earned in trade, the recurring margin a running business makes rather than a single lucky gain
example: दुकान का मुनाफ़ा हर महीने बढ़ रहा है — The shop's profit is rising every month.

hindi: पाखंडी — मुँह पर कुछ, पीठ पीछे कुछ
definition: a two-faced person whose stated position differs from the private one; names duplicity, not merely preaching unlived virtue
example: सामने दोस्त, पीछे शिकायत — मुनाफ़िक़ निकला। — Friend to your face, complaints behind your back; he turned out two-faced.

hindi: कंगाल — जिसके पास इस वक़्त कुछ न हो
definition: left without money, destitute in the present moment rather than poor by birth or by class
example: कल का मालिक आज मुफ़लिस है — Yesterday's owner is destitute today.

hindi: कंगाली — सबके सामने ज़ाहिर हो जाने वाली ग़रीबी
definition: poverty as visible destitution, the state of a person stripped of money and reduced in front of others
example: मुफ़लिसी छुपाए नहीं छुपती — Destitution cannot be hidden however you try.

hindi: वियोग — औपचारिक रूप से अलग होना
definition: formal parting from someone, the word used in letters and elegies where plain separation would sound too everyday
example: उनकी मुफ़ारक़त का सदमा अब तक ताज़ा है — The shock of parting from them is still fresh.

hindi: आपसी समझ — दोनों पक्षों का बीच का रास्ता निकालना
definition: the mutual understanding two sides reach to settle a dispute without either of them winning it outright
example: मुक़दमा नहीं, मुफ़ाहमत से मसला हल हुआ — The matter was solved by mutual understanding, not litigation.

hindi: धर्म-न्यायविद् — फ़तवा देने का अधिकारी विद्वान
definition: a religious scholar qualified to issue formal rulings in answer to questions of law put to him
example: मुफ़्ती साहब ने सवाल का जवाब लिखा — The jurist wrote out an answer to the question.

hindi: अतिशयोक्ति — बात को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहना
definition: deliberate overstatement in speech; treated as rhetorical decoration rather than an outright lie
example: थोड़ा मुबालग़ा है, मगर कहानी अच्छी है। — There's some exaggeration in it, but the story is good.

hindi: शास्त्रार्थ — उसूलों के तहत होने वाली इल्मी बहस
definition: a formal disputation in which two sides argue a question by rules before an audience; a quarrel is personal, this is scholarly and has a subject
example: दोनों आलिमों के बीच मुबाहसा हुआ — A formal disputation took place between the two scholars.

hindi: ग्रस्त — किसी रोग या लत में फँसा हुआ
definition: afflicted with or caught in something harmful, describing the person rather than the condition; the word a doctor and a moralist both employ
example: वो बरसों से इस बीमारी में मुब्तला है। — He has been afflicted with this illness for years.

hindi: मनाही — किसी काम पर रोक
definition: an explicit prohibition placed on an act by someone with authority, forbidding rather than merely advising against
example: यहाँ सिगरेट की मुमानअत है। — Smoking is prohibited here.

hindi: धन रोकने वाला — हिसाब से पकड़कर रखने वाला
definition: holding on to money tightly, close-fisted by deliberate discipline rather than out of plain meanness
example: वो मुम्सिक है, फ़ुज़ूल एक रुपया नहीं निकालता — He is close-fisted; he will not part with a needless rupee.

hindi: संरक्षक-गुरु — पालने और सँवारने वाला बुज़ुर्ग
definition: a mentor who raises and shapes a person rather than merely teaching a subject; a teacher hands over knowledge, this one takes responsibility for the whole character
example: वे मेरे उस्ताद ही नहीं, मुरब्बी भी थे — He was not just my teacher but the man who shaped me.

hindi: रिश्ते का लिहाज़ — जिसकी वजह से इनकार न हो सके
definition: the fellow-feeling that makes refusing someone, or being hard on them, practically impossible; obligation wearing the clothes of kindness
example: मुरव्वत में हाँ कर दी, वरना वक़्त नहीं था — I agreed out of fellow-feeling; I had no time.

hindi: प्रेषक — जो पत्र भेजता है
definition: the sender who dispatches a letter, the person whose name closes it and to whom a reply must return
example: लिफ़ाफ़े पर मुरसिल का नाम नहीं था। — There was no sender's name on the envelope.

hindi: जड़ाऊ — नगों से भरा हुआ
definition: set thickly with jewels; describes an object encrusted with ornament, most often a hilt, a crown, or a casket
example: मुरस्सा तलवार दीवार पर सजी थी। — The jewel-set sword hung on the wall.

hindi: ध्यान — बैठकर मन को एक तरफ़ लगाने का अमल
definition: the disciplined practice of sitting in watchful attention on the unseen; a method deliberately undertaken, unlike a state that overtakes one
example: वो हर सुबह मुराक़बा करते हैं — He sits in meditation every morning.

hindi: पुनरावर्तन — छोड़ी हुई जगह या बात की ओर फिर लौटना
definition: returning to a place, a text or a person once left behind, a formal word for going back to resume or to consult again
example: मसले पर पुरानी किताबों की मुराजअत ज़रूरी है — On this question a return to the older books is necessary.

hindi: मन की चाह — जिसे पाने के लिए निकला जाए
definition: the heart's wish one sets out to obtain, a purpose felt as longing rather than planned as an aim
example: मुराद पूरी हुई तो वापस आऊँगा — I will return when my wish is fulfilled.

hindi: पत्राचार — भेजी-आई चिट्ठियों का सिलसिला
definition: correspondence conducted by letter over distance, an exchange of writing rather than a single message
example: दोनों के बीच बरसों मुरासला रहा — Correspondence went on between them for years.

hindi: शिष्य — पीर के हाथ पर बैअत करने वाला
definition: a disciple who has pledged himself to a spiritual master on the mystical path, bound by obedience and not mere admiration
example: वह उस बुज़ुर्ग का मुरीद हो गया — He became a disciple of that elder.

hindi: कोमलता — बात और बरताव की नरमी
definition: softness of speech and dealing, the opposite of harshness in manner rather than weakness of will
example: मुलाइमत से कही बात ज़्यादा असर करती है। — A thing said gently has more effect.

hindi: कर्मचारी — तनख़्वाह पर रखा गया आदमी
definition: a paid employee, of a household or an office alike, bound by wages and terms; a contract of service, where a household servant belongs to the family
example: घर में दो मुलाज़िम रखे हुए हैं — They keep two employees at the house.

hindi: अवलोकन — ध्यान से देख-परख लेना
definition: the careful noting of something before judging or deciding about it; observation carried out with an eye on what will follow from it
example: काग़ज़ात का मुलाहज़ा फ़रमा लीजिए — Please look over the papers.

hindi: आरोपी — जिस पर इल्ज़ाम है पर साबित नहीं हुआ
definition: the person against whom a charge stands but has not yet been proved, an accused rather than a convict
example: मुल्ज़िम को सुने बिना फ़ैसला नहीं होता — No verdict is given without hearing the accused.

hindi: नियुक्त अदृश्य सेवक — किसी अमल या जगह पर मुक़र्रर की गई रूह
definition: an unseen being appointed to guard a place or serve whoever masters a formula; assigned, unlike a spirit that afflicts on its own
example: उस अमल का मुवक्किल बहुत सख़्त बताया जाता है — The spirit attached to that formula is said to be severe.

hindi: काव्य-गोष्ठी — शायरों का बारी-बारी शेर सुनाने का जलसा
definition: a gathering where poets recite in turn before a listening audience that answers aloud; a reading is one-way, this is a running exchange between stage and floor
example: मुशायरा सुबह चार बजे तक चला — The poetry gathering ran until four in the morning.

hindi: अवलोकन — ध्यान से देखकर निकाला गया नतीजा
definition: deliberate observation, looking at something closely enough to draw a conclusion from it; watching used as a method rather than as a pastime
example: यह मेरा अपना मुशाहिदा है, सुनी हुई बात नहीं — This comes from my own observation, not from hearsay.

hindi: कस्तूरी — हिरन से मिलने वाली तेज़ ख़ुशबू
definition: the musk taken from the deer, a scent famed for carrying far; it names the fragrance itself rather than the pod that holds it
example: हवा में मुश्क की ख़ुशबू घुली हुई थी — The scent of musk hung in the air.

hindi: कस्तूरी जैसा — गहरा काला और ख़ुशबूदार
definition: musk-like in both darkness and scent, a fragrance word that describes colour at the same time
example: उसकी मुश्कीं ज़ुल्फ़ें कंधों पर बिखरी थीं। — Her musk-dark tresses lay scattered on her shoulders.

hindi: मुट्ठी भर मिट्टी — इंसान की हैसियत का बयान
definition: a handful of dust, used to size a human being against his own arrogance; the burial image turned into an argument about pride
example: मुश्त-ए-ख़ाक होकर इतना ग़ुरूर — So much pride, from a handful of dust.

hindi: उत्सुक — मिलने को बेक़रार
definition: longing to see or meet someone, describing the person who carries the eagerness rather than the longing itself
example: हम आपकी वापसी के मुश्ताक़ हैं — We are longing for your return.

hindi: शामक दवा — दर्द दबा देने वाली दवा
definition: a medicine that quiets pain without curing its cause, relief bought for several hours; the opposite of a remedy that removes disease
example: मुसक्किन से नींद तो आई मगर मरज़ वहीं है। — The painkiller brought sleep, but the disease remains.

hindi: वश में किया हुआ — जो साध कर आज्ञाकारी बना लिया जाए
definition: brought under control and made obedient, said of a broken animal or a conquered will; the end state the untamed and the unruly resist
example: जंगली घोड़ा आख़िरकार मुसख़्ख़र हो गया — The wild horse was at last brought under control.

hindi: प्रमाणित — जिसे किसी अधिकारी ने सही ठहराया हो
definition: attested, describing a written copy certified by an authority as true to the original it was taken from
example: मुसद्दक़ा नक़ल के बग़ैर दरख़्वास्त नामंज़ूर हो जाएगी। — Without an attested copy the application will be rejected.

hindi: लेखक-ग्रंथकार — किताब लिखने वाला
definition: the author of a composed book, named by the work rather than by any literary reputation; a scholar is known for learning, this one for having written it down
example: मुसन्निफ़ ने दीबाचे में सबका शुक्रिया अदा किया — The author thanked everyone in the preface.

hindi: तय की गई दूरी — सफ़र में पार किया गया फ़ासला
definition: the measured distance of a journey, the ground actually covered rather than the trip as an experience
example: दो दिन की मुसाफ़त के बाद गाँव दिखा — The village appeared after two days' distance travelled.

hindi: यात्री — सफ़र में पड़ा हुआ आदमी
definition: a person on a journey, defined by being away from home rather than by any love of travelling
example: हर मुसाफ़िर को कहीं न कहीं पहुँचना होता है — Every traveller has somewhere he must reach.

hindi: मेल-मिलाप — दुश्मनी छोड़कर सुलह की तरफ़ झुकाव
definition: reconciliation as an attitude of settling rather than fighting, the disposition to compromise; a temperament where सुलह is a single act
example: उसने हमेशा मुसालहत का रास्ता चुना — He always chose the path of reconciliation.

hindi: भविष्य — आने वाला समय
definition: the future spoken of as a prospect being planned for; formal register, at home in speeches and bulletins
example: बच्चों का मुस्तक़बिल इसी फ़ैसले पर टिका है। — The children's future rests on this decision.

hindi: हक़दार — जिसका उस पर वाजिब हक़ बनता हो
definition: having a rightful claim to something, deserving by entitlement rather than by merit or fitness
example: वो इस मदद का असल मुस्तहक़ है। — He is the true deserving claimant of this help.

hindi: शोधकर्ता — तहक़ीक़ करके सच तक पहुँचने वाला
definition: a researcher who establishes what is true by investigation and evidence; a scholar holds inherited learning, this one tests it and adds to it
example: मुहक़्क़िक़ ने पुराने नुस्ख़े से असल इबारत निकाली — The researcher recovered the original text from an old manuscript.

hindi: निगरां — जो अफ़सरों की ज़्यादतियों की जाँच करे
definition: an official appointed to check the misconduct of other officials and hear public grievances against them; a watchdog rather than a judge of ordinary cases
example: शिकायत मुहतसिब के दफ़्तर भेज दी गई — The complaint was sent to the ombudsman's office.

hindi: मुद्रा — काग़ज़ पर लगने वाली सरकारी छाप
definition: the seal stamped on a document to attest it officially, older and weightier than a signature
example: काग़ज़ पर अदालत की मुहर लगी हुई थी। — The court's seal was stamped on the paper.

hindi: मुंशी — दफ़्तर में लिखा-पढ़ी करने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: the clerk who drafts and records writing in an office; a writer of official papers whose work is the file, not the letter
example: मुहर्रिर ने रिपोर्ट लिखकर पढ़कर सुनाई। — The clerk wrote the report and read it out.

hindi: प्रवासी — हिजरत करके आया हुआ आदमी
definition: one who has migrated from his homeland and settled elsewhere, a person named by the migration he made
example: शहर का यह हिस्सा मुहाजिरों ने बसाया — Migrants settled this part of the city.

hindi: लोकोक्ति — ज़बान का जमा हुआ लाक्षणिक बंधा-बँधाया प्रयोग
definition: a fixed turn of phrase whose meaning cannot be worked out from its words, settled by usage rather than invented by a writer
example: यह मुहावरा बोलचाल से आया है — This idiom comes out of everyday speech.

hindi: हिसाब लेना — किए हुए कामों की जाँच-पड़ताल
definition: the calling to account in which deeds are examined one by one, whether by a court, an employer or a person over himself at night; justice is the verdict, this is the audit before it
example: हर रात अपना मुहासबा कीजिए — Take account of yourself every night.

hindi: घेराबंदी — शहर या क़िले को चारों तरफ़ से घेर लेना
definition: the surrounding of a fort or city to force surrender by cutting it off, a slow squeeze rather than a direct attack
example: मुहासरा चालीस दिन तक चला — The siege lasted forty days.

hindi: अभियान — एक तय मक़सद से चलाई गई कोशिश
definition: a campaign, the planned military or civic drive aimed at one objective, longer than a battle and narrower than a war
example: सरहद पर एक बड़ी मुहिम शुरू हुई — A major campaign was launched at the border.

hindi: चींटी — मेहनती और बेहद छोटा जीव
definition: the ant among insects, the tiny creature named for patient labour and littleness; it stands for the humble against the great
example: मूर की मेहनत सुलैमान के दरबार तक पहुँची — The ant's labour reached even Solomon's court.

hindi: मेज़बानी करने वाला — जिसके घर दावत हो
definition: the host in whose house guests are received, the one who carries the duty rather than the one enjoying it
example: मेज़बान ने ख़ुद दरवाज़े पर इस्तक़बाल किया — The host welcomed us at the door himself.

hindi: इमारत बनाने वाला — जो नक़्शा बनाकर तामीर कराता है
definition: the builder who plans a structure and raises it, answering for how it stands; commands the work, where the mason only lays what he is told
example: इस मस्जिद का मेमार कौन था, किसी को याद नहीं। — Nobody remembers who the builder of this mosque was.

hindi: वास्तुकला — इमारत बनाने का फ़न और उसका अंदाज़
definition: the art of building considered as a whole, its styles and proportions; names the discipline, not any one builder or any one building raised
example: मुग़ल मेमारी में पत्थर और छाया का खेल है। — Mughal architecture plays with stone and shadow.

hindi: मेहनत करने वाला — जो हाथ के काम से रोज़ी कमाता है
definition: the person who lives by physical labour, taken as a class; names who bears the toil, where hard labour names the toil itself
example: इस बस्ती में ज़्यादातर मेहनतकश रहते हैं। — Mostly working people live in this settlement.

hindi: पारिश्रमिक — मेहनत और हुनर का मूल्य
definition: the payment made for someone's effort and skill, measured by work done rather than by time served
example: कारीगर ने अपना मेहनताना माँगा — The craftsman asked for his fee.

hindi: आतिथ्य — आने वाले को सिर-आँखों पर बिठाने की रीत
definition: hospitality treated as a matter of honour, measured by how much is pressed upon a visitor; declining the food becomes the guest's problem
example: उनकी मेहमान-नवाज़ी के आगे इनकार चलता ही नहीं — There is no refusing their hospitality.

hindi: एड़ — सवार की एड़ी में लगी नुकीली कील
definition: the spur on a rider's heel that urges the horse without a stroke; it goads by pressure where a whip goads by pain
example: मेहमेज़ लगते ही घोड़े ने रफ़्तार पकड़ ली — The horse picked up speed the moment it felt the spur.

hindi: स्त्रीधन — निकाह में पत्नी का तय किया हुआ हक़
definition: the sum a husband owes his wife under the marriage contract, her own property and her right to claim; a settlement she is owed, never a gift from her family
example: मेहर तय किए बिना निकाह मुकम्मल नहीं होता — Without a settled dower the marriage contract is not complete.

hindi: कृपा — ऊपर वाले की ओर से की गई भलाई
definition: kindness done from a position of advantage, and the ordinary word for thanking someone who did it; 'favour' sounds transactional, this does not
example: आपकी बड़ी मेहरबानी होगी — It will be a great kindness on your part.

hindi: डाट — दरवाज़े या छत का घुमावदार बना हुआ हिस्सा
definition: the curved span built over an opening so the wall above it holds; carries weight sideways to its supports instead of standing under it
example: दरवाज़े की मेहराब पर बेल-बूटे तराशे हुए हैं। — Vines are carved on the arch of the doorway.

hindi: चमत्कार — नबी के हाथों होने वाला क़ुदरत से बाहर का काम
definition: a wonder worked through a prophet as proof of his message, breaking the ordinary course of nature; reserved for prophets alone
example: ये किसी मोजिज़ा से कम नहीं था — This was nothing short of a miracle.

hindi: मोर्चाबंदी की जगह — लड़ाई में डटने का ठिकाना
definition: the front position a fighting side holds on a battlefield, the place you take, defend and abandon; also the political front one opens
example: उसने अकेले मोर्चा सँभाले रखा — He held the front alone.

hindi: परमुखापेक्षी — दूसरे के सहारे का ज़रूरतमंद
definition: made dependent on another person's money or help, poor in the sense of needing rather than merely lacking
example: वो किसी का मोहताज नहीं रहना चाहता — He does not want to be dependent on anyone.

hindi: परमुखापेक्षिता — अपनी ज़रूरत के लिए दूसरों के आगे हाथ फैलाना
definition: poverty experienced as dependence, where money must be asked for from another person; the shame is in the asking, not the lack
example: मोहताजी से मौत बेहतर है, वो यही कहता रहा — Death is better than dependence, he kept saying.

hindi: अवधि की छूट — काम पूरा करने को दिया गया अतिरिक्त समय
definition: a granted extension of time; a reprieve handed over by someone who could have refused it
example: दो दिन की और मोहलत दे दीजिए। — Grant me two more days.

hindi: प्राणनाशक — जिसका नतीजा मौत ही हो
definition: fatal rather than merely dangerous, said of a wound or a disease whose outcome is death; the clinical register where जान-लेवा is the spoken one
example: ज़ख़्म मोहलिक साबित हुआ — The wound proved fatal.

hindi: स्थगित — किसी और बात के इंतज़ार में रोका हुआ
definition: held up and pending, suspended until something else arrives or is decided rather than cancelled outright
example: फ़ैसला गवाह के आने तक मौक़ूफ़ है — The decision is held pending the witness's arrival.

hindi: चमड़े का मोज़ा — जूते के अंदर पाँव पर पहना जाता है
definition: a soft leather sock covering the feet inside the shoe, wiped over instead of washed at ablution
example: सर्दी में वुज़ू के लिए मौज़ा पहन लेते हैं। — In winter they wear leather socks for ablution.

hindi: विषय — जिस चीज़ पर बात या रचना हो रही हो
definition: the subject a piece of writing or a discussion is about, the topic named before the work begins, as against the content it eventually carries
example: आज की गुफ़्तगू का मौज़ू संगीत है — Today's discussion has music as its subject.

hindi: उत्तराधिकार में मिला — विरासत के हक़ से हासिल
definition: held by right of inheritance and transferable to heirs, the legal description of family property; a claim in law, where hereditary describes long custom
example: मौरूसी ज़मीन का बँटवारा अदालत में हुआ — The division of the inherited land happened in court.

hindi: नवजात — अभी-अभी जन्मा बच्चा
definition: a child considered in the moment of birth itself, named by the act that produced it rather than by age
example: मौलूद के कान में अज़ान दी गई। — The call was recited in the newborn's ear.

hindi: एकाग्रता — ध्यान का एक ही तरफ़ जमा रहना
definition: singleness of attention, the mind turned one way and kept there; a passing act of noticing is momentary, this is a held state that work requires
example: पढ़ाई यकसूई माँगती है — Study demands undivided attention.

hindi: विश्वास — संदेह से परे पक्का भरोसा
definition: certainty held without doubt, closer to conviction than to belief; used for what a person would stake something on
example: मुझे यक़ीन है कि वो वक़्त पर पहुँचेगा। — I'm certain he'll arrive on time.

hindi: बर्फ़ — जमा हुआ पानी
definition: frozen water turned solid with cold, the hard result of freezing rather than the snow that falls from above
example: तालाब के किनारे यख़ जम गई थी। — Ice had formed at the edge of the pond.

hindi: गोश्त का उबाला पानी — जिससे सालन की बुनियाद बनती है
definition: the stock got by boiling meat and bones, used as the base for cooking other dishes rather than served as food itself
example: पुलाव यख़नी में पकाया जाता है। — The pulao is cooked in meat stock.

hindi: अनाथ — जिसका बाप मर चुका हो
definition: a child left fatherless, singled out in religious and legal texts as owed protection and charity; not merely a child without both parents
example: यतीम बच्चों के लिए अलग वक़्फ़ बना — A separate endowment was made for orphaned children.

hindi: अनाथपन — माँ-बाप के बिना बचपन बीतना
definition: the condition of growing up without parents, naming the lack itself rather than the child who carries it
example: यतीमी ने उसे उम्र से पहले बड़ा कर दिया। — Orphanhood made him grown-up before his years.

hindi: धावा — अचानक किया गया तेज़ हमला
definition: a sudden massed charge on an enemy or a place, an assault made at speed rather than a planned campaign
example: भोर से पहले यलग़ार का हुक्म हुआ — The order for the assault came before dawn.

hindi: माणिक — गहरे लाल रंग का क़ीमती पत्थर
definition: a ruby, named in verse for the deep red of lips and wine rather than for its market price
example: उसके होंठ याक़ूत जैसे थे — Her lips were like rubies.

hindi: स्मरण कराना — भूली हुई बात दोबारा याद दिलाना
definition: reminding someone of a duty they have let slip, a nudge to memory rather than a demand for action
example: एक याद-दहानी भेज दीजिए। — Please send a reminder.

hindi: हताशा — उम्मीद का पूरी तरह ख़त्म हो जाना
definition: utter despair in which the longing itself gives out, a literary word much heavier than ordinary disappointment
example: उसके चेहरे पर यास की परछाईं थी — There was a shadow of despair on his face.

hindi: रंग-रूप — चेहरे का रंग जो हाल बता देता है
definition: the colour of a face read as a report on health or feeling; complexion treated as evidence, which is why it drains away and comes back
example: दवा से चेहरे की रंगत लौट आई — The medicine brought the colour back to her face.

hindi: रंगाई करने वाला — बुने कपड़े को रंग देने वाला
definition: the dyer who colours cloth after it is woven; he changes the colour, he neither weaves nor stitches
example: रंगरेज़ ने दुपट्टा गहरा सुर्ख़ रंग दिया। — The dyer coloured the wrap a deep red.

hindi: रंगों की भरमार — चटक रंगों से भरा होना
definition: the abundance of colour in a scene or a temperament, brightness rather than the newness that freshness names
example: बहार की रंगीनी देखते ही बनती है। — The colourfulness of spring has to be seen.

hindi: क्षोभ — किसी के बर्ताव से पहुँचा भीतरी कष्ट
definition: hurt caused by a particular person's behaviour, held quietly instead of voiced; unlike sorrow it always has an address
example: मुझे उसकी बात का रंज है, ग़ुस्सा नहीं — What he said hurt me; I am not angry.

hindi: मनमुटाव — दिल में बैठा हुआ पुराना गिला
definition: a settled grievance between relatives that keeps them cold to each other without open quarrel; resentment stored up, not a fight breaking out
example: दोनों भाइयों में बरसों की रंजिश है — There is years-old resentment between the two brothers.

hindi: रोग और दुख से टूटा — बीमारी से बेहाल
definition: worn down by illness and sorrow together, sick in body and spirit at once; unlike simply unwell, it names the wearing
example: बीमारी ने उसे रंजूर कर दिया है। — The illness has left him worn in body and spirit.

hindi: कुलीन धनी — ख़ानदानी दौलत और रुतबे वाला
definition: a wealthy person of established family whose money carries inherited rank, standing rather than mere property
example: शहर के रईस उस जलसे में जमा थे — The wealthy notables of the city had gathered at that assembly.

hindi: प्रतिद्वंद्वी — एक ही प्रिय का दूसरा चाहने वाला
definition: the rival for a beloved's attention, an adversary with almost formal standing instead of a passing competitor
example: दोनों दोस्त थे, फिर एक ही लड़की के रक़ीब बन गए। — They were friends, then became rivals over the same girl.

hindi: पायदान — ज़ीन से लटकी हुई पाँव रखने की कड़ी
definition: the stirrup hanging from the saddle for the rider's foot, the piece of riding gear that steadies him; to hold it is to attend on a great man
example: पाँव रकाब में डालते ही वो घोड़े पर चढ़ गया — He put his foot in the stirrup and mounted.

hindi: रुचि — किसी चीज़ की तरफ़ मन का झुकाव
definition: an inclination or leaning toward something, wholesome or not, weaker than craving and stronger than mere liking; it is a tilt, not yet a hunger
example: उसे पढ़ाई में रग़बत नहीं रही — He no longer has any inclination for study.

hindi: प्रसन्न-स्वीकृति — जो हुआ उसी पर राज़ी हो जाना
definition: willing contentment with whatever God decrees, going past submission to actually wanting what was given
example: उनकी रज़ा में हमारी भलाई है — Our good lies in accepting His will gladly.

hindi: दूध का रिश्ता — एक ही स्त्री का दूध पीने से बना संबंध
definition: the kinship created when two children are nursed by the same woman, which bars marriage between them like blood relation; family made by milk, not by descent
example: रज़ाअत की वजह से ये रिश्ता जाइज़ नहीं — Because of milk kinship this match is not permissible.

hindi: सहमति — दोनों तरफ़ की ख़ुशी से मिली रज़ा
definition: willing consent to an arrangement, agreement given freely instead of extracted under pressure
example: लड़की की रज़ामंदी के बग़ैर निकाह नहीं होता। — There is no marriage without the girl's willing consent.

hindi: रणभूमि — जंग का पूरा मैदान
definition: the battlefield itself as ground, the arena where armies meet, naming the whole field rather than one position on it
example: सुबह तक रज़्मगाह ख़ामोश हो चुकी थी — By morning the battlefield had fallen silent.

hindi: टेक — हर शेर के अंत में ज्यों का त्यों दोहराया जाने वाला शब्द
definition: the word or phrase repeated unchanged at the end of every rhyming line of a ghazal, sitting after the rhyme and giving the poem its refrain
example: इस ग़ज़ल की रदीफ़ बहुत मुश्किल है — The refrain of this ghazal is very difficult.

hindi: साथ निभाना — सफ़र और ज़िंदगी का संग
definition: steady companionship over time, the walking-alongside kind of love rather than the meeting or the longing
example: बीस साल की रफ़ाक़त कोई छोटी बात नहीं — Twenty years of companionship is no small thing.

hindi: सहचर — भरोसे का साथी
definition: a trusted comrade who stays with you through a journey or an undertaking, closer than a chance companion
example: मुश्किल वक़्त में वही रफ़ीक़ निकला — In hard times he proved the true comrade.

hindi: अदृश्य सिलाई — जिससे कपड़े का सूराख़ छुप जाए
definition: the invisible darning of a hole in a garment so that afterwards the tear cannot be found
example: जला हुआ हिस्सा ऐसा रफ़ू हुआ कि पता न चला। — The burnt part was darned so well that nothing showed.

hindi: गति — चलने की तेज़ी या धीमापन
definition: the speed at which something moves or proceeds, the rate of a journey rather than its length
example: गाड़ी की रफ़्तार कम करो — Reduce the speed of the car.

hindi: रबाब — तारों वाला पुराना गज़-साज़
definition: the bowed string instrument of the older courts, plaintive in tone and tied to sufi music; a named instrument, not the general class
example: रबाब की आवाज़ ने पूरी रात उदास कर दी। — The sound of the rabab saddened the whole night.

hindi: रवाना होना — चल पड़ने की घड़ी
definition: the act and timing of setting off on a journey, the plain fact of departure recorded rather than the feeling of parting
example: गाड़ी की रवानगी शाम पाँच बजे है — The train's departure is at five in the evening.

hindi: प्रवाह — लिखी या बोली गई भाषा का बहाव
definition: the flow of written or spoken language, moving forward without stumbling; ease of movement, not simplicity of words
example: उसकी तहरीर में ग़ज़ब की रवानी है। — There is a remarkable flow in his writing.

hindi: चलन — बरताव और चलने का ढंग
definition: a person's habitual way of conducting themselves, walk and manner taken together; style read as behaviour over time
example: उसकी रविश में शराफ़त झलकती है — Decency shows through in his manner.

hindi: सराहना भरी ईर्ष्या — काश मुझे भी ऐसा मिलता
definition: envy that admires rather than resents, wishing the same good for oneself without wishing the other to lose it
example: उनकी दोस्ती पर रश्क आता है — Their friendship makes one envious in the admiring way.

hindi: फ़ौज का राशन — घेरे या लड़ाई में भेजा जाने वाला खाना
definition: food supplies sent out to an army, a camp or a besieged town, provisions in transit rather than grain sitting in a store
example: क़िले तक रसद पहुँचना बंद हो गई। — Supplies of food stopped reaching the fort.

hindi: दूत — नई शरीअत लेकर भेजा गया पैग़ंबर
definition: a messenger prophet sent with a scripture and a law, a higher station than one who only receives revelation
example: हर रसूल नबी है, हर नबी रसूल नहीं — Every messenger is a prophet; not every prophet is a messenger.

hindi: लिपि — किसी भाषा को लिखने की स्वीकृत वर्ण-व्यवस्था
definition: a writing system, the agreed set of letters in which a language is written down; the script itself, distinct from any style of forming it
example: एक ज़बान, दो रस्म-उल-ख़त। — One language, two scripts.

hindi: राह — वह रास्ता जिससे कोई गुज़रता है
definition: the road along which someone passes, named from the passing itself and common in verse about waiting on a route
example: वह उसी रहगुज़र पर खड़ा रहा — He kept standing on that very road.

hindi: बंधक — क़र्ज़ की ज़मानत में रखी गई चीज़
definition: property handed over as security for a debt, a thing pledged where a surety would have pledged himself
example: ज़मीन रहन रखकर उसने बेटी की शादी की। — He pledged the land as security to marry off his daughter.

hindi: पथप्रदर्शक — राह बताने वाला अगुआ
definition: one who shows the way to others, a guide whose authority is moral or political as often as literal
example: क़ौम को सच्चे रहनुमा की ज़रूरत है — The nation needs a true guide.

hindi: मार्गदर्शन — रास्ता दिखा कर आगे बढ़ाना
definition: guidance that shows someone the way forward through a subject or a difficulty; correction repairs what exists, this points to what should come next
example: उनकी रहनुमाई के बिना यह काम न होता — This work would not have happened without his guidance.

hindi: मार्गदर्शक — रास्ता दिखाने वाला
definition: one who leads travellers along the right road, a guide trusted with the way rather than merely consulted
example: अच्छा रहबर मिल जाए तो सफ़र आसान है — With a good guide the journey is easy.

hindi: अगुवाई — रास्ता दिखाते हुए साथ चलना
definition: the act of leading someone along a difficult path, guidance that walks with you instead of merely pointing
example: इस मुश्किल वक़्त में उनकी रहबरी काम आई। — Their leadership helped us in this difficult time.

hindi: दया — तकलीफ़ देखकर नरम पड़ जाना
definition: mercy that softens a punishment out of pity for the offender's condition, granted from above and never owed; the opposite of what इंसाफ़ demands
example: क़ातिल ने अदालत से रहम की भीख माँगी — The murderer begged the court for mercy.

hindi: कृपा — ईश्वर की दया, जो बरसती है
definition: divine mercy imagined as something that descends and covers, the compassion of God rather than the kindness of a person
example: यह बारिश नहीं, रहमत है — This is not rain, it is divine mercy.

hindi: दयालु — तरस खाकर माफ़ कर देने वाला
definition: merciful, quick to soften toward someone already in your power; mercy where plain goodness is only goodwill
example: जज रहमदिल था, सज़ा कम कर दी। — The judge was merciful and reduced the sentence.

hindi: तेज़ चलने वाला घोड़ा — सफ़र का सवारी-घोड़ा
definition: a swift riding horse kept for the road, a mount valued for covering distance rather than for show
example: रहवार ने रास्ता आधे वक़्त में तय किया — The steed covered the road in half the time.

hindi: गंध — किसी चीज़ से उठने वाली बू
definition: the smell a thing gives off, named neutrally so it may be pleasant or foul unlike a word for perfume
example: मिट्टी की राइहा दूर तक फैली थी। — The smell of the earth carried a long way.

hindi: व्यर्थ — बिना नतीजे के चला गया
definition: of effort, time or a life that was spent and produced nothing; wasted, judged after the fact
example: उसकी सारी मेहनत राएगाँ गई — All his labour went to waste.

hindi: रुझान रखने वाला — जिसका मन किसी ओर खिंचे
definition: inclined and drawn towards something by desire, at the stage of attraction rather than of habit or affliction
example: आजकल वो तसव्वुफ़ की तरफ़ राग़िब है। — These days he is inclined towards mysticism.

hindi: भेद निभाना — किसी का राज़ अपने पास रखना
definition: the keeping of another person's secret as a duty, concealment that is loyalty rather than deceit
example: दोस्ती की पहली शर्त राज़-दारी है — The first condition of friendship is keeping secrets.

hindi: भेद रखना — किसी का राज़ अपने पास रखने का गुण
definition: the reliability of keeping what someone confided to you, a standing quality rather than one act of concealment; covering a fault is a favour, this is a trust
example: उसकी राज़दारी पर पूरा भरोसा है — I trust him completely to keep a secret.

hindi: जो मिला उसी में संतुष्ट — होनी को ख़ुशी से क़बूल करने वाला
definition: content with whatever has been decreed, accepting the outcome willingly rather than merely enduring it
example: वो हर हाल में राज़ी-ब-रज़ा रहता है। — He stays content with his lot in every condition.

hindi: समझौता-पत्र — दोनों फ़रीक़ों की लिखित रज़ामंदी
definition: the written settlement recording that both parties have agreed and the dispute is closed; the document a court accepts to end a case
example: अदालत में राज़ीनामा दाख़िल कर दिया गया — The written settlement was filed in court.

hindi: लावण्य — रंग-रूप की ताज़गी और लोच
definition: the fresh supple loveliness of a young face or body, beauty with sap still in it; bloom rather than grandeur or polish
example: उसकी आवाज़ में भी वही रानाई थी — There was the same freshness in her voice too.

hindi: संपर्क — बात-चीत का सिलसिला बनाए रखना
definition: the working contact kept up between two parties, maintained by messages and visits, unlike a connection that exists whether or not anyone tends it
example: बरसों बाद उनसे राबिता हुआ — Contact with them was made after years.

hindi: राह चलता आदमी — रास्ते से गुज़रने वाला अजनबी
definition: a passer-by on the road, a stranger met in transit whose journey has nothing to do with yours
example: एक राहगीर ने रुक कर पता बता दिया — A passer-by stopped and gave the address.

hindi: डाकू — राह में लूटने वाला
definition: a robber who waits on the road to plunder travellers, preying on people in transit rather than in their homes
example: उस घाटी में राहज़न का ख़तरा है — There is danger of highwaymen in that valley.

hindi: राह में लूट — मुसाफ़िरों को लूटने का काम
definition: robbery committed on the road against travellers, the practice itself rather than the man who commits it
example: इस इलाक़े में राहज़नी आम थी — Highway robbery was common in this area.

hindi: पथिक — रास्ते पर चलता हुआ
definition: one who is on the road, defined by the walking itself rather than by any destination ever reached
example: इस रास्ते का हर राहरौ थका हुआ है — Every traveller on this road is tired.

hindi: पथिक — सफ़र में चलता रहने वाला
definition: one who keeps walking a road, a wayfarer named for the movement itself rather than for the destination
example: राही को ठहरना नहीं आता — A wayfarer does not know how to stay put.

hindi: बेपरवा शराबी — जो पीता भी है और शर्मिंदा भी नहीं
definition: the drinker who wears his drinking as a creed and refuses the preacher's shame; not a drunkard but a declared unbeliever in respectability
example: वो रिंद है, उससे तौबा की उम्मीद मत रखो। — He is that kind of drinker; expect no repentance from him.

hindi: छूट — हालात देखकर दी गई नरमी
definition: an allowance made for somebody's circumstances, a rule deliberately softened; concession when it concerns money, consideration when it concerns conduct
example: बच्चा है, थोड़ी रिआयत कर दो — He is only a child; make some allowance.

hindi: द्रवित होना — सुनकर दिल का पिघल जाना
definition: the melting of the heart at a pitiful sight or sound, compassion as a sudden physical softening that often brings tears; sympathy is felt, this overtakes you
example: उस मंज़र पर रिक़्क़त तारी हो गई — That sight left everyone's heart melting.

hindi: जीविका — ऊपर से बँटा हुआ हिस्सा
definition: the sustenance allotted to a person, livelihood seen as granted from above rather than as something earned
example: रिज़्क़ कहीं और लिखा था, इसलिए शहर छोड़ना पड़ा — His sustenance was written elsewhere, so he had to leave the city.

hindi: बिना सिली चादर — ऊपरी बदन पर लपेटी जाने वाली
definition: a plain unstitched outer cloth wrapped over the upper body; a wrap rather than a tailored robe
example: हाजी सफ़ेद रिदा लपेटे तवाफ़ कर रहे थे। — The pilgrim circled wrapped in white unstitched cloth.

hindi: हराम ब्याज — धार्मिक रूप से मना किया गया सूद
definition: interest condemned as unlawful gain, the religious term that treats money charged on a debt as forbidden
example: उसने बैंक का मुनाफ़ा रिबा कहकर छोड़ दिया — He gave up the bank's return, calling it unlawful interest.

hindi: दिखावा — दूसरों को दिखाने के लिए की गई नेकी
definition: doing a good or pious act so that people will see it, which empties the act of worth; the deed is real, the intention behind it is the fraud
example: रिया की इबादत बेकार है — Worship done for show is worthless.

hindi: पाखंड — दिखावे के लिए की गई नेकी
definition: goodness or piety performed for onlookers; virtue done in order to be seen, which is exactly what separates it from the real thing
example: इबादत में रियाकारी सबसे बड़ी ख़राबी है — Show in worship is its worst flaw.

hindi: साधना — कठिन अभ्यास से नफ़्स को साधना
definition: austere spiritual exercise, devotion practised as hard training of the self rather than as prescribed worship
example: सालों की रियाज़त के बाद वह मक़ाम मिला — That station came after years of austere practice.

hindi: राज्य — अपनी हद और अपने निज़ाम वाला मुल्क या प्रांत
definition: a state as a bounded political unit with its own administration, whether a former princely domain or the modern state as an institution
example: रियासत हर शहरी की हिफ़ाज़त की ज़िम्मेदार है — The state is responsible for the safety of every citizen.

hindi: घूस — फ़ैसला मोड़ने के लिए दिया गया पैसा
definition: money paid to an official to bend a decision, a bribe rather than a lawful charge or an honest gift
example: फ़ाइल आगे बढ़ाने के लिए रिश्वत माँगी गई — A bribe was demanded to move the file forward.

hindi: कूच — दुनिया से चल बसने का सफ़र-जैसा बयान
definition: death spoken of as a departure on a journey rather than an ending, the literary word that keeps the traveller moving instead of stopping
example: उनकी रिहलत के बाद घर सूना पड़ गया — After his departure the house fell silent.

hindi: रहने का इंतज़ाम — रहने की जगह और सुविधा
definition: living accommodation arranged for someone, the housing provided rather than the legal address of residence
example: कंपनी ने रिहाइश का बंदोबस्त कर दिया — The company arranged accommodation.

hindi: छुटकारा — क़ैद या बंधन से आज़ादी
definition: release from confinement or obligation, a physical freeing rather than a spiritual deliverance; the prison door is the picture behind it
example: छह महीने बाद उसकी रिहाई हुई — He was released after six months.

hindi: पुर्ज़ा — जल्दी में लिखी गई दो पंक्ति की चिट्ठी
definition: a short letter or slip of a few lines sent in haste; a note rather than a full written letter, meant to be read at once
example: बस एक रुक़्आ भेज दिया कि आज नहीं आ सकूँगा। — I just sent a short note saying I could not come today.

hindi: कमर से झुकना — नमाज़ में आधा झुकाव
definition: the bow from the waist in ritual prayer, a lesser bending than placing the forehead on the ground
example: रुकू में हाथ घुटनों पर रखे जाते हैं — In the bow the hands rest on the knees.

hindi: चेहरा — मुख का वह हिस्सा जो सामने हो
definition: the face as the side turned towards you, and by extension the direction a matter is currently facing
example: उसने रुख़ मोड़ लिया — He turned his face away.

hindi: गाल — चेहरे का वह हिस्सा जिस पर रंग चढ़ता और आँसू बहते हैं
definition: the cheek as the part of the face where colour rises and tears run down; the tender word for it, never the anatomical one
example: आँसू रुख़सार पर आकर ठहर गए — The tears stopped on her cheek.

hindi: विदाई — जाने की इजाज़त और उसका लम्हा
definition: the formal leave-taking itself, permission to depart granted and accepted; unlike a casual goodbye it marks a departure the household has agreed to
example: बेटी की रुख़्सत के वक़्त सब चुप खड़े थे — At the moment of the daughter's leave-taking everyone stood silent.

hindi: विदाई — ख़ासकर दुल्हन के घर से जाने की रस्म
definition: the ceremony of sending someone off, especially a bride leaving her family home for good
example: रुख़्सती के वक़्त सब रो पड़े — Everyone wept at the send-off.

hindi: वापसी — ग़लत रास्ते से लौट आना
definition: turning back toward the right course or the right authority after having strayed, the movement that repentance requires; repentance is the vow, this is the return itself
example: देर हो गई मगर उसने रुजू कर लिया — It was late, but he turned back.

hindi: दर्जा — समाज या ओहदे में मिला हुआ मक़ाम
definition: the rank a person holds in the eyes of others, standing conferred by position rather than earned by character
example: रुतबा बढ़ा तो दोस्त कम होते गए — As his rank rose, his friends grew fewer.

hindi: आर्द्रता — हवा में मौजूद नमी की मात्रा
definition: humidity, the measurable amount of moisture the air is holding, spoken of as a condition of climate rather than of a surface
example: साहिली शहरों में रुतूबत बहुत ज़्यादा रहती है। — Humidity stays very high in coastal cities.

hindi: चौपदी — चार पंक्तियों की कविता जो एक ही बात पर घूमती है
definition: a quatrain of four lines turning on a single thought, the whole written argument delivered in the last line
example: उमर ख़य्याम की रुबाई सबको याद है। — Everyone remembers that quatrain of Omar Khayyam.

hindi: सच्चा ख़्वाब — वह सपना जो महज़ ख़याल नहीं, इशारा माना जाता है
definition: a dream held to carry true meaning from beyond, weighty enough to act on; the religious sense of dreaming, not idle night-images
example: उन्हें रुया में एक सफ़ेद घोड़ा दिखाई दिया — In a true dream he saw a white horse.

hindi: बदनाम — जिसकी बात खुलकर हँसी बन गई हो
definition: disgraced before people, describing the person after exposure where बे-नक़ाब describes only that the mask is off
example: वह सारे शहर में रुसवा हुआ — He was disgraced through the whole city.

hindi: बदनामी — सबके सामने भेद खुल जाना
definition: the disgrace of having one's private matter laid open to everyone's view; a shame that consists precisely in being seen
example: इस झगड़े से सिर्फ़ रुसवाई हाथ आई — All that quarrel earned us was public disgrace.

hindi: आमने-सामने — मुँह के ठीक सामने, सीधे
definition: face to face and in person; said of an encounter with nothing standing between two people, as against messages, rumour or hearsay
example: यह बात रू-ब-रू कहनी थी — This should have been said face to face.

hindi: प्राण — किसी काम या जमात की जान, जिसके बिना सब ठप
definition: the animating soul of an enterprise, the one whose withdrawal would stop everything; names indispensability, not rank or title
example: वो इस तहरीक की रूह-ए-रवाँ थे — He was the living soul of this movement.

hindi: आध्यात्मिकता — रूह की तरबियत और उसका असर
definition: the cultivated inward life of the soul that shows as presence in a person or place; spirituality as a quality, not a single spiritual act
example: उनकी बातों में एक अजीब रूहानियत है — There is a strange spirituality in his words.

hindi: आत्मिक — जिस्म से नहीं, रूह से ताल्लुक़ रखने वाला
definition: belonging to the unseen life of the soul rather than the body or the world; spiritual in substance, not merely religious in form
example: उस महफ़िल में एक रूहानी सुकून था — There was a spiritual calm in that gathering.

hindi: सुगंधित पत्ती — तुलसी जैसी ख़ुशबूदार बूटी
definition: a sweet-smelling herb valued for its leaf, the plant one grows for scent rather than for any flower it shows
example: आँगन में रैहान की क्यारी लगी थी। — A bed of sweet basil was planted in the courtyard.

hindi: ढलान पर — जिसका उतार शुरू हो चुका हो
definition: of something already turned toward its decline though not yet fallen; marks the direction, where the nouns mark the process
example: ये कारोबार अब रो-ब-ज़वाल है — This business is now on the decline.

hindi: दैनिकी — रोज़-रोज़ की घटनाओं का लिखित लेखा
definition: a day-by-day written record of events entered as they happen; a running journal rather than an account written up afterwards
example: थाने का रोज़नामचा रोज़ भरा जाता है। — The station day-book is filled in every day.

hindi: दैनिक जीविका — दिन-ब-दिन का पेट भरने वाला
definition: daily bread, the earning that feeds a person day by day rather than wealth that piles up over years
example: मज़दूर की रोज़ी बारिश ने मार दी — The rain destroyed the labourer's daily earning.

hindi: रुतबे का असर — जिससे सामने वाला सहम जाए
definition: the intimidating impressiveness someone projects, often deliberately put on show; cruder and more transactional than दबदबा
example: उसने अफ़सर होने का रोब जमाया — He threw his weight around as an officer.

hindi: चहल-पहल — जिससे जगह जीवंत और सुंदर लगे
definition: the liveliness that makes a place look bright and worth being in, beauty of bustle rather than of form
example: उसके आते ही महफ़िल में रौनक़ आ गई — The gathering came alive the moment he arrived.

hindi: झरोखा — दीवार में ऊपर बना छोटा सूराख़
definition: the small high vent above a door or window, letting daylight and air into a room without giving anyone a view
example: कमरे में सिर्फ़ रौशनदान से धूप आती थी — Sunlight entered the room only through the high vent.

hindi: मुफ़्त खाना — दरगाह या मस्जिद से बँटने वाला सबका खाना
definition: free cooked food given out to all comers at a shrine or mosque kitchen, charity served as a meal and never as coins
example: दरगाह पर रोज़ लंगर बँटता है। — Free food is served daily at the shrine.

hindi: स्वादिष्ट — जिसका ज़ाइक़ा मज़ा देता हो
definition: delicious, said of food whose taste gives real pleasure to eat; praises the dish rather than the cook or the appetite
example: खाना इतना लज़ीज़ था कि सब ख़त्म हो गया। — The food was so delicious that all of it went.

hindi: स्वाद का आनंद — खाने से मिलने वाला मज़ा
definition: the pleasure that a good taste gives the eater, the delight rather than the flavour itself; a dish has taste, the eater has this
example: पहले निवाले की लज़्ज़त कुछ और थी। — The pleasure of the first mouthful was something else.

hindi: कोमल सुघड़ता — बारीक और नफ़ीस सुंदरता
definition: the delicate refinement of beauty, its fineness rather than its force; beauty that rewards a careful look instead of striking from across a room
example: उसके चेहरे में एक अजीब लताफ़त है — There is a strange delicacy in her face.

hindi: सूक्ष्म — हल्का और महीन, जो भारी न लगे
definition: subtle and light almost to the point of not being there, used of a scent, a joke and a feeling alike
example: इसमें एक लतीफ़ तंज़ छिपा है — A subtle jibe is hidden in this.

hindi: होंठ — मुँह के किनारे
definition: the lips in the register where they are the seat of speech and of silence rather than a body part
example: उसके लब हिले तक नहीं — His lips did not even move.

hindi: छलकता हुआ — किनारे तक भरा
definition: filled right to the brim so that a touch would spill it, said of a goblet and of a heart; full to the edge rather than merely full
example: जाम लबरेज़ था और हाथ काँप रहा था। — The cup was brimful and the hand was shaking.

hindi: मुँहामुँह भरा — पूरी तरह लबों तक
definition: packed completely full with no room left, said of vessels and crowded places alike; emphasises quantity where the brim-word emphasises the edge
example: मयकदा आज लबालब भरा हुआ था। — The tavern was packed full today.

hindi: झलक — रौशनी की एक क्षणिक चमक
definition: a brief gleam of light that shows and vanishes, a flash lasting a moment rather than a steady spreading brightness
example: अँधेरे में किसी शीशे का लम्अ नज़र आया। — A gleam of glass showed in the dark.

hindi: क्षण — बीतते ही हाथ से निकल जाने वाला पल
definition: a single moment held up for attention; suggests something irretrievable rather than merely short
example: वो लम्हा ज़िंदगी भर याद रहेगा। — That moment will stay with me all my life.

hindi: कँपकँपी — डर या सर्दी से जिस्म का काँपना
definition: the trembling that runs through a body under dread or cold; the visible shaking, where terror names what causes it
example: उसके बदन पर लरज़ा तारी था — A trembling had come over his body.

hindi: कँपकँपी — बुख़ार से पहले का काँपना
definition: the shivering attack that runs ahead of a fever, the body shaking while the heat rises; a symptom, not the fever itself
example: लर्ज़ा आया और फिर तेज़ बुख़ार चढ़ गया। — The shivering came, and then the fever climbed.

hindi: सेना — कूच करती फ़ौज अपने साज़-सामान के साथ
definition: an army on the move with its camp and baggage, the host as a travelling mass rather than the standing institution
example: लश्कर नदी के किनारे पड़ाव डाले हुए था — The army was encamped along the river.

hindi: स्वर-भंगिमा — कहने का ढंग, जिससे अर्थ बदल जाए
definition: the tone and inflection a sentence is delivered in; the part of speech that decides whether identical words wound or comfort
example: अल्फ़ाज़ ठीक थे, लहजा ग़लत था। — The words were right; the tone was wrong.

hindi: क़ब्र का ताक़ — गड्ढे के भीतर बनी वह जगह जहाँ जिस्म लिटाया जाता है
definition: the side niche cut inside a dug grave where the body is actually laid, the innermost hollow rather than the whole pit or the marked grave above
example: लहद में उतारते वक़्त सब ख़ामोश थे — Everyone was silent as he was lowered into the niche.

hindi: निष्फल — जिससे कुछ हासिल न हो
definition: of a pursuit that can yield nothing however long it is continued; futile by nature, not merely wasted this time
example: ये बहस बिलकुल ला-हासिल है — This argument is entirely futile.

hindi: असाध्य — जिसका कोई इलाज न हो
definition: beyond any remedy, said of a disease no treatment can touch; states the outcome, not how long the illness lasts
example: मरज़ लाइलाज है, बस तकलीफ़ कम की जा सकती है। — The disease is incurable; only the suffering can be eased.

hindi: बेपरवा — जिसे किसी की परवाह ही नहीं
definition: indifferent to consequence and to opinion in the tavern's own manner; describes a settled temperament, never a passing state of drink
example: उसका लाउबाली रवैया दफ़्तर में नहीं चलता। — His devil-may-care manner does not work in an office.

hindi: दुबला — कमज़ोरी से पतला पड़ा हुआ
definition: thin from weakness and poor nourishment, the leanness that signals failing health rather than fitness
example: बीमारी के बाद घोड़ा लाग़र हो गया। — After the sickness the horse grew gaunt.

hindi: अनिवार्य — जिससे बचा न जा सके
definition: describing what is obligatory and cannot be set aside, a duty the situation itself imposes on you
example: अब जवाब देना तुम पर लाज़िम है। — Answering is now obligatory upon you.

hindi: लालों का मैदान — लाल फूलों से भरी ज़मीन
definition: a stretch of ground made red by wild tulips in flower; greenness that has turned into a field of colour
example: बहार में वो ढलान लालाज़ार बन जाती है। — In spring that slope becomes a field of tulips.

hindi: निर्वारिस — जिसका कोई वारिस या रिश्तेदार न हो
definition: left without heir or claiming relative, so that nobody comes forward for the person or the property; absence of kin, not absence of spouse or children
example: लावारिस लाश को कमेटी ने दफ़्न किया — The committee buried the unclaimed body.

hindi: मुँह-नाक पर बाँधा कपड़ा — आँखें खुली रहती हैं
definition: a cloth wound over the mouth and nose, covering the lower face while leaving the eyes free
example: रेगिस्तान में लिथाम बाँधे बग़ैर चलना मुश्किल है। — In the desert it is hard to walk without a face cloth.

hindi: आवरण — पत्र बंद करके भेजने का काग़ज़ी ख़ोल
definition: the envelope a letter is sealed into for sending; also an outer covering that hides how little it actually carries
example: लिफ़ाफ़ा खोलने से पहले हाथ काँप रहे थे। — My hands were shaking before I opened the envelope.

hindi: पहनावा — जो कपड़े इंसान की पहचान बन जाते हैं
definition: clothing taken as the whole image a person presents to the world, not any single garment; dress as identity rather than as cloth
example: सादा लिबास में भी उसका रुतबा छुपता नहीं था। — Even in plain dress his standing did not stay hidden.

hindi: संकोच — किसी का मान देखकर रुक जाना
definition: the regard for another's standing that stops you from saying or doing what you otherwise would; deference explains it, restraint performs it
example: बुज़ुर्गों का लिहाज़ करके वो चुप रह गया — Out of regard for the elders he stayed silent.

hindi: निवाला — एक बार में मुँह में जाने वाला खाना
definition: a single mouthful of food as the hand carries it up, the unit of eating rather than the portion served on a plate
example: पहला लुक़्मा उसने माँ के हाथ से लिया। — He took the first mouthful from his mother's hand.

hindi: रसीला निवाला — आसान शिकार, बे-मेहनत का माल
definition: a juicy mouthful, used for an easy prize or a defenceless victim swallowed without effort rather than for actual food
example: कमज़ोर मुल्क बड़ी ताक़तों के लिए लुक़्मा-ए-तर है। — A weak country is an easy morsel for great powers.

hindi: शब्दकोश — लफ़्ज़ों के मानी बताने वाली किताब
definition: a dictionary, the book that fixes what words mean and how they are used; a glossary sits at the back of one text, this covers a whole language
example: यह लफ़्ज़ लुग़त में भी नहीं मिला — This word was not even in the dictionary.

hindi: मज़ा और मेहरबानी — आनंद, और कोमल कृपा
definition: pleasure taken in something, and in the older sense a gentle kindness, the one member of this group that is mostly about the receiver's enjoyment
example: बारिश में चाय का अपना लुत्फ़ है — Tea in the rain has its own pleasure.

hindi: मोती — पाकीज़गी की मिसाल के तौर पर बोला गया
definition: the pearl as named in scripture and formal verse; the pearl praised for purity rather than for its price
example: उसने महबूब के दाँतों को लूलू कहा। — He called the beloved's teeth pearls.

hindi: चेतावनी — आगे आने वाली सज़ा का डर, ख़ासकर ख़ुदा की तरफ़ से
definition: a threat of punishment still to come, especially a divine one; a warning of consequence rather than of immediate harm
example: क़ुरआन में झूठों के लिए सख़्त वईद है — There is a stern warning for liars in the Quran.

hindi: गरिमा — जिससे आदमी का भार बना रहे
definition: the weight of dignity a person carries that keeps others from taking liberties, earned by conduct rather than granted by rank
example: उसने अपना वक़ार कभी नहीं खोया — He never lost his dignity.

hindi: नियत समय — पहले से तय किया हुआ वक़्त
definition: the appointed time fixed in an agreement, the term by which performance is due
example: वक़्त-ए-मुक़र्रर पर रक़म अदा कर दी गई। — The money was paid at the appointed time.

hindi: पैरवी का पेशा — किसी की तरफ़ से बोलने का काम
definition: the profession or act of arguing on another's behalf, in court or in life; used equally for advocating a person's cause in an argument
example: तुम हमेशा उसकी वकालत क्यों करते हो — Why do you always argue his case?

hindi: रखरखाव — पहनावे और चाल-ढाल का अपना ढंग
definition: a person's settled outward style of dress and bearing, the look they hold constant across years; character made visible
example: उसने पुरानी वज़ा नहीं छोड़ी — He never gave up his old style.

hindi: स्पष्टीकरण — बात साफ़ करने वाला बयान
definition: a clarification issued to remove a misunderstanding, usually about something you yourself already said
example: मिनिस्टर ने अपने बयान की वज़ाहत दी। — The minister issued a clarification of his statement.

hindi: नित्य जप — रोज़ गिनकर पढ़ी जाने वाली दुआ
definition: a prayer or holy formula repeated a fixed number of times every day as a settled practice, not a spontaneous asking
example: उसने चालीस दिन का वज़ीफ़ा बाँध रखा है — He has bound himself to a forty-day daily recitation.

hindi: मात्रा-भार — किसी मिसरे का लयात्मक तौल
definition: the syllabic weight of an individual line measured against the chosen metre, which is what makes a line scan or stumble when recited aloud
example: लफ़्ज़ अच्छा है मगर वज़्न बिगड़ रहा है — The word is good but it is breaking the weight of the line.

hindi: बा-रोब ख़ूबसूरती — जिससे शख़्सियत भारी लगे
definition: the pleasing dignity of a well-turned-out person; good appearance that carries weight, not mere handsomeness
example: उनकी वजाहत देखकर लोग रास्ता छोड़ देते थे। — People made way at the sight of his dignified bearing.

hindi: भाव-समाधि — सुनते-सुनते झूम उठने की हालत
definition: ecstatic transport in which a listener is carried out of themselves by music or remembrance, a spiritual peak beyond ordinary exhilaration
example: क़व्वाली सुनते-सुनते वह वज्द में आ गया — Listening to the qawwali he fell into ecstasy.

hindi: मातृभूमि — अपनी जड़ों वाली जगह
definition: the homeland one belongs to by birth and attachment, larger than a house and more personal than a country
example: परदेस में वतन की मिट्टी याद आती है — Abroad, one remembers the soil of the homeland.

hindi: निष्ठा — साथ निभाने की पक्की आदत
definition: keeping faith with someone across time, weighted by what the keeping costs rather than reporting bare fidelity
example: कुत्ता वफ़ा निभाता है, लोग नहीं। — A dog keeps faith; people don't.

hindi: वफ़ादार — जिसकी आदत ही वफ़ा हो
definition: describing one whose loyalty is habit, faithful by disposition rather than because an oath was taken
example: ऐसा वफ़ा-शिआर दोस्त मुश्किल से मिलता है। — Such a habitually faithful friend is hard to find.

hindi: निधन — किसी बड़े या बुज़ुर्ग के मरने का आदरसूचक शब्द
definition: death recorded with reverence, used for elders, saints, poets and public figures; more formal than a passing announcement and the word a written history or a plaque prefers
example: ग़ालिब की वफ़ात उन्नीस सौ से पहले हुई थी — Ghalib died before the nineteenth century closed.

hindi: स्वामिभक्ति — साथ निभाने का पक्का रवैया
definition: steady loyalty to a person, a state or a cause, proved by staying on when leaving would be far easier
example: पुरानी वफ़ादारी उन्हें छोड़ने नहीं देती — Old loyalty does not let him leave.

hindi: महामारी — एक साथ फैलने वाला रोग
definition: a disease spreading through a whole population at once, illness as a public event rather than a private case
example: वबा फैलते ही शहर के दरवाज़े बंद कर दिए गए। — As the epidemic spread, the city gates were shut.

hindi: भार बनी मुसीबत — जो अपने ही किए से गले पड़ जाए
definition: a lasting burden of trouble earned by one's own act and now impossible to shake off; consequence weighing down, not misfortune arriving
example: ये मकान अब मेरे लिए वबाल बन गया है — This house has become a burden round my neck.

hindi: पन्ना — काग़ज़ का एक पत्र, या चाँदी-सोने का पत्तर
definition: a single leaf of paper counted as two written faces; also a beaten sheet of silver or gold laid over something
example: किताब का आख़िरी वरक़ फटा हुआ था। — The last leaf of the book was torn.

hindi: फुसलाना — बहका-फुसलाकर अपनी बात मनवाना
definition: to talk someone into a wrong course by flattery or false promise, misleading them into acting against their interest
example: उसे वरग़लाना आसान था, वो किसी की भी बात मान लेता है। — It was easy to lead him astray; he believes anyone.

hindi: उमंग — भीतर उठती जोश की लहर
definition: a surge of enthusiasm rising in a person, felt as a wave that lifts them into action rather than a steady heat
example: उसकी बातों से नया वलवला पैदा हुआ — His words stirred a fresh surge of enthusiasm.

hindi: अभिभावक — निकाह और मामलों में लड़की की ओर से खड़ा होने वाला
definition: the male guardian who acts for a woman or minor in a marriage contract and legal matters; a role defined by law, narrower than a household protector
example: निकाह में लड़की के वली उसके चचा थे — In the marriage contract the girl's guardian was her paternal uncle.

hindi: युवराज — गद्दी का घोषित उत्तराधिकारी
definition: the successor already named while the present holder still rules, waiting rather than inheriting
example: वली-अहद का ऐलान दरबार में हुआ। — The heir apparent was proclaimed in the court.

hindi: शादी के बाद की दावत — दूल्हे की तरफ़ से दिया जाने वाला खाना
definition: the feast the groom's side gives after a wedding, a meal owed by custom rather than a party thrown by choice
example: वलीमा इतना बड़ा था कि पूरा मोहल्ला बुलाया गया। — The wedding feast was so large that the whole neighbourhood was invited.

hindi: कुविचार — मन में बार-बार आने वाला बहकाने वाला ख़याल
definition: an intrusive whispering thought that tempts toward sin or gnaws at faith, arriving unbidden and returning; the self desires steadily, this one whispers in bursts
example: इबादत में वसवसा आता रहता है — A whispering doubt keeps intruding during worship.

hindi: बिचवई — दो लड़ते पक्षों के बीच बात पहुँचाना
definition: standing between two quarrelling sides to carry terms and cool tempers; mediation that persuades rather than judges anything
example: उनकी वसातत से बात बन गई — The matter came together through his mediation.

hindi: विलेख — अधिकार सिद्ध करने वाला क़ानूनी लेख
definition: a legal deed of title, the written instrument on which a right rests; losing it can cost the right itself
example: मकान का वसीक़ा उसके नाम है। — The deed of the house is in his name.

hindi: अंतिम इच्छा — मरने से पहले लिखी या कही गई हिदायत
definition: the instruction a person leaves for after their death, about property, burial or unfinished duties; binding on the living in a way a wish is not
example: उन्होंने वसीयत में मकान बेटी के नाम किया — In his will he left the house to his daughter.

hindi: माध्यम — जिसके ज़रिये बात पहुँचे या काम बने
definition: the means or connection through which a request reaches the one who can grant it; intercession is the plea itself, this is the channel it travels along
example: कोई वसीला ढूँढ़कर बात वहाँ तक पहुँचाइए — Find some channel and get word to him.

hindi: उगाही — बकाया रक़म वसूल करना
definition: the recovery of money due under an agreement, collecting from the other side what he owes
example: क़र्ज़ की वसूली में महीनों लग गए। — The recovery of the loan took months.

hindi: मिलन — प्रेमियों का साथ होना
definition: the union of lovers after waiting, the meeting that separation exists to be measured against, not any ordinary meeting between two people
example: वस्ल की रात बहुत छोटी लगी — The night of union felt very short.

hindi: भ्रम — बेबुनियाद बात जिसे मन सच मान बैठे
definition: a groundless notion the mind takes for fact and will not release, half suspicion and half fancy; a fallacy has bad reasoning behind it, this has none at all
example: उसे बीमारी का वहम हो गया है — He has got it into his head that he is ill.

hindi: शक्की — जो हर बात में बेबुनियाद डर पाल ले
definition: given to forming groundless fears and believing them; describes the person prone to delusion, not the false notion itself
example: वो इतना वहमी है कि हर आहट से डरता है — He is so given to imagined fears that every sound frightens him.

hindi: उन्माद और भय — लोगों से भागने का जुनूनी हाल
definition: the wild, panicked state that drives a person away from company into wilderness, darker and more fearful than love's sweet madness
example: तन्हा रातों में उस पर वहशत तारी है — On lonely nights a wild dread comes over him.

hindi: जंगली — जो आदमी से डरे और पालतू न हो
definition: untamed, said of an animal that shuns men and of a person who cannot bear company; it names shyness turned to wildness, not fury
example: वो हादसे के बाद वहशी हो गया — After the accident he turned wild and withdrawn.

hindi: ईश-वाणी — ईश्वर की ओर से उतरा संदेश
definition: revelation sent down to a prophet as binding scripture, unlike the private inspiration that may visit any heart
example: वही का सिलसिला बरसों चला — The sending down of revelation continued for years.

hindi: धर्मोपदेशक — मिंबर से वाज़ करने वाला
definition: the preacher who sermonises from the pulpit to a crowd, holding office where the private adviser holds none; public authority against the tavern
example: वाइज़ हर जुमे को शराब पर बोलता है। — The preacher speaks against wine every Friday.

hindi: परिचय — किसी चीज़ या शख़्स से जान-पहचान का ज्ञान
