definition: acquaintance-level knowledge of a subject or person gained by exposure rather than study; you know your way around it without claiming to have learned it properly
example: मुझे इस इलाक़े से थोड़ी वाक़फ़ियत है — I have some familiarity with this area.

hindi: धर्म-उपदेश — मजमे के सामने दिया गया नसीहत भरा भाषण
definition: a sermon delivered publicly to move listeners toward better conduct; counsel spoken to a crowd rather than to one person
example: जुमे के दिन मस्जिद में लंबा वाज़ हुआ। — There was a long sermon in the mosque on Friday.

hindi: अनिवार्य — जिसका करना या देना लाज़िम हो
definition: obligatory, describing what must be done or paid because law or religion requires it; marks a thing as owed rather than naming the duty
example: इतना जुर्माना अदा करना वाजिब है — Paying this much fine is obligatory.

hindi: देय — जिसका चुकाना अब ज़रूरी हो
definition: describing a sum that has fallen due under an agreement and must now be paid without further delay
example: यह रक़म पहली तारीख़ को वाजिब-उल-अदा है। — This sum is due for payment on the first.

hindi: वचन-भंग — दिया हुआ वादा तोड़ देना
definition: the breaking of a promise, naming the act as a fault to be answered for rather than the disloyalty of the heart behind it
example: उसकी वादा-ख़िलाफ़ी अब आदत बन गई है — His promise-breaking has become a habit.

hindi: वादा भूल जाने वाला — जो किया हुआ वादा याद ही न रखे
definition: describing someone who forgets a promise rather than breaks it on purpose, careless with his word instead of treacherous
example: वो बुरा नहीं, बस ज़रा वादा-फ़रामोश है। — He is not a bad man, only rather forgetful of his promises.

hindi: बहुत ज़्यादा — जितना चाहिए उससे भी ज़्यादा मौजूद
definition: available in ample quantity, of food or means present in more than the needed measure without being wasteful excess
example: दस्तरख़्वान पर वाफ़िर खाना मौजूद था। — Ample food was laid out on the spread.

hindi: जुड़ाव — किसी से बँधे होने की हालत
definition: the state of being bound up with a person or cause, describing attachment as a tie one cannot easily step out of
example: उसकी वाबस्तगी उस तहरीक से पुरानी है — His attachment to that movement is old.

hindi: बेख़ुदी भरा लगाव — ख़ुद को भूल जाने की हद तक चाहत
definition: the state of being carried away by love, self-forgetting devotion described as a condition one is in rather than an act one performs
example: उसकी वारफ़्तगी छिपाए नहीं छिपती — His helpless devotion cannot be hidden.

hindi: उत्तराधिकारी — जिसे मरने वाले का माल-असबाब मिले
definition: the person entitled to what a dead man leaves behind, named by law or by blood; also the one who carries on a name or a tradition
example: उसके बाद कोई वारिस बचा ही नहीं — After him no heir was left at all.

hindi: पिता — आदर से कहा गया बाप
definition: one's father named respectfully, as on forms, in introductions and in speaking of him to others; the courteous term a man uses, not the word a child calls him by
example: मेरे वालिद रेलवे में थे — My father was in the railways.

hindi: माता — आदर से कही गई माँ
definition: one's mother named respectfully in formal speech and writing, pairing with the courteous word for father; distance of register, never distance of feeling
example: वालिदा की दुआ हमेशा साथ रही — My mother's prayer was always with me.

hindi: माता-पिता — दोनों अभिभावक एक साथ
definition: one's mother and father taken together as a single pair owed obedience and care; a dual word, where each parent has a separate term of address
example: वालिदैन की ख़िदमत सबसे बड़ी इबादत है — Serving one's parents is the greatest worship.

hindi: सुध-बुध खोया — देखकर ठगा-सा रह जाने वाला
definition: stunned into stillness by love or beauty, describing the lover frozen mid-thought rather than the one running after someone
example: उसे देखकर वह वालेह खड़ा रह गया — Seeing her, he stood there transfixed.

hindi: हाहाकार — चीख़-पुकार और शोर भरा मातम
definition: a clamour of lamenting voices raised together, mourning heard as noise from outside the house; a crowd's sound, not one person's cry
example: ख़बर पहुँचते ही गली में वावैला मच गया — The lane erupted in lamentation as the news arrived.

hindi: उत्तराधिकार — मरने पर आगे जाने वाला सब कुछ
definition: what passes to heirs at a death, inheritance taken to include standing and trade as well as property
example: उसे बाप से क़र्ज़ की विरासत मिली — He inherited debt from his father.

hindi: जन्म — किसी के पैदा होने की घड़ी
definition: the event of a child's birth, spoken of formally as in announcements and anniversaries; the arrival itself, not the pregnancy that preceded it
example: उनकी विलादत का साल किताब में दर्ज है — The year of his birth is recorded in the book.

hindi: मिलन — लंबी जुदाई के बाद का मेल
definition: union with the beloved that matters precisely because it closes a debt long separation opened
example: पूरी फ़िल्म इंतज़ार की है, विसाल सिर्फ़ आख़िरी गाने में। — The whole film is waiting; the reunion arrives only in the last song.

hindi: उजाड़पन — बसी हुई जगह के सूने पड़ जाने की हालत
definition: the desolation of a place that people once filled and have since left, an emptiness with a history behind it
example: उस हवेली की वीरानी डराती है — The desolation of that mansion is frightening.

hindi: नमाज़-पूर्व शुद्धि — हाथ, मुँह और पाँव की विधिवत धुलाई
definition: the prescribed washing performed before ritual prayer, a required purification rather than ordinary cleaning
example: वुज़ू किए बिना नमाज़ नहीं होती — Prayer is not valid without the prescribed washing.

hindi: पदार्पण — कहीं पहुँचने की औपचारिक घड़ी
definition: formal arrival at a destination, the word used in announcements and records where a plain word for coming would sound too casual
example: सदर के वुरूद पर शहर सज गया — The city was decorated on the president's arrival.

hindi: विस्तार — फैलाव, गुंजाइश की चौड़ाई
definition: sheer extent of open space, the width the sky or a mind has for holding more than it already holds
example: सहरा की वुसअत देखकर आदमी छोटा लगने लगता है। — Seeing the desert's expanse a man begins to feel small.

hindi: प्राप्ति — भेजी हुई चीज़ का हाथ में आना
definition: the receipt of what was sent, money or a letter reaching the hand it was meant for; the closing half of a dispatch
example: आपका ख़त वुसूल हुआ। — Your letter has been received.

hindi: उगाही — बकाया पैसा वापस लाने का काम
definition: the work of collecting money already owed and overdue, from a debtor or a tenant; recovery of dues, not the earning of new income
example: किराए की वुसूली के लिए उसने आदमी भेजा। — He sent a man for the recovery of the rent.

hindi: सलीक़ा-बोध — क्या कब कैसे करना है, इसकी समझ
definition: the trained sense of how things ought to be done and said, perception applied to conduct; a person may be sharp and learned and still visibly lack it
example: बात करने का भी कोई शऊर होता है — There is a proper sense to how one speaks.

hindi: धैर्य — दुख में भी शांत बने रहना
definition: quiet patience kept in the middle of sorrow, composure that endures rather than power that resists
example: इस ग़म में शकेब ही सहारा है। — In this grief, patience is the only support.

hindi: धैर्य — दुख में भी टूट कर न बिखरना
definition: the endurance that keeps a person composed while the pain is still going on; patience under load, not patience while waiting
example: इतने नुक़सान के बाद भी उसकी शकेबाई क़ायम रही — Even after such loss his composure held.

hindi: खिला हुआ — प्रसन्न और तरो-ताज़ा
definition: in bloom, said of a flower and equally of a face or mood that has opened up cheerfully
example: आज उसका मिज़ाज शगुफ़्ता है — His mood is bright today.

hindi: वृक्ष — तना और शाख़ों वाला पेड़
definition: a tree as a standing living thing with trunk and branches, the general word under which every named tree falls
example: हर शजर अपने साये से पहचाना जाता है। — Every tree is known by its shade.

hindi: वंश-वृक्ष — पीढ़ियों का लिखा हुआ नक़्शा
definition: a written family tree setting out generations of descent name by name; the ancestry drawn on paper, where the plain word for descent stays an abstract claim
example: उनके घर में सात पुश्तों का शजरा महफ़ूज़ है — A family tree of seven generations is preserved in their house.

hindi: संध्या-लालिमा — डूबते सूरज के बाद की लाली
definition: the red glow left on the horizon after the sun has set, the colour of dusk rather than the act of setting
example: शफ़क़ की लाली अभी आसमान पर बाक़ी थी। — The red of dusk still lingered in the sky.

hindi: वात्सल्य — बड़ों की छोटों पर नर्म ममता
definition: the tender mercy an elder feels toward someone younger and dependent, warm and protective; mercy can be shown to a stranger, this presumes a bond of care
example: उस्ताद की शफ़क़त कभी नहीं भूली — I never forgot my teacher's affection.

hindi: सिफ़ारिश — गुनहगार के लिए माफ़ी की गुज़ारिश
definition: intercession pleaded on behalf of a guilty person so that punishment is remitted, especially on the day of judgement; the pardon is still the judge's to give
example: उस दिन शफ़ाअत ही काम आएगी — On that day only intercession will avail.

hindi: अस्पताल — जहाँ मरीज़ भर्ती होकर इलाज पाते हैं
definition: a hospital where patients are admitted and healed, the whole institution with beds and surgeons; larger than any clinic or dispensary
example: शहर का शफ़ाख़ाना रात भर खुला रहता है। — The city hospital stays open all night.

hindi: रात्रि — जागरण और ग़म की रात
definition: night as the appointed hour of vigil and grief, the register in which sleeplessness gets talked about
example: शब भर जागते रहे, सुबह का इंतज़ार करते। — We lay awake the whole night, waiting on the morning.

hindi: रात का छापा — अँधेरे में किया गया अचानक हमला
definition: a night raid, an attack launched under cover of darkness on an unprepared enemy; the treachery lies in the timing
example: दुश्मन ने शबख़ून मारा — The enemy launched a night raid.

hindi: ओस — रात भर में जमी नमी की बूँदें
definition: moisture that settles as small drops overnight and dries by mid-morning, unlike mist which hangs in the air
example: घास पर शबनम अब तक चमक रही थी। — Dew still glistened on the grass.

hindi: यौवन — जवानी का चरम
definition: youth at its fullest pitch, the peak years rather than the whole young period of a life
example: मौसम अपने शबाब पर है। — The season is at the peak of its youth.

hindi: बॉक्स वृक्ष — सीधा लंबा पेड़, क़द की उपमा
definition: the box tree used as a figure for a graceful upright height, softer in tone than the stern cypress
example: उसका क़द शमशाद जैसा था। — Her height was like a box tree's.

hindi: घुमावदार तलवार — फ़ारसी अंदाज़ का बाँका हथियार
definition: the curved sword of Persian style, a blade named for its shape and prized as a fine weapon in itself
example: दीवार पर एक पुरानी शमशीर टँगी थी — An old curved sword hung on the wall.

hindi: मोमबत्ती — महफ़िल में जलती हुई बत्ती, शायरी का बड़ा प्रतीक
definition: the candle of the poetic gathering, standing for a beauty that burns while it gives light and for the beloved who does not notice the moth
example: शमा जलती रही और महफ़िल उठ गई — The candle kept burning and the gathering broke up.

hindi: महक — ठंडी हवा के साथ आती ख़ुशबू
definition: fragrance carried on a breeze, the word chosen when the moving air itself is the vehicle of the scent
example: सुबह की हवा में एक शमीम थी — There was a fragrance in the morning air.

hindi: बुराई भड़काना — जान-बूझकर आग लगाना
definition: the deliberate stirring up of trouble between people, discord created on purpose by a third party who profits from it
example: उसकी शर-अंगेज़ी से दो घर टूट गए — His trouble-making broke two households.

hindi: उपद्रव-प्रियता — झगड़ा कराने में मज़ा लेने की तबीयत
definition: the disposition of a person who enjoys making trouble; a standing taste for discord rather than one act of incitement
example: इस मोहल्ले में उसकी शर-पसंदी मशहूर है — His taste for trouble is famous in this locality.

hindi: टीका — किसी किताब के मुश्किल हिस्सों की खोल-भाषा
definition: a commentary written to open up a difficult text line by line for students; exegesis of scripture is grand, this is the workaday classroom commentary
example: इस दीवान की शरह के बिना समझ नहीं आता — This collection is unintelligible without a commentary.

hindi: शर्तें — मुआहिदे में तय की गई तमाम शर्तें
definition: the full set of conditions written into an agreement, taken together as its terms
example: क़रार की शराइत दोनों फ़रीक़ों ने पढ़ लीं। — Both parties read the terms of the agreement.

hindi: भलमनसाहत — कुलीन और सज्जन आचरण
definition: decency of conduct expected of a well-raised person, judged by restraint rather than by kindness
example: शराफ़त से पेश आओ, झगड़ा मत करो। — Behave decently; don't pick a fight.

hindi: धर्म-विधान — इबादत और आचरण का धार्मिक क़ानून
definition: the whole body of religious rulings governing worship and daily conduct, distinct from the statute law a state enforces
example: यह मामला शरीअत के मुताबिक़ तय हुआ — The matter was settled according to religious law.

hindi: अपराध में साझीदार — जुर्म में साथ देने वाला
definition: an accomplice in a crime, the person whose collusion makes them liable although another hand committed the deed
example: ख़ामोश रहकर तुम भी शरीक-ए-जुर्म हो — By staying silent you too are an accomplice.

hindi: प्रतिबंध — जिस पर सारा सौदा टिका हो
definition: the condition on which an agreement depends, so that if it fails the whole promise lapses
example: एक शर्त पर मैं राज़ी हूँ। — I agree on one condition.

hindi: बंसी का काँटा — जिसमें फँसा कर मछली पकड़ी जाए
definition: the hook on which a fish is caught, the fisherman's small trap; it takes one creature at a time where a net takes many
example: शस्त में फँसी मछली छूट न सकी — The fish caught on the hook could not get free.

hindi: बढ़ावा — पीछे से मिलने वाली हिम्मत
definition: quiet backing that emboldens someone to persist in bad behaviour, encouragement given from behind rather than openly
example: किसी की शह पर ही वो इतना बेख़ौफ़ है। — He is this fearless only because someone is backing him.

hindi: नागरिकता — किसी मुल्क का बाशिंदा होने का क़ानूनी दर्जा
definition: citizenship as legal membership of a state, the status that carries rights and duties rather than mere residence
example: बरसों की भागदौड़ के बाद उन्हें शहरियत मिली — He received citizenship after years of running about.

hindi: काम-वासना — जिस्मानी ख़्वाहिश
definition: sexual desire named plainly as an appetite of the body, narrower than the greedy craving that can fasten on anything
example: शहवत और मोहब्बत में फ़र्क़ है — There is a difference between lust and love.

hindi: कुशल घुड़सवार — घोड़े पर पूरा क़ाबू रखने वाला
definition: a master rider on horseback, praised for command of the animal; it names skill, where a plain rider names only the act of sitting a horse
example: ऐसा शहसवार कि बे-लगाम घोड़ा भी मान जाए — Such a horseman that even an unbridled horse obeys.

hindi: साक्ष्य — गवाह की दी हुई बात जो सबूत बने
definition: the evidence a witness gives, valued as proof in a case; the testimony itself as against गवाह the person who offers it
example: उसकी शहादत पर ही मुक़दमा टिका है — The whole case rests on his testimony.

hindi: उल्का — आसमान से गिरता हुआ जलता तारा
definition: a meteor, the burning streak that falls across the night sky and dies out, unlike the fixed stars that stay in place
example: रात के आसमान पर शहाब-ए-साक़िब लकीर खींच गया। — A meteor drew a line across the night sky.

hindi: शिष्टता — तालीम से आया सँवरा हुआ बरताव
definition: refinement of manner acquired through upbringing and education, showing itself in restraint and in choice of words
example: उसकी बातों में शाइस्तगी है — There is refinement in the way he speaks.

hindi: शिष्य — किसी उस्ताद से जुड़ कर सीखने वाला
definition: a pupil bound to one particular master and learning in his line, not simply a person enrolled somewhere; the relationship, not the classroom, makes the word
example: वो ग़ालिब के शागिर्दों में गिने जाते थे — He was counted among Ghalib's pupils.

hindi: घाघ — जो चालों में सबसे आगे हो
definition: sharply cunning and hard to outmanoeuvre, praising the skill in the deceit where मक्कार only condemns the character
example: वह शातिर खिलाड़ी है, पहले ही सोच लेता है — He is a cunning player; he thinks two moves ahead.

hindi: ताज़गी — खिली हुई हरी-भरी रौनक़
definition: the freshness of something well watered and in bloom, used of a face that looks rested, fed and alive
example: छुट्टियों के बाद उसके चेहरे पर शादाबी थी — After the holidays there was a bloom on her face.

hindi: उपयुक्त — जो मौक़े और मरतबे के मुताबिक़ हो
definition: befitting the occasion or the person's standing, appropriate to a role rather than deserved as a due
example: ये लहजा एक उस्ताद के शायाँ नहीं। — This tone is not befitting a teacher.

hindi: शाही ख़र्च — दिखाने के लिए किया गया बड़ा ख़र्च
definition: spending on a princely scale, lavish expenditure meant to be seen and remembered rather than merely wasted
example: शादी में शाह-ख़र्ची ने क़र्ज़ चढ़ा दिया — Princely spending at the wedding piled up debt.

hindi: राजमार्ग — बड़ी और मुख्य सड़क
definition: a great highway carrying the main traffic of a region, larger and more public than an ordinary road
example: शाहराह पर ट्रैफ़िक रुका हुआ है — Traffic is stalled on the highway.

hindi: साक्षी — गवाही देने वाला
definition: a witness in the formal register, the word used for those attesting an oath or a contract
example: निकाह में दो शाहिद मौजूद थे। — Two witnesses were present at the marriage.

hindi: बाज़ जैसा शिकारी परिंदा — ऊँची उड़ान भरने वाला
definition: the royal falcon among birds of prey, prized for hunting from a great height; it stands for lofty ambition, not mere fierceness
example: नौजवान को शाहीन की तरह ऊँचा उड़ना चाहिए — The young should fly high like the falcon.

hindi: जकड़ — कसती चली जाने वाली पकड़
definition: the closing grip in which a victim is held once trapped, the tightening rather than the snare that first caught them
example: क़र्ज़ का शिकंजा पूरे घर पर कसा हुआ था — The grip of debt was tight on the whole household.

hindi: सिलवट — माथे या कपड़े पर पड़ी लकीर
definition: a fold or crease, read on a forehead as the mark the years and worries have pressed into a face
example: उनकी पेशानी पर उम्र की शिकनें उभर आईं। — The creases of age had risen on his forehead.

hindi: पेट — भूख और खाने का ठिकाना
definition: the belly considered as the seat of hunger and the place food goes, a formal word used where daily speech says stomach
example: शिकम की आग हर उसूल तोड़ देती है। — The fire of the belly breaks every principle.

hindi: पेट-पूजा — खाने के सिवा कोई फ़िक्र न होना
definition: living to feed the belly, making food the whole business of life; not appetite but the vice of serving it above all else
example: उसकी सारी दौड़ शिकम-परवरी तक महदूद है। — All his striving stops at feeding his belly.

hindi: छोटा बाज़ — जिसे साध कर शिकार पर छोड़ा जाता है
definition: the small hawk kept and trained by hunters, a bird of prey that works on a man's wrist rather than for itself
example: शिकरा हाथ पर बैठा हुक्म का इंतज़ार कर रहा था — The hawk sat on his hand awaiting the command.

hindi: गिला — अपनों से किया गया नरम उलाहना
definition: a complaint made only to someone close, expecting affection rather than redress; a grievance wants justice, this wants attention
example: मुझे तुमसे एक छोटा सा शिकवा है — I have one small complaint against you.

hindi: पराजय — मुक़ाबले में मिली हार
definition: a defeat suffered in a contest of strength, the breaking of one's own side rather than mere failure to succeed
example: पहली शिकस्त के बाद उन्होंने तरीक़ा बदल दिया — After the first defeat he changed his method.

hindi: टूट-फूट — इमारत का धीरे-धीरे बिगड़ना
definition: the slow dilapidation of a built structure, decay eating a building long before it becomes an outright ruin
example: पुरानी इमारत शिकस्त-ओ-रेख़्त का शिकार है — The old building has fallen into dilapidation.

hindi: फूट — एक ही घर या क़ौम का दो ख़ेमों में बँट जाना
definition: a split into hostile camps inside one family or community; enmity that divides a whole group rather than only two people
example: छोटी सी बात ने बिरादरी में शिक़ाक़ डाल दिया — A small matter split the community into camps.

hindi: शिकार-भूमि — बादशाहों का सुरक्षित जंगल
definition: the reserved ground kept for the hunt, a forest held for game rather than any wild place a hunter wanders into
example: बादशाह की शिकारगाह में आम आदमी का दाख़िला मना था — Commoners were barred from the king's hunting reserve.

hindi: कोंपल — नया खिलता हुआ फूल या नई बात
definition: a blossom just breaking open, and figuratively a fresh piece of news or mischief someone has let loose
example: उसने आज एक नया शिगूफ़ा छोड़ा है। — He has floated a fresh piece of mischief today.

hindi: तीव्रता — किसी भाव का बहुत तेज़ होना
definition: sheer intensity of a feeling or condition, naming the degree rather than the feeling, so it attaches to love, heat, pain alike
example: उसने शिद्दत से इनकार किया — He refused with intensity.

hindi: पहचान — देखकर यह तय करना कि यह कौन है
definition: the identifying of a person or thing by looking at it; recognition performed as a formal act, of the kind demanded at a station or a checkpoint
example: लाश की शिनाख़्त भाई ने की — The body was identified by the brother.

hindi: परिचित — जिसे पहले से जानते हों
definition: known to one from before, familiar by acquaintance; describes a person whose face you can place, which stops well short of friendship
example: वह चेहरा कुछ शिनासा लगा — That face seemed somewhat familiar.

hindi: आरोग्य — रोग का पूरी तरह मिट जाना
definition: the cure itself, health restored and the disease gone, understood as a gift rather than a technique; treatment aims at this
example: अल्लाह शिफ़ा दे, दवा तो सिर्फ़ ज़रिया है। — May God grant healing; medicine is only the means.

hindi: दूध — पीने और पकाने का दूध, ख़ास तौर पर तरकीबी लफ़्ज़ों में
definition: milk as food and drink, used chiefly in compounds for dishes and for the bond of suckling rather than in plain daily speech
example: शीर और शक्कर से मीठा पकाया गया। — The sweet was cooked from milk and sugar.

hindi: दूध पीता — वो बच्चा जो अभी अनाज नहीं खाता
definition: still living on milk, of an infant too young for solid food; marks a stage of feeding, not merely an age in months
example: शीर-ख़्वार बच्चे को माँ से अलग नहीं किया जाता। — A suckling infant is not separated from its mother.

hindi: दूध से गुँधी रोटी — हल्की मीठी, ज़ाफ़रानी
definition: a soft bread kneaded with milk and lightly sweetened, baked for feasts where plain leavened bread would be too ordinary
example: क़ोरमे के साथ शीरमाल परोसी गई। — Milk bread was served with the korma.

hindi: गाढ़ा मीठा रस — गुड़ या चीनी का बहता हुआ रूप
definition: the thick sweet syrup of boiled sugar or jaggery, the running form of sweetness poured over food rather than stirred in
example: गाढ़ा शीरा जलेबियों पर डाला गया। — Thick syrup was poured over the jalebis.

hindi: मीठा — जिसमें मिठास हो, ज़बान हो या ज़ाइक़ा
definition: sweet in taste, and equally of speech that goes down as easily as sweet food; the quality itself, not the sweet being eaten
example: उसकी शीरीं ज़बान से बात बन गई। — His sweet tongue settled the matter.

hindi: ख़ुशी की मिठाई — अच्छी ख़बर पर बाँटी जाने वाली मिठास
definition: sweets distributed to mark good news or a settled engagement, sweet food carrying an announcement rather than ending a meal
example: मंगनी की शीरीनी घर घर भेजी गई। — The engagement sweets were sent to every house.

hindi: किरण — सूरज की एक सीधी रौशनी की लकीर
definition: a single beam of sunlight travelling in a straight line, the thread of brightness rather than the heat it carries
example: रौशनदान से एक शुआ फ़र्श पर पड़ रही थी। — A ray of light fell on the floor from the skylight.

hindi: आभार प्रकट करना — कृतज्ञता ज़ाहिर करने का बरताव
definition: gratitude carried into behaviour and words toward the giver, thankfulness expressed rather than merely felt
example: उसने ख़त लिखकर शुक्रगुज़ारी की। — He expressed his thankfulness in a letter.

hindi: वीरता — ख़तरे के सामने डटे रहने का गुण
definition: courage as a settled quality of character rather than a single brave act; the bravery a man is known for, not the one he managed once
example: उसकी शुजाअत की मिसाल आज भी दी जाती है — His courage is still cited as an example.

hindi: ऊँट — रेगिस्तान की सवारी और बोझ ढोने वाला जानवर
definition: the camel as the desert's mount and load-bearer, an animal valued for endurance rather than speed; the Persian word of proverbs and compounds
example: शुतुर के गले में घंटी बजती रही — The bell kept ringing at the camel's neck.

hindi: संदेह — किसी बात के सही होने पर उठा हुआ शक
definition: a specific doubt about whether something is true or someone is honest, resting on some ground; a groundless notion is baseless, this can be stated and tested
example: उसकी नीयत पर मुझे शुबहा है — I have a doubt about his intentions.

hindi: दोहा-नुमा इकाई — दो मिसरों का पूरा-पूरा ख़याल
definition: a couplet of two lines carrying one complete thought, the smallest unit that can be quoted on its own and the unit an audience actually applauds
example: यह शेर सुनते ही महफ़िल हिल गई — The gathering was shaken the moment it heard this couplet.

hindi: मुग्ध — जो किसी पर लट्टू हो
definition: smitten to the point of losing one's senses over someone, stronger than merely being in love because it names the loss of self-command
example: वह उसकी आवाज़ का शैदा है — He is besotted with her voice.

hindi: चंचल — जो खुलकर शरारत करे
definition: playfully forward in the way the young are, said of manner and of bright colours that behave the same way
example: बच्चा ज़रा शोख़ है, मगर दिल का साफ़। — The child is a bit playfully bold, but clean of heart.

hindi: चंचलता — बेबाक और शरारती अंदाज़
definition: the bold playfulness of the young, charming in a child and taken as impudence in an adult
example: उसकी शोख़ी पर बड़े भी हँस पड़े। — Even the elders laughed at his playfulness.

hindi: करतब — आँख को धोखा देने वाला जादू का खेल
definition: a conjuring trick that deceives the eyesight by sleight rather than by real magic; performance, not the sorcery it imitates
example: बच्चों के सामने उसने एक शोबदा दिखाया — He performed a conjuring trick before the children.

hindi: बाज़ीगरी — दिखावटी करतबों से लोगों को बहलाना या ठगना
definition: trickery worked as a show, whether on a stage or in politics; names the deceiving craft itself, not a single trick performed
example: ये मंसूबा नहीं, महज़ शोबदा-बाज़ी है — This is no plan, just conjuring trickery.

hindi: शोर-शराबा — मिली-जुली आवाज़ों का हुजूम
definition: the mixed clamour of many voices in a street, noise without any incident behind it
example: बाज़ार के शोर-ओ-ग़ुल में उसकी बात सुनाई न दी — In the market's clamour her words went unheard.

hindi: पतला रसा — गोश्त या सब्ज़ी का बहता हुआ पानी
definition: the thin liquid part of a cooked dish, drunk or soaked into bread; runnier than gravy and lighter than a stew
example: बीमार को सिर्फ़ शोरबा दिया गया। — Only broth was given to the patient.

hindi: उपद्रव — बेचैनी और हंगामे की फैली हुई हालत
definition: widespread unrest and agitation that unsettles a state without yet hardening into an organised revolt
example: शहर में महीनों शोरिश रही — There was unrest in the city for months.

hindi: उन्माद — भीतर का तूफ़ान, बिखरा हुआ मन
definition: the turbulent madness of one stirred past bearing, mind in uproar rather than fixed on a single idea; agitation, not obsession
example: फ़िराक़ की शोरीदगी ने उसे रात भर जगाया। — The frenzy of separation kept him awake all night.

hindi: बावला — जिसका सर उन्माद से भरा हो
definition: wild-headed and past all restraint, the madness showing as reckless action; names the storm in the head rather than a settled eccentricity
example: शोरीदा-सर आशिक़ को कोई समझा नहीं सका। — Nobody could reason with that wild-headed lover.

hindi: प्रसिद्धि — नाम का दूर-दूर तक फैल जाना
definition: the spread of a person's name far beyond the people who know them, which may be earned or notorious; it measures reach and says nothing about affection
example: शोहरत मिली, मगर सुकून चला गया — Fame came, but peace went away.

hindi: शान — रुतबे की भव्यता
definition: the grandeur that surrounds high standing, splendour belonging to power rather than to beauty
example: दरबार की शौकत देखने लायक़ थी — The grandeur of the court was worth seeing.

hindi: पत्थर तराशने वाला — जो पत्थर काटकर शक्ल देता है
definition: the craftsman whose material is stone, cutting and dressing it into shape; among skilled hands he is the one working what cannot be melted or beaten
example: मेहराब के फूल किसी पुराने संगतराश ने बनाए थे। — The flowers on the arch were made by some old stone-carver.

hindi: निष्ठुर — पत्थर जैसा दिल रखने वाला
definition: hard-hearted before suffering it could easily relieve; the coldness reads as chosen rather than inborn
example: इतना संगदिल मालिक पहले कभी नहीं देखा। — I've never seen such a stone-hearted landlord.

hindi: प्रयास — मक़सद पाने की कोशिश और दौड़-धूप
definition: the effort and running about undertaken to reach an aim, striving rather than the wish behind it
example: उसकी सई रंग लाई — His striving bore fruit.

hindi: दुश्वारी — झेलनी पड़ने वाली सख़्ती
definition: difficulty in the sense of harsh conditions that must be borne, such as heat, distance or a long ordeal; hardship rather than complexity
example: सफ़र की सऊबत बुज़ुर्गों के लिए आसान नहीं — The hardship of travel is not easy for the elderly.

hindi: जड़ता — सन्न रह जाना, बोलती बंद हो जाना
definition: the stunned stillness in which a person neither speaks nor moves, awareness frozen rather than lost; a stupor with the eyes open
example: उस मंज़र को देखकर उस पर सकता तारी हो गया। — At that sight a stunned stupor came over him.

hindi: मौत की तकलीफ़ — जान निकलते वक़्त का दर्द और बेहोशी
definition: the agony and stupor of dying, naming the pain of the passage where नज़्अ names only its timing
example: सकरात में उसने किसी को पहचाना नहीं — In the death agony he recognised no one.

hindi: दानशीलता — खुले हाथ देने की आदत
definition: generosity in giving money away, the settled habit of open-handedness rather than a single generous gesture
example: उसकी सख़ावत का चर्चा पूरे मोहल्ले में है — His generosity is talked about all over the neighbourhood.

hindi: दानी — बिना माँगे खुले हाथ देने वाला
definition: giving money freely and by habit, generous without waiting to be asked and without publishing the gesture
example: वो सख़ी आदमी है, कोई ख़ाली नहीं लौटता — He is a generous man; nobody returns empty-handed.

hindi: योग्य — जो किसी सिला या सज़ा के लायक़ हो
definition: deserving what one gets, said of reward or punishment earned by conduct rather than claimed by right
example: ऐसी हरकत के बाद वो किसी रियायत का सज़ावार नहीं। — After such an act he deserves no concession.

hindi: साष्टांग — माथा ज़मीन पर टेकना
definition: the prostration of putting the forehead on the ground in worship, the bodily act rather than the words; a prayer is spoken, this is performed and marks total submission
example: उसका सज्दा बहुत लंबा था — His prostration was a very long one.

hindi: ढकने की हद — बदन का वो हिस्सा जिसका ढका रहना ज़रूरी है
definition: the part of the body that religious rule requires to be kept covered by clothing
example: नमाज़ में सतर का ढका होना शर्त है। — Covering the required part of the body is a condition in prayer.

hindi: बड़ाई — किसी की खुले तौर पर की गई तारीफ़
definition: open praise of a person spoken to others, a reputation being built in public; it addresses the doer rather than the work, and can slide into flattery in a way considered praise cannot
example: वह अपनी सताइश सुनकर झेंप गया — He grew shy hearing himself praised.

hindi: प्रताप — दबा देने वाली ताक़त
definition: overpowering might that makes others yield without a contest, force felt as pressure rather than shown as display
example: उसकी सत्वत के आगे किसी ने ज़बान न खोली — Nobody opened their mouth before his might.

hindi: उतारा — बला टालने के लिए दिया जाने वाला दान
definition: charity given to turn misfortune away from oneself or another, voluntary giving with a protective intention behind it
example: बच्चे की तबीयत पर उन्होंने सदक़ा दिया — For the child's health they gave alms in protection.

hindi: सीपी — जिसके अंदर मोती बनता है
definition: the oyster shell in which the pearl grows; the plain container praised only for the pearl it hides
example: सदफ़ टूटे बग़ैर मोती हाथ नहीं आता। — The pearl is not had until the shell breaks.

hindi: पुकार — दूर तक जाने वाली आवाज़
definition: a voice sent out as a call, heard rather than seen, often with nobody visible making it; ordinary sound merely reaches you, this one is addressed to you
example: रात में एक सदा आई और ख़ामोशी छा गई — A call came in the night and then silence fell.

hindi: उद्योग — बड़े पैमाने पर माल बनाने का काम
definition: the making of goods organised at scale, whole sectors of it; stands above handicraft and above one man's trade, taking in factories together
example: इस शहर की कपड़ा सनअत हज़ारों को रोज़गार देती है। — This city's cloth industry gives thousands their work.

hindi: प्रमाण-पत्र — लिखित अधिकार या प्रमाण जिसे पेश किया जा सके
definition: a written authority or certificate that can be produced as proof of standing; a document cited, not merely held
example: उसकी बात सनद मानी जाती है। — His word is taken as authoritative.

hindi: गुणगान — किसी के गुणों का बखान
definition: praise spoken by listing someone's qualities, usable of God or of a revered person alike
example: उसने उस्ताद की सना में क़सीदा पढ़ा — He recited an ode in praise of his master.

hindi: चीड़ जैसा पेड़ — सीधा और सदाबहार
definition: the pine-like evergreen tree, cited for staying green and upright through every season
example: पहाड़ी पर सनोबर के दरख़्त क़तार में थे। — Pines stood in a row on the hillside.

hindi: क़तार — लड़ाई या नमाज़ में खड़ी पंक्ति
definition: the drawn-up rank of a fighting force, the line soldiers stand in on a battlefield, also the row of worshippers
example: दुश्मन की सफ़ें टूट गईं — The enemy's ranks broke.

hindi: यात्रा — एक जगह से दूसरी जगह तक का जाना
definition: a journey considered as the whole passage from setting out to arriving, the trip as an experience rather than the distance covered
example: यह सफ़र उम्मीद से लंबा निकला — This journey turned out longer than expected.

hindi: पित्त — गरम और ख़ुश्क समझा जाने वाला रस
definition: yellow bile among the humours, held burning and parched, blamed for fevers and quick anger; the humour of heat rather than of cold
example: सफ़रा बढ़ जाए तो मिज़ाज तेज़ हो जाता है। — When bile rises, the temper turns sharp.

hindi: राजदूत-कर्म — एक मुल्क की तरफ़ से दूसरे मुल्क में नुमाइंदगी
definition: the work of representing one state inside another, diplomacy as an office with an embassy rather than as skill in talk
example: उन्होंने दस साल सफ़ारत में गुज़ारे — He spent ten years in the diplomatic service.

hindi: नाव या जहाज़ — पानी पर चलने वाली सवारी
definition: a vessel that carries travellers over water, used in the elevated register where an ordinary boat would not do
example: सफ़ीना तूफ़ान में फँस गया — The vessel was caught in the storm.

hindi: ख़ून बहाने वाला — बिना पछतावे क़त्ल करने वाला
definition: blood-shedding without flinching, said of a person whose cruelty is habitual; it names the killer, where savagery names his act
example: इतना सफ़्फ़ाक हाकिम पहले कभी न देखा — Never before had they seen so bloodthirsty a ruler.

hindi: क्रूरता — ख़ून बहाने में हिचक न होना
definition: cruelty of the blood-shedding kind, which kills without hesitation; goes further than the mere absence of mercy
example: उस क़त्ल की सफ़्फ़ाकी अख़बारों में छाई रही — The butchery of that murder filled the papers.

hindi: पृष्ठ — पन्ने का एक लिखा हुआ रुख़
definition: one page, the single written face of a leaf; a smaller unit than the leaf of paper that carries it
example: पहला सफ़्हा ही फटा हुआ था। — The very first page itself was torn.

hindi: पुरवाई — सुबह की हल्की हवा जो ख़ुशबू लाती है
definition: the morning breeze of moving air that carries scent and message, tied to dawn and to lovers where the plain wind is not
example: सबा फूलों की ख़ुशबू लेकर आई। — The morning breeze came carrying the scent of flowers.

hindi: हरा रंग — उगती चीज़ों और बरकत का रंग
definition: green in colour, the colour of growing things and of cloth associated with blessing
example: मज़ार पर सब्ज़ चादर चढ़ाई गई। — A green cloth was laid on the tomb.

hindi: हरियाली — ज़मीन पर उगी हुई नई घास
definition: young green growth spread over the ground, the greenness itself rather than any single plant or tree
example: बारिश के बाद हर तरफ़ सब्ज़ा निकल आया। — After the rain green growth came up everywhere.

hindi: हरियाली का मैदान — घास से ढकी ज़मीन
definition: a stretch of greenery and grass, ground praised for being green rather than for any flowers planted on it
example: बारिश के बाद पूरा मैदान सब्ज़ा-ज़ार बन गया — After the rain the whole field became a green sward.

hindi: धैर्य — तकलीफ़ में भी टिके रहना
definition: endurance held steady through hardship, a patience that bears weight rather than merely waits out time
example: थोड़ा सब्र करो, नतीजा आने वाला है। — Have a little patience; the result is about to come.

hindi: धैर्य की परीक्षा लेने वाला — जो सहते-सहते थका दे
definition: of a wait or an ordeal long enough to test a person's endurance to its limit; describes the trial, not the one enduring it
example: इलाज का ये सब्र-आज़मा दौर आख़िर ख़त्म हुआ — This patience-testing stretch of treatment finally ended.

hindi: बादामी रंग का तेज़ घोड़ा — पसंदीदा सवारी
definition: a fine dun-coloured riding horse, praised as a mount worth owning; it names the prized animal, not the wild or the burdened one
example: समंद पर सवार होकर वो मैदान में उतरा — He came onto the field mounted on his fine steed.

hindi: फल — पेड़ का दिया हुआ, और मेहनत का नतीजा भी
definition: the fruit a tree yields, and in the same breath the fruit of labour; names the yield rather than any particular edible fruit
example: हर पेड़ अपने समर से पहचाना जाता है। — Every tree is known by its fruit.

hindi: सूफ़ी संगीत-सभा — सुनकर हाल में आ जाने वाली महफ़िल
definition: the listening assembly where music is heard as devotion and might bring on ecstasy; a gathering for hearing rather than for wine
example: समा में क़व्वाली सुनते-सुनते वो उठ खड़ा हुआ। — Listening in the devotional assembly, he rose to his feet.

hindi: विष — शरीर में जाकर मार डालने वाली चीज़
definition: poison as a medical substance, a thing that kills once inside the body; the clinical term where common speech has an everyday word
example: साँप का सम्म ख़ून में फैल चुका था। — The snake's poison had already spread in the blood.

hindi: शिकारी — जाल या तीर से परिंदे-जानवर पकड़ने वाला
definition: the hunter as a figure, the man who lays the trap rather than one who merely kills game; in poetry he is whoever cages a free creature
example: सय्याद ने जाल बिछाया और परिंदा उतर आया — The hunter spread his net and the bird came down.

hindi: रास्ते में ही — बीच राह में, चलते-चलते
definition: right on the road, said of something happening in passing on the way rather than at a settled place
example: सर-ए-राह मुलाक़ात हो गई — We met right there on the road.

hindi: जान की बाज़ी — सिर देने को तैयार रहना
definition: the readiness to give one's own head for a cause, resistance carried to the point of death
example: सर-फ़रोशी की तमन्ना उस नस्ल के लहू में थी — The wish to give their heads was in that generation's blood.

hindi: मुहरबंद — जिसकी मुहर अभी टूटी न हो
definition: sealed and still unopened, describing a letter or envelope whose seal no one has yet broken; the contents remain unread
example: लिफ़ाफ़ा सर-बमोहर वापस आ गया। — The envelope came back still sealed.

hindi: मुँहज़ोर — जो लगाम और हुक्म दोनों न माने
definition: unruly and hard to break, of a horse that fights the rein and of a man who refuses authority; it defies where the wild one merely flees
example: सरकश घोड़े को कोई सवार पसंद नहीं आता — An unruly horse takes to no rider.

hindi: उद्दंडता — हुक्म मानने से खुला इनकार
definition: one person's defiance of authority, refusing to obey without necessarily aiming to overthrow anyone
example: उसकी सरकशी से अफ़सर तंग आ चुके थे — The officers were tired of his insubordination.

hindi: सरगना — टोली का मुखिया
definition: the chief of a band or gang, leader of a small armed party, a word said with suspicion rather than respect
example: डाकुओं का सरख़ैल पकड़ा गया — The chief of the bandits was caught.

hindi: मस्त — जिसके सिर पर नशा चढ़ा हो
definition: drunk to the head while still walking and talking, cheerful with it; describes an elated drinker rather than a collapsed one
example: सरख़ोश होकर वो हर बात पर हँस रहा था। — Merrily drunk, he was laughing at everything.

hindi: मारा-मारा फिरना — परेशानी में इधर-उधर भटकना
definition: distracted wandering in search of something, roaming driven by worry rather than by freedom
example: काग़ज़ात के लिए महीनों सरगर्दानी रही — There were months of running about for the documents.

hindi: कानाफूसी — कान के पास कही गई बात
definition: a whisper exchanged close to the ear; implies an audience deliberately kept outside it
example: अदालत में सरगोशी तक सुनाई दे रही थी। — In the courtroom even a whisper carried.

hindi: डाँट-फटकार — ग़लती पर मुँह पर की गई संजीदा फटकार
definition: a rebuke delivered to someone's face for a fault, measured and formal; scolding that carries the weight of authority rather than temper
example: अफ़सर ने सबके सामने उसकी सरज़निश की — The officer rebuked him in front of everyone.

hindi: संरक्षक — जो किसी की देखभाल और ज़िम्मेदारी ले
definition: the person who takes charge of a child's or family's affairs and answers for them; a protector by role, where the elders hold authority merely by age
example: यतीम बच्चों के सरपरस्त उनके चचा बने — Their uncle became the guardian of the orphaned children.

hindi: संरक्षण — किसी को अपने साये में लेकर सँभालना
definition: the protection and backing a guardian extends over dependents or a household; the ongoing care itself, where the guardian is the person who gives it
example: उसकी पढ़ाई मामू की सरपरस्ती में हुई — His schooling happened under his maternal uncle's protection.

hindi: सर कटाने को तैयार — मक़सद पर जान देने वाला
definition: brave in the particular way of one who offers his head for a belief; fearlessness dedicated to a cause rather than shown in ordinary danger
example: सरफ़रोश नौजवानों ने झंडा नहीं झुकने दिया — The self-sacrificing youths did not let the flag fall.

hindi: मतवालापन — बेपरवाह और झूमती हुई ख़ुशी
definition: a swaggering intoxicated abandon in which a person stops caring how they appear, more careless and more physical than mere elation
example: वह सरमस्ती में झूमता हुआ चला गया — He walked off swaying in careless abandon.

hindi: शीत ऋतु — जाड़े का मौसम
definition: the winter season taken as a stretch of the year, the cold months as a period rather than the sensation of cold
example: सरमा की छुट्टियाँ पहाड़ों पर गुज़रीं। — The winter holidays were spent in the hills.

hindi: पूँजी — कारोबार में लगाने के लिए रखा गया धन
definition: capital held to be put to work in trade, wealth kept as a working stock rather than as spent property
example: सारा सरमाया एक ही दुकान में लगा दिया — He put all his capital into a single shop.

hindi: धन-दौलत — बड़े पैमाने पर जमा की हुई संपत्ति
definition: wealth as a large accumulated mass of holdings that ranks a household, not the money a person happens to be carrying
example: उसकी सरवत का अंदाज़ा किसी को नहीं था — Nobody had any idea of the extent of his wealth.

hindi: सरशार होने का हाल — ख़ुशी से लबालब भरा होना
definition: the brimming-over of joy or love until a person overflows with it, fullness rather than the heaviness that follows
example: कामयाबी की सरशारी उसके चेहरे पर थी — The brimming joy of success was on his face.

hindi: हरा-भरा — जो पानी पाकर लहलहा रहा हो
definition: green and thriving with water and leaf, describing the health of a growing thing before any fruit appears
example: नहर के दोनों किनारे सरसब्ज़ हैं। — Both banks of the canal are green and thriving.

hindi: सीमा — दो मुल्कों के बीच खिंची हुई पहरेदार हद
definition: the guarded line where one state's territory ends and another's begins, a political boundary rather than any ordinary edge
example: सरहद पर दोनों तरफ़ की चौकियाँ आमने-सामने हैं — On the border the posts of both sides face each other.

hindi: संचरण — रोग या असर का भीतर फैल जाना
definition: the seeping of a disease or influence from one place or body into another, the act of spreading itself, not the disease
example: ज़हर की सराएत ख़ून तक हो चुकी थी। — The poison had already spread into the blood.

hindi: सिर से पाँव तक का वर्णन — पूरा हुलिया
definition: a description of the beloved from head to foot, the poem-form and the word for a whole appearance taken together rather than a single feature
example: उसने ख़त में अपने महबूब का सरापा लिखा — In the letter he described his beloved from head to foot.

hindi: मृगतृष्णा — रेगिस्तान में पानी का धोखा
definition: a mirage of water that recedes as the traveller approaches, a hope that proves empty on arrival
example: वह उम्मीद सराब निकली — That hope turned out to be a mirage.

hindi: मुसाफ़िरख़ाना — राह में मुसाफ़िरों के ठहरने की जगह
definition: a roadside inn built for travellers to rest overnight, lodging meant for passing strangers rather than guests
example: रात सराय में गुज़ारी — We spent the night at the inn.

hindi: घबराहट — क्या करें कुछ न सूझना
definition: the confused panic in which a frightened person cannot decide what to do first; dread turned into disorder of the mind
example: आग लगते ही सरासीमगी में लोग एक-दूसरे पर गिरने लगे — In the panic when the fire started, people fell over each other.

hindi: ख़िलअत — सिर से पाँव तक दिया जाने वाला इनामी लिबास
definition: a robe of honour given from head to foot by a ruler to mark favour, never as payment for work
example: दरबार में शायर को सरोपा अता हुआ। — At court the poet was granted a robe of honour.

hindi: सरो वृक्ष — सीधा और लंबा सदाबहार पेड़
definition: the cypress, the standard image of an upright slender height that never bends
example: बाग़ के किनारे सर्व खड़े थे। — Cypresses stood along the edge of the garden.

hindi: सरो जैसे क़द वाला — लंबा और सीधा
definition: having a height as straight and slender as a cypress, praising a person's stature rather than naming a tree
example: वो सर्व-क़द जवान भीड़ में अलग दिखता था। — That cypress-tall youth stood out in the crowd.

hindi: पूर्वज — पहले गुज़र चुके बड़े लोग
definition: the elders of earlier generations taken as a body, cited as the example the present is measured against
example: हमारे सलफ़ इस मामले में सख़्त थे। — Our elders of earlier generations were strict in this matter.

hindi: सरलता — कठिन बात को सादे शब्दों में कहने का गुण
definition: the easy plainness of good prose, saying a difficult thing in simple written words without losing its force
example: उनकी ज़बान की सलासत सिखाने लायक़ है। — The plainness of his language is worth teaching.

hindi: क्षमता — किसी काम के क़ाबिल होने की भीतरी ताक़त
definition: the underlying capability to do a thing well, present before any practice has shaped it; mastery has been earned, this is what makes earning it possible
example: उसमें सिखाने की सलाहियत है — He has the capability to teach.

hindi: क़रीना — काम को सुघड़ ढंग से करने का हुनर
definition: the knack of doing ordinary things gracefully, from folding clothes to answering a stranger; not politeness but competence with taste in it
example: उसे बात करने का सलीक़ा है — He has the knack of speaking well.

hindi: बादशाहत — एक ताजदार के अधीन फैला हुआ बड़ा राज्य
definition: a kingdom held under one crowned ruler, stressing the extent and inheritance of the domain rather than the daily business of governing
example: सल्तनत तीन नदियों के पार तक फैली हुई थी — The kingdom stretched beyond three rivers.

hindi: पुण्य — नेक काम से मिलने वाला बदला
definition: the credit earned by a good deed and carried into the hereafter, a countable reward that can even be dedicated to someone already dead
example: प्यासे को पानी पिलाने में बड़ा सवाब है — There is great reward in giving water to the thirsty.

hindi: लाल शराब — पुरानी, सुर्ख़ रंग की मदिरा
definition: aged crimson wine named by its colour and vintage, not by what it does to the drinker; the wine a poet praises for beauty before effect
example: सुराही में सहबा का रंग शाम जैसा था। — The red wine in the flask had the colour of evening.

hindi: सहम जाना — डर से एकदम ठिठक जाने की हालत
definition: the sudden freezing of a person struck by fear, showing as stillness rather than flight; the body's check, not the dread behind it
example: आवाज़ सुनकर बच्चों पर सहम छा गया — At the sound a frozen fear came over the children.

hindi: मरुस्थल — रेत का सूना मैदान
definition: the desert taken as a landscape of exile and endless walking, chosen in poetry for its indifference to the traveller
example: वह सहरा में पानी ढूँढ़ता फिरा — He wandered the desert searching for water.

hindi: भोर का भोजन — रोज़ा शुरू होने से पहले खाया जाने वाला खाना
definition: the meal eaten just before dawn to begin a day of fasting, the counterpart of the meal that breaks it
example: सहरी के वक़्त सब उठकर खाना खाते हैं — At the pre-dawn meal everyone rises to eat.

hindi: चूक — असावधानी से हुई भूल, और सूफ़ी की जागृति भी
definition: the sober clarity that follows mystic intoxication, and in ordinary speech a slip made through inattention; the return of everyday awareness
example: सुकर के बाद सहव आता है, यही सिलसिला है। — After intoxication comes sobriety; such is the order.

hindi: सुविधा — काम आसान करने की व्यवस्था
definition: an ease or facility provided so a task troubles you less; names the arrangement, never the feeling it produces
example: ऑनलाइन फ़ॉर्म की सहूलत अब हर ज़िले में है। — The convenience of an online form is now available in every district.

hindi: वज्रपात — गिरने वाली बिजली जो जला दे
definition: the thunderbolt that actually strikes and burns, the lightning that lands rather than the flash that only lights the cloud
example: साइक़ा गिरा और पुराना दरख़्त जल गया। — The thunderbolt fell and the old tree burned.

hindi: छप्पर — धूप-बारिश से बचाने वाली छाजन
definition: an awning built to make shade, a made shelter against sun and rain rather than shadow falling by chance
example: दुकान के आगे कपड़े का साएबान तान दिया गया। — A cloth awning was stretched in front of the shop.

hindi: पिलाने वाला — महफ़िल में जाम भरकर देने वाला
definition: the one who pours the wine at a gathering, addressed by the poet as the giver of both the drink and the mercy behind it
example: साक़ी ने आज देर कर दी — The cupbearer is late tonight.

hindi: मय का प्याला — पीने का बड़ा कटोरा
definition: the goblet from which wine is drunk, the vessel in the drinker's hand as opposed to the flask it was poured from
example: साग़र उठाते ही उसका हाथ काँपा। — His hand shook as he lifted the goblet.

hindi: वाद्ययंत्र — जिससे संगीत निकलता है
definition: a musical instrument taken as a class, the thing played rather than any particular one; the general word beneath the named instruments
example: साज़ छिड़ा तो महफ़िल की रंगत बदल गई। — The instrument struck up and the gathering changed colour.

hindi: साज़ो-सामान — घर का ज़रूरी सामान
definition: the furnishings and goods a household needs to function, useful things where decoration is added only for looks
example: नए मकान का साज़-ओ-सामान अभी पूरा नहीं — The new house's furnishings are not yet complete.

hindi: गुपचुप समझौता — विरोधी से अंदरखाने मेल
definition: a covert understanding with the other side, collusion that betrays your own people rather than an open plot against a target
example: दोनों की साज़-बाज़ थी — The two of them were in collusion.

hindi: षड्यंत्र — चुपके से बनाई गई नुक़सान की योजना
definition: a plot worked out in secret by several people to harm or unseat someone, the planning rather than the deed itself
example: उन्हें हटाने की साज़िश महीनों चलती रही — The plot to remove him ran on for months.

hindi: भोलापन — चालाकी से ख़ाली सीधापन
definition: the unwritten simplicity of someone who takes everything at face value, a child's innocence surviving into adult life
example: उनकी सादा-लौही का लोग फ़ायदा उठाते रहे। — People kept taking advantage of his guileless simplicity.

hindi: सिल्ली — घूमता पत्थर जिस पर धार तेज़ की जाती है
definition: the turning stone against which a blade is sharpened; restores an edge that has gone dull, unlike the file, which reshapes the body of a piece
example: छुरी सान पर लगाओ, धार बिलकुल ख़त्म है। — Put the knife to the grindstone; the edge is completely gone.

hindi: हादसा — एक दुखद वाक़या जो याद रह जाए
definition: a single tragic incident grave enough to be spoken of afterwards as an event; the newspaper word for a calamity with a date
example: ये सानिहा आज भी शहर को याद है — This tragedy is still remembered by the city.

hindi: अटल — जो अपने इरादे और वादे पर टिका रहे
definition: describing one who stands firm on his commitment under pressure, steadfast where others give way
example: मुश्किल दिनों में भी वो साबित-क़दम रहा। — Even in hard days he stood firm on his commitment.

hindi: पाँव का न उखड़ना — दबाव में भी जमे रहना
definition: firmness of footing under pressure, staying exactly where one stood when fear or temptation pushes the other way
example: ख़तरे में उसकी साबित-क़दमी क़ाबिल-ए-तारीफ़ थी — His firmness in danger was admirable.

hindi: छप्पर — धूप रोकने के लिए तानी हुई छत
definition: a canopy put up on purpose to make shade, a built thing rather than the shade a tree happens to cast
example: आँगन में एक सायबान तान दिया गया। — A canopy was stretched over the courtyard.

hindi: याचक — दरवाज़े पर माँगने आया हुआ
definition: one who asks for money or help, the petitioner at the door rather than a professional living by begging
example: सायल को ख़ाली हाथ लौटाना अच्छा नहीं — It is not good to send a petitioner away empty-handed.

hindi: छायादार — जो अच्छी छाँव देता हो
definition: wide enough to give good shade, describing the tree that provides it rather than the shade itself
example: रास्ते में एक साया-दार दरख़्त मिला। — We found a shady tree along the way.

hindi: ऊँट वाला — क़ाफ़िले के ऊँट हाँकने वाला
definition: the camel-driver who leads the beasts of a caravan; he governs the animals, unlike the travellers who merely ride them
example: सारबान ने ठहरने का इशारा किया — The camel-driver signalled a halt.

hindi: उम्रदराज़ — जिसके ऊपर से बहुत साल गुज़र चुके
definition: worn by the passing of many years, said of an old person or object that shows its age plainly
example: एक सालख़ुर्दा बुज़ुर्ग दरवाज़े पर बैठे थे। — A years-worn old man sat at the door.

hindi: तरी वाला गोश्त या सब्ज़ी — जो रोटी के साथ खाया जाए
definition: the cooked meat or vegetable dish in gravy eaten with bread, the counterpart of the bread rather than a dish on its own
example: आज सालन में आलू गोश्त है। — Today the curry is potato and meat.

hindi: बरसों-बरस — साल पर साल गुज़रते हुए
definition: year after year in an unbroken run of time, marking how long a state has lasted rather than when it began
example: सालहा-साल वो इसी कमरे में रहे। — Year after year he lived in this same room.

hindi: नायक — दल के आगे चलने वाला अगुआ
definition: a leader at the head of a body of men, commander of a column or party rather than of the entire army
example: क़ाफ़िले का सालार आगे चल रहा था — The leader of the caravan walked ahead.

hindi: मध्यस्थ — दोनों की रज़ा से चुना गया फ़ैसला करने वाला
definition: the arbitrator both parties choose to settle their dispute, a judge by agreement and not by office
example: बुज़ुर्ग को सालिस मुक़र्रर किया गया। — The elder was appointed as arbitrator.

hindi: मध्यस्थता — तीसरे के ज़रिए झगड़ा तय कराना
definition: arbitration in which a chosen third party settles a dispute both sides have agreed to accept
example: दोनों फ़रीक़ सालिसी पर राज़ी हो गए। — Both parties agreed to arbitration.

hindi: पाखंड — भलमनसाहत का ओढ़ा हुआ चोला
definition: a settled pretence of piety or goodness worn as a character, not just performed in one act; showing off borrows a moment, this is a whole false person
example: उसका सालूस आख़िर खुल ही गया — His hypocrisy was exposed in the end.

hindi: हैसियत वाला — जिसकी माली ताक़त उसे वज़न देती है
definition: a person of means whose wealth gives him weight in a decision, standing measured by capacity to spend
example: मामला साहिब-ए-हैसियत लोगों के हाथ में चला गया — The matter passed into the hands of men of means.

hindi: जादूगर — जो अपने असर से बाँध ले
definition: the one who casts the spell, a magician, used of a beautiful or eloquent person who holds a whole audience captive
example: वह लफ़्ज़ों का साहिर है — He is a magician of words.

hindi: किनारा — समुंदर या दरिया का तट
definition: the shore where water ends and safety begins, the goal of a sea journey rather than a place on land generally
example: कश्ती साहिल के क़रीब आ गई — The boat came near the shore.

hindi: निहाई — लोहे का ठोस कुंदा जिस पर गरम धातु पीटी जाती है
definition: the solid iron block on which heated metal is hammered into shape; it takes the blow rather than delivering it, the still half of forging
example: गरम लोहा सिंदान पर रखकर उसने हथौड़ा उठाया। — He set the hot iron on the anvil and raised the hammer.

hindi: अत्याचार — जान-बूझकर दिया गया कष्ट
definition: a deliberate act of tormenting someone, countable and repeatable, so a person commits many of these over time
example: यह उसका पहला सितम नहीं था — This was not his first act of torment.

hindi: ज़ुल्म करने वाला — दुख देने वाला महबूब भी
definition: one who inflicts suffering, used in verse half-fondly of a beloved whose indifference causes pain; softer in tone than a tyrant
example: ऐ सितम-गर, कभी हाल तो पूछ लिया कर — Tormentor, ask after me at least sometimes.

hindi: प्रशंसा — आदर के साथ की गई तारीफ़
definition: formal praise offered with reverence, the kind addressed upward to a patron or to God
example: सिताइश सुनकर वह झेंप गया — He grew shy on hearing the praise.

hindi: आयु — गिनती में उम्र
definition: age stated as a number of years, the plain figure asked for on a form rather than the feel of being old or young
example: सिन पूछा तो उसने बताने से इनकार कर दिया। — When asked his age in years he refused to say.

hindi: समझदारी की उम्र — अपना भला-बुरा समझने की अवस्था
definition: the age at which judgement is presumed, later than mere legal age and measured by fitness to handle one's own affairs
example: सिन-ए-रुश्द पर पहुँचकर जायदाद उसके हवाले हुई। — The property passed to him on reaching the age of judgement.

hindi: उम्र-हिसाब — किसी की आयु का ब्योरा
definition: a person's age reckoned in years and stage of life together, used when a record needs both the number and the season
example: सिन-ओ-साल के लिहाज़ से वो अब बुज़ुर्गों में गिने जाते हैं। — By his age and years he is now counted among the elders.

hindi: भाले की नोक — फल का नुकीला सिरा
definition: the iron head of a spear, the part that actually pierces; it names the point rather than the whole hunting weapon
example: सिनान चमक रही थी और दुश्मन ठिठक गया — The spearhead glinted and the enemy faltered.

hindi: ढाल — वार रोकने के लिए आगे की गई चीज़
definition: the shield raised to stop a blow, protection you interpose rather than wear; also anyone pushed forward to take the harm
example: उसने दोस्त के आगे ख़ुद को सिपर कर दिया — He made himself a shield in front of his friend.

hindi: सेनापति — पूरी फ़ौज का सबसे बड़ा सरदार
definition: the supreme commander of an army, the one officer the whole force answers to, above every subordinate leader
example: सिपहसालार ने पीछे हटने का हुक्म दिया — The commander-in-chief ordered a retreat.

hindi: सैन्य बल — सिपाहियों का पूरा समूह
definition: the fighting force considered as a body of soldiers, the army in its formal sense, the word that sits inside titles of command
example: सिपाह का हौसला बुलंद था — The morale of the army was high.

hindi: सौंप देना — अपना मामला पूरी तरह हवाले कर देना
definition: the act of handing oneself or one's affair over completely, surrender described as a transfer rather than as an attitude
example: अब पूरी सिपुर्दगी है, कोई शिकायत नहीं — There is complete handing-over now, no complaint.

hindi: गुण — किसी में मौजूद ख़ूबी
definition: a quality that belongs to someone, and by extension the praising of it, so listing these is how one praises without flattery
example: उसमें सब्र की सिफ़त है — He has the quality of patience.

hindi: अनुशंसा — किसी के हक़ में लगाई गई पैरवी
definition: a recommendation put in on someone's behalf; in practice often the pull of influence rather than the weight of merit
example: नौकरी सिफ़ारिश से नहीं, इम्तिहान से मिली। — The job came from the exam, not from connections.

hindi: दिशा — जिस ओर चला जाए
definition: the direction in which one moves, a bearing on the compass rather than a road or a goal
example: हवा की सिम्त बदल गई — The direction of the wind changed.

hindi: काली क़िस्मत — जन्म से चला आया दुर्भाग्य
definition: misfortune spoken of as a darkness written into a life from the start, the poetic name for chronic bad luck
example: अपनी सियह-बख़्ती का रोना वो अब नहीं रोता — He no longer laments his black fortune.

hindi: तपेदिक़ — फेफड़ों को खा जाने वाला रोग
definition: tuberculosis named as a specific lung disease, the ailment behind the wasting fever; used where the older word describes the wasting itself
example: सिल का इलाज लंबा चलता है। — The treatment of tuberculosis runs long.

hindi: पुराणों का विशाल पक्षी — क़ाफ़ पहाड़ पर रहने वाला
definition: the giant mythical bird of Persian story, wise and hidden on a far mountain; unlike the luck-bird it grants counsel rather than a crown
example: सीमुर्ग़ की तलाश में सब परिंदे निकल पड़े — All the birds set out in search of the fabled Simurgh.

hindi: चरित्र — भीतर का असल स्वभाव
definition: the inner character that lies behind a face; what a person actually is, named specifically to be set against the appearance the eye reports
example: सूरत नहीं, सीरत देखो — Look at the character, not the face.

hindi: आध्यात्मिक नशा — इबादत या इश्क़ में होश का डूब जाना
definition: the intoxication of the spirit in which awareness of self is drowned; a mystical state, not the effect of any drink
example: उस हाल में सूफ़ी सुकर की बात करते हैं — Sufis call that condition spiritual intoxication.

hindi: शांति — हलचल थमने के बाद वाला ठहराव
definition: settled inner peace once agitation stops, spoken of as something sought and rationed; calm describes the surface, this describes underneath
example: किताब पढ़ते हुए ही सुकून मिलता है — Only while reading a book do I find peace.

hindi: रिहाइश का पता — जहाँ आप क़ानूनन रहते हों
definition: residence as an official fact of where a person lives, the word a form or a court asks for
example: फ़ार्म में सुकूनत का पता लिखना ज़रूरी है — The form requires writing the address of residence.

hindi: वाणी — कहा हुआ शब्द, ख़ास तौर पर शेर
definition: speech treated as an art, and by extension poetry itself, the word used when language is being weighed as craft rather than used to convey information
example: सुख़न का शौक़ उन्हें बचपन से था — He has had a passion for poetry since childhood.

hindi: वाग्मी कवि — जिसकी ज़बान और कहन दोनों उम्दा हों
definition: a poet praised for command of language itself rather than for feeling alone, one whose speech is the achievement; any versifier is a शायर, this title is earned
example: वह दौर बड़े सुख़नवरों का दौर था — That era belonged to great masters of the word.

hindi: खंभा — छत का बोझ उठाने वाला सीधा स्तंभ
definition: the upright member that carries the weight of a roof down to the ground; bears load standing straight, where an arch carries it across a span
example: बरामदे के सुतून संगमरमर के हैं। — The pillars of the verandah are of marble.

hindi: पैग़ंबरी रीति — नबी का तरीक़ा, जिसका पालन पुण्य है
definition: the Prophet's own practice, recommended by religious law and rewarded when followed but not obligatory like a duty
example: मिस्वाक करना सुन्नत है — Using the tooth-stick is the Prophet's practice.

hindi: मिट्टी के हवाले — दफ़नाने का अदबी बयान
definition: committing a dead body to the earth, said as handing the person over to the dust that will keep them; the dignified phrase newspapers use for a burial that has taken place
example: शाम को उन्हें सुपुर्द-ए-ख़ाक कर दिया गया — He was committed to the earth in the evening.

hindi: हल्का — जिसमें भारीपन न हो
definition: light in weight or in bearing, lending a thing an unlaboured grace; also used of a person made to feel small
example: उसकी चाल बहुत सुबुक है — His walk is very light.

hindi: सेवानिवृत्ति — काम का बोझ उतरना
definition: the laying down of a working life at the appointed age, the shoulder freed of duty rather than a rest taken
example: सुबुकदोशी के बाद उन्होंने पढ़ना शुरू किया। — After retirement he took up reading.

hindi: मय का मटका — जिसमें से प्याले भरे जाते हैं
definition: the earthen flask that holds the wine from which cups are filled, the source vessel rather than the one drunk from
example: सुबू ख़ाली हो गया मगर प्यास बाक़ी थी। — The wine flask emptied but the thirst remained.

hindi: सच्ची भोर — असली सवेरा जिसके बाद अँधेरा नहीं लौटता
definition: the true dawn whose light keeps growing, distinguished from the false glow before it that fades back into darkness
example: सुब्ह-ए-सादिक़ के बाद रोज़ा शुरू हो जाता है। — The fast begins after the true dawn.

hindi: लू — जलती हुई ज़हरीली गर्म हवा
definition: a scorching poisonous wind of desert air that kills what it touches, the opposite of the cooling breeze in every way
example: दोपहर की सुमूम में बाहर निकलना ख़तरनाक है। — Going out in the noon scorch-wind is dangerous.

hindi: जलकुंभी-पुष्प — जिसकी उपमा घुँघराले बालों से दी जाती है
definition: the hyacinth flower, used as the standard image for dark curling hair rather than for the eye or the cheek
example: उसके बाल सुम्बुल की लटों जैसे थे। — Her hair was like the tresses of a hyacinth.

hindi: सूत्र — जिससे किसी का पता चले
definition: a clue pointing to where someone or something has gone, a trace usable for tracking rather than proof
example: अब तक कोई सुराग़ नहीं मिला — No clue has been found so far.

hindi: हल्का नशा — मीठी सी ख़ुमारी, जो सँभली हुई हो
definition: the first gentle lift of drink or of music, pleasure still under control; the state before drunkenness rather than drunkenness itself
example: दो घूँट में ही उस पर सुरूर छा गया। — Two sips and a gentle glow came over him.

hindi: लाल रंग का — कपड़े का या ग़ुस्से से तमतमाए चेहरे का
definition: red in colour, said of cloth and of a face flushed with anger or with shame
example: सुनते ही उसका चेहरा सुर्ख़ हो गया। — His face went red the moment he heard.

hindi: काजल — आँखों की पलकों पर लगाया जाने वाला काला चूर्ण
definition: the fine dark powder applied along the eyelids to darken and cool the eyes
example: उसने आँखों में सुर्मा लगाया और चल दी। — She applied kohl to her eyes and set off.

hindi: समझौता — लड़ाई ख़त्म करके मिल जाना
definition: the making of peace between disputing sides, ending a quarrel by agreement instead of by a verdict; both sides walk away rather than one winning
example: मुक़दमा वापस लेकर सुलह हो गई — The case was withdrawn and peace made.

hindi: बुरा सोचना — दूसरे के बारे में बुरी राय बना लेना
definition: thinking badly of another, the formal name for the vice of suspicion where बदगुमानी names the everyday habit
example: सू-ए-ज़न से बचना चाहिए — One should avoid thinking ill of others.

hindi: बुरी नीयत — दिल में खोट रखकर मुआमला करना
definition: bad intention hidden behind a dealing, the direct opposite of good faith in an agreement
example: उसकी ख़ामोशी में सू-ए-नीयत झलकती थी। — Bad intention showed through his silence.

hindi: ब्याज — क़र्ज़ पर वक़्त के बदले लिया गया अतिरिक्त धन
definition: the extra money charged on a debt for time, interest as a fixed price on borrowing rather than profit earned in trade
example: असल रक़म से ज़्यादा सूद भर चुका है — He has paid more in interest than the principal itself.

hindi: ब्याजजीवी — ब्याज की कमाई पर जीने वाला
definition: a moneylender who lives on the interest he charges, despised for making his money out of other people's debt
example: गाँव का सूद-ख़ोर सबकी ज़मीन हड़प चुका है — The village usurer has swallowed everyone's land.

hindi: तृप्त — जितना खाना चाहिए था उतना खा चुका
definition: full of food to the point where appetite has stopped, describing the eater rather than the meal; the exact opposite pole of hungry
example: वो दो रोटी में ही सेर हो जाता है। — He is full on just two rotis.

hindi: तृप्ति — पेट भर जाने की वो हालत जिसके बाद और नहीं जाता
definition: the state of being full after food, the satisfied condition itself and not the eater; names what a good meal leaves behind
example: खाने की सेरी नींद ले आई। — The fullness of the meal brought on sleep.

hindi: स्वास्थ्य-लाभ — बीमारी के बाद तंदुरुस्त हो जाना
definition: the completed return to health after an illness, recovery reached rather than begun; where improvement is partial, this is the arrival
example: आपकी जल्द सेहत-याबी की दुआ है। — We pray for your swift recovery.

hindi: जादू — मंत्र-सा असर करने वाली क्रिया
definition: magic in the worked deliberate sense of a spell cast on someone, and by extension a beauty that seems to act on you against your will
example: उसकी आवाज़ में सेहर है — There is magic in her voice.

hindi: मौर — दूल्हे के चेहरे पर बाँधी जाने वाली फूलों की लड़ियाँ
definition: the veil of flower strings tied over a bridegroom's face at the wedding ceremony
example: सेहरा बाँधते ही उसकी आँखें भर आईं। — His eyes filled the moment the flower veil was tied.

hindi: चमकाई — घिसकर धातु को चमकाने का काम
definition: the burnishing that brings a dulled metal surface back to shine; works on the finish only, where sharpening restores an edge
example: पुरानी तलवार सैक़ल के बाद नई जैसी लगने लगी। — After burnishing, the old sword looked new.

hindi: शिकार किया जाने वाला जीव — जिसका पीछा हो रहा हो
definition: the prey being chased, the creature still running rather than the one already taken; it names the hunted side of the hunt
example: सैद थक जाए तो सय्याद जीत जाता है — When the prey tires, the hunter wins.

hindi: प्यास बुझा हुआ — पानी से भरपूर, चाहे आदमी हो या ज़मीन
definition: thirst fully quenched with water, said of a person who has drunk enough or of soil soaked through; not merely wet but satisfied
example: बारिश के बाद खेत सैराब हो गए। — After the rain the fields were fully watered.

hindi: बाढ़ — बरसात का पानी जो किनारे तोड़कर फैल जाए
definition: a flood of rain water that has broken its banks and spread over land, destruction by excess water rather than by its shortage
example: सैलाब में पूरा गाँव पानी के नीचे चला गया। — The whole village went under water in the flood.

hindi: शोक की अवधि — मरने के बाद का वह वक़्त जिसमें ख़ुशी छोड़ दी जाती है
definition: the period of mourning kept after a death, during which celebration, colour and music are set aside; a stretch of time observed, not a cry let out
example: साल भर घर में सोग रहा — The house stayed in mourning for a year.

hindi: शोकाकुल — जिस पर सोग बैठा हो
definition: in mourning, said of a person or a house carrying a recent death; describes the mourner's state rather than the grief or the rite
example: सोगवार परिवार से कोई कुछ न पूछ सका — No one could ask the mourning family anything.

hindi: जलन — भीतर धीरे-धीरे जलते रहने का भाव
definition: the inward burning of love or grief, a slow scorching that gives a voice or a poem its ache, unlike a sudden flare of feeling
example: उसकी आवाज़ में एक सोज़ है — There is a burning ache in his voice.

hindi: जलता हुआ — भीतर से सुलगता
definition: burning steadily from within, said of a heart or a lamp rather than of a thing that sets others alight
example: दिल-ए-सोज़ां को कोई शराब ठंडा नहीं करती। — No wine cools a burning heart.

hindi: जलन — सूजन के साथ होने वाली जलती पीड़ा
definition: burning pain with inflammation, the searing ache of a swollen wound; distinguishes scalding hurt from dull or stabbing hurt
example: ज़ख़्म की सोज़िश रात भर सोने न दे। — The burning of the wound allows no sleep all night.

hindi: रेती — खुरदुरा औज़ार जिससे धातु घिसी जाती है
definition: the rough-surfaced tool that smooths metal or wood by rubbing away a little at a time; finishes an edge the saw has already made
example: सोहन से किनारा घिसकर उसने चूड़ी चिकनी कर दी। — He rubbed the edge with the file and made the bangle smooth.

hindi: संगत — किसी के साथ रहने का असर
definition: the company one keeps and the influence it leaves, association considered for what it does to character
example: अच्छी सोहबत आदमी बदल देती है — Good company changes a man.

hindi: सपत्नी — एक ही पति की दूसरी पत्नी
definition: the other wife of one's own husband, a rival within the same household; a relation created by a second marriage, hostile by structure rather than by choice
example: सौत के आते ही घर का चैन उठ गया — The moment the co-wife arrived the peace of the house was gone.

hindi: विषाद-धातु — काला पित्त, जिससे उदासी और उन्माद आए
definition: black bile among the humours, held to breed brooding, obsession and madness; the humour that turns illness of body into illness of mind
example: सौदा ग़लबा कर जाए तो आदमी ख़यालों में खो जाता है। — When black bile prevails, a man is lost in his own thoughts.

hindi: सनकी — किसी एक ख़याल में डूबा हुआ पागल
definition: deranged in the fixated manner, held by one obsession rather than generally insane; describes the person the black humour has claimed
example: इश्क़ में सौदाई हो गया, दिन रात एक ही नाम। — Love made him obsessed; one name, day and night.

hindi: सौदा करने वाला — माल लेकर घूमने और मोल तय करने वाला
definition: a trader who moves with his goods and bargains deal by deal, a dealer rather than a settled merchant house
example: सौदागर ऊँटों पर माल लादकर निकला — The trader set off with goods loaded on camels.

hindi: मोल-भाव — शर्तों पर आपसी खींचतान
definition: bargaining over the terms of a deal, each side conceding a little to reach a settlement
example: घंटों की सौदेबाज़ी के बाद दाम तय हुआ। — After hours of bargaining, the price was settled.

hindi: अधिकार-हनन — किसी का जायज़ हक़ मार लेना
definition: depriving a person of what is rightfully theirs, denying an entitlement rather than inflicting some fresh harm on them
example: मज़दूरों की मज़दूरी रोकना हक़तलफ़ी है — Withholding the workers' wages is a denial of their right.

hindi: वैद्य — यूनानी तरीक़े से इलाज करने वाला
definition: a physician of the traditional Greek-Arabic system who treats by temperament and herbs, distinguished from a modern doctor of medicine
example: हकीम साहब ने तीन दिन का परहेज़ बताया। — The traditional physician prescribed three days of dietary restraint.

hindi: आनंद — किसी चीज़ से मिला हुआ मज़ा
definition: the pleasure a person takes from something, usually said with the taking rather than the thing; a personal enjoyment, not a feast
example: उसकी बातों से बहुत हज़ हुआ। — I took great pleasure in what he said.

hindi: करारी हार — बेइज़्ज़त कर देने वाली शिकस्त
definition: a humiliating rout, defeat so complete that disgrace is part of it, far worse than an ordinary loss
example: दुश्मन को हज़ीमत उठानी पड़ी — The enemy had to suffer a rout.

hindi: लोप — लिखे हुए में से कोई शब्द या हिस्सा निकाल देना
definition: the deleting of a word or passage from a written text; removing what was written rather than mending it
example: उस जुमले का हज़्फ़ कर दिया गया। — That sentence was deleted.

hindi: पाचन — खाने का पेट में घुल जाना
definition: the digesting of food in the belly, and figuratively the swallowing of money or an insult without any of it showing
example: भारी खाना आसानी से हज़्म नहीं होता। — Heavy food is not easily digested.

hindi: इज़्ज़त पर हमला — वह काम जिससे किसी की आबरू घटे
definition: an act that publicly injures another's honour; names the assault on dignity itself, not the disgrace that follows it
example: ये बयान मेरी इज़्ज़त की हतक है — This statement is an injury to my honour.

hindi: भेंट — अदब के साथ दिया गया उपहार
definition: a gift offered with respect, given to honour the receiver rather than to relieve any need of his
example: उस्ताद को किताब बतौर हदिया पेश की — The book was presented to the teacher as a respectful gift.

hindi: चारदीवारी वाला बाग़ — घिरा हुआ बग़ीचा
definition: an enclosed garden defined by its boundary wall; the plot as property and design, not as flowers in bloom
example: महल के पीछे एक पुराना हदीक़ा है। — Behind the palace lies an old walled garden.

hindi: उमस — बंद हवा की भारी गर्मी
definition: sultry stillness in which hot air does not move at all, oppressive because of the absence of wind rather than the strength of the sun
example: बारिश से पहले की हब्स नाक़ाबिल-ए-बर्दाश्त थी। — The sultriness before the rain was unbearable.

hindi: सह- / साझा — समानता और साथ बताने वाला उपसर्ग
definition: prefix meaning 'same' or 'shared', naming not the thing but the person who shares it with you; हमसफ़र folds an entire fellow-traveller relationship into one warm noun that English must build from two words
example: शादी के चालीस साल बाद भी वो उसे हमसफ़र ही कहते हैं। — Even forty years after the wedding he still calls her his fellow traveller.

hindi: आलिंगन — बाँहों में समा जाना
definition: the state of being in one another's arms, naming the embrace as a condition the lovers are in rather than an act one performs
example: हम-आग़ोशी में सारी शिकायतें भूल गईं — In that embrace all complaints were forgotten.

hindi: समवयस्क — बराबर उम्र वाला
definition: of the same age as another, marking the shared years that let two people speak without deference
example: हम-उम्र दोस्तों में तकल्लुफ़ नहीं रहता। — Formality does not survive among friends of the same age.

hindi: क़दम मिला कर चलने वाला — बराबर साथ चलने वाला
definition: one who keeps step with you, a companion matching your pace rather than merely sharing the route
example: वह हर मोड़ पर मेरा हम-क़दम रहा — He kept step with me at every turn.

hindi: सुर मिलाने वाला — जो साथ गाए और जिसकी राय भी मिले
definition: one who sings in the same voice as another and by extension agrees with them completely, a companion in tone as well as in opinion
example: इस मामले में मैं आपका हम-नवा हूँ — On this matter I am of one voice with you.

hindi: सहयात्री — सफ़र में साथ चलने वाला
definition: one who travels the same road beside you, a companion of the journey and, in wider use, of a whole life
example: अच्छा हम-सफ़र लंबा रास्ता छोटा कर देता है — A good fellow traveller makes a long road short.

hindi: जन्म-साथी — हर इंसान के साथ पैदा हुआ अदृश्य साया-जोड़ीदार
definition: the unseen double believed born alongside each person and shadowing them for life; a twin spirit, not a spirit that arrives from outside
example: कहते हैं हर आदमी का एक हमज़ाद होता है — They say every person has an unseen twin.

hindi: साढ़ू — जिसकी पत्नी अपनी पत्नी की बहन हो
definition: a man whose wife is one's own wife's sister, making two husbands relatives through their wives; kinship acquired sideways by marriage, not by blood or descent
example: मेरे हमज़ुल्फ़ भी उसी दफ़्तर में हैं — My wife's sister's husband is in the same office.

hindi: सहानुभूति — दूसरे का दुख अपना-सा लगना
definition: sympathy that feels another's pain as if sharing it, the ordinary word for fellow-feeling in trouble; mercy spares a person, this simply suffers with them
example: उसे सिर्फ़ हमदर्दी चाहिए थी, मशवरा नहीं — He wanted sympathy, not advice.

hindi: साथ चलने वाला — जो किसी हिस्से तक साथ रहे
definition: someone travelling along with you, a companion for part of the road rather than for the whole of it
example: एक हमराह मिल गया तो डर कम हुआ — With a companion along the fear lessened.

hindi: गर्भ — पेट में पल रहा बच्चा
definition: a pregnancy, the child carried before birth and the condition of carrying it; the months before, where birth names the moment they end
example: हमल के दौरान उसे सख़्त परहेज़ बताया गया — During the pregnancy she was told to keep a strict diet.

hindi: भगिनी — बहन, आदरपूर्ण शब्द
definition: a sister, in the courteous register used in letters and formal introduction, and as respectful address to an unrelated woman; pairs with the formal word for brother
example: उनकी हमशीरा लाहौर में रहती हैं — His sister lives in Lahore.

hindi: सफ़र का साथी — जो पूरे रास्ते साथ चले
definition: one who shares the whole journey with you, a companion of the road often used for a life partner
