example: अच्छा हमसफ़र मिल जाए तो रास्ता छोटा लगता है — With a good fellow traveller the road feels short.

hindi: पड़ोसी — जिसकी छाया आपकी छाया से मिलती हो
definition: the neighbour whose house adjoins yours, named by shared shade and shared wall rather than by friendship
example: हमारा हमसाया रात-बिरात मदद को हाज़िर रहता है — Our neighbour is there to help at any hour.

hindi: कंधे से तिरछा लटका हुआ — गले में नहीं, बदन पर आड़ा
definition: slung diagonally across the chest from one shoulder; said of a belt or chain worn across the body, not round the neck
example: तलवार का पट्टा उसके सीने पर हमायल था। — The sword belt hung across his chest.

hindi: अपनों की ग़ैरत — अपने लोगों के लिए तड़प उठना
definition: the protective pride that makes a person stand up for their own people, honour felt on a group's behalf rather than for oneself
example: क़ौमी हमीयत ने सबको एक कर दिया — National pride united them all.

hindi: स्तुति — ईश्वर की प्रशंसा में कहा गया वचन
definition: praise directed to God alone for what He is, the register in which scripture and formal speech both open
example: महफ़िल का आग़ाज़ हम्द से हुआ — The gathering opened with praise of God.

hindi: क़ुली — पीठ पर बोझ उठाकर ले जाने वाला मज़दूर
definition: the labourer who carries loads on his own back for a fee; the human end of haulage, where the trade word covers carts and ships too
example: हम्माल ने बोरा उठाकर गाड़ी में रख दिया। — The porter lifted the sack and put it in the cart.

hindi: लाज — भीतर से रोकने वाली शर्म
definition: modesty felt as an inner restraint that stops a person before they overstep, closer to conscience than to the blush of embarrassment
example: हया ने उसे कुछ कहने न दिया — Modesty kept her from saying anything.

hindi: जीवन — जीते रहने की अवस्था
definition: life as the state of being alive across a whole span, used where a span of years is being weighed rather than daily living
example: पूरी हयात उन्होंने पढ़ाने में गुज़ार दी। — He spent his entire life teaching.

hindi: संदेशवाहक — पैदल चिट्ठी और ख़बर पहुँचाने वाला
definition: the runner who carried letters and news on foot between towns, the postal service before there was one
example: हरकारा तीन दिन में ख़त लेकर पहुँचा। — The runner arrived with the letter in three days.

hindi: नुक़सान की भरपाई — अदालत से दिलवाई गई रक़म
definition: damages awarded to the injured party, money paid to cover a loss suffered rather than levied as a fine
example: अदालत ने उसे हरजाना दिलवाया — The court had damages awarded to him.

hindi: अंतःपुर — घर की वह चारदीवारी जो औरतों के लिए महफ़ूज़ हो
definition: the protected inner household of a family's women, sacred and closed to outsiders by custom; carries an air of inviolability the plain women's quarters does not
example: उस दौर में हरम में दाख़िला आम बात न थी — In that era entry into the inner household was not a common thing.

hindi: नाजायज़ कमाई — मना किए रास्तों से पैसा खाना
definition: living on money obtained by forbidden means, dishonest earning judged as sinful rather than prosecuted as a crime
example: हराम-ख़ोरी से जमा किया माल टिकता नहीं — Wealth piled up by dishonest earning never lasts.

hindi: गर्मी — हल्का बुख़ार या भावों की तपन
definition: warmth in the body or in speech, mild enough to mean a slight fever, which makes it the everyday member of this group of heat words
example: बातों में एक अजीब हरारत थी — There was a strange warmth in the conversation.

hindi: प्रतिद्वंद्वी — बराबरी की टक्कर देने वाला
definition: a rival of comparable strength competing for the same prize, an opponent without the hatred that enemy implies
example: दोनों हरीफ़ एक ही मैदान में उतरे — The two rivals entered the same field.

hindi: बारीक रेशमी कपड़ा — नरमी के लिए मशहूर
definition: fine silk cloth, praised in verse for its softness against the skin rather than for any pattern
example: उसका लहजा हरीर की तरह नरम था। — His tone was soft as fine silk.

hindi: अक्षर — वर्णमाला का एक अक्षर, और लांछन का शब्द
definition: a single letter of the written alphabet, and by extension a word of blame set against someone's name
example: उसके किरदार पर कोई हर्फ़ नहीं आया। — Not a mark came upon his character.

hindi: नुक़्स निकालना — कही हुई बात में ऐब ढूँढ़ना
definition: objecting to the exact words someone used, fault-finding aimed at expression rather than at substance
example: वो हर बात पर हर्फ़-गीरी करता है। — He picks at the wording of every statement.

hindi: थका-हारा — भाग-दौड़ में निढाल
definition: worn out by running about and repeated effort in a single day; exhaustion from activity, not decay over years
example: दिन भर दफ़्तर के चक्कर लगा कर वो हलकान हो गया — Running around offices all day left him worn out.

hindi: विधिक शपथ — अदालत के सामने ली गई रस्मी क़सम
definition: the formal sworn oath taken before a court or officer, carrying legal penalty if broken; the official register of the everyday क़सम
example: गवाह ने हलफ़ उठाकर बयान दिया — The witness gave his statement on oath.

hindi: निष्ठा की शपथ — वफ़ादार रहने की क़सम
definition: the sworn oath of loyalty taken to a state or a master, allegiance made formal and public
example: नए वज़ीरों ने हलफ़-ए-वफ़ादारी उठाया। — The new ministers took the oath of loyalty.

hindi: शपथपत्र — काग़ज़ पर लिखी और क़सम से पुष्ट बात
definition: a written statement sworn on oath and filed as evidence; the document form of an oath, admissible without the person speaking aloud
example: अदालत में हलफ़नामा दाख़िल करना होगा — An affidavit will have to be filed in court.

hindi: तबाही भरी मौत — हादसे या हमले में जान जाना
definition: death by violence, accident or disaster rather than by its appointed hour, the word news reports use when counting how many were lost
example: धमाके में दस लोगों की हलाकत हुई — Ten people were killed in the blast.

hindi: लिप्सा — कभी न भरने वाली चाह
definition: greedy craving that grows as it is fed, aimed at bodies, money or power alike, and distinguished from love by having no interest in the other person
example: यह मोहब्बत नहीं, महज़ हवस है — This is not love, only craving.

hindi: थाने की हिरासत — मुक़दमे से पहले रखे जाने की जगह
definition: police custody before trial, where a person is held who has not yet been convicted of anything; short, unsentenced confinement unlike क़ैद
example: रात भर हवालात में रखा गया — He was kept in police custody all night.

hindi: इंद्रियाँ और सुध — आदमी के होश-ओ-हवास
definition: the working senses taken together with presence of mind, what drink or terror takes away; the faculty itself, not its loss
example: इतनी शराब के बाद भी उसके हवास क़ायम थे। — Even after that much wine his senses held.

hindi: हड़बड़ाया हुआ — जिसके होश उड़े हों
definition: having lost command of one's senses and acting in panic, still conscious but useless; describes the person, where the plain word names the faculty
example: हवास-बाख़्ता होकर वो उल्टी तरफ़ भागा। — Out of his wits, he ran the wrong way.

hindi: बड़ा पुश्तैनी मकान — आँगन और कई हिस्सों वाला
definition: a large courtyarded family mansion, a building that stands for a lineage rather than merely housing one household
example: हवेली के दरवाज़े अब सिर्फ़ त्योहारों पर खुलते हैं — The mansion's doors open only at festivals now.

hindi: वैभव — बड़प्पन और ठाठ-बाट
definition: pomp and magnificence in a household or retinue, splendour counted in servants, horses and rooms
example: उनकी हश्मत का ज़माना गुज़र गया — The days of their magnificence are gone.

hindi: महासभा — हिसाब के लिए सबका इकट्ठा होना
definition: the mass gathering of all creation for judgment, and colloquially the wretched state a thing has been reduced to
example: किताबों का यह हश्र किसने किया — Who reduced these books to this state?

hindi: जलन — दूसरे का भला देखकर होने वाली कुढ़न
definition: the sour envy that wants the other to be stripped of what they have, the malicious twin of admiring envy
example: हसद इंसान को भीतर से खा जाता है — Malicious envy eats a person from within.

hindi: कुल-ख़ानदान — घराने की हैसियत और वंश दोनों
definition: family standing and line of descent taken together, what marriage talks weigh before anything about the person
example: उन्होंने हसब-नसब देखे बिना रिश्ता तय नहीं किया। — He did not settle the match without looking at family and descent.

hindi: अधूरी चाह — जो हो न सका उसका बचा हुआ अफ़सोस
definition: a longing that has already failed, kept on afterwards as regret; unlike a wish, it names the wanting once hope for it is gone
example: एक हसरत रह गई कि उनसे आख़िरी बार मिल लेता — One longing stayed behind: to have met him one last time.

hindi: अधिकारी — जिसके हाथ में हुक्म चलाने की ताक़त हो
definition: the officer in whom authority to command and to punish is vested; the ruling official rather than the impartial judge of a dispute
example: हाकिम के सामने सब की ज़बान बंद हो गई — Everyone fell silent before the officer.

hindi: उपस्थित लोग — सभा में मौजूद सुनने वाले
definition: the people present at a gathering, named for their attendance rather than their attention; used to address an audience formally from a stage
example: हाज़िरीन से गुज़ारिश है कि ख़ामोश रहें — The audience is requested to remain silent.

hindi: दुर्घटना — अचानक हो जाने वाला बुरा वाक़िआ
definition: a sudden mishap that befalls people, an accident on the road or in life rather than a planned misfortune
example: रास्ते में एक हादसा हो गया — An accident happened along the way.

hindi: स्मरण-शक्ति — बातें याद रखने की दिमाग़ी क़ुव्वत
definition: the faculty of memory itself, the mind's capacity to retain and return things; what is memorised is the content, this is the vessel holding it
example: उम्र के साथ हाफ़िज़ा कमज़ोर पड़ गया — His memory weakened with age.

hindi: स्वीकृति — मान जाने पर दी गई मंज़ूरी
definition: the assent that closes a request, the spoken agreement rather than the inward willingness behind it
example: बहुत समझाने पर उसने हामी भरी। — After much persuading he gave his assent.

hindi: वर्तमान दशा — इस वक़्त की स्थिति
definition: the present condition of a person or household; asks after state and circumstance, not merely tense
example: घर का हाल पहले से बेहतर है। — Things at home are better than before.

hindi: परिवेश — चाँद के चारों ओर बना रौशनी का घेरा
definition: the ring of light around the moon in a hazy sky, a circle drawn by moisture rather than an arc of colour made by rain
example: चाँद के गिर्द हाला बन गया, शायद बारिश हो। — A halo formed around the moon; perhaps it will rain.

hindi: हाशिये का नोट — पन्ने के किनारे लिखी टिप्पणी
definition: a marginal note written beside a text to gloss a word or add a remark; a commentary is a work in its own right, this lives in the margin of someone else's page
example: पुरानी किताब का हाशिया उस्ताद की तहरीर से भरा था — The old book's margin was filled with the teacher's notes.

hindi: प्रज्ञा — ज्ञान को सही जगह बरतने की सूझ
definition: practical wisdom that knows how and when to apply what it knows; where knowledge is the material, this is the judgment that puts it to use without wasting it
example: उसने बड़ी हिकमत से झगड़ा टाल दिया — He defused the quarrel with great wisdom.

hindi: रणनीति — मक़सद पाने का सोचा-समझा तरीक़ा
definition: the strategy chosen to reach a goal, the reasoning about how rather than the plan's list of steps
example: हिकमत-ए-अमली बदले बिना नतीजा नहीं बदलेगा — The result will not change until the strategy changes.

hindi: घृणा भरी नज़र — किसी को छोटा समझने का भाव
definition: the feeling of contempt itself, looking down on someone as small; the emotion sitting behind an insult rather than the insult
example: उसने हिक़ारत से मेरी तरफ़ देखा — He looked at me with contempt.

hindi: देश-त्याग — हालात से मजबूर होकर वतन छोड़ देना
definition: migration forced by circumstance, leaving one's homeland for good rather than travelling with any intention of coming back
example: उनका पूरा ख़ानदान बँटवारे में हिजरत कर गया — Their whole family migrated away during the partition.

hindi: ओट — शर्म का पर्दा, दूरी बनाए रखने वाली झिझक
definition: the veil of reserve between two people, both the covering itself and the shyness that keeps someone from speaking freely
example: अब भी उनके बीच हिजाब बाक़ी है — A veil of reserve still remains between them.

hindi: वियोग — प्रिय से बिछड़े रहने की अवस्था
definition: separation from the beloved treated as a condition one lives inside, not the single event that caused it
example: हिज्र की रातें काटना सबसे मुश्किल होता है। — The nights of separation are the hardest to get through.

hindi: मार्गदर्शन — अमल करने के लिए दिया गया साफ़ निर्देश
definition: guidance issued with authority, telling someone the correct course rather than merely suggesting it; advice you may decline, this you are expected to follow
example: डॉक्टर की हिदायत के बिना दवा बंद मत करना। — Do not stop the medicine without the doctor's instruction.

hindi: तीव्रता — गर्मी या भावना की तेज़ी
definition: intensity of heat measured as sharpness rather than duration, the degree to which sun, fever, or feeling is fierce
example: जून की हिद्दत में काम करना मुश्किल है। — Working in the intensity of June heat is hard.

hindi: मेहँदी — हाथों और बालों को रंगने वाली पत्ती
definition: the leaf paste used to adorn hands and hair with a red-brown colour; a dye worn as ornament
example: हिना का रंग अभी हथेली पर बाक़ी था। — The henna colour still remained on her palm.

hindi: कंठस्थ करना — पूरा मतन ज़बानी याद कर लेना
definition: the committing of a whole text to memory word for word, an achievement rather than a faculty; retention is the ability, this is the finished feat of learning by heart
example: उसने पूरा दीवान हिफ़्ज़ कर रखा है — He has the entire collection memorised.

hindi: वंचना की टीस — मुराद कभी पूरी न होने का दुख
definition: the deprivation of never once getting what one longed for, disappointment hardened over time into a permanent condition
example: उसकी शायरी हिरमान से भरी है — His poetry is full of lifelong deprivation.

hindi: भय — दिल बैठा देने वाला डर
definition: dread that settles in and weakens a person from inside, unlike a fright which passes when the danger does
example: रात की ख़बर से घर में हिरास फैल गया — The night's news spread dread through the house.

hindi: अभिरक्षा — तफ़्तीश के दौरान पुलिस की क़ैद
definition: custody in which a person is held while a case is still being investigated, before any sentence has been passed
example: मुल्ज़िम अभी पुलिस की हिरासत में है — The accused is still in police custody.

hindi: रक्षा-कवच — बचाव के लिए पढ़ा या पहना जाने वाला हिफ़ाज़ती अमल
definition: a protective formula recited or carried as a shield against harm; the guarding itself, where an amulet is only its container
example: ये दुआ बुज़ुर्ग हिर्ज़ के तौर पर पढ़ते थे — The elders recited this prayer as a shield.

hindi: पेशा — जिस काम से रोज़ी चलती है
definition: the trade a person lives by, learnt and practised for wages; names the occupation as a skilled calling, not the industry that employs it
example: बढ़ईगिरी उसके ख़ानदान का पुराना हिर्फ़ा है। — Carpentry is his family's old trade.

hindi: लालच — कभी न भरने वाली चाह
definition: greed as an appetite that grows by feeding, applied alike to money, power, and reputation
example: हिर्स ने उसे कहीं का नहीं छोड़ा। — Greed left him with nothing.

hindi: अर्धचंद्र — पतला नया चाँद
definition: the thin crescent of the new moon whose sighting begins a month, a shape of the moon rather than the moon in general
example: ईद का हिलाल नज़र आते ही ख़ुशी फैल गई। — Joy spread the moment the Eid crescent was sighted.

hindi: नरमी — बदला ले सकने वाले की चुनी हुई सहनशीलता
definition: gentleness of temper in a person strong enough to retaliate; forbearance chosen deliberately, never mistaken for weakness
example: ताक़त होते हुए हिल्म दिखाना बड़ी बात है — Showing forbearance while holding power is no small thing.

hindi: क़िलेबंदी — चारों तरफ़ से बंद घेरा
definition: a fortified enclosure, the fort seen as a ring of walls that shuts people in or keeps an army out
example: बादशाह ने हिसार में पनाह ली — The king took refuge inside the fortress.

hindi: बहाना — काम टालने के लिए गढ़ी गई वजह
definition: a manufactured pretext used to dodge an obligation, a small deceit aimed at escape rather than at gain
example: हर बार कोई नया हीला निकाल लाता है — Every time he produces some new pretext.

hindi: बहानेबाज़ी — क़ायदे से बचने के रास्ते गढ़ना
definition: the manufacturing of pretexts and technical excuses to slip past a rule, fraud that stays formally within the letter
example: क़ानून की हीला-साज़ी में वह माहिर था — He was expert at contriving loopholes.

hindi: टाल-मटोल — बहाने बनाकर काम लटकाए रखना
definition: stringing someone along with one excuse after another, evasion drawn out over time rather than a single refusal
example: महीनों से हीला-हवाला चल रहा है — The stalling has gone on for months.

hindi: साख-पत्र — लिखित काग़ज़ जिस पर दूर शहर में रक़म मिल जाए
definition: a written order on a trading house by which money handed over in one city is drawn in another; moves value without moving cash
example: व्यापारी ने रक़म हुंडी के ज़रिए भेजी। — The merchant sent the amount through a bill of exchange.

hindi: अधिकार — जो कुछ किसी को क़ानूनन मिलना ही चाहिए
definition: the entitlements a person may demand from the state and from others, claims recognised by statute rather than favours asked for
example: मज़दूरों के हुक़ूक़ काग़ज़ पर तो मौजूद हैं — The workers' rights exist at least on paper.

hindi: शासन — राज करने और हुक्म चलाने का निज़ाम
definition: government as the machinery that rules and enforces, the whole apparatus rather than the single officer's power to decide
example: हुकूमत ने नया क़ानून नाफ़िज़ किया — The government brought a new law into force.

hindi: अधिकारीगण — हुक्म चलाने वाले अफ़सरों का समूह
definition: the officials of a government taken together, the people who actually issue orders, spoken of as one body
example: हुक्काम ने इलाक़े के दौरे का ऐलान कर दिया — The officials announced a tour of the area.

hindi: लिखित आदेश — काग़ज़ पर दर्ज हुक्म
definition: the written decree that records an order, the physical document a party is served with; the paper form of what was spoken as हुक्म
example: हुक्मनामा हाथ में आते ही मकान ख़ाली करना पड़ा — The house had to be vacated the moment the decree arrived.

hindi: उपस्थिति — बड़े के सामने होने की हालत
definition: the presence of one before whom a person stands respectfully; also the form of address used to whoever holds that presence
example: उनके हुज़ूर में यह बात कहने की हिम्मत न हुई — I lacked the courage to say this in his presence.

hindi: उपस्थिति-भाव — मन का पूरी तरह हाज़िर होना
definition: the felt presence of the divine while worshipping, the mind fully arrived instead of wandering; nearness rather than absorption or intoxication
example: नमाज़ में हुज़ूरी हो तो वक़्त का पता नहीं चलता। — With true presence in prayer, one loses track of time.

hindi: गहरा दुख — भीतर बैठी हुई उदासी
definition: settled inward sorrow that quietly colours everything, a grief lived with over years rather than displayed to anyone
example: उसकी आवाज़ में एक पुराना हुज़्न था — There was an old sorrow in his voice.

hindi: भीड़ का रेला — एक जगह जमा हुए लोग
definition: a dense crowd pressing into one place, people massed and stationary rather than flowing along a road
example: बाज़ार में इतना हुजूम था कि क़दम रखना मुश्किल था — The market crowd was so dense that walking was hard.

hindi: बहस-तकरार — अड़ कर की जाने वाली दलीलबाज़ी
definition: argument pressed stubbornly past the point of usefulness, or a proof advanced to silence someone; a reason persuades, this insists
example: हर बात पर हुज्जत मत करो — Do not argue over every single thing.

hindi: कठफोड़वे जैसी कलग़ीदार चिड़िया — सुलैमान का क़ासिद
definition: the hoopoe, the crested bird remembered as Solomon's messenger; it stands for the bird that carries news, not one that sings
example: हुदहुद ख़बर लेकर आया, ऐसा क़िस्सा मशहूर है — The tale goes that the hoopoe came bearing news.

hindi: ऊँट हाँकने का गीत — जिसकी लय पर ऊँट चलते हैं
definition: the chant sung to keep camels moving on a desert march, a song addressed to animals rather than to listeners
example: रेत पर सारबान की हुदी गूँज रही थी — The camel-driver's chant echoed over the sand.

hindi: सीमाएँ — जहाँ तक किसी की हद है
definition: the bounds of a place or an authority, the agreed edge of what falls inside rather than a physical wall
example: यह इलाक़ा नगर की हुदूद से बाहर है — This area lies outside the town's bounds.

hindi: कौशल — हाथ या ज़बान की सधी हुई महारत
definition: a practical skill visible in what a person can actually do, praised in a craftsman as readily as in a singer; an art is a whole field, this is the working ability inside it
example: उसके हाथ में हुनर है, पैसा अपने आप आएगा — He has skill in his hands; money will follow.

hindi: भाग्य का पक्षी — जिसकी छाया बादशाही देती है
definition: the mythical bird whose shadow is said to make a man a king; it names luck arriving from above, not luck earned
example: जिस सर पर हुमा बैठे वही ताजदार है — Whoever the fabled bird alights on becomes the crowned one.

hindi: ज्वर — शरीर का तप उठना
definition: fever as a clinical condition in the physician's vocabulary, the heat of the body treated as the illness under study
example: हुम्मा तीन दिन तक उतरा नहीं। — The fever did not break for three days.

hindi: निषेध और प्रतिष्ठा — जिस रिश्ते या चीज़ का उल्लंघन मना हो
definition: the inviolability of a relation or a house, what makes crossing it forbidden rather than merely rude; sanctity that carries a prohibition, not honour that can be praised
example: रिश्ते की हुरमत का ख़याल रखना चाहिए — One should keep in mind the sanctity of the relation.

hindi: शक्ल-सूरत का ब्योरा — पहचानने के लिए बताया गया चेहरे और डील-डौल का विवरण
definition: a description of someone's face and build detailed enough to identify them; appearance set down for recognition rather than for admiration
example: गुमशुदा लड़के का हुलिया थाने में लिखवा दिया — We gave the missing boy's description at the station.

hindi: सौंदर्य — रूप की खूबसूरती
definition: beauty held as a possession, discussed almost as leverage exercised over whoever is looking
example: हुस्न के साथ थोड़ी अक़्ल भी हो तो बेहतर। — Beauty goes better with a little sense alongside it.

hindi: शुभ नीयत — भलाई की सोच के साथ किया गया मुआमला
definition: good faith in the legal sense, the clean intention with which a party enters an agreement
example: सौदा हुस्न-ए-नीयत के साथ किया गया था। — The deal was entered into in good faith.

hindi: रोबदार भय — किसी की भारी मौजूदगी से पैदा हुआ डर
definition: fear produced by an imposing presence, awe and dread mixed together, felt before a person or a place rather than before an event
example: अदालत की हैबत से उसकी ज़बान लड़खड़ा गई — The awe of the court made his tongue falter.

hindi: विस्मय — ऐसी हैरानी जिसमें अक़्ल ठहर जाए
definition: an astonishment that halts the understanding rather than merely surprising it; wonder at what cannot be grasped, not curiosity
example: उसकी बात सुनकर हैरत हुई — Hearing him left me astonished.

hindi: आश्चर्यजनक — जो देखने वाले को हैरत में डाल दे
definition: of a kind that throws the beholder into astonishment; describes the thing producing wonder, where wonder names the state produced
example: ये एक हैरत-अंगेज़ इत्तिफ़ाक़ था — It was an astonishing coincidence.

hindi: पशुता — इंसान में जानवर वाली प्रवृत्ति
definition: the animal nature inside a person, the appetite side of him set against reason; it names a condition, where savagery names the deed
example: भूख इंसान की हैवानियत जगा देती है — Hunger wakes the animal in a person.

hindi: औक़ात — किसी की माली और समाजी ताक़त
definition: a person's actual standing measured in means and influence, what they can back up rather than what they claim
example: अपनी हैसियत से बढ़कर ख़र्च मत करो — Do not spend beyond your means.

hindi: कुंड — पानी जमा करने का बना हुआ टैंक
definition: a built tank holding still water in a courtyard or mosque, storage where a spring is a source
example: मस्जिद के हौज़ पर लोग वुज़ू करते थे — People performed ablution at the mosque's tank.

hindi: दहशत — दिल बैठा देने वाला अनजाना डर
definition: a gripping dread of something unseen that seizes the heart rather than the mind; terror at the uncanny, not fear of a known danger
example: क़ब्रिस्तान के पास जाते ही हौल तारी हो गया — Dread came over me the moment I neared the graveyard.

hindi: भयानक — जिसे देख या सुनकर दहशत तारी हो जाए
definition: so frightful that dread comes over whoever meets it; describes the thing causing terror, where dread names the feeling itself
example: उसने एक हौलनाक ख़्वाब देखा — He had a terrifying dream.

hindi: साहस — मुश्किल उठाने का दम
definition: the spirit to attempt or withstand something hard; also the encouragement one person deliberately puts into another
example: हार के बाद भी उसका हौसला नहीं टूटा। — Even after losing, his spirit did not break.

hindi: उत्साहवर्धन — किसी का मनोबल बढ़ाना
definition: raising another person's courage by praise or backing, encouragement given before the attempt rather than after
example: उस्ताद की हौसला-अफ़ज़ाई से उसने दोबारा कोशिश की। — The teacher's encouragement made him try again.
